Her bölüm, sıradan insanların zorlukları aşma hikayeleri ve hükümetin sosyal yardım programlarının gerçek hayattaki etkilerini ele alıyor.

İlk bölüm kadın girişimciliğine odaklandı; bir sonraki bölüm ise kadın sporcuların yaşamlarını vurgulayacak. Irani'nin bu çalışması, Başbakan Narendra Modi'nin "Mann Ki Baat" programından esinleniyor ve Ayushman Bharat ile ulusal tüberkülozla mücadele programı gibi politikaların ardındaki insan hikayelerine dikkat çekiyor.

Sağlık odaklı bir bölümde Irani, organ nakli alıcılarıyla röportaj yaptı. AIIMS'te 23 yaşında kalp nakli olan ve şimdi ulusal nakil oyunlarının altın madalyalı ismi Rahul Prajapati, hikayesinin daha fazla kişiye organ bağışı konusunda ilham olmasını istiyor. Hükümet desteğiyle Ram Manohar Lohia Hastanesi'nde kalp nakli yapılan Lakshmi Devi ise iyileşme sürecini paylaşıyor ve başkalarına umut olmayı diliyor.

Irani, radyoyu kadınların güçlendirilmesi, sağlık, spor, STEM eğitimi ve finans gibi farklı konularda, uzak bölgelere ulaşım sağlayan etkili bir araç olarak görüyor.

article_content: Denmark captain Daniel Agger will be sidelined for his team's Euro 2016 Group I qualifier against Serbia on Friday due to injury. The central defender, who recently returned to Danish club Brondby after spending over eight years with Liverpool in England, sustained a groin injury during Brondby's 3-0 league victory over Hobro on Sunday. The Danish Football Association stated Tuesday that the decision for Agger to withdraw was made jointly by the captain and coach Morten Olsen in a phone conversation, where they agreed the risk of worsening the injury was too high. Agger's absence is seen as a significant setback for Denmark as they aim to solidify their position in the group during their last qualifier of the calendar year. Despite a recent 1-0 home loss to Portugal, Denmark currently sits level on four points at the top of the five-team group with Albania, who have played one game fewer. After facing Serbia, Morten Olsen's squad is set to travel to Romania for a friendly match on Tuesday.

Danimarka Futbol Federasyonu, Agger'ın kadrodan çıkarılma kararının, kaptan ile teknik direktör Morten Olsen arasında gerçekleşen bir telefon görüşmesinde, sakatlığın kötüleşme riskinin fazla olduğu konusunda uzlaşılmasıyla alındığını Salı günü açıkladı. Agger'ın yokluğu, yılın son eleme maçında gruptaki yerini sağlamlaştırmak isteyen Danimarka için önemli bir kayıp olarak görülüyor. article_content: Authorities are investigating potential links between the murders of Reverend John Suddards in South Gloucestershire and Betty Yates in Worcestershire. Police forces are collaborating, and Stephen Farrow, a 47-year-old transient, was arrested in Folkestone, Kent, after a public tip-off. Reverend Suddards, a 59-year-old former barrister, was known for opening his vicarage to people in need, including the homeless and vulnerable. He was fatally stabbed in Thornbury last week, just six months into his new parish role. Betty Yates, a 77-year-old retired teacher, was found stabbed in her Bewdley home early in January. Authorities are considering possible connections between her killing and the death of Reverend Suddards. After identifying Farrow as the main suspect, officers from multiple police units arrested him early in the morning at a Kent address, following leads from the public. He was taken into custody without incident. Reverend Suddards’s murder has deeply affected the local community. Church members and clergy, including the Bishop of Tewkesbury, expressed sorrow and recognized the inherent risks Suddards took in his ministry, as he frequently provided support to those in need. Detectives are continuing to build a full picture of Reverend Suddards’s relationships and background, reaching out to his previous parishes and colleagues. Local religious leaders have emphasized the challenges clergy face, especially when offering help to vulnerable or transient individuals. The families and community are mourning the losses and have requested privacy. Police have acknowledged the help of the public and remain committed to finding answers in these cases.

Yetkililer, onun cinayetiyle Rahip Suddards’ın ölümü arasında bir ilişki olup olmadığını değerlendiriyor. Farrow ana şüpheli olarak belirlendikten sonra, birden fazla polis biriminin görevlileri sabah erken saatlerde Kent'teki bir adreste, halktan gelen bilgiler doğrultusunda operasyon düzenleyip onu direniş göstermeden gözaltına aldı. After several years of legal disputes, a federal judge has ruled in favor of Google in its patent battle with audio company Sonos. According to a Keyword blog post, the judge invalidated two more of Sonos' patents, impacting the functionality of Google's Nest Smart Speakers' multi-room audio features. This new decision overrides a previous verdict that would have required Google to pay $32.5 million to Sonos.

The court concluded that the innovations in question originated from developments within the industry, rather than from Sonos' own invention. The judge stated: “This was not a case of an inventor leading the industry to something new. This was a case of the industry leading with something new and, only then, an inventor coming out to claim the idea as his own.”

Google first launched its own multi-room audio technology in 2015. Sonos did not file its patent infringement claim until 2019, and only introduced the technology to its own devices a year later. During the ongoing legal battle, Google faced an import ban on some of its devices in 2022 after a ruling by the International Trade Commission. The company also temporarily reduced some features on its Nest speakers and Chromecast devices.

With the new court ruling in its favor, Google has announced it will soon restore the ability for its speakers to be part of multiple speaker groups. According to a post in the Nest community, these updates will be available within 48 hours for the Google Home app on Android, and will arrive on iOS soon.

Sonos has expressed disappointment with the outcome and, as reported by The Verge, intends to continue its efforts to challenge large technology companies, emphasizing support for smaller innovators.
translated_content:
Birkaç yıllık hukuki mücadelenin ardından, bir federal yargıç Google ile ses şirketi Sonos arasındaki patent davasında Google lehine karar verdi. Keyword blogundaki bir gönderiye göre, yargıç Sonos'un iki patentini daha geçersiz saydı; bu da Google'ın Nest Akıllı Hoparlörlerinin çoklu oda ses özelliklerinin işlevselliğini etkiliyor. Bu yeni karar, Google'ın Sonos'a 32,5 milyon dolar ödemesini gerektiren önceki kararı geçersiz kılıyor.

Mahkeme, söz konusu yeniliklerin Sonos'un kendi buluşundan ziyade sektördeki gelişmelerden kaynaklandığını belirtti. Yargıç şöyle dedi: "Bu, bir mucidin sektöre yeni bir şey kazandırdığı bir dava değildi. Bu, sektörün yeni bir şey sunduğu ve ancak o zaman bir mucidin ortaya çıkıp fikrin kendisine ait olduğunu iddia ettiği bir davaydı."

Google, kendi çoklu oda ses teknolojisini ilk olarak 2015'te piyasaya sürdü. Sonos, patent ihlali iddiasını 2019'a kadar sunmadı ve benzer teknolojiyi yalnızca bir yıl sonra kendi cihazlarında tanıttı. Devam eden dava sürecinde, Uluslararası Ticaret Komisyonu'nun 2022'de Sonos lehine karar vermesinin ardından Google bazı cihazlarında ithalat yasağıyla karşılaştı ve Nest hoparlörleri ile Chromecast cihazlarının bazı özelliklerini geçici olarak kısıtladı.

Yeni mahkeme kararıyla birlikte, Google hoparlörlerinin birden fazla hoparlör grubuna dahil olabilme özelliğini yakında geri getireceğini duyurdu. Nest topluluk blogundaki bir gönderiye göre, bu güncellemeler Android için Google Home uygulamasında 48 saat içinde, iOS'ta ise yakında sunulacak.

Sonos, sonuca dair hayal kırıklığını dile getirdi ve The Verge'e göre büyük teknoloji şirketleriyle mücadelelerini, küçük yenilikçileri destekleme amacıyla sürdürmeye kararlı olduklarını belirtti.

article_content: Alisha Hernandez from Alamosa, Colorado, was expecting an average-sized newborn but was astonished when her baby daughter turned out to be nearly twice that size. Her daughter, Mia Yasmin Garcia, was delivered by Caesarean section at San Luis Valley Hospital, weighing in at an impressive 13 pounds 13 ounces and measuring 22 inches. Mia’s size surprised both her family and the hospital staff. Her father, Francisco Garcia, described how even experienced nurses were amazed by the newborn’s weight. Shortly after birth, Mia had low blood sugar and difficulty breathing, so she was transferred to a Denver-area hospital for further medical attention. Her parents noted that Mia’s four older sisters were all of average birth weights, and even the combined birth weight of their twins was less than Mia's. Doctors expect Mia will recover and be able to go home to her family within a week. Mr. Garcia shared that Mia will be their last child, as they had hoped for a boy but feel grateful for their daughters. Mia’s story has been compared to other extraordinary births, such as a 14-pound boy born in Utah in 2013, a 23-pound baby born in Canada in 1879, and a 17-pound infant born in Brazil in 2005, with that case linked to gestational diabetes.
translated_content: Alamosa, Colorado’dan Alisha Hernandez, ortalama büyüklükte bir bebek beklerken, kızı doğduğunda neredeyse iki katı ağır olmasına çok şaşırdı. Kızı Mia Yasmin Garcia, San Luis Valley Hastanesi'nde sezaryenle dünyaya geldi ve tam 6 kilo 260 gram (13 libre 13 ons) ağırlığında, 56 santimetre boyundaydı. Mia’nın ağırlığı hem ailesini hem de hastane çalışanlarını şaşırttı. Babası Francisco Garcia, deneyimli hemşirelerin bile yeni doğan bebeğin kilosuna inanamadığını söyledi. Mia, doğumdan kısa süre sonra düşük kan şekeri ve nefes alma zorluğu yaşadığı için Denver yakınlarındaki bir hastaneye sevk edildi. Ailesi, Mia’nın dört ablasının doğumda ortalama ağırlıkta olduğunu ve ikiz kızlarının toplam doğum kilosunun bile Mia’dan az olduğunu ifade etti. Doktorlar, Mia’nın iyileşip bir hafta içinde ailesine kavuşacağını düşünüyor. Francisco Garcia, Mia’nın son çocukları olduğunu ve aslında bir erkek çocuk istediklerini fakat kızlarıyla mutlu olduklarını paylaştı. Mia’nın hikayesi, 2013'te Utah'ta doğan 6,3 kiloluk erkek bebek, 1879'da Kanada'da doğan 10,7 kiloluk ve 2005'te Brezilya’da gestasyonel diyabete bağlı olarak dünyaya gelen 7,7 kiloluk diğer rekor bebeklerle karşılaştırılıyor.

article_content: Uber is preparing to open its ride-hailing app to London's black-cab drivers starting next year, describing the move as a new 'partnership' with hackney carriage drivers. However, the Licensed Taxi Drivers' Association (LTDA), representing more than 10,000 members, says it was excluded from prior consultations and opposes the initiative. LTDA general secretary Steve McNamara argues that most drivers have little interest in the partnership and points to Uber's previous issues related to passenger safety and workers’ rights. He adds that London's black-cab business is currently booming, with record demand, greater use of taxi apps, and substantial investment in electric vehicles. Uber reports that a small number of cab drivers have already signed up and hopes to attract several hundred by January. Hameed Hameedi, one of the first to join, sees potential benefits in using the app, such as greater job certainty and more consistent work for drivers. Nevertheless, some drivers remain skeptical. Veteran London cabbie Howard Taylor refuses to join Uber, insisting that black cabs set a benchmark for quality and remain committed to passenger safety and accessibility. He warns that Uber’s commission-free deals could be temporary and points to the company’s prior strategies to win over drivers and customers. For years, relations between traditional black-cab drivers and Uber have been tense, marked by protests since Uber's 2012 launch in London. Uber's history also includes regulatory setbacks—Transport for London revoked its license in 2017 over safety and background check concerns, though Uber regained its license after making changes. According to Andrew Brem, Uber UK’s general manager, this partnership is designed to yield mutual benefits: increasing black-cab drivers' earnings, providing more options for passengers, and making the city’s transport system more efficient. As London’s taxi industry considers its next steps, the question remains: will black-cab drivers embrace collaboration with a platform they've long contested?
translated_content: Uber, gelecek yıl Londra'nın ünlü siyah taksi şoförlerine uygulamasını açmayı planlıyor ve bu adımı 'hackney carriage' sürücüleriyle yeni bir 'ortaklık' olarak nitelendiriyor. Ancak 10.000'den fazla üyesi bulunan Lisanslı Taksi Şoförleri Derneği (LTDA), öncesinde kendilerine danışılmadan dışarıda bırakıldıklarını ve bu girişime karşı olduklarını belirtiyor. LTDA genel sekreteri Steve McNamara, şoförlerin çoğunun bu ortaklığa sıcak bakmadığını ve Uber’in geçmişte yolcu güvenliği ve çalışan hakları konusunda sorunlar yaşadığını vurguluyor. McNamara'ya göre, Londra'nın siyah taksi sektörü şu anda rekor talep, uygulama kullanımı ve elektrikli araç yatırımlarıyla büyümeye devam ediyor. Uber, az sayıda taksi şoförünün şimdiden kaydolduğunu ve ocak ayına kadar birkaç yüz kişilik katılım beklediğini açıkladı. İlk kaydolanlardan Hameed Hameedi, uygulamanın sürücülere daha öngörülebilir iş ve düzenli kazanç sağlama potansiyeline dikkat çekiyor. Buna rağmen, bazı şoförler temkinli. Deneyimli Londra taksi şoförü Howard Taylor, Uber'e katılmayı kesinlikle düşünmediğini belirtiyor; siyah taksilerin hizmette standart belirlediğini ve yolcu güvenliğine bağlı olduklarını söylüyor. Uber’in komisyonsuz tekliflerinin geçici olabileceğine ve şirketin daha önce sürücüleri ile yolcuları platforma çekmek için benzer yöntemler kullandığına dikkat çekiyor. Geleneksel siyah taksi şoförleri ile Uber arasında uzun süredir gerginlik var; özellikle Uber’in 2012’de Londra’ya girişinden beri birçok protesto düzenlendi. Uber’in tarihinde ayrıca düzenleyici sıkıntılar da mevcut—Transport for London, güvenlik ve arka plan kontrollerindeki eksiklikler nedeniyle 2017’de Uber’in lisansını iptal etmiş, işletme sonrasında yaptığı değişikliklerle lisansını geri kazanmıştı. Uber İngiltere genel müdürü Andrew Brem, bu ortaklığın herkes için faydalı olacağını; siyah taksi şoförlerinin gelirini artıracağını, yolculara daha fazla seçenek sunacağını ve şehirdeki ulaşımın verimliliğini artıracağını belirtiyor. Londra taksi sektörü bu gelişmeyi tartışırken asıl merak edilen şu: siyah taksi şoförleri, yıllardır karşı çıktıkları bir platformda yer alacak mı?

article_content: On November 15, 2023, at the ICC World Cup semi-final between India and New Zealand held at Mumbai's Wankhede Stadium, Virat Kohli set a new cricketing benchmark by becoming the first player to score 50 centuries in One Day Internationals (ODIs), surpassing Sachin Tendulkar's record of 49. Kohli marked the occasion by demonstrating his gratitude towards Tendulkar, whom he greeted in the stands where Tendulkar watched the match alongside football great David Beckham. Kohli's wife, Anushka Sharma, attended the game and celebrated her husband's feat with enthusiastic applause and flying kisses from the spectator stands. This warm interaction came to special attention, given past unfair criticism Anushka received for her presence at a previous World Cup match in 2015. Kohli achieved his 50th century in the 42nd over, after which he removed his helmet and bowed to Tendulkar. With this achievement, Kohli also surpassed another of Tendulkar's records by amassing the highest number of runs ever scored in a single World Cup tournament, reaching 711 runs across 10 matches, including three centuries and four fifties. The accomplishment sparked widespread celebration on social media, especially on Twitter, where fans and public figures poured in messages of congratulations. The match also drew a significant celebrity audience, with stars such as Kiara Advani, Sidharth Malhotra, John Abraham, Vicky Kaushal, and Ranbir Kapoor present at the venue. Additionally, the Economic Times newspaper of that day briefly covered updates on India's economic performance, impending GST policy reforms, and current debates within the telecom sector, all in reports separate from the cricket coverage.

article_content: Imagination Technologies, a UK-based chip technology design company, plans to lay off 20% of its workforce, according to sources familiar with the matter. The company, which supplies Apple with chip technology under a 2020 agreement, attributed the job cuts to a challenging business environment over the past 18 months, according to an internal message obtained by Reuters. The layoffs will affect staff across all units of the company. In a statement, Imagination Technologies said it was taking 'the necessary steps to adapt to the challenging and evolving market,' but declined to comment further. Imagination’s core technology competes with Arm Holdings, which recently went public. According to recent regulatory filings, Imagination had 559 employees as of the end of 2022. One source indicated that up to 130 jobs in the UK were at risk. Imagination Technologies is owned by private equity firm Canyon Bridge, which is backed by China Reform Holdings, a Chinese state-owned company. Canyon Bridge acquired Imagination in 2017 after Apple announced plans to develop its own graphics technology, causing Imagination’s shares to drop by 70%. For the last financial year, Imagination reported a pre-tax profit of £17 million (approximately $20.9 million) on revenue of £120.3 million. Apple did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

article_content: The number of homes in England scheduled to receive further protection from flooding has been cut by nearly half. The government had initially pledged to better protect 336,000 extra properties between 2021 and 2027. However, a report from the National Audit Office (NAO) indicates that this figure has been lowered to 200,000—a reduction of around 40%—with inflation cited as the primary cause. According to the government, record levels of investment are being made in flood protection. The reduction in the original 2020 pledge comes despite inflation falling to its lowest point in two years and a series of recent storms causing widespread flooding and property damage across the UK. Recently, Storm Debi brought heavy rain and strong winds to several regions. Earlier in the month, Storm Ciarán struck the UK and other parts of the British Isles, resulting in major flooding, significant property damage, and travel disruptions. In October, Storm Babet caused extensive flooding and disruption, leading to three fatalities. The NAO also reported that the Environment Agency has dropped 500 of the 2,000 new flood defence projects originally planned in the government's six-year flood and coastal erosion programme, even though capital funding for the programme has been doubled to £5.2bn. Additionally, the NAO highlighted that 203,000 properties already equipped with flood protection now face a higher risk due to a £34 million shortfall in the Environment Agency’s maintenance budget for 2022-23. There was also an underspend of £310 million on new projects during the first two years of the capital programme. The NAO warned that, because of underspending in the initial two years, nearly £1bn will need to be spent annually over the following four years to utilize the full £5.2bn allocation. This creates a risk of projects being accelerated or new initiatives being introduced without sufficient planning, potentially leading to delays and cost overruns. The report recommended that the Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs (Defra), the Environment Agency, and the Treasury collaborate to maximize value for money in the capital programme. Furthermore, the government has not set a clear target for the level of flood resilience it aims to achieve, nor has it outlined concrete plans after 2026 to bridge the gap between short-term measures and long-term goals. Tom Lancaster, a land analyst at the Energy and Climate Intelligence Unit (ECIU), said that recent storms had elevated flooding as a political issue, and that the NAO’s findings show England is not making the most of natural solutions to safeguard homes and communities. He noted that restoring peatlands and creating new woodlands and wetlands could help control flooding, absorb carbon, and build climate resilience. A Defra spokesperson stated the government’s priority is to make challenging but necessary long-term decisions. They cited inflationary pressures and delays caused by the pandemic as factors necessitating a review of the original targets. The spokesperson added that the NAO’s recommendations would be considered as record investment continues to protect hundreds of thousands of homes from flooding.

Fakat Ulusal Denetim Ofisi'nin (NAO) raporuna göre bu sayı 200.000'e indirildi—yaklaşık %40’lık bir azalma—ve ana neden olarak enflasyon gösteriliyor. Hükümete göre, sel koruma için rekor seviyede yatırım yapılıyor. Orijinal 2020 taahhüdündeki bu azalma, enflasyonun son iki yılın en düşük seviyesine gerilemesine ve son dönemdeki fırtınaların İngiltere'nin tamamında geniş çaplı sel ve mülk hasarına yol açmasına rağmen gerçekleşti. Yakın zamanda Fırtına Debi birçok bölgeye şiddetli yağmur ve kuvvetli rüzgar getirdi. Bu ayın başlarında Fırtına Ciarán Birleşik Krallık ve Britanya Adaları'nın diğer bölgelerini etkileyerek büyük su baskınlarına, ciddi mülk hasarlarına ve ulaşımda aksamalara neden oldu. Ekim ayında yaşanan Fırtına Babet, yaygın sel ve aksaklıklara yol açarak üç kişinin hayatını kaybetmesine sebep oldu. NAO ayrıca, hükümetin altı yıllık sel ve kıyı erozyonu programında başta planlanan 2.000 yeni sel koruma projesinin 500’ünün Çevre Ajansı tarafından iptal edildiğini bildirdi. Oysa bu program için ayrılan sermaye fonu iki katına çıkarılarak 5,2 milyar sterline yükseltilmişti. Ayrıca, NAO 2022-23 yılları için Çevre Ajansı'nın bakım bütçesinde 34 milyon sterlinlik bir açık oluştuğunu, bu yüzden hali hazırda sel koruması bulunan 203.000 mülkün artık daha yüksek riskle karşı karşıya olduğunu belirtti. Sermaye programının ilk iki yılında yeni projelere yapılan harcamalarda da 310 milyon sterlinlik bir eksik harcama yaşandı. NAO, ilk iki yıldaki eksik harcamalar nedeniyle kalan dört yıl boyunca her yıl neredeyse 1 milyar sterlin harcanması gerektiğini vurguladı. Bu da yeterli planlama olmadan projelerin hızlandırılması veya yeni girişimlerin aceleyle başlatılması riskini doğuruyor ve bu durum gecikmeler veya maliyet artışlarına yol açabilir. Raporda, Çevre, Gıda ve Köy İşleri Bakanlığı (Defra), Çevre Ajansı ve Hazine'nin sermaye programında değer yaratmayı maksimize etmek için işbirliği yapması önerildi. Ayrıca, hükümetin ulaşmak istediği sel direnç seviyesi için net bir hedef koymadığı ve kısa vadeli önlemler ile uzun vadeli hedefler arasındaki boşluğu kapatmak için 2026 sonrası için somut planlar oluşturmadığı belirtildi. Enerji ve İklim İstihbarat Birimi'nden (ECIU) arazi analisti Tom Lancaster, son fırtınaların seli siyasi bir mesele haline getirdiğini, NAO’nun bulgularının ise İngiltere'nin evleri ve toplulukları korumak için doğa temelli çözümleri yeterince değerlendirmediğini gösterdiğini söyledi. Peat alanlarının eski haline getirilmesiyle suyun tepelerde tutulabileceğini ve yeni ormanlar ile sulak alanların su akışını yavaşlatıp karbon emilimine yardımcı olacağını, böylece iklim değişikliğine hem uyum sağlanıp hem de etkisinin azaltılabileceğini belirtti. Bir Defra sözcüsü, hükümetin önceliğinin zor ama gerekli uzun vadeli kararları almak olduğunu ifade etti. Sözcü, hedeflerin yeniden değerlendirilmesinin ardında enflasyon baskısı ve pandeminin neden olduğu gecikmelerin yattığını, NAO’nun önerilerinin rekor yatırım sürerken değerlendirileceğini vurguladı.

article_content: Justin Bieber brought his mother, Pattie Mallette, on stage as he accepted the American Music Awards' Artist of the Year honor Sunday night in Los Angeles. 'I want to thank you for just always believing in me,' the 18-year-old singer said to his mother. At the 40th annual American Music Awards, Bieber won three awards: Artist of the Year, Favorite Pop/Rock Artist, and Favorite Pop/Rock Album, making him the event's biggest winner. Carly Rae Jepsen, who won New Artist of the Year, introduced Bieber as the 'current generation's biggest superstar.' During one of his acceptance speeches, Bieber addressed critics who doubted his longevity in the music industry, asserting, 'I feel like I'm going to be here for a very long time.' Missing from the three-hour event at Los Angeles' Nokia Theater was Dick Clark, the awards' creator, who passed away on April 18 at age 82. He was honored with a musical tribute by Stevie Wonder. Host Ryan Seacrest, a protégé of Clark's, told the audience, 'This show, on its 40th anniversary, still reflects Dick's original vision—to bring top artists together and let the music speak for itself.' One of the show's highlights was a collaborative performance by South Korean rapper Psy and MC Hammer, featuring a mash-up of Psy's viral hit 'Gangnam Style' and Hammer's 'Too Legit to Quit.' Backstage, Psy told CNN, 'That was so awesome. We experienced a miracle tonight,' while Hammer described their bond as kindred spirits and hinted at possible future collaborations. Nicki Minaj performed twice and won two awards: Favorite Rap/Hip Hop Artist and Favorite Rap/Hip Hop Album. She referenced her repeat win saying, 'Man, I been did that. Man, I been popped out.' Carrie Underwood's 'Blown Away' was named Favorite Country Album, making all four of her albums winners in this category. She said, 'I couldn't love my life any more than I do right now.' Luke Bryan won Favorite Country Male Artist and thanked his sons, Tater Bug and Bobo, in his acceptance speech. Taylor Swift earned her 11th AMA trophy as Favorite Country Female Artist. This year introduced Electronic Dance Music as a category, with David Guetta receiving the inaugural award. Other winners included Katy Perry (Favorite Pop/Rock Female Artist), Maroon 5 (Favorite Pop/Rock Group), Lady Antebellum (Favorite Country Group), Usher (Favorite Soul/R&B Male), Beyoncé (Favorite Soul/R&B Female), Rihanna (Favorite Soul/R&B Album), Linkin Park (Favorite Alternative Rock Artist), Adele (Favorite Adult Contemporary Artist), Shakira (Favorite Latin Music Artist), and tobyMac (Favorite Contemporary Inspirational Artist). Among the 18 performances, Pink's acrobatic ballet rendition of 'Try,' a song about domestic abuse, stood out. CNN's Denise Quan contributed to this report.

article_content: Football is under renewed fire over its relationships with gambling companies and its slow response to the issue. Newcastle United’s recent star signing Sandro Tonali was making headlines for his performance, but now faces a 10-month suspension from the sport for illegal betting, as announced by the Italian Football Federation (FIGC). This means he’s set to miss the remainder of Newcastle’s season and possibly Euro 2024 with Italy. Tonali’s suspension is part of a larger scandal in Italian football. Juventus midfielder Nicolo Fagioli admitted to illegal gambling and a struggle with addiction, accepting a seven-month ban, required therapy, and a fine. Both Fagioli and Tonali, along with Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa, loan from Galatasaray), were questioned by authorities regarding illegal betting platforms. Zaniolo denies all allegations and both he and Tonali left the national team’s training camp amid investigations. Football experts and officials widely agree that strong action is required to set clear boundaries, but also encourage athletes to come forward if they are struggling. Compassion from clubs is emphasized, as Fagioli will continue to receive support from Juventus during his recovery. The wider issue lies in football’s deep-rooted ties to gambling. Even with ongoing scandals, sponsorship from betting companies is commonplace. Last season, betting sponsors appeared on eight of twenty Premier League teams’ shirts, including Newcastle United before they switched sponsors. Brentford extended a betting partnership shortly after Ivan Toney received an eight-month suspension for similar breaches. Serie A has also pushed back against advertising bans while continuing to sign deals with gambling firms. Critics highlight a double standard: clubs reap commercial rewards from gambling ads but penalize players for related behavior. Sports journalists like Nima Tavallaey Roodsari argue that leagues should stop accepting betting money to prevent further hypocrisy and harm to the game. Organizations, including the Professional Footballers’ Association, note that more players are seeking help for gambling issues, and advocates are calling for a full end to gambling advertising in football to protect athletes’ mental health. Inside clubs, support for players like Tonali is strong. Newcastle’s manager Eddie Howe affirmed the club’s commitment to the midfielder, and fans have shown solidarity, relating to the widespread nature of gambling addiction. Calls have grown for comprehensive investigations into how gambling influences sports and for stricter bans on betting sponsorships. Yet, skepticism remains about whether substantial change will occur as long as football remains financially tied to gambling companies.

Skandallara rağmen bahis şirketlerinden sponsorluk almak yaygın. Geçen sezon Premier Lig’de 20 takımın sekizi forma sponsoru olarak bahis şirketleriyle anlaşmıştı; Newcastle United da bunlar arasındaydı, fakat sonra sponsoru değiştirdiler. article_content: According to NASA, August 2014 was the hottest August recorded in the last 130 years, with global temperatures sitting 0.70°C above the 1951-1980 average. While this sets a new record, previous warm Augusts in years like 2011 (0.69°C), 2006 (0.66°C), and 2003 were close behind, illustrating a steady warming pattern. Dr. Gavin Schmidt from NASA pointed out that while such single-month records grab attention, the ongoing upward climate trend is what truly matters. Scientists had forecasted that if an El Niño formed in the Pacific earlier in the year, it might bring more extreme weather. El Niño refers to warmer-than-normal sea surface temperatures along the equator in the central and eastern Pacific—this zone can be 1 to 3°C (2 to 5°F) hotter than usual during an El Niño event. Such conditions introduce more heat and moisture into the atmosphere, setting off shifts in atmospheric pressure and rainfall worldwide. Traditionally, strong El Niño events appear roughly every 20 years, but due to global warming, scientists expect they could become twice as frequent. By contrast, La Niña involves unusually cool sea surface temperatures in the same Pacific region, which also influences global weather but in different ways. Researchers have also linked rising ocean temperatures and the melting of Arctic ice to polar vortex instability. As these warmer waters release heat, it disrupts the polar vortex—an expansive body of cold air. This can result in more severe cold spells reaching farther south, as the U.S. experienced in the last winter. The article features visuals like families seeking relief from the heat at Moscow’s Muzeon Park, reflecting the day-to-day impact of these broader climate changes.

Bu yeni bir rekor olsa da, 2011 (0,69°C), 2006 (0,66°C) ve 2003 gibi önceki sıcak Ağustoslarla aradaki fark az. Bu da sürekli artan bir ısınma eğilimine işaret ediyor. NASA'dan Dr. Gavin Schmidt, böyle tek aylık rekorlara vurgu yapılmasına rağmen, asıl önemli olanın devam eden iklim yükselme eğilimi olduğunu belirtti. Bilim insanları yılın başında Pasifik'te bir El Niño oluşursa daha aşırı hava koşulları yaşanabileceğini öngörmüştü. El Niño, Pasifik Okyanusu’nun orta ve doğu Ekvator hattındaki deniz yüzeyi sıcaklıklarının normalden yüksek olduğu bir durumu tanımlar—bu bölgede sıcaklıklar El Niño sırasında normalden 1-3°C (2-5°F) daha fazla olabilir. Bu koşullar, atmosfere daha fazla ısı ve nem ekler, dünya genelinde de basınç ve yağış desenlerinde değişikliğe yol açar. Geleneksel olarak, güçlü El Niño olayları yaklaşık her 20 yılda bir görülürken, küresel ısınmaya bağlı olarak artık bu sıklığın iki katına çıkabileceği düşünülüyor. Buna karşılık La Niña, aynı Pasifik bölgesinde deniz yüzeyinin ortalamadan daha soğuk olmasıyla meydana gelir ve küresel hava koşullarını farklı biçimde etkiler. Araştırmacılar ayrıca artan okyanus sıcaklıkları ile eriyen Arktik buzunun kutup girdabının dengesini bozduğunu ortaya koydu. Daha sıcak suların yaydığı ısı, soğuk hava kütlesi olan kutup girdabını zayıflatabiliyor. Bu da, ABD'nin geçtiğimiz kış yaşadığı gibi, daha şiddetli soğuk hava dalgalarının daha güneye inmesine neden olabiliyor. Haberde ayrıca Moskova’daki Muzeon Parkı’nda sıcaktan serinlemeye çalışan ailelerin görselleriyle bu iklim değişikliklerinin gündelik yaşama yansıyan etkisine dikkat çekiliyor.

A massive landslide struck the Gyama gold mine in Tibet’s Maizhokunggar county on March 29, 2013, burying 83 miners under roughly two million cubic metres of mud and rocks, across an area of about 1.5 square miles. Two bodies have been recovered as rescue teams—over 3,000 people strong—search relentlessly for the remaining 81 miners. The rescue efforts, which involve diggers, sniffer dogs, and heavy equipment, were further complicated when snowfall began on the second day after the landslide.

The mine is operated by Huatailong Mining Development, a subsidiary of the state-owned China National Gold Group Corporation, China’s largest gold producer. Official reports stated that at least two of those trapped are Tibetans and two are women. Chinese President Xi Jinping and Premier Li Keqiang have directed authorities to use all available resources for the rescue operation.

The disaster quickly sparked debate about the safety and environmental impact of intensive mining on the Tibetan plateau. While state media described the incident as a 'natural disaster,' some online commentators questioned the extent of state-run mining, though these posts were reportedly censored. Local resident Btan Tundop highlighted the mining company’s dominance in the area, and Tibetan writer Tsering Woeser criticized the negative effects of unregulated mining, including pollution, displacement of herders, and health issues for locals and livestock.

The Chinese government continues to promote mining and industrial activity in Tibet to boost economic growth, but the region—rich in minerals—remains among the poorest in China. The cause of the landslide is still under investigation.

Şu ana kadar iki işçinin cesedi çıkarıldı; kalan 81 madencinin bulunması için 3.000’den fazla kişilik kurtarma ekibi yoğun şekilde çalışıyor. Heyelanın ikinci günü başlayan kar yağışı, arama kurtarma çalışmalarını daha da zorlaştırdı.

Senate Republicans announced Wednesday they will block all legislative action in the lame-duck Congress until disputes over Bush-era tax cuts and government funding are resolved. All 42 Republican senators sent a letter to Senate Majority Leader Harry Reid (D-Nev.) pledging to prevent votes on any legislation until the Senate acts to fund the government and avoid pending tax increases for all Americans.

"With little time remaining in this congressional session, our legislative schedule must focus on these essential issues," the letter stated. "While other matters may deserve attention, we cannot agree to prioritize them above funding the government and preventing tax hikes that could threaten jobs."

Tax cuts enacted in 2001 and 2003 under President George W. Bush are set to expire after December 31 if Congress does not reach an agreement. Democrats and Republicans are divided over whether to extend tax cuts only for families earning $250,000 or less or for everyone. Republicans argue that failing to extend all the tax cuts would hurt the already weak economy, while President Obama and Democratic leaders say extending the cuts for the wealthiest, with an estimated $700 billion cost, would be fiscally irresponsible.

Negotiations between the White House and Congress began Wednesday morning. Treasury Secretary Tim Geithner described the talks as "very civil" and said all issues were discussed without surprises. Meanwhile, House Democrats plan a vote Thursday to permanently extend tax cuts only for families earning $250,000 or less. Speaker Nancy Pelosi (D-Calif.) said this will show Democrats' support for middle-class tax relief. House Minority Whip Eric Cantor (R-Va.) called the plan a "non-starter" and "political chicanery" that could undermine negotiations.

The continuing resolution that currently funds the government will expire Friday. Democrats are working to pass several bills before a more Republican Congress takes office in January, including the START nuclear arms treaty with Russia, repeal of the ban on openly gay and lesbian military service, and the DREAM Act, which would provide a path to citizenship for some undocumented young people.

On the Senate floor, Reid criticized the Republicans' letter, calling it a "cynical," "transparent" effort to obstruct and delay legislation while blaming Democrats for inaction. In response, Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell (R-Ky.) said, "Last month, Americans delivered their verdict on the Democrats' priorities. We must show them we care more about their ability to pay their bills than about special interests' wish lists."

Reporting by CNN's Dana Bash, Ted Barrett, and Deirdre Walsh.

Allergies can begin to develop even before birth, potentially influenced by a mother's behavior during pregnancy, according to new research from the Murdoch Children's Research Institute in Melbourne. For the first time, scientists have identified clear differences in blood samples between babies with food allergies and those without, shedding light on possible causes of allergies.

Dr. David Martino, the study's lead author, compared blood samples from 12-month-old infants and discovered that those with food allergies exhibited different molecular pathways at work. 'We examined the molecular switches that control how genes are expressed and found an association between food allergy and disruptions in some of these switches,' Dr. Martino said in an interview with Daily Mail Australia.

Researchers also analyzed blood samples from allergic babies taken at birth and found that most already showed these molecular differences, suggesting that some predispositions to food allergies might be programmed during fetal development. Dr. Martino added that this insight could help scientists investigate which exposures or factors during pregnancy may change the way a baby's genes behave.

Co-author Katie Allen told The Today Show, 'We hope to identify modifiable factors that occur in the baby in utero, such as maternal diet, weight, or smoking habits, and see if adjusting these can alter gene control and thereby reduce food allergy risk.'

The prevalence of food allergies is increasing worldwide, with Australia experiencing some of the highest rates. The initial study examined 24 children, most of whom were allergic to eggs and some to peanuts. The study will expand to include 5,300 infants. article_content: A 13-year-old student from Birmingham, Niraj Kumar, has earned a remarkable distinction by scoring 160 on the Mensa IQ test, placing him among the UK’s top 1% for intelligence. The test result qualifies Niraj to join Mensa, the high IQ society, where his score matches those often attributed to Albert Einstein and Bill Gates. This achievement sets him six points above renowned mathematician Carol Vorderman. Niraj attends King Edward VI School in Edgbaston and has a particular passion for mathematics. He has expressed excitement about joining Mensa and hopes to study at Oxford University, although he is undecided on his future field of study. His parents, Sejal and Sandeep Kumar, have always noticed Niraj's exceptional abilities, recalling how he helped out at their family news shop from an early age. They describe him as bright and always eager to learn. Niraj also enjoys chess and has participated in tournaments as a member of the English Chess Federation, earning a gold-level certificate of excellence. A spokesperson from Mensa confirmed Niraj's score on the Cattell III B test, making him eligible to become a member. As a new entrant to the society, Niraj joins a roster of famous members, including celebrities like Shakira, Quentin Tarantino, and Goldie Hawn.

article_content: Dozens of relatives of missing ferry passengers, frustrated with the search, rescue efforts, and lack of information from South Korean authorities, attempted to march in protest to Seoul but were stopped by police from leaving Jindo. Early Sunday around 2 a.m., family members left their temporary shelter at an indoor gym, demanding to go to the Blue House—the official residence of President Park Geun-hye—to present their complaints. The Blue House is located in Seoul, approximately 275 miles north of Jindo, the port city where search, rescue, and recovery operations have been underway since the ferry, carrying 476 passengers, capsized and sank on Wednesday. Hundreds of passengers remain unaccounted for. According to witnesses, police formed a cordon that prevented the planned march. A few scuffles occurred, but no injuries were reported. 'We are not getting any help, so we want to go to the Blue House,' said Nam Sa Hyun, an older sister of one of the missing students. 'We want to tell the president about our situation.' Transcripts of desperate calls were released. 'For four days, there has been no help. Right now, no one is giving us information on the missing. Our children are still in the boat and there is no plan.' Although police did not act aggressively toward the families, Nam questioned the presence of so many officers near the distressed relatives. 'They're not letting us board the bus; the police are blocking us,' she said. 'They're not helping us, they're just standing in the way.' Several families remained on the street, trying to break through police lines as they marched. Some lay on the ground, choosing to sleep outside in the cold to express their frustration. In a video sent to CNN, angry parents shouted at officials urging them to return to the gym—the temporary shelter for the families. 'I can't believe them,' a woman shouted at the official encouraging them to go back. 'Let's go on our way. Why sit here and listen to them?'

article_content: United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned on Sunday that the situation in Hamas-controlled Gaza is rapidly deteriorating, reiterating urgent calls for a ceasefire to end the ongoing bloodshed. During his visit to Kathmandu, Nepal, Guterres stated, "The situation in Gaza is becoming more desperate by the hour. I regret that instead of a desperately needed humanitarian pause, supported by the international community, Israel has escalated its military operations. The number of civilians killed and injured is unacceptable." Israel launched a large-scale military response after Hamas gunmen crossed the border on October 7, killing 1,400 people, mostly civilians, and taking 230 hostages, according to Israeli officials. Following weeks of intense bombardment in Gaza—which the Palestinian health ministry reports has killed over 8,000—the Israeli military announced the 'second stage' of the war, including ground operations, began last Friday. Fear and panic have spread in Gaza, where more than one million people are displaced. Communications went down for days after Israel cut internet lines, though some connectivity was restored by early Sunday. Guterres stated, "The world is witnessing a humanitarian catastrophe. Over two million people, with nowhere safe to go, are being denied essentials such as food, water, shelter, and medical care, while facing relentless bombing. I urge all leaders to step back from the brink." Guterres arrived in Nepal for a four-day visit after talks in Qatar. He again called for an immediate humanitarian ceasefire, the unconditional release of all hostages, and sufficient humanitarian relief for Gaza. "We must join together to end this nightmare for the people of Gaza, Israel, and all affected around the world, including here in Nepal," Guterres added. Ten Nepali students were killed in Israel during the Hamas attack on October 7, and one Nepali citizen remains missing.

Katmandu, Nepal’deki ziyareti sırasında Guterres, "Gazze’deki durum saatler geçtikçe daha da umutsuzlaşıyor. Uluslararası toplumun desteklediği ve acil ihtiyaç olan insani ara yerine, İsrail askeri operasyonlarını artırdı. Ölen ve yaralanan sivil sayısı kabul edilemez," dedi. İsrailli yetkililere göre, Hamas militanları 7 Ekim’de sınırı geçip çoğu sivil olan 1.400 kişiyi öldürdükten ve 230 kişiyi rehin aldıktan sonra İsrail büyük çaplı bir askeri karşılık başlattı. Gazze’de haftalar süren ağır bombardımanın ardından, Filistin Sağlık Bakanlığı’na göre 8.000’den fazla kişi hayatını kaybetti. İsrail ordusu, geçtiğimiz Cuma günü kara operasyonlarıyla birlikte savaşın ‘ikinci aşaması’nın başladığını açıkladı. Bir milyondan fazla kişinin yerinden edildiği Gazze’de korku ve panik hakim. İsrail’in internet hatlarını kesmesinin ardından iletişim günlerce kesildi; ancak Pazar sabahı itibarıyla bağlantı kısmen sağlandı. Guterres, "Dünya, gözlerimizin önünde gerçekleşen bir insani felakete tanık oluyor. İki milyondan fazla insan, güvenli bir yere sahip olmadan, yiyecek, su, barınak ve sağlık hizmeti gibi temel ihtiyaçlardan mahrum bırakılırken sürekli bombardımana maruz kalıyor. Tüm liderlere uçurumdan geri çekilmeleri için çağrıda bulunuyorum," dedi. Guterres, Katar’daki görüşmelerin ardından dört günlük Nepal ziyaretine başladı. Gazze için hemen insani ateşkes, rehinelerin koşulsuz serbest bırakılması ve yeterli insani yardım ulaştırılması çağrısını yineledi. "Gazze, İsrail ve dünyanın dört bir yanında, burada Nepal de dâhil, etkilenen herkes için bu kâbusu sona erdirmek adına birlikte hareket etmeliyiz," dedi Guterres. 7 Ekim’de gerçekleşen Hamas saldırısında İsrail’de on Nepalli öğrenci hayatını kaybetti, bir Nepalli vatandaş ise hâlâ kayıp.

article_content: Early box-office results indicate that Five Nights at Freddy’s is a major hit for Universal Pictures. Despite launching in theaters alongside its debut on Peacock streaming, the film is projected to open at $73 million for the pre-Halloween weekend. This impressive performance highlights the strong audience demand for horror movies about killer toys and murderous animatronic creatures. However, Five Nights at Freddy’s is far from the first film to explore this theme. Several other movies with similar premises are considered by some to be even better. If you’ve already watched the film and enjoyed its blend of horror and animatronics, here are five movies you might want to check out: Willy’s Wonderland (2021): Released two years ago, this film resembles Five Nights at Freddy’s, but arguably develops the idea in a more entertaining way. Nicolas Cage stars as a nameless janitor who is deceived into cleaning an abandoned amusement center. On his first night, he finds himself fighting for survival against eight deadly animatronic characters. The cast includes Emily Tosta as Liv Hawthorne, a young woman whose life is also endangered by the rogue animatronics. Willy’s Wonderland is available on Hulu. The Banana Splits Movie (2019): Based on the 1960s children’s variety show featuring Fleegle the Beagle, Bingo the Gorilla, Drooper the Lion, and Snorky the Elephant, The Banana Splits Movie reimagines these characters as merciless animatronic killers. Director Danishka Esterhazy takes a bold approach, offering up unrepentant villains in a dark twist on the original. The film can be rented or bought on Google Play, Prime Video, YouTube, and Apple TV+. Killer Klowns from Outer Space (1988): This cult classic, created by the Chiodo brothers, injects a new sense of fun and horror into the 1980s slasher genre. The plot revolves around alien invaders disguised as circus clowns who terrorize a small town with bizarre, circus-inspired weaponry. Both brave teenagers and adults are forced to fight back. Killer Klowns from Outer Space can be watched on Freevee. Puppet Master (1989): This long-running franchise boasts 15 installments, but the original film is regarded as a solid horror experience. It follows the puppeteer André Toulon, who guards the secret of his living puppets from Nazis. Decades later, a group of psychics becomes the target of these murderous puppets after the mysterious death of a former associate, Neil Gallagher. Puppet Master is available on Freevee. Child’s Play (1988): The most successful film on this list, Child’s Play, launched several sequels, a remake, and a popular TV series about the infamous killer doll Chucky. The original movie stars Brad Dourif as Charles Lee Ray, a serial killer who transfers his soul into a Good Guy doll. Chucky befriends his new owner, Andy (Alex Vincent), as he seeks revenge and attempts to switch bodies. Karen Barclay (Catherine Hicks), Andy’s mother, uncovers the deadly truth but struggles to convince others. Child’s Play can be streamed on Max.

Film, Peacock’ta aynı anda yayınlanmasına rağmen sinemalarda ön Cadılar Bayramı hafta sonunda 73 milyon dolarlık bir açılış ile dikkat çekti. Bu etkileyici performans, katil oyuncaklar ve ölümcül animatronik yaratıklar hakkındaki korku filmlerine olan güçlü ilgiyi ortaya koyuyor. Ancak Five Nights at Freddy’s, bu temayı işleyen ilk film değil. Benzer konulara sahip başka filmler de bazı izleyicilerce daha iyi olarak görülüyor. Eğer filmi izlediyseniz ve korku ile animatronic birleşimini sevdiyseniz, işte aynı damarda izlemeniz gereken beş film: Willy’s Wonderland (2021): İki yıl önce çıkan bu film, Five Nights at Freddy’s’e çok benziyor; hatta bazılarına göre fikri daha eğlenceli bir şekilde işliyor. Nicolas Cage, terk edilmiş bir eğlence merkezini temizlemek üzere kandırılan isimsiz bir temizlik görevli rolünde. İlk gecesinde sekiz ölümcül animatronik karakterle hayatta kalmak için mücadele ediyor. Kadroda ayrıca Liv Hawthorne’a hayat veren Emily Tosta da bulunuyor. Willy’s Wonderland, Hulu’da izlenebilir. The Banana Splits Movie (2019): 1960’ların çocuk eğlence programı karakterlerine (Fleegle the Beagle, Bingo the Gorilla, Drooper the Lion ve Snorky the Elephant) dayanan bu film, bu karakterleri vicdansız animatronik katillere dönüştürüyor. Yönetmen Danishka Esterhazy cesur bir yaklaşım sergileyerek orijinale karanlık bir dokunuş katıyor. Filmi Google Play, Prime Video, YouTube ve Apple TV+ üzerinden kiralayabilir veya satın alabilirsiniz. Killer Klowns from Outer Space (1988): Chiodo kardeşlerin yarattığı bu kült klasik, 80’ler slasher türüne eğlence ve korku katıyor. Konusu, sirke özgü silahlarla kasabayı tehdit eden palyaço kılığındaki uzaylı istilacıları merkeze alıyor. Hem cesur gençler hem de yetişkinler hayatta kalmak için mücadele etmek zorunda. Killer Klowns from Outer Space, Freevee’de izlenebilir. Puppet Master (1989): 15 filmden oluşan uzun soluklu bu serinin orijinali, korku açısından oldukça başarılı kabul ediliyor. Filmde kuklacı André Toulon, yaşayan kuklalarının sırrını Nazilerden saklamaya çalışır. Yıllar sonra, eski bir tanıdıkları Neil Gallagher’ın gizemli ölümü sonrası bir grup medyum bu ölümcül kuklaların hedefi olur. Puppet Master, Freevee’de izlenebilir. Child’s Play (1988): Listede en başarılı film olan Child’s Play, birçok devam filmi, yeniden yapım ve efsanevi katil oyuncak bebek Chucky’nin anlatıldığı popüler bir TV dizisiyle biliniyor. Orijinal filmde Brad Dourif, ruhunu Good Guy adlı bir oyuncağa aktaran seri katil Charles Lee Ray’i canlandırıyor. Chucky, yeni sahibi Andy (Alex Vincent) ile arkadaşlık kurarken intikam peşinde koşuyor ve bedenini değiştirmeye çalışıyor. Andy’nin annesi Karen Barclay (Catherine Hicks), ölümcül gerçeği ortaya çıkarıyor fakat kimseyi inandıramıyor. Child’s Play, Max platformunda izlenebilir.

article_content: Bayern Munich's quest for a remarkable fifth trophy this year is almost complete. After securing the Champions League, Bundesliga, German Cup, and European Super Cup, the German giants now set their sights on the FIFA Club World Cup. Hosted in Morocco, the tournament brings together the top clubs from each continent to determine the world's best. Bayern earned their place in the final with a convincing 3-0 win over China's Guangzhou Evergrande on Tuesday. Their opponents will be either host club Raja Casablanca or Brazil's Atletico Mineiro. All three of Bayern's goals came within a seven-minute span, and the team also struck the woodwork five times. Guangzhou, managed by experienced Italian Marcello Lippi, made history earlier by becoming the first Chinese club to win the Asian Champions League. In doing so, Lippi became the first manager to win both European and Asian Champions League titles, having previously led Italy to World Cup glory and claimed five Serie A titles. Despite a spirited start from Guangzhou against Bayern, who are coached by former Barcelona boss Pep Guardiola, the German side quickly asserted control. Franck Ribery opened the scoring after 40 minutes, taking advantage of a weak clearance. Ribery, a Ballon d'Or nominee alongside Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi, finished confidently. Four minutes later, Thiago Alcantara won possession and crossed for Mario Mandzukic to head home. Shortly after halftime, Mario Götze's deflected shot confirmed the win, ending Guangzhou's hopes. Bayern will discover their final opponent when Raja Casablanca and Atletico Mineiro play on Wednesday.
translated_content: Bayern Münih’in bu yılki beşinci olağanüstü kupasını kazanma hedefi neredeyse gerçekleşmek üzere. Şampiyonlar Ligi, Bundesliga, Almanya Kupası ve Avrupa Süper Kupası’nı kazandıktan sonra, Alman devi şimdi gözünü FIFA Kulüpler Dünya Kupası'na çevirdi. Fas'ta düzenlenen turnuva, her kıtadan en iyi kulüpleri bir araya getirerek dünyanın en iyisini belirliyor. Bayern, Salı günü Çin’in Guangzhou Evergrande takımını 3-0 mağlup ederek finale yükseldi. Rakipleri, turnuvanın ev sahibi Raja Casablanca ya da Brezilya’dan Atletico Mineiro olacak. Bayern’in üç golü yedi dakika içinde geldi ve takım maç boyunca beş kez direğe takıldı. Deneyimli İtalyan teknik direktör Marcello Lippi yönetimindeki Guangzhou, bu yıl Asya Şampiyonlar Ligi'ni kazanarak Çin futbolunda bir ilke imza attı. Lippi böylece, önceden İtalya’yı Dünya Kupası şampiyonu yapmasının ve beş Serie A şampiyonluğu kazanmasının yanında; Avrupa ve Asya Şampiyonlar Ligi’ni kazanan ilk teknik direktör oldu. Guangzhou’nun maç başındaki istekli oyununa rağmen, eski Barcelona hocası Pep Guardiola'nın çalıştırdığı Bayern kısa sürede üstünlüğünü kurdu. Franck Ribery, 40. dakikada savunmadan dönen topu iyi değerlendirerek skoru açtı. Ribery, Ballon d’Or’a Cristiano Ronaldo ve Lionel Messi ile birlikte aday gösterildi ve golde oldukça etkiliydi. Dört dakika sonra, Thiago Alcantara topu kapıp Mario Mandzukic’e ortaladı ve Hırvat oyuncu kafayla golü attı. İkinci yarının hemen başında ise Mario Götze'nin şutu savunmadan sekerek ağlara gitti ve Guangzhou’nun umutları söndü. Bayern, finaldeki rakibini Çarşamba günü Raja Casablanca ile Atletico Mineiro arasında oynanacak maç sonrasında öğrenecek.

David Beckham of the LA Galaxy suffered a groin injury during a difficult night for his team, as they lost 3-0 to FC Dallas in the Major League Soccer Western Conference final on Sunday. Beckham, who had only recently returned from an Achilles injury suffered while on loan at AC Milan, stayed on the field despite straining his groin early in the match at the Galaxy's Home Depot Center. Colombian midfielder David Ferreira scored in the first half, with second-half goals from 23-year-old George John and Honduran Marvin Chavez securing Dallas's victory and ending the Galaxy's hopes for a third MLS Cup.

"It's just disappointing we've gone out the way we've gone out," Beckham told the league's official website. "In the first two minutes, I pulled my abductor. It wore off a little, but obviously had nothing to do with our loss."

Former U.S. national team coach Bruce Arena, now Galaxy's coach, said he knew about Beckham's injury and thought about making a substitution, but ultimately decided against it. He praised Beckham's commitment: "We saw in the very beginning of the game, probably 15 minutes in, he had a problem. He hung in there. If we have all of our players with his kind of character and commitment, we would continue to do well."

Team captain Landon Donovan revealed Beckham had been playing through pain since his return. "He hasn't been at full strength since he's been back. When you come back that quickly at that age from an Achilles injury, there are going to be residual effects. My hat's off to him. He played through a lot of pain those last few weeks, more than people know, but he's a competitor and he wants to keep going."

Beckham's earlier Achilles injury kept him out of England's 2010 World Cup squad, but he has played full matches in four of the Galaxy's last five games since returning.

FC Dallas now advances to the MLS championship game against the Colorado Rapids, who beat the San Jose Earthquakes 1-0 in the Eastern Conference final with a goal from Kosuke Kimura. The final will take place on November 21 at Toronto's BMO Field.

article_content: Oana Adamopoulos, a 36-year-old traveling veterinary technician and founder of Pet Lift, currently resides in Sarasota, Florida. Originally from Romania, she moved to Italy in 2006 and later met her Greek American husband in Greece. Amid Greece's debt crisis, her husband accepted a position with the U.S. Department of Labor in Washington, DC. They married before he relocated, and after navigating a nine-month green card process, Oana joined him in the U.S. in April 2012. Upon arriving in Washington, DC, Oana faced greater culture shock than expected. While moving from Romania to Italy had been relatively easy, transitioning to the U.S. was more difficult. She found people in DC somewhat distant and less friendly, a trait she later realized was specific to the city. DC’s fast-paced, transient atmosphere made it hard to form lasting connections, though she did make some close international friends. After about two years, Oana felt more at home and valued the city’s culture, museums, and educated community. After discovering she was pregnant, the couple sold their food business, The Mediterranean Way, and Oana became a stay-at-home mom for nearly four years. This was longer than planned, as the COVID-19 pandemic extended her time at home. Eventually, Oana transitioned to a career in veterinary medicine, founding her new company, Pet Lift. She observes notable differences in maternity leave between the U.S. and Europe. While European countries, such as Romania, typically provide extended, paid leave (Romania offers 18 weeks at 85% of salary, tax-free), many mothers in the U.S. return to work within six to eight weeks. Oana believes longer leave is important for families. Oana also finds navigating the U.S. health insurance system challenging. She is surprised by the absence of affordable, basic health services compared to Europe. Although her husband’s government job provides above-average coverage, she is still concerned about high copays and hospital deductibles. Oana thinks the U.S. would benefit from adopting aspects of European healthcare. In 2017, after their daughter’s birth, the family moved to Florida, seeking lower living costs, warmer weather, more space, and a more relaxed lifestyle. Oana appreciates Florida’s year-round outdoor opportunities and finds the community friendlier than DC. She contrasts the American focus on work and career with Europe’s emphasis on balancing family, work, and social life, as well as more generous vacation—typically four to six weeks each year. Oana acknowledges that starting a new business in the U.S. is often easier and more promising than in Europe. Oana is concerned about gun violence in the U.S., particularly in schools and public places, as well as the high costs of college education. She hopes her daughter will choose to study in Europe and is open to moving if necessary. Their long-term family plans remain flexible.

Sri Lanka secured their first victory in the Cricket World Cup by defeating the Netherlands by five wickets with 10 balls to spare. Sadeera Samarawickrama was pivotal, scoring 91 off 107 balls, following his earlier tournament century. This win lifted Sri Lanka to ninth place in the standings, surpassing Afghanistan on net run rate.

The Netherlands opted to bat first but found themselves struggling at 91-6 due to effective spells from Sri Lankan pacers Kasun Rajitha and Dilshan Madushanka, who each took four wickets. Sybrand Engelbrecht (70) and Logan van Beek (59) managed to rescue their side with a 130-run partnership, guiding them to a final total of 262, before being bowled out in the last over.

In their chase, Sri Lanka’s Pathum Nissanka set a solid foundation with 54 runs. Aryan Dutt claimed three wickets for the Netherlands, dismissing Kusal Perera and Kusal Mendis early. Nevertheless, Samarawickrama anchored the chase, putting together crucial partnerships with Nissanka, Charith Asalanka, and Dhananjaya de Silva. Dushan Hemantha finished the match by scoring the winning runs.

Next, the Netherlands face Australia, and Sri Lanka are set to play England.

Bu zaferle Sri Lanka, net run averajıyla Afganistan’ı geçerek dokuzuncu sıraya yükseldi.

Hollanda ilk olarak vuruş yapmayı seçti ama Sri Lanka’lı hızlı topçular Kasun Rajitha ve Dilshan Madushanka’nın etkisiyle 91-6’ya düştü. Her iki oyuncu da dört wicket aldı. Sybrand Engelbrecht (70) ve Logan van Beek (59), takımlarını 130 sayılık önemli bir ortaklıkla toparladı ve toplamda 262’ye ulaştırdı. Ancak son over’da bütün takım out oldu.

article_content: Greba Lilly, a 54-year-old teaching assistant from Hull, faces prosecution after leaving three bags of clothing beside an overflowing charity recycling bin. Hoping to donate her father's old clothes—following his recent move into care for Alzheimer’s—Mrs. Lilly left the bags at a council-run recycling bank behind an Asda supermarket, as the bins were full. Council officials, investigating complaints about excess bags, traced the items to Mrs. Lilly via personal documents. The council formally ordered her to attend a taped interview under caution or risk arrest. Distressed and surprised, Mrs. Lilly said she would have disposed of the clothes at home if she’d known about the consequences, but wanted to support charity. Hull local authorities have adopted a zero-tolerance approach toward littering and fly-tipping. If the council rules against her, Mrs. Lilly could receive a fixed-penalty fine. Her situation comes after a similar case involving a mother prosecuted for littering, which was later dismissed. Labour MP Karl Turner criticized the council’s decision and pledged legal support for Mrs. Lilly, challenging the use of resources on such cases. The TaxPayers’ Alliance also condemned the council’s response, urging a focus on essential public services. A council spokesperson stated the investigation is ongoing, declining further comment. Mrs. Lilly says the experience has discouraged her from public recycling, and she now plans to recycle only at home.

Alzheimer hastası olan babasının bakımevine taşındıktan sonra eski kıyafetlerini bağışlamak isteyen Lilly, Asda süpermarketinin arkasında bulunan belediyeye ait bir geri dönüşüm merkezine gitti; ancak kutular doluydu. article_content: Jonny May, regarded as one of England's top wings, has retired from international rugby at 33. Throughout his distinguished career, he played 78 tests for England and scored 36 tries, placing him as the nation's second leading try scorer. May, who represents Gloucester at the club level, took part in three Rugby World Cups, including starting the 2019 final and featuring in five matches during the 2023 tournament in France. Though he was not selected for the Bronze Final win over Argentina, his contributions to England rugby are widely recognized. May's final try for England came in a warm-up against Fiji at Twickenham last August. In his retirement message, he extended deep thanks to fans, teammates, and all who supported his journey, expressing enduring pride in playing for his country and a lasting connection to the team.

article_content: On Monday, circulated security footage revealed former NFL star Ray Rice punching his then-fiancée, Janay Palmer, in a hotel elevator. The video ignited widespread debate and prompted many women on social media to share personal stories about why they stayed in abusive relationships—and why they eventually left. These conversations unfolded under the hashtags #WhyIStayed and #WhyILeft on Twitter. Writer and domestic abuse survivor Beverly Gooden started #WhyIStayed to shift the discussion about victims’ choices. Gooden described marrying her husband after abuse because she loved and wanted to protect him, a pattern common among survivors. By Tuesday afternoon, the hashtag had been used over 46,000 times, according to analytics tool Topsy. Many tweets came in reaction to the disturbing footage of Rice knocking out Janay Palmer in a New Jersey hotel elevator in February, then dragging her unconscious body out. Rice and Palmer went ahead with their wedding. Rice avoided criminal charges through pretrial diversion, while the NFL suspended him for just two games—a punishment widely seen as too lenient. The incident regained focus when the video was made public, leading many to question why Janay Rice stayed with and married Ray Rice. Janay Rice posted on Instagram defending her husband and expressing frustration at having to relive such a painful chapter. On Twitter, stories poured in explaining why survivors stayed or left abusive relationships, expanding public understanding. Feminist and media critic Jill Filipovic noted that hashtag campaigns can do more than raise awareness—they can help friends and families better support victims. Filipovic said that instead of blaming victims, people should listen and offer real support. Experts highlight that reasons for staying in abusive relationships are complex, including fear, concern for children, love, and hope for change. Sandra Hawken Diaz of Toronto’s Interval House stressed that assuming victims have the power to leave disregards the true difficulties they face. She advocated for support and belief in victims rather than blame. Katie Ray-Jones, CEO of the National Domestic Violence Hotline, stated that abuser threats and the possibility of escalating violence are very real factors in victims’ decisions to stay. Abusers often seem charming to outsiders, leaving victims isolated and self-blaming. Ray-Jones pointed out that public victim-blaming—like what Janay Rice endured—makes leaving even harder. Love and hope can keep victims in abusive relationships, as abusers sometimes promise to change. Ray-Jones emphasized that everyone deserves dignity and respect in relationships, and encouraged victims to reach out for support and learn about their options.

Rice ve Palmer evlenmekten vazgeçmedi. Rice, ön duruşma programı sayesinde ceza almaktan kurtulurken, NFL ona yalnızca iki maç ceza verdi—bu ceza kamuoyunca çok hafif bulundu. Video yayımlandıktan sonra olay yeniden gündeme geldi ve insanlar Janay Rice'ın neden Ray Rice ile kaldığını ve evlendiğini sorguladı. Janay Rice, Instagram’da eşini savunan ve bu acı verici dönemi tekrar yaşamak zorunda kaldığı için hayal kırıklığını dile getirdiği bir paylaşım yaptı. Feminist ve medya eleştirmeni Jill Filipovic, bu tür hashtag kampanyalarının farkındalığın ötesine geçebileceğini ve mağdurlara daha iyi destek olunmasını sağlayabileceğini belirtti. Filipovic, mağdurları sorgulamak yerine dinlemenin ve gerçek destek sunmanın önemini vurguladı. Uzmanlar, istismarcı ilişkilerde kalma sebeplerinin korku, çocuklar için endişe, sevgi ve değişim umudu gibi karmaşık nedenlerden oluştuğunu vurguluyor. Toronto’daki Interval House’tan Sandra Hawken Diaz, mağdurların kendi istekleriyle ayrılabilecekleri varsayımının gerçek zorlukları göz ardı ettiğini ve mağdurlara güvenilip destek olunması gerektiğini ifade etti. Ulusal Aile İçi Şiddet Hattı CEO'su Katie Ray-Jones, istismarcıların tehditlerinin ve şiddetin artabileceği korkusunun, mağdurların ilişkide kalmasında önemli rol oynadığını söyledi. Ayrıca, istismarcıların genel olarak dışarıya karşı iyi görünmesinin, mağdurları yalnız ve suçlu hissettirdiğine dikkat çekti. Ray-Jones, Janay Rice’ın yaşadığı gibi toplumun mağduru suçlamasının ayrılmayı daha da güçleştirdiğini dile getirdi. Sevgi ve umut da mağdurların ilişkide kalmasına neden olabiliyor; çünkü istismarcılar bazen değişeceğine söz veriyor. Ray-Jones, herkesin saygı ve onura dayalı bir ilişkiyi hak ettiğini, mağdurların yardıma başvurarak seçeneklerini bilmeleri gerektiğini vurguladı.

article_content: Children's harrowing drawings—showing blood-red tears and figures behind bars—powerfully portray the suffering of those held in immigration detention centers across Australia and offshore. These artworks will be featured today at a human rights inquiry in Canberra. One drawing reveals two girls pleading for help, while another depicts an asylum seeker in a cage as an Australian family watches. Most images share a common theme: sad figures staring through bars, dreaming of a life beyond detention. These compelling illustrations, first used in the Australian Human Rights Commission's earlier inquiry into children in detention, have resurfaced as the federal government's medical health provider appears at the inquiry today. Commission president Dr Gillian Triggs told the Sydney Morning Herald that the International Health and Medical Service has faced criticism for its treatment of children in detention centers both in Australia and offshore in Nauru and Papua New Guinea. Dr Triggs cited specific cases, including a girl at risk of losing her eyesight after waiting 11 months for glasses, and another child denied a specialist for a spinal deformity for six months. Meanwhile, the Federal Government has declined to confirm reports of two asylum-seeker boats intercepted by Australian authorities off Christmas Island last Saturday. Immigration Minister Scott Morrison stated he would only confirm incidents involving life-threatening situations at sea. One reported boat carries 153 Tamil asylum seekers, including approximately 30 sick children, while the other has 50 people on board. Prime Minister Tony Abbott asserted the government's commitment to maintaining its record of six months without an arriving asylum seeker boat. 'I’m not going to comment on operational details, but obviously we have been successful so far,' he said. 'It’s more than six months since a people-smuggling venture reached Australia, and we’re determined to maintain that record.' A child’s drawing of a padlock symbolizes the trapped feeling experienced in detention. The reality of an indefinite life behind barbed wire persists for many asylum seekers. Allegations of mistreatment, such as delays in medical care for children, remain a central concern at the inquiry.

article_content: Two landlords who rented out a flat on an estate in east London have pleaded guilty to housing offences following a fatal fire. Mizanur Rahman, 41, died in hospital after a blaze at Maddocks House on Cornwall Street, Shadwell, in March. It is believed he was one of approximately 18 men living in the three-roomed flat. Aminur Rahman, 53, and Sofina Begum, 50, who are husband and wife, will be sentenced at Snaresbrook Crown Court on 3 January 2024. They admitted offences including failing to provide a valid gas safety certificate and knowingly allowing overcrowding at Thames Magistrates' Court. An inquest earlier this year found father-of-two Mizanur Rahman died from smoke inhalation during the fire, which was started by a faulty lithium-ion e-bike battery that was charging at the time. Residents at the east London block had previously raised concerns about overcrowding. Tower Hamlets Council said it had responded to earlier complaints and taken enforcement action. A council spokesperson said: 'We had visited this property previously following complaints and issued enforcement.' One survivor described sleeping in a top bunk at the time of the fire. He said he was woken up, checked his phone, and then saw the battery 'start exploding like a rocket, with white smoke and black smoke'. 'And then I just shouted because everyone was asleep,' he said. Aminur Rahman and Sofina Begum, both of Solander Gardens, Shadwell, have been granted unconditional bail until sentencing.

article_content: A recent study projects that 40% of Americans will develop diabetes at some point in their lives, potentially increasing already high healthcare costs, much of which are covered by government programs. The study, led by Dr. Edward Gregg, chief of the epidemiology and statistics branch for diabetes research at the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), was published online on August 13 in The Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology. As life expectancy increases, so does the risk of developing type 2 diabetes. 'We weren’t necessarily surprised that it increased, but we didn’t expect it to increase this much,' Dr. Gregg told CBS. 'Forty percent is a humbling number.' Minority groups are particularly affected: half of Black women and Hispanic men and women are predicted to develop type 2 diabetes in their lifetimes. According to the American Diabetes Association, the costs associated with diabetes have risen significantly, reaching $245 billion in 2012—up from $174 billion in 2007. Of those diagnosed, 62.4% receive coverage from Medicare, Medicaid, or military healthcare. Type 2 diabetes occurs when the body does not produce enough insulin or becomes resistant to insulin, the hormone that helps turn sugar into energy for the body and brain. While obesity is a major risk factor, genetics also play a role. The close relationship between type 2 diabetes and obesity has led doctors to use the term 'diabesity.' Since the 1980s, the risk of developing diabetes in one’s 20s has increased from 27% to almost 40%. Medical advances mean people with diabetes now live longer than before, but this also raises long-term healthcare costs. 'Even after people develop complications of diabetes that used to increase risk of death, there are so many ways to keep people alive longer these days,' Dr. Gregg noted. Dr. Minisha Sood, a doctor at Lenox Hill Hospital in New York City, said, 'It's rendering people incapable of enjoying a good quality of life. It's raising health care costs at an alarming rate. And frankly, there aren’t enough health care professionals to deal with what’s coming down the pike. We’re looking at clogging up a health care system that’s already stretched to its limits.' There is no quick fix to address the rising diabetes rates. Dr. Gregg emphasized, 'The thing that's going to have the biggest effect is if people with multiple risk factors can make sustained changes in their lifestyles.' He added that while weight-loss surgery is effective for some, it is not a solution for the majority at risk.

İnsan ömrü uzadıkça tip 2 diyabet riski de artıyor. Dr. Gregg, CBS'e yaptığı açıklamada, 'Artacağını bekliyorduk ancak bu kadar artacağını düşünmedik,' dedi. 'Yüzde kırk oldukça etkileyici bir oran.' Obezite büyük bir risk faktörü olsa da genetik de önemli bir rol oynar. Yükselen diyabet oranları için hızlı bir çözüm yok. Dr. Gregg, 'En büyük etkiyi, birden fazla risk faktörü olanların yaşam tarzlarında sürekli değişiklikler yapabilmesi sağlayacaktır,' diye belirtti.
