article_content: Every year, more than three million people in the US develop peripheral neuropathy, a condition where nerves outside the brain and spinal cord become damaged. This leads to pain and numbness, and can be caused by a range of issues including diabetes, injuries, inherited diseases, or infections. Scientists at the Salk Institute have uncovered a way to help repair damaged nerves in mice suffering from peripheral neuropathy. Their research focuses on the Mitf protein, which plays a key role in switching specialized Schwann cells—the cells that insulate and repair nerves—into a repair mode when damage occurs. Published in the journal Cell Reports, these discoveries may pave the way for new treatments aimed at improving nerve repair and recovery from peripheral neuropathy. Professor Samuel Pfaff, senior author of the study, explained that his team wanted to understand the mechanisms behind nerve damage response, particularly how Schwann cells are activated after different types of injuries or disorders. They found that the Mitf protein acts as a trigger for Schwann cells, prompting them to repair damaged nerves. Unlike the central nervous system, which includes the brain and spinal cord and cannot regenerate damaged areas, the peripheral nervous system demonstrates a remarkable ability to heal. However, the exact reasons for this capability have remained unclear until now. By studying mouse models of Charcot Marie Tooth (CMT) disease—a hereditary nerve disorder—Pfaff and his team analyzed how Mitf interacts with Schwann cells. Lydia Daboussi, the study’s first author, noted that gene programs activated by Mitf can repair damage even in chronic nerve diseases, and that shutting off these repair programs worsens symptoms. They observed that Mitf normally resides in the Schwann cell's cytoplasm, but after nerve damage, it moves into the cell's nucleus. Once inside, it instructs the cell to initiate repair processes. When the researchers removed Mitf from Schwann cells in mice, the cells could no longer repair nerves, either after an injury or in the CMT disease model. This demonstrates Mitf's essential role in nerve regeneration. Daboussi likened Mitf’s function to a fire extinguisher—always present but only activated in emergencies to start the repair process. Professor Pfaff emphasized the exciting therapeutic potential: by tapping into the repair mechanisms of Schwann cells, it may be possible to treat chronic nerve diseases and perhaps stimulate similar repair in the brain and spinal cord, offering hope for new kinds of therapies.
translated_content: Her yıl Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nde üç milyondan fazla kişi, beyin ve omuriliğin dışında kalan sinirlerin zarar gördüğü periferik nöropati hastalığına yakalanıyor. Bu rahatsızlık ağrı ve his kaybına yol açıyor; diyabet, yaralanmalar, kalıtsal hastalıklar veya enfeksiyonlar gibi birçok nedeni olabiliyor. Salk Enstitüsü'nden bilim insanları, periferik nöropatili farelerde hasarlı sinirlerin onarımına yardımcı olabilecek yeni bir yol buldu. Yaptıkları araştırmalar, sinirleri izole eden ve onaran özel Schwann hücrelerini onarım moduna geçiren Mitf adlı proteinin önemli bir rol oynadığını gösterdi. Cell Reports dergisinde yayımlanan bu bulgular, sinir onarımını hızlandıracak ve periferik nöropatiden iyileşmeyi kolaylaştıracak yeni tedavilere öncülük edebilir. Çalışmanın kıdemli yazarı Profesör Samuel Pfaff, ekibiyle birlikte farklı hasar veya hastalıklarda Schwann hücrelerinin nasıl aktive olduğunu ve sinir hasarına karşı nelerin devreye girdiğini anlamayı amaçladıklarını belirtti. Araştırmada, Mitf proteininin Schwann hücrelerinde bir tetikleyici görevi görüp zarar gören sinirleri onarmaya başladığı ortaya çıktı. Beyin ve omuriliği kapsayan merkezi sinir sistemi zarar gördüğünde yenilenme göstermezken, çevresel sinir sistemi oldukça etkileyici bir iyileşme kapasitesine sahip. Ancak, bunun nedeni şimdiye kadar bilinmiyordu. Pfaff ve ekibi, kalıtsal bir sinir hastalığı olan Charcot Marie Tooth (CMT) hastalığının fare modellerini inceleyerek Mitf’in Schwann hücreleriyle ilişkisini analiz etti. Araştırmanın ilk yazarı Lydia Daboussi, Mitf’in aktive ettiği gen programlarının kronik hastalık durumlarında bile onarımı sağladığını, bu programların kapatıldığında ise hastalık belirtilerinin şiddetlendiğini kaydetti. Araştırmacılar, Mitf’in genellikle Schwann hücresinin stoplazmasında bulunduğunu, ancak sinir hasarı olduğunda hücrenin çekirdeğine taşındığını gördü. Mitf çekirdeğe geçtiğinde hücreye onarım talimatı veriyor. Mitf ortadan kaldırıldığında, ister yaralanma ister CMT hastalığı olsun, Schwann hücreleri sinirleri artık onaramıyor. Bu da Mitf’in sinir yenilenmesinde kilit rol oynadığını kanıtlıyor. Daboussi, Mitf’in işlevini, sadece hasar olduğunda devreye giren bir yangın söndürücüye benzetiyor. Profesör Pfaff, Schwann hücrelerinin onarım mekanizmasının kullanılması sayesinde kronik sinir hastalıklarının tedavisinde ve belki beyin ile omurilikte benzer onarımların başlatılmasında yeni umut ışığı doğduğunu vurguladı.

article_content: Colombian singer Shakira, 46, turned heads on the red carpet in Spain at the Latin Grammy Awards by wearing a dramatic chainmail gown with bold cutouts. Throughout the evening, she showcased a series of striking outfits, including a gold floor-length gown covered in sparkling details, a daring bodysuit, and an elegant black and gold corset dress. At the event, Shakira received seven nominations, including Record of the Year, Song of the Year, and Best Pop Song for her hit collaboration with producer Bizarrap, 'Shakira: Bzrp Music Sessions, Vol. 53.' She took home the Song of the Year and Best Pop Song awards, celebrating on stage alongside Bizarrap. Her sons, Sasha (7) and Milan (9), supported her at the event, sitting in the front row in coordinated cream satin jackets and shorts. They congratulated their mother with embraces and kisses after her win. Footballer Sergio Ramos, formerly a teammate of Shakira’s ex-partner Gerard Pique, presented one of the awards. In her acceptance speech, Shakira thanked her fans for their support during 'difficult moments.' After 11 years together, Shakira and Pique announced their separation last summer. Pique’s subsequent relationship with Clara Chia Marti has drawn media attention. Following her move from Barcelona to Miami with her children, Shakira said her new home base has made artist collaborations, particularly with those based in the US, easier and has benefited her career. Shakira’s recent song 'The Boss' is believed by many to allude to aspects of her former relationship with Pique, reflecting the personal and emotional challenges she has faced. She expressed heartfelt gratitude to her Spanish audience, noting, 'You have supported me through good times and hard ones.'

Sanatçı, İspanyol hayranlarına, 'İyi günde de, zor zamanda da yanımda oldunuz,' diyerek içten teşekkür etti.

article_content: Tammy Murphy, the first lady of New Jersey, has officially launched her campaign for the Democratic nomination for the U.S. Senate in the upcoming election. If elected, she would make history as the first woman from New Jersey to serve in the Senate. The Democratic primary already includes U.S. Representative Andy Kim and may feature incumbent Senator Bob Menendez, who is currently facing federal bribery charges and has lost significant support within his party, though he has not ruled out running again. In a four-minute video announcing her candidacy, Murphy stated, 'We need a senator who will work every single day to lower the cost of living, protect abortion rights, end the gun violence epidemic, and defend our democracy.' Murphy, 58, frequently appears at public events alongside her husband, Governor Phil Murphy, and has made maternal and infant health, as well as environmental issues, the cornerstones of her advocacy. She emphasized these priorities in her campaign announcement. A native of Virginia and a graduate of the University of Virginia, Murphy previously worked at Goldman Sachs, where she met Phil Murphy. The couple settled in New Jersey and have four children. Democrats made gains in the state's Assembly in this year's legislative elections, potentially boosting county-level support for Murphy, who campaigned with the governor to strengthen their party's majority. County party endorsements play a key role in New Jersey's political landscape. Debbie Walsh, director of the Center for American Women and Politics at Rutgers University, noted that while the ballot system can be a hurdle for newcomers, Murphy's position may enable her to use it to achieve a breakthrough for women in the Senate. Patricia Campos-Medina, political activist and labor leader, is also considering a Democratic run and highlighted concerns about the loss of Latino representation if Menendez does not return. She also intends to champion workers' and women's reproductive rights. On the Republican side, Mendham Mayor Christine Serrano Glassner is running for the Senate seat. In a statement, she criticized Murphy's candidacy as an example of 'cronyism' in Democratic politics. New Jersey's primary is scheduled for June 4. Murphy is well known in state political circles. Prior to the governor's first campaign in 2017, she helped establish a think tank to showcase policy ideas. She also serves as honorary chair of the New Jersey Council on the Green Economy and founded Nurture NJ, aiming to improve maternal and infant health and reduce maternal mortality by 50% by 2026. Once a Republican, Murphy grew up in a conservative area of Virginia and previously donated to the Republican Party before becoming a Democrat ahead of her husband's gubernatorial run. Murphy was named in a gender discrimination lawsuit by state troopers assigned to the governor's security detail, alleging she denied a trooper use of a property space to pump breast milk. Murphy denied the allegations, calling them 'outrageous and categorically false.' Senator Menendez has pleaded not guilty to federal bribery charges, with prosecutors alleging he and his wife, Nadine Menendez, accepted bribes from New Jersey businessmen in exchange for favors over five years. He is also accused of acting as an unregistered agent for Egypt. Menendez has not announced whether he will seek re-election but has stated he is 'not going anywhere.' In a statement, Menendez criticized Murphy for her prior affiliation with the Republican Party and claimed she would have to answer for her husband’s administration. Menendez emphasized his own record, stating, 'I'll gladly put my record of success on behalf of the people of New Jersey against anyone.' Menendez was first appointed to the Senate in 2006 and has been elected three times since. His indictment has led to a steep decline in Democratic support within New Jersey. Andy Kim, a three-term representative from New Jersey's 3rd District and the state's first Asian American member of Congress, announced his Senate candidacy a day after Menendez was charged, stating that the state deserves better leadership. He underscored the need for a strong candidate to prevent Republicans from reclaiming the Senate.

Seçilirse, Senato'ya New Jersey'den giren ilk kadın olacak. Demokrat Parti ön seçimlerinde şu anda Temsilci Andy Kim yer alıyor ve federal rüşvet suçlamaları ile partide önemli ölçüde destek kaybeden mevcut Senatör Bob Menendez de aday olabilir. Menendez yeniden aday olabileceğini henüz netleştirmedi. Adaylığını duyurduğu dört dakikalık videoda Murphy, 'Yaşam maliyetini düşürmek, kürtaj hakkını korumak, silahlı şiddet salgınına son vermek ve demokrasimizi savunmak için her gün çalışacak bir senatöre ihtiyacımız var' dedi. 58 yaşındaki Murphy, sık sık eşi Vali Phil Murphy ile beraber kamu etkinliklerinde yer alıyor ve özellikle annelik ve bebek sağlığıyla çevre konularını öncelikleri olarak vurguluyor. Virginia doğumlu ve Virginia Üniversitesi mezunu olan Murphy, daha önce Goldman Sachs'ta çalıştı ve eşi Phil Murphy ile orada tanıştı. Çift, New Jersey'ye yerleşti ve dört çocuk sahibi. Demokratlar, bu yılki yasama seçimlerinde eyalet meclisinde sandalye sayısını artırdı; bu da partinin çoğunluğunu güçlendirmek için valiyle birlikte kampanya yapan Murphy'ye il düzeyinde destek sağlayabilir. İl parti destekleri, New Jersey siyasi sisteminde kritik bir rol oynuyor. Rutgers Üniversitesi Amerikan Kadınları ve Politika Merkezi Direktörü Debbie Walsh, oy pusulası sisteminin yeni adaylar için zorluk oluşturabildiğini fakat Murphy'nin mevcut konumuyla Senato'da kadınlar için bir dönüm noktası yaratabileceğini belirtti. Siyasi aktivist ve emekçi lider Patricia Campos-Medina da Demokrat adaylığı düşünüyor ve Menendez’in dönmemesi halinde Senato’da Latin kökenli temsilin kaybolmasından endişe duyulduğunu vurguladı. Ayrıca işçiler ve kadınların üreme hakları için mücadele edeceğini bildirdi. Cumhuriyetçi cephede ise Mendham Belediye Başkanı Christine Serrano Glassner, Senato koltuğu için aday. Glassner, Murphy’nin adaylığını Demokrat siyasette 'kayırmacılık' olarak eleştirdi. New Jersey’de ön seçimler 4 Haziran’da yapılacak. Murphy, eyaletin siyasi çevrelerinde iyi tanınıyor. Vali'nin ilk seçim kampanyasından önce politika fikirlerini öne çıkarmak için bir düşünce kuruluşunun kurulmasına yardımcı oldu. New Jersey Yeşil Ekonomi Konseyi'nin onursal başkanlığını yürütüyor ve 2026 yılına kadar anne ölüm oranını %50 azaltmayı hedefleyen Nurture NJ girişimini başlattı. Eskiden bir Cumhuriyetçi olan Murphy, Virginia'nın muhafazakâr bir bölgesinde büyüdü ve valinin adaylığı öncesi Cumhuriyetçi Parti'ye bağışlarda bulundu. Sonrasında Demokrat oldu. Murphy, valinin güvenlik ekibinde görevli bazı eyalet polislerinin açtığı cinsiyet ayrımcılığı davasında adı geçti; iddiaya göre Murphy, bir polise mülklerindeki bir alanı anne sütü sağmak için kullanma izni vermedi. Murphy bu iddiaları 'asılsız ve bütünüyle gerçek dışı' olarak reddetti. Senatör Menendez, federal rüşvet suçlamalarına karşı suçsuz olduğunu belirtti. Savcılar, Menendez ve eşi Nadine Menendez'in beş yılda New Jerseyli iş adamlarından rüşvet aldığını ve Mısır adına kayıt dışı ajanlık yapmakla suçlandığını iddia ediyor. Menendez tekrar aday olup olmayacağını açıklamadı ama 'hiçbir yere gitmeyeceğim' dedi. Menendez, Murphy’nin geçmişte Cumhuriyetçi olmasını eleştirerek, eşinin yönetiminin politikalarını savunmak zorunda kalacağını söyledi. Kendi başarılarını vurgulayan Menendez, 'New Jersey halkı için başarılarımı herkesle kıyaslamaktan mutluluk duyarım,' dedi. Menendez 2006’da Senatör olarak atandı ve o zamandan beri üç kez seçildi. Hakkındaki iddianame, eyaletteki Demokrat desteğin hızla düşmesine yol açtı. Andy Kim, New Jersey'nin 3. Bölgesi’nden üç dönemdir temsilci ve eyalet tarihindeki ilk Asyalı Amerikalı Kongre üyesi. Menendez’in suçlamalarından bir gün sonra Senato adaylığını açıklayan Kim, eyaletin daha iyi bir liderliği hak ettiğini belirtti ve Cumhuriyetçilerin Senato’yu geri almaması için güçlü bir aday gerektiğini vurguladı.

article_content: Zach Sobiech, 18, passed away on Monday morning, surrounded by his family and friends. In recent weeks, donations to Zach’s cause, the Children’s Cancer Research Fund, surged, as did downloads of his song, 'Clouds,' which surpassed 2.9 million views on YouTube at the time of his passing. Zach’s family expressed their gratitude in a statement: 'We’d like to thank those people who listened with their hearts and helped Zach bring his message and his music to the world.' Diagnosed at age 14 with osteosarcoma, a type of bone cancer primarily affecting children, Zach faced a tough prognosis. Last May, after exhausting treatment options, doctors told him he had a year to live. Following his diagnosis, Zach began writing music. His mother, Laura, discovered his first song, 'Clouds,' while cleaning and realized it was a heartfelt expression for himself and their family. Zach went on to write many more songs. 'Clouds' quickly went viral after being posted to YouTube, and recently, celebrities joined together to honor Zach by lip syncing to his song. Among them were Jason Mraz, Anna Faris, Rainn Wilson, Bryan Cranston, Rachel Bilson, Ashley Tisdale, Colbie Caillat, the Lumineers, and Sarah Silverman, each lending their support and voices in tribute. The group video was organized by Rainn Wilson and director Justin Baldoni, who produced a short documentary about Zach for his poignant online series, 'My Last Days,' featured on the SoulPancake YouTube channel. Baldoni recalled: 'Visiting Zach in Minnesota was one of the greatest experiences of my life. He chose happiness despite difficult circumstances—he’s an old soul who inspires everyone he meets. You leave thinking: I want to be a better person.' In the documentary, Zach declares: 'You don’t have to find out you’re dying to start living.' He describes living on the extremes—having really good days and really bad ones instead of remaining in life’s comfortable middle. In his final days, Zach often slept but sometimes gathered enough energy to play his guitar. His mom reminisced about a powerful family trip to Europe, likening the past three and a half years to that intense and unforgettable journey. Despite their grief, they focus on gratitude for the time they shared. Laura reflected, 'That may be the lesson here: wherever you are in life, look at what you have and be grateful. Zach was always so good at that—recognizing the good and being thankful. He taught all of us.' A YouTube commenter, Taylor Engel, wrote: 'Well, you got a 6-foot, 220-pound man sobbing his face off here. Prayers and thoughts with you, Zach…I hope someday I can be half the man you’ve become.' Many shared similar feelings, grateful that Zach’s light touched their lives, however briefly, as he sang: 'And maybe someday I’ll see you again. We’ll float up in the clouds and we’ll never see the end…'
translated_content: 18 yaşındaki Zach Sobiech, Pazartesi sabahı ailesi ve arkadaşlarının yanında hayatını kaybetti. Son haftalarda Zach’in desteklediği Çocuk Kanseri Araştırma Fonu’na yapılan bağışlar ve onun 'Clouds' adlı şarkısının indirme sayısı büyük ölçüde arttı. Ölümü sırasında 'Clouds', YouTube’da 2,9 milyonun üzerinde izlenmeye ulaştı. Zach’in ailesi şu açıklamayı yaptı: 'Yürekten dinleyip Zach’in mesajını ve müziğini dünyaya yaymasına yardımcı olan herkese teşekkür ederiz.' Zach, 14 yaşında çocuklarda sıkça görülen bir kemik kanseri türü olan osteosarkom teşhisi aldığında zorlu bir süreçle karşılaştı. Geçen Mayıs, tedavi imkanları tükendiğinde, doktorlar ona bir yıl ömrü kaldığını söyledi. Bu teşhisin ardından Zach, müzik yazmaya başladı. Annesi Laura, temizlik yaparken Zach’in ilk yazdığı şarkı olan 'Clouds'u bulduğunu ve bunun aile için ne kadar özel olduğunu fark etti. Zach, sonraki yıllarda birçok şarkı daha yazdı. 'Clouds', YouTube’a yüklendikten sonra hızla yayıldı. Son zamanlarda birçok ünlü isim, Zach’i desteklemek amacıyla şarkısına lip sync yaparak bir projede buluştu; Jason Mraz, Anna Faris, Rainn Wilson, Bryan Cranston, Rachel Bilson, Ashley Tisdale, Colbie Caillat, The Lumineers ve Sarah Silverman bu isimler arasında yer aldı. Bu video, Rainn Wilson ve yönetmen Justin Baldoni tarafından organize edildi. Baldoni, Zach’in hayatını konu alan etkileyici bir belgeseli, Wilson’un SoulPancake YouTube kanalında yayınlanan 'My Last Days' isimli serisi için çekti. Baldoni o anları şöyle anlattı: 'Minnesota’da Zach’le tanışmak, hayatımın en güzel deneyimlerinden biriydi. Zor şartlara rağmen mutlu olmayı seçen, karşılaştığı herkese ilham veren eski bir ruh. Oradan ayrılırken insan daha iyi bir insan olmak istiyor.' Belgeselde Zach şöyle diyor: 'Öleceğini öğrenmeden de yaşamaya başlayabilirsin.' Hayatını uçlarda yaşadığını, sıradanlıktan uzak, çok iyi ve çok kötü günler geçirdiğini anlatıyor. Zach son günlerinde çoğunlukla uyudu ancak bazen gitarını çalacak kadar gücü vardı. Annesi, ailece yaptıkları Avrupa seyahatini ve geçen üç buçuk yılı bu yoğun ve unutulmaz yolculuğa benzeterek, tüm acıya rağmen paylaştıkları zaman için minnettar olduklarını söyledi. Laura şöyle dedi: 'Belki de buradaki mesaj şu olmalı: Hayatın neresinde olursan ol, elindekilere bak ve minnettar ol. Zach, iyiliği fark etmekte ve şükretmekte çok iyiydi. Bize bunu öğretti.' YouTube yorumcusu Taylor Engel şöyle yazdı: 'Burada 1.80 boyunda, 100 kiloluk bir adam ağlıyor. Dualarım ve düşüncelerim seninle Zach… Umarım bir gün senin kadar iyi bir insan olabilirim.' Birçok kişi aynı duyguları yaşadı; Zach’in hayatımıza kattığı ışıktan, kısa sürede de olsa, büyük minnet duyduk. Şarkısında dediği gibi: 'Belki bir gün yeniden görüşürüz. Bulutlarda süzülürüz ve asla sonu gelmez…'

article_content: Taylor Lianne Chandler has revealed that Olympic swimmer Michael Phelps connected with her via Tinder, and that they were romantically involved before eventually ending the relationship. Chandler, now 41, says that Phelps, who is 12 years younger, first contacted her on the dating platform before entering rehab in September. Initially, Chandler was unsure if Phelps’s account was genuine, but their connection became serious after they met in person. In an interview with The Daily Beast, Chandler described regular communication, visits to Phelps’s home, and a close bond. She has also openly shared on social media that she was born intersex — with male genitalia but no testicles, a uterus, and no ovaries — and discussed how the relationship made her feel accepted and valued. Chandler clarified that the reason for the breakup is for Phelps to disclose if he wishes. Chandler recounted her early medical history, including starting testosterone blockers in her teens and undergoing corrective surgery in her early twenties. She described legal name and identity changes, emancipation from her family, and legal troubles in her late teens, including a period in jail during which she faced hardship related to her identity. Now an advocate for gender rights, Chandler continues to speak out about her experiences to raise awareness. Michael Phelps, who remains the most decorated Olympian with 22 medals, is currently serving a six-month suspension from swimming following a DUI arrest and recently completed a rehabilitation program.

Başta Phelps’in hesabının gerçekliğinden emin olmayan Chandler, yüz yüze görüştüklerinde aralarındaki bağın güçlendiğini belirtti. The Daily Beast'e verdiği röportajda Chandler, düzenli iletişimlerinden, Phelps’in evine yaptığı ziyaretlerden ve aralarındaki yakın ilişkiden bahsetti. Ayrıca sosyal medyada interseks olarak doğduğunu—erkek genital organlarına sahip olup testisleri bulunmayan, rahmi olan ve yumurtalıkları olmayan biri olduğunu—ve ilişkilerinin kendini kabul edilmiş ve değerli hissettirdiğini paylaştı. Chandler, ayrılma sebeplerinin Phelps tarafından açıklanmasının daha doğru olacağını ifade etti. Chandler, ergenlik döneminde testosteron engelleyici kullanmaya başladığını ve yirmili yaşlarının başında düzeltici ameliyat geçirdiğini anlattı. Aynı zamanda ergenliğinde yasal isim ve kimlik değişikliği yaptığını, ailesinden ayrıldığını ve genç yaşta bazı yasal sorunlar yaşadığını, hapiste kimliğiyle ilgili zorluklar yaşadığını aktardı. Günümüzde bir cinsiyet hakları savunucusu olan Chandler, deneyimlerini paylaşarak farkındalığı artırmaya devam ediyor. Öte yandan tüm zamanların en çok madalya kazanan olimpiyat sporcusu Michael Phelps, Baltimore’daki DUI tutuklamasının ardından altı aylık yüzme cezası almış ve kısa süre önce rehabilitasyon programını tamamlamış durumda.

article_content:
Poppy cultivation and opium production in Afghanistan have plummeted by more than 90% since the Taliban banned the crop in April 2022, according to a report issued Sunday by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC). The area dedicated to poppy farming dropped sharply—from 233,000 hectares at the close of 2022 to just 10,800 hectares in 2023—a 95% decrease. Opium output followed the same trend, falling from 6,200 tonnes to 333 tonnes over the same period. This sharp decline has devastated the livelihoods of hundreds of thousands of Afghan farmers and laborers, leading to a loss of approximately $1 billion in revenue.

While UN officials acknowledge that these reductions could significantly impact the global illicit opium trade, they also warn of serious risks to Afghanistan’s vulnerable population. Ghada Waly, executive director of UNODC, described this as an opportunity to fight the illegal opium market and its harmful effects. However, she emphasized the urgent need to address the consequences for those who depended on opium cultivation for their survival. 

Since the Taliban resurgence in August 2021—following the withdrawal of US-led forces—Afghanistan has faced severe humanitarian and economic crises, compounded by international sanctions and diplomatic isolation. The country was previously responsible for over 80% of the world’s opium supply and was a major heroin source for Europe and Asia. The Taliban once generated significant income from the drug trade, with US officials estimating $400 million in earnings between 2018 and 2019. After returning to power, the group pledged to eliminate poppy cultivation, formally banning it in April 2022.

The ban has severely affected rural communities, worsening an already dire humanitarian situation. Afghanistan continues to struggle with drought, conflict, and natural disasters, with more than 40% of Afghans facing acute food insecurity and over half relying on humanitarian aid. UNODC’s Ghada Waly stressed the need for robust investment in sustainable livelihoods to provide alternatives to opium cultivation.

The UNODC report cautions that the financial shock to the opiate supply chain could drive Afghans toward other illicit trades, including smuggling of arms, people, or synthetic drugs. Notably, Afghanistan has become the world’s fastest-growing producer of methamphetamine, with seizures rising as poppy farming declines.

article_content: Former Manchester United star Eric Cantona was arrested and cautioned in London on Wednesday on suspicion of common assault, according to reports from Britain's Press Association. The Metropolitan Police in London confirmed that a man in his mid-40s was arrested and then cautioned, but they did not release his name. The police said they were called to the incident at around 1 p.m. According to police, the alleged victim, also a man, did not require medical treatment. CNN was unable to reach Cantona’s representatives for immediate comment. In the UK, police may issue cautions to people for minor offenses. If someone accepts a caution, they admit to the offense and are released. A caution is not a criminal conviction but can be used as evidence of character in future legal proceedings. Cantona, 47, retired from football at the age of 30 but left a lasting mark at Manchester United. In 2011, supporters voted him the club’s player of the century.

article_content: To advance your career—whether you're aiming for a promotion, a salary increase, or a lateral move—you need to plan strategically and engage proactively with your manager. Success is rarely accidental; instead, it results from dedicated effort and collaboration. Before scheduling your important career conversation with your manager, keep these five critical steps in mind:  1. Identify What You Love Reflect on your passions, strengths, and the activities you enjoy most both at work and outside of it. Consider which aspects of your current role are most fulfilling, and observe colleagues whose roles interest you. Ask them about their experiences to gain valuable insights. Since career moves—whether internal or external—often require new skills, ensure your choice aligns with your interests and long-term satisfaction.  2. Align with Company Goals This is a great time to discuss how your career objectives can support your company's strategic direction, especially as organizations establish goals for the coming year. When preparing for your conversation, connect your strengths to company initiatives, consider industry trends like AI or hybrid work models, and demonstrate how you can contribute to your company's position in the market. Use specific examples of your past achievements to strengthen your case for advancement.  3. Set Long- and Short-Term Goals Think about where you want to be in 10 years, then break down that ambition into milestones for 5 years, 3 years, 1 year, 6 months, 3 months, and 30 days. For instance, if your long-term goal is a marketing leadership role and you currently work in sales, plan to move into a junior marketing position as a first step. Having a clear, structured vision shows your manager you are committed.  4. Request Feedback and Support Self-assess to identify areas for growth and seek your manager's feedback on any skill gaps or growth opportunities. Managers often have valuable insights and can suggest resources such as mentorship, training, or specific projects to help you prepare for your desired role.  5. Prepare Thoroughly Bring a prepared agenda and thoughtful questions to your meeting. Do your research so you can participate meaningfully in the conversation. Schedule the meeting at a time free from distractions—possibly during a performance review or regular catch-up. Your preparation demonstrates ownership of your career and future.  By following these five steps, you'll be able to approach your next career conversation with confidence. Building a solid case for your development and aligning your growth with business needs will help you identify new opportunities and achieve your long-term goals.

Kendinizi geliştirmek ve şirketinizin ihtiyaçlarıyla gelişiminizi uyumlu hâle getirmek, yeni fırsatların önünü açacak ve uzun vadeli hedeflerinize ulaşmanızı kolaylaştıracaktır.

article_content: Virat Kohli matched Sachin Tendulkar’s record for most one-day international (ODI) centuries, scoring his 49th hundred during India's World Cup match against South Africa at Eden Gardens. With this milestone, Kohli also climbed to third place on the list of all-time leading World Cup run-scorers, overtaking Kumar Sangakkara of Sri Lanka. Playing a brilliant innings, Kohli compiled 101 runs from 121 deliveries, hitting 10 boundaries and maintaining a calm strike rate of 83.47. Over 34 World Cup appearances, he has now accumulated 1,573 runs at an average of 58.25, contributing four centuries and 10 half-centuries. Kohli’s top World Cup score remains 107. The World Cup’s run-scoring charts are led by Sachin Tendulkar (2,278) and Ricky Ponting (1,743), with Kohli now in third ahead of Sangakkara (1,532). In this World Cup alone, Kohli has been in stellar form, notching 543 runs over eight matches at an average of 108.60, including two hundreds and four fifties. His highest score in the tournament is an unbeaten 103, making him the event’s second-highest run-scorer so far. Kohli has a dominant record against South Africa in ODIs, tallying 1,091 runs from his last 15 games against them, with an extraordinary average of over 109 as well as five centuries and five half-centuries. The recent hundred puts Kohli one step closer to becoming the first-ever player with 50 ODI centuries. His total tally is now 79 international centuries—49 in ODIs, 29 in Tests, and one in T20Is. Adding a poetic touch, Kohli’s record-equaling century came at Eden Gardens, the same ground where he celebrated his first international hundred against Sri Lanka back in 2009. Marking his birthday with the 49th ODI hundred, Kohli has joined a select group of cricketers who’ve scored centuries on their birthdays, including icons like Tendulkar, Vinod Kambli, Sanath Jayasuriya, Ross Taylor, Tom Latham, and Mitchell Marsh. Notably, Kohli’s century took 119 balls to reach—matching the slowest century of his career, which he previously achieved against Pakistan in 2015 and South Africa in 2018.

Muhteşem bir performans sergileyen Kohli, 121 toptan 101 sayı kaydetti, 10 sınır vurdu ve 83.47 gibi sakin bir vuruş oranı yakaladı. 34 Dünya Kupası maçında şimdiye kadar toplamda 1.573 koşuya ulaştı, ortalaması 58.25; dört asır ve 10 yarım asırı bulunuyor. Dünya Kupası koşu listesinde Sachin Tendulkar (2.278) ve Ricky Ponting (1.743) liderlik ediyor, Kohli ise artık Sangakkara'yı (1.532) geçerek üçüncü sırada. article_content: Ian Thorson, who participated in a secretive Buddhist and yoga retreat in Bowie, Arizona, died from exposure and dehydration in the mountains after fleeing the retreat with his wife, Christie McNally. Search and rescue teams discovered Thorson's body in a cave, while McNally was found alive but delirious and dehydrated. Six weeks earlier, both were asked to leave the Diamond Mountain retreat after McNally revealed she had accidentally stabbed Thorson during a martial arts exercise. The retreat, situated in the Arizona wilderness, was led by Michael Roach, a Princeton-educated monk whose unconventional Buddhist teachings have drawn criticism from other Buddhist leaders, including the Dalai Lama. Participants at the Diamond Mountain retreat committed to meditating in isolation for more than three years, communicating only through written notes. Some ex-members have expressed concerns about initiation ceremonies and certain practices within the group, including unusual rituals like kissing, touching, and bloodletting. Roach's secret marriage to McNally, which is prohibited under traditional Buddhist monastic rules, lasted over a decade before ending in 2010. McNally later married Thorson, who had once been her student and their attendant. Roach and McNally claimed their marriage was celibate, but some descriptions suggest their practices were unconventional. After being expelled for the stabbing incident, Thorson and McNally chose to camp in the nearby mountains rather than return to normal life. When their condition worsened, McNally sent out a distress signal. By the time rescuers arrived, Thorson had died due to a lack of water and exposure. Authorities have found no evidence of foul play in Thorson's death. Of the original 39 individuals at the Diamond Mountain retreat, 34 participants remained as of the article's report. The retreat was scheduled to end in April 2014.

Arama kurtarma ekipleri Thorson’un cansız bedenini bir mağarada bulurken, McNally bitkin ve susuz bir halde sağ olarak bulundu. Altı hafta önce, McNally'nin bir dövüş sanatı egzersizi sırasında Thorson'u yanlışlıkla bıçakladığını açıklamasının ardından ikisi de Diamond Mountain inzivasından ayrılmak zorunda bırakıldı. Arizona'nın vahşi doğasındaki inziva, Budist liderler—özellikle Dalai Lama—tarafından eleştirilen sıradışı Budist öğretileriyle bilinen, Princeton mezunu bir keşiş olan Michael Roach tarafından yönetiliyordu. Diamond Mountain inzivasının katılımcıları, üç yılın üzerinde izole meditasyon yapmayı taahhüt etti ve aralarında sadece yazılı notlarla iletişim kurdu. Eski bazı üyeler, grup içindeki başlatma törenleri ve alışılmadık uygulamalar (örneğin öpüşme, dokunma ve kan alma) konusunda endişelerini belirtti. Roach'un Budist rahiplik kurallarına göre yasak olan McNally ile gizli evliliği on yıldan fazla sürdü ve 2010'da sona erdi. McNally daha sonra bir zamanlar öğrencisi ve yardımcısı olan Thorson ile evlendi. article_content:
Sheynnis Palacios of Nicaragua was crowned Miss Universe 2023 at the conclusion of the annual beauty pageant, held Saturday night in San Salvador, the capital of El Salvador. Anntonia Porsild of Thailand finished as the first runner-up, while Moraya Wilson of Australia was named second runner-up. Palacios' victory marks the first time a woman from Nicaragua has won the Miss Universe title.

Palacios previously represented Nicaragua in the 2017 Teen Miss Universe pageant, reaching the top 10, and in the 2021 Miss World pageant. This year’s competition brought together winners from 84 national pageants, who were judged by a panel featuring model Halima Aden, 'Queer Eye' star Carson Kressley, TikTok influencer Avani Gregg, and former Miss Universe winners Janelle Commissiong (Trinidad & Tobago, 1977) and Iris Mittenaere (France, 2016).

During the pageant, twenty semi-finalists were selected at the start of the event, based on preliminary results and a global fan vote. After the swimsuit round, the field was narrowed to ten, resulting in the elimination of Miss Nepal—the first 'curvy' contestant to reach the semi-finals—and Miss Pakistan, who was the first to wear a burkini during the swimsuit segment. The evening gown round reduced the competitors further, leading into two rounds of Q&A that determined the final three: Palacios, Porsild, and Wilson.

In the final question round, Palacios was asked which historical figure she would choose to spend a day with. She selected 18th-century British philosopher and feminist Mary Wollstonecraft, noting her role in breaking barriers and creating opportunities for women. Through a translator, Palacios said, 'There are no limitations for women today.'

Camila Avella of Colombia and Karla Guilfú of Puerto Rico rounded out the top five, while Athenea Pérez of Spain received the Miss Congeniality award. Palacios succeeds the 2022 Miss Universe, R’Bonney Gabriel of the United States.

article_content: On Monday, former President Donald Trump released a report praising his 'exceptional' cognitive health—a move widely seen as a swipe at President Joe Biden on his 81st birthday. The note, signed by Trump's physician, commends the overall health of the Republican presidential frontrunner as 'excellent' and his cognitive test performance as 'exceptional,' but does not provide specific health metrics. It claims Trump has lost weight through a better diet and daily exercise, resulting in better lab results than previous tests, although no figures are provided. In August, Trump self-reported his height and weight as 6'3" and 215 pounds when booked at the Fulton County Jail—numbers quickly compared by social media users to those of Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson, who is 6'2". Previously, Trump was recorded at 243 pounds in a 2019 presidential physical, when he was said to be in 'very good health,' but technically classified as obese. Trump, now 77, has often made health a talking point, previously questioning Hillary Clinton's capacity for presidential duties. Both Trump's and his opponents' health have drawn public attention and controversy: Trump's 2015 doctor’s letter was later revealed to have been dictated by Trump himself; his doctors were also criticized in 2020 for inconsistent updates about his COVID-19 diagnosis. Trump has regularly touted his cognitive testing, once famously reciting 'Person. Woman. Man. Camera. TV.' to prove his mental sharpness. As Trump seeks the 2024 Republican nomination, he continues to question Biden's mental acuity, a line of attack apparently echoed by some voters, according to polls. The positive health note was released on Biden's birthday, though it states Trump's latest full exam was on September 13. Biden, whose last physical in February 2023 found him in good health, continues to face scrutiny for physical and verbal stumbles, recently mixing up pop stars Britney Spears and Taylor Swift during a White House turkey pardoning event and joking about his age.

Şu anda 77 yaşında olan Trump, daha önce de sağlık konusunu gündeme taşıyarak Hillary Clinton’ın başkanlık görevlerini yerine getirme kapasitesini sorgulamıştı. Trump ve rakiplerinin sağlık durumu sık sık kamuoyunun ilgisini ve tartışmaları üzerine çekti: Trump'ın 2015 tarihli doktor mektubunun aslında kendi dikte ettiği sonradan ortaya çıkmış; ayrıca 2020'de COVID-19 tanısıyla ilgili doktorlarının tutarsız açıklamaları da eleştirilmişti. Olumlu sağlık raporu, Trump’ın son tam muayenesinin 13 Eylül’de gerçekleştiğini not etse de, Biden’ın doğum gününde yayımlandı. article_content: On Monday, labour leaders in Nigeria expressed concerns about the increasing hardships faced by workers, highlighting the impact of fuel subsidy removal and growing inflation. They observed that transportation costs have risen sharply, and food prices have increased significantly. At the opening ceremony of the 28th annual National Management/Industrial Relations Seminar, the leaders recognized the Federal Government’s efforts to soften the effects of subsidy removal, but insisted that further measures are needed. The three-day seminar, themed “Creative and Innovative Strategies to Manage Worker’s Expectations and Reality in a Challenging Economy,” is being held from Monday to Wednesday. Comrade Segun David, National President of the Chemical and Non-Metallic Products Senior Staff Association of Nigeria, which organized the seminar, pointed out that workers’ take-home pay no longer meets even basic expenses. While noting that President Bola Tinubu’s administration is relatively new, David called on the government to do more to support Nigerian workers facing these economic difficulties. David urged workers to strategize and adapt to the reality of declining incomes and emphasized the challenging economic climate. He added that employers are also struggling to adjust to government policies, particularly the removal of fuel subsidies, and that doing business in Nigeria is becoming increasingly challenging. David highlighted that the naira’s exchange rate recently exceeded one thousand to the US dollar, and that manufacturing heavily depends on foreign exchange. However, foreign exchange volatility has brought no positive changes so far. Nigeria’s dependence on imports has exacerbated the effects of the high exchange rate, with inflation in September 2023 hitting an 18-year high of 26.7%. The removal of fuel subsidies has further contributed to elevated inflation. Food prices increased by 30.6%, transportation costs by 27.2%, housing and utilities by 22.5%, and miscellaneous goods and services by 21.9%. He emphasized that essentially all basic needs—food, housing, transportation, electricity, clothing, education, health, recreation, and communication—have been impacted. ‘We need to plan on how to manage our expectations in the face of falling incomes and understand the realities on the ground,’ David said. Babatunde Olatunji, National President of the National Union of Chemical Footwear Rubber Leather and Non-Metallic Products Employees, outlined additional issues facing Nigerian workers: subsidy removal, higher electricity tariffs, rampant inflation, poor infrastructure, unreliable power supply, excessive taxation, and insecurity. Olatunji noted that subsidy removal has affected all Nigerians, from small traders to vehicle owners and those grappling with increased electricity bills. He called for urgent government intervention, pointing to continued security concerns with no immediate solution, and urged political leaders to address these challenges to prevent further decline in the country’s situation.

Semineri organize eden Nijerya Kimya ve Metal Dışı Ürünler Kıdemli Personel Birliği Ulusal Başkanı Komrade Segun David, işçilerin aldığı ücretlerin artık temel giderler için bile yeterli olmadığını ifade etti. Ayrıca, işverenlerin hükümet politikalarına—özellikle sübvansiyonun kaldırılmasına—uyum sağlamakta zorlandığını, ülkede iş yapmanın her geçen gün daha da zorlaştığını sözlerine ekledi. David, nairanın dolar karşısında son zamanlarda binin üzerine çıktığını ve üretimde dövize bağımlılığın arttığını söyledi. Ancak dövizdeki dalgalanmaların şu ana kadar olumlu bir sonuç vermediğini belirtti. Nijerya’nın ithalata bağımlılığı, yüksek döviz kuru nedeniyle olumsuz etkilendi; enflasyon Eylül 2023’te son 18 yılın en yüksek seviyesi olan %26,7’ye ulaştı. David, gıda, barınma, ulaşım, elektrik, giyim, eğitim, sağlık, rekreasyon ve iletişim dahil tüm temel ihtiyaçların etkilendiğini belirtti. ‘Azalan gelirler karşısında beklentilerimizi nasıl yöneteceğimizi planlamalı ve mevcut gerçekleri anlamalıyız,’ dedi. Nijerya Kimyasal Ayakkabı, Kauçuk, Deri ve Metal Dışı Ürünler Çalışanları Sendikası Başkanı Babatunde Olatunji de işçilerin karşılaştığı diğer sorunları şöyle sıraladı: sübvansiyonun kaldırılması, artan elektrik tarifeleri, yüksek enflasyon, yetersiz altyapı, düzensiz elektrik tedariği, çoklu vergilendirme ve güvenlik sorunları. Olatunji, sübvansiyonun kaldırılmasının çarşı esnafından araç sahiplerine ve artan elektrik faturalarıyla mücadele eden herkese etki ettiğini belirtti. Acil hükümet müdahalesi çağrısında bulunan Olatunji, çözümü olmayan devam eden güvenlik sorunlarına dikkat çekerek, ülkenin daha da kötüleşmemesi için siyasi liderleri harekete geçmeye davet etti.

article_content: Duolingo is recognized as a top language-learning app due to its fun, game-based approach to education. The app allows users on both iPhone and Android to choose from over 30 languages. Adding a new language is a simple process on both platforms. After logging in, users tap the Home icon at the bottom left, then the Flag icon at the top left, which represents the current language. To add another language, they select the '+ Course' icon, pick their desired language, and can begin their first lesson right away. Switching between languages is just as straightforward: tap the Home and Flag icons, then select your preferred language to make it active. A major benefit of Duolingo is that it’s entirely free, allowing effortless switching and learning of various languages.

article_content: Francis Benali will likely be emotional when he arrives at St Mary’s Stadium on Saturday. Known for his tough reputation as a former Southampton defender, it's understandable he might shed a tear—especially after running nearly 1,000 miles in three weeks. Benali is running to every Premier League ground in just 21 days, averaging close to 50 miles a day, all to raise money for Cancer Research UK. He has endured physical pain, ice baths, and significant sleep deprivation during the journey. Speaking to Sportsmail, Benali shared that he’s long been interested in extraordinary challenges and that this idea had been on his mind for about three years. He wanted a challenge connected to football, given his playing background, but partway through, he questioned the decision. While the physical aspect is grueling, Benali admits the biggest test is mental, with many days blurring together. Sometimes he finishes a run exhausted, with little appetite, needing encouragement from his support team to keep going. Benali, now 45, made over 300 league appearances for Southampton between 1988 and 2004, but he says that this run is far more demanding than his football career. He has been joined for stretches by fellow former players like Alan Shearer, Matt Le Tissier, and James Beattie, as well as current footballers Dean Hammond and Danny Ings. Southampton’s start to the season has been better than many expected, despite losing manager Mauricio Pochettino and several key players. New manager Ronald Koeman has guided the team to a respectable early record, which lifts Benali’s spirits during his journey. Benali remains positive about Southampton's prospects and believes Koeman has brought in quality despite the summer’s upheaval. Francis Benali’s run concludes at Swansea’s Liberty Stadium on Saturday. To support his cause, more information and donation details can be found at benalisbigrun.co.uk or by texting “BIGR55 £amount” to 70070.

The European free ad-supported TV (FAST) channel market is still developing, especially in comparison to the more mature U.S. market. This early stage presents significant opportunities for content owners interested in entering the sector.

European FAST Market Overview
Europe’s television landscape is still largely dominated by traditional free-to-air broadcasters, which has contributed to the slower growth of digital-native FAST channels. However, countries like Germany, Spain, France, Italy, the Netherlands, and Sweden are not yet reaching their full potential, presenting a strong opportunity for content owners and licensors.

Diverse Genre Preferences
Europe’s cultural diversity results in varying tastes for sports, news, languages, and entertainment genres. The flexibility of FAST allows providers to cater to these localized preferences through specialized channels. In contrast, the U.S. market is more homogenous, with previously regional sports content evolving into national brands.

Trends and Growth
A growing number of broadcasters are migrating into the FAST space, converting their channels into dynamic streaming options. This demonstrates a willingness to adapt to new media consumption habits and capitalize on the rise of FAST channels.

In Europe, sports and news genres are experiencing significant audience increases. The 2022 Global Sports Survey found that 57% of UK respondents watch sports monthly, representing a 45% increase in two years, with average live sports viewing at 3.5 hours per week. The Premier League’s 2023/24 opening weekend saw viewership rise 39% over the previous season. France and Italy show similar trends. Forecasts suggest Western Europe will overtake North America by 2024 in the number of households with at least one streaming subscription.

Strategies for Content Owners
Content owners and licensors can:
• Adopt proven U.S. FAST strategies, like genre-based channels, and localize them for multiple languages.
• Develop single-theme channels (such as those centered on reality TV, animation, or personalities) and adapt content linguistically.
• Use breaking news to create clips and near real-time segments for demographically targeted news channels.
• Repackage sports and event licenses to design FAST-ready channels for specific markets.

A robust content management strategy and adherence to GDPR are necessary, alongside building partnerships with leading and emerging FAST platforms. While Samsung TVplus and The Roku Channel are industry leaders, newer players like rlaxx TV, LG, and Rakuten offer valuable trial and growth opportunities.

Outlook
Europe’s FAST channel market is poised for growth and innovation, especially in sports and news. Content providers and platforms have a prime opportunity to engage diverse audiences with streamlined, tailored content.

Ed Laczynski, Backlight'ta stratejik ortaklıkların başında bulunuyor. Daha önce 2021'de satın alınan önde gelen bir OTT çözümü olan Zype'ın kurucu ortağıydı.

Avrupa'daki ücretsiz reklama dayalı TV (FAST) kanalı pazarı, daha olgun olan ABD pazarına kıyasla hâlâ gelişme aşamasında. Bu ilk dönem, sektöre girmek isteyen içerik sahipleri için önemli fırsatlar sunuyor.

Avrupa FAST Pazarı Genel Görünümü
Avrupa televizyon piyasasında hâlâ geleneksel, ücretsiz yayın yapan kanallar baskın durumda ve bu durum dijital FAST kanallarının büyümesini yavaşlattı. Ancak Almanya, İspanya, Fransa, İtalya, Hollanda ve İsveç gibi ülkeler henüz potansiyelinin tamamına ulaşmadı; bu da içerik sahipleri ve lisansörler için büyük bir fırsat anlamına geliyor.

Çeşitli Tür Tercihleri
Avrupa'nın kültürel çeşitliliği; spor, haber, dil ve eğlence türlerinde farklı zevklere yol açıyor. FAST kanallarının esnekliği, sağlayıcıların özelleştirilmiş kanallarla yerel tercihlere kolayca uyum sağlamasını mümkün kılıyor. Karşılaştırıldığında, ABD pazarı daha homojen ve daha önce bölgesel olan sporlar zamanla ulusal markalara dönüştü.

Trendler ve Büyüme
Giderek artan sayıda yayıncı, FAST alanına giriyor ve kanallarını dinamik yayın platformlarına dönüştürüyor. Bu, değişen medya tüketimine uyum sağlama ve FAST kanallarının yükselen popülerliğinden faydalanma eğilimini gösteriyor.

Avrupa'da spor ve haber türlerinde izleyici sayısı gözle görülür biçimde artıyor. 2022 Küresel Spor Anketi'ne göre İngiltere'deki katılımcıların %57'si ayda en az bir kez spor izliyor; bu, iki yıl öncesine kıyasla %45'lik bir artış ve haftada ortalama 3,5 saat canlı spor izleme anlamına geliyor. Premier Lig'in 2023/24 sezon açılışı, önceki sezona göre %39 daha fazla izleyici çekti. Fransa ve İtalya da benzer artışlar gösteriyor. Tahminler, Batı Avrupa'nın 2024'te en az bir dijital aboneliği olan hane sayısında Kuzey Amerika'nın önüne geçeceğini gösteriyor.

İçerik Sahipleri İçin Stratejiler
İçerik sahipleri ve lisansörler şunları uygulayabilir:
• ABD'de başarılı olmuş FAST stratejilerini (tür odaklı kanallar gibi) alıp bunları çok dilli olarak sunmak.
• Gerçeklik TV, animasyon veya şahsiyet odaklı özel tema kanalları geliştirip, içeriği farklı dillere uyarlamak.
• Flaş haberlerden yararlanarak, demografik olarak hedeflenmiş haber kanalları için anlık klipler ve bölümler hazırlamak.
• Spor ve etkinlik lisanslarını yeniden düzenleyerek belirli pazarlara uygun FAST kanalları oluşturmak.

Güçlü bir içerik yönetim altyapısı ve GDPR'ye uygun veri politikaları gereklidir. İçerik hakları ve yerelleştirme dışında, önde gelen veya büyüyen FAST sağlayıcılarıyla ilişkiler kurmak da önemlidir. Samsung TVplus ve The Roku Channel sektör liderleri olurken, rlaxx TV, LG ve Rakuten gibi yenilikçi platformlar da dikkate değerdir.

Genel Bakış
Avrupa'nın FAST kanalı pazarı, özellikle spor ve haber kategorilerinde büyüme ve yenilik için büyük bir potansiyele sahip. İçerik sağlayıcıları ve platformlar, çeşitli izleyici kitlelerine özel, akıcı içerikler sunarak bu gelişen pazardan en iyi şekilde yararlanabilir.

article_content: Stanley, a spaniel cross, faced euthanasia after failing to qualify as a police sniffer dog and surviving two close calls—a bone stuck in his throat and poisoning from rotten chicken. Rescued by Anne and Mike Higgins, both police inspectors living near Tiverton, Devon, Stanley underwent four years of determined training. Now, he has reached the finals of the Crufts dog agility competition in Birmingham next March. Stanley assists with household chores, handing over laundry and selecting pegs for the washing line. Initially, he showed no interest in toys or socialization and was scared of everyday noises. Anne Higgins recalled that, as inexperienced dog owners, they were unaware of the importance of early training and socialization but were committed to giving Stanley a loving home. Today, Stanley's journey showcases the profound impact of patience, resilience, and dedication.

Şimdi ise gelecek mart ayında Birmingham’da düzenlenecek Crufts köpek çevikliği yarışmasında finale yükseldi. Stanley, aynı zamanda ev işlerine de yardımcı oluyor; çamaşırları veriyor ve çamaşır ipi için mandalları seçiyor. Başlangıçta oyuncaklara ve sosyalleşmeye hiç ilgi göstermeyen Stanley, sıradan ev seslerinden de korkuyordu. article_content: Adeola Thomas (38) and Abimbola Abiola (34), a couple from Nigeria, have been sentenced to nearly ten years in prison for masterminding a major benefits scam in the UK. Between 2007 and 2011, they used about 1,400 stolen identities to submit around 2,500 bogus handwritten applications for tax credits and welfare benefits, attempting to defraud the system of £3.8 million—ultimately receiving £87,000. They spent much of the money on expensive items like designer clothes and electronics. Investigators became suspicious when multiple claims originated from the same address, leading to deeper scrutiny by HMRC and the Department for Work and Pensions. Thomas, lacking legal immigration status, and Abiola, a legal UK resident, directed payments to bank accounts opened under false identities or used accounts belonging to acquaintances. On October 7, 2011, Thomas was arrested outside a Hackney post office in possession of multiple post office accounts, fraudulent paperwork, and mobile phones. Abiola was found that day with over £4,000 cash, which she claimed was from child benefits. The authorities’ thorough investigation, which included document analysis, surveillance, and tracking financial records, resulted in both individuals being put on trial at Snaresbrook Crown Court. Judge William Kennedy described their operation as a 'criminal industry' that posed significant risk to public funds. Thomas pleaded guilty to several charges and received seven years in prison; Abiola was convicted on related offenses and sentenced to two and a half years. The judge recommended both face deportation after serving their sentences.

Bu paranın çoğunu lüks kıyafetler ve elektronik eşyalar gibi pahalı şeyler almak için harcadılar. Yetkililer, aynı adresten gelen çok sayıda başvuru dikkat çekince HMRC ve Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı kapsamlı bir soruşturma başlattı. Thomas’ın yasal oturma izni yoktu, Abiola ise Birleşik Krallık’ta yasal olarak ikamet ediyordu. İkili, ödemeleri sahte kimliklerle açılmış banka hesaplarına veya tanıdıklarının hesaplarına yönlendirdi. 7 Ekim 2011'de, Thomas Hackney'deki bir postanede birçok posta hesabı, sahte belgeler ve cep telefonlarıyla yakalandı. Aynı gün Abiola, çocuk yardımı olduğunu iddia ettiği 4.000 sterlinden fazla nakit para ile bulundu. Belgelerin incelenmesi, kamera görüntüleri ve banka kayıtlarının takibi dahil detaylı soruşturma sonucunda, her ikisi de Snaresbrook Crown Court’ta yargılandı. Yargıç William Kennedy, bu işi kamu fonlarına büyük zarar vermeye yönelik bir 'suç endüstrisi' olarak nitelendirdi. Thomas, çeşitli suçlamaları kabul ederek yedi yıl hapis cezasına çarptırıldı. Abiola ise ilgili suçlardan mahkum edilip iki buçuk yıl hapis aldı. Yargıç, cezalarının bitiminde her ikisinin de sınır dışı edilmesini önerdi.

article_content: A Los Angeles judge has ruled that A$AP Rocky must stand trial on charges of firing a gun at a former friend and collaborator near a Hollywood hotel in 2021. Superior Court Judge M.L. Villar made the ruling at a preliminary hearing after hearing approximately a day and a half of testimony from two witnesses. A$AP Rocky, a 35-year-old rapper, fashion influencer, and two-time Grammy nominee, has pleaded not guilty to two felony counts of assault with a semiautomatic firearm. If convicted on all charges, he could face up to 24 years in prison, according to prosecutors. Judge Villar stated that the combined video evidence and witness testimony provide sufficient grounds for a trial, noting that preliminary hearings require a lower standard of proof than a full trial. Rocky's attorney, Joe Tacopina, said outside court that they had anticipated going to trial, expressing confidence that Rocky would be vindicated. Testimony from Terell Ephron described a longtime friendship with Rocky, including their creative collaboration during high school in New York, and a falling out that led to the incident on November 6, 2021. Ephron testified that Rocky first pointed a gun at him and later fired shots, grazing his knuckles. Deputy District Attorney Paul Przelomiec argued that Ephron’s testimony, supported by surveillance video, was sufficient to proceed. Tacopina questioned the credibility of Ephron’s statements and highlighted that police searching the area after the incident found no physical evidence. Police body camera footage showed officers searching for about 10 minutes, but finding no evidence. 9 mm shell casings later turned over by Ephron had no fingerprints. Prosecutors presented a video in which two gunshots can be heard and a man is seen running away. Detective Frank Flores said they determined the man was Rocky, though a gun was never recovered. Surveillance images showed a man in a hooded sweatshirt holding what appeared to be a gun; his face was not always clearly visible. Tacopina argued it was unclear if the weapon seen on video was real or operable since it was never recovered. He also questioned the seriousness of Ephron’s injury and why medical treatment was delayed. Judge Villar at times admonished Tacopina for the tone of his questioning. Rocky was arrested at Los Angeles International Airport in April, charged in August, and appeared in court after participating in a Formula One event as Puma’s creative director. In recent years, Rocky has released less music but is widely known as Rihanna's partner and co-parent of their two sons. Tacopina said Rocky wants to protect his family from the trial publicity. Previously, then-President Donald Trump advocated for Rocky’s release following the rapper’s 2019 arrest in Sweden, which ended with a conditional sentence and no additional jail time. Other unrelated news in the article covers Indian tax authorities investigating e-tailers for alleged tax evasion, Indian companies’ GST concerns in business transactions, and allegations against industrialist Gautam Singhania by his estranged wife.
translated_content: Los Angeles'ta bir yargıç, A$AP Rocky'nin 2021 yılında Hollywood yakınlarında eski bir arkadaşına ve iş ortağına ateş ettiği iddiasıyla yargılanmasına karar verdi. Yüksek Mahkeme Yargıcı M.L. Villar, yaklaşık bir buçuk gün süren iki tanığın ifadesinin ardından ön duruşmada bu karara vardı. 35 yaşındaki rapçi, moda ikonu ve iki kez Grammy adayı olan A$AP Rocky, yarı otomatik ateşli silahla saldırı suçlamalarından iki ağır suçlamadan suçsuz olduğunu iddia etti. Savcılara göre, tüm suçlamalardan hüküm giymesi halinde Rocky 24 yıla kadar hapis cezası alabilir. Yargıç Villar, video kanıtları ve tanık ifadelerinin bir arada davanın mahkemeye taşınması için yeterli olduğunu, ön duruşmalarda delil standartlarının tam bir mahkemeye göre daha düşük olduğunu belirtti. Rocky'nin avukatı Joe Tacopina, mahkeme dışında yaptığı açıklamada yargılamaya hazırlıklı olduklarını ve Rocky'nin aklanacağından emin olduklarını ifade etti. Terell Ephron'un ifadesi, Rocky ile lise yıllarında New York'ta başlayan arkadaşlıkları, yaratıcı bir kolektifte beraberlikleri ve 6 Kasım 2021'de yaşanan olaya kadar süren ilişkilerini anlattı. Ephron, Rocky'nin önce kendisine silah doğrulttuğunu, ardından ateş edip parmak eklemlerini sıyırdığını söyledi. Başsavcı Yardımcısı Paul Przelomiec, Ephron'un ifadesinin ve olayla ilgili güvenlik kamerası görüntülerinin davanın sürdürülmesi için yeterli olduğunu savundu. Tacopina ise Ephron'un ifadelerinin güvenilirliğini ve olay sonrası polis tarafından herhangi bir fiziksel kanıt bulunamamasını sorguladı. Polis vücut kamerası görüntülerinde, ekiplerin yaklaşık 10 dakika kanıt aradığı, ancak bir bulguya rastlamadığı, Ephron tarafından daha sonra teslim edilen 9 mm'lik kovanlarda da parmak izi tespit edilemediği belirtildi. Savcılar, iki el silah sesi duyulan ve bir adamın kaçtığı video görüntüsünü sundu. Dedektif Frank Flores, adamın Rocky olduğunu belirlediklerini, fakat silahın bulunamadığını söyledi. Güvenlik kamerasında kapüşonlu bir şahsın elinde silah olduğu düşünülüyor, fakat yüzü her zaman net görünmüyor. Tacopina, videodaki silahın gerçek ya da çalışır durumda olup olmadığının anlaşılamadığını savundu çünkü silah bulunamadı. Ayrıca Ephron'un yarasının ciddiyetini ve neden tıbbi yardım için geciktiğini de sorguladı. Yargıç Villar, bazı zamanlarda Tacopina'nın sorgu tarzı nedeniyle uyarılarda bulundu. Rocky, Nisan ayında Los Angeles Uluslararası Havalimanı'nda tutuklandı, Ağustos'ta suçlandı ve geçtiğimiz hafta sonu Puma'nın yaratıcı direktörü olarak Formula 1 etkinliğine katıldıktan sonra mahkemeye çıktı. Rocky son yıllarda daha az müzik yayınladı, fakat Rihanna'nın partneri ve iki oğlunun babası olarak sıkça gündeme geldi. Tacopina, Rocky'nin ailesini davanın medya ilgisinden korumak istediğini belirtti. Daha önce, dönemin ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Rocky'nin 2019 yılında İsveç'te tutuklanmasının ardından serbest bırakılması için girişimlerde bulunmuştu; dava şartlı ceza ile sonuçlanmıştı. Aynı makalede Hindistan'da vergi yetkililerinin sosyal medya üzerinden satış yapan e-ticaret firmalarını incelemesi, şirket birleşmeleriyle ilgili GST sorunları ve sanayici Gautam Singhania'ya yönelik iddialar gibi başlıklara da yer verildi.

article_content: For four years, the war in Syria has upended countless lives, pushing families to seek shelter in refugee camps along the border with Turkey. The fighting has left many with only memories of the peace that once was. In these camps, daily life is a struggle — mothers fight hunger and brave the icy wind to dry laundry while their children entertain themselves in mud-soaked fields, using battered bikes and simple toys. Scenes from Aleppo’s camps show children trudging barefoot through thick mud, toddlers in tattered clothes carrying pots, and girls helping their siblings navigate the makeshift settlement. Most inhabitants are women and children, living in tents vulnerable to rain and cold, where even their few possessions are often left muddy and wet. Shoes line the entrance of temporary homes, and washing lines sag under the weight of wet clothes. The ongoing violence, fueled by battles between Islamic State, government forces, and militias, means safety and stability remain out of reach. While families try to make the best of small comforts and brief sunshine, their exhaustion and grief linger as relief seems ever distant.

article_content: In a determined effort to overcome his lifelong smoking habit, 42-year-old Ibrahim Yücel from Kütahya, Turkey, created a unique helmet resembling a cage to prevent himself from smoking. Yücel, who has smoked heavily since he was 16 and lost his father to lung cancer, felt compelled to make a significant change for the sake of his health and family. Doubting his own self-control, Yücel designed a helmet inspired by motorcycle headgear. Each morning, his daughter assists in locking the cage on his head while his family safeguards the keys, ensuring he cannot access cigarettes. Initially skeptical, his family has grown supportive after witnessing his commitment. Although his unconventional method attracts curious looks from neighbors and children, Yücel is hopeful that this bold approach will help him quit smoking once and for all.

Kendi iradesine güvenemeyen Yücel, motosiklet kasklarından ilham alarak bu özel başlığı tasarladı. Her sabah işe gitmeden önce kızı, kafesi babasının başına takıyor ve anahtarlar ailesinde kalıyor. Böylece sigaraya erişimi tamamen engelleniyor. Ailesi başta şüpheliydi fakat onun kararlılığını görünce destek olmaya başladı. Bu alışılmadık yöntem, komşuların ve çocukların dikkatini çekiyor. Yücel ise bu cesur hareketin sonunda sigarayı tamamen bırakmasına yardımcı olacağına inanıyor.

article_content: In St. Paul, Minnesota, the recent government shutdown has left over 20,000 state employees—including the two mothers of 17-year-old Claire Thomas—uncertain about their future. Claire, who is set to start her senior year of high school, appreciates having her mothers, Toby McAdams and Wendy Crowell, at home, but she is also anxious about what's next. Both women lost their state jobs in wide-ranging layoffs after their roles in emergency preparedness and invasive species research were deemed 'nonessential.' They will keep some benefits but are no longer receiving salaries, with no promise their jobs will still be there when the shutdown ends. The family is facing difficult financial decisions—possibly having to use college savings meant for Claire and her brother Adam, and making everyday cutbacks, like changing their grocery shopping habits. Claire works part-time at a farm and has a preference for organic food, but she's prepared to adapt by relying more on farm surplus and their home garden. The shutdown has resulted from a deadlock between Governor Mark Dayton, who supports a mix of spending cuts and tax increases to address a $5 billion state budget deficit, and Republican legislators who oppose any tax hikes. During this impasse, many lawmakers have continued to receive pay, though some refused their checks. Both McAdams and Crowell worry about how prolonged cutbacks to government services, and the loss of so many state jobs, could impact Minnesota in the future. McAdams hopes state legislators will reach a budget agreement soon, so families like hers can regain some sense of normalcy.

article_content: Andrew Ng, co-founder of Google Brain and former chief scientist at Baidu, has accused major technology companies of amplifying fears that artificial intelligence could lead to human extinction as part of a 'regulatory capture campaign' intended to suppress competition from open-source AI. In an October 30 interview with The Australian Financial Review, Professor Ng called the notion that AI could cause human extinction a 'massively, colossally dumb idea' and argued that lobbyists use this narrative to push for strict regulations that would stifle innovation in the AI sector. Ng specifically mentioned OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, a former student of his at Stanford, for supporting a letter in May that asserted 'mitigating the risk of extinction from AI should be a global priority.' Professor Ng suggested that OpenAI has incentives to restrict open-source AI, which could potentially rival its proprietary models. 'There are certainly large tech companies that would prefer not to compete with open-source AI, so they are creating fear about AI causing human extinction,' Ng said. While he acknowledged that AI has caused harm, including fatalities involving self-driving cars, Professor Ng maintained that excessive regulation could be more harmful than taking no regulatory action at all. 'I don’t think no regulation is the right solution, but with the direction that regulation is heading in many countries, I think we’d be better off with no regulation than what is being proposed,' he stated. However, he emphasized that requirements for greater transparency could have prevented past crises, such as the social media challenges of the early 2000s, and would help prevent future AI mishaps. Professor Ng warned that regulatory requirements imposing licensing burdens on the AI industry would 'crush innovation.' His comments highlight concerns that dominant technology companies may be exploiting extinction fears to maintain their market position at the expense of open-source developers. Ng’s remarks support suspicions that anti-competitive interests may be shaping the AI safety movement. Featured image credit: Illustration by Google DeepMind; Pexels.

Ng, Stanford'daki eski öğrencisi olan OpenAI CEO'su Sam Altman'ı, Mayıs'ta 'YZ kaynaklı yok oluş riskinin azaltılması küresel öncelik olmalı' diyen bir mektuba imza attığı için özel olarak ele aldı. article_content: Google hosted its October hardware event in New York City, where it unveiled three major products: the Pixel 8, Pixel 8 Pro smartphones, and the Pixel Watch 2. The new Pixel 8 and Pixel 8 Pro are equipped with updated features, including secure face authentication, seven years of software updates, a built-in thermometer, and refined designs. The second-generation Pixel Watch introduces more modest improvements over the previous model. Google also announced upcoming software enhancements for the Pixel Buds Pro wireless earbuds. In addition to hardware launches, Google shared plans to enhance the Google Assistant with its Bard large language model, bringing advanced AI-powered conversational abilities to the voice assistant. This year marks the eighth generation of Pixel smartphones. The Pixel 8 has a slightly smaller 6.2-inch screen than last year’s Pixel 7, while the Pixel 8 Pro retains a 6.7-inch display. Both models feature more rounded edges, with the Pixel 8 offering a matte camera bar and glossy glass back. The Pro model features a soft-touch matte back glass with a glossy camera bar. Frames for both phones are made from 100% recycled aluminum. Google introduced proprietary names for its OLED displays: the Pixel 8 features an 'Actua display,' and the Pixel 8 Pro offers a 'Super Actua display.' While these names do not reflect major changes, the Pixel 8 can reach a peak outdoor brightness of 2,000 nits—42% brighter than its predecessor—while the Pro version achieves up to 2,400 nits. Both models support refresh rates up to 120 Hz for smoother animations. Only the Pro model includes low-temperature polycrystalline oxide (LTPO) technology, allowing dynamic adjustment of the frame rate to save battery life. A notable addition to the Pixel 8 series is secure face authentication. Unlike the Pixel 4, which used the Soli radar chip, the new models offer this capability without it, enabling secure access to apps and services that require biometric verification. Fingerprint sensors remain available for those who prefer this option.

article_content: Preventing Wildfires: The Rise of AI Assistance Massive wildfires continue to force thousands of people to evacuate as blazes spread quickly, destroying homes and landscapes. As global temperatures rise, the frequency and severity of wildfires have increased, causing widespread destruction. Preventing and predicting wildfires before they become uncontrollable is now a key priority for governments worldwide, especially with 2024 expected to bring another year of intense heat. Fighting wildfires is complex, dangerous, and can be deadly. Global Forest Watch data shows we now lose twice as much tree cover to wildfires as we did 20 years ago. A recent University of Maryland study also found that wildfires now cause three million hectares more tree cover loss per year than in 2001—an area about the size of Belgium—making up over a quarter of all tree cover loss over the past two decades. In 2023, Canada experienced record-breaking wildfires, with significant activity also affecting Hawaii. These increases are largely driven by climate change and extreme heat waves, which are now five times more likely than a century ago. In the US, the 2022 Mosquito Fire in California was one of the largest, burning thousands of hectares and destroying 78 structures near the wildland-urban interface. That year, wildfires burned nearly one million hectares across the country, resulting in about $3.2 billion in damages. Heat waves in the Mediterranean further fueled major fires. In Spain, 2022 saw the highest loss of tree cover to fire since 2001, exceeding 70,000 hectares. In Portugal, more than 130,000 hectares burned five years before, the highest loss in a decade. Canada was especially hard hit in 2023, recording 18.5 million hectares burned—the highest on record since 1983 according to the Canadian Interagency Forest Fire Centre. Though forecasting wildfire risk has a long history, the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) is a relatively new and promising strategy as climate risks intensify. Firefighters and companies are using AI-powered cameras, a German company is launching satellites to detect fires from space, and Microsoft is developing AI models to anticipate potential wildfires. The World Economic Forum’s FireAId initiative leverages AI to give firefighters early warnings and improve response. By gathering and analyzing data trends, these tools help crews allocate resources more effectively and react quickly to changing conditions. The goal is to provide user-friendly, intuitive tools to give firefighters more time and optimize efforts. Canada’s Alberta province, hit hard by fires in 2023, has partnered with Edmonton-based AltaML. Using machine learning, their model forecasts wildfires with 80% accuracy, analyzing thousands of data points—including historical fire data, weather, and forest conditions—to predict next-day fire risk by region. AltaML's system could save Alberta Wildfire $2–5 million in annual operating costs by allocating resources more efficiently. Their research also looks for links between carbon emissions, weekly patterns, wildfires, climate change, and human behavior. Another innovation is NASA’s AUDREY software, which collects crucial fire data—such as temperatures, gases, development speed, and effects of burning materials—and provides first responders with situational awareness and guidance. In the future, AUDREY is expected to track entire firefighting teams and optimize response tactics. As greenhouse gas emissions rise, so do wildfire risks. Fires release millions of tons of CO2 each year, impeding forest recovery, depleting resources, and putting both residents and firefighters at risk. With the world warming, governments are racing to use the latest AI technology to stay ahead of fire threats. Innovations from AltaML, Microsoft, NASA, and the World Economic Forum are examples of leadership in using tech to detect and help prevent wildfires.
translated_content: Orman Yangınlarını Önlemede Yeni Dönem: Yapay Zeka Destekli Çözümler Devasa orman yangınları, binlerce insanı tahliye etmeye zorluyor; alevler hızla yayılıyor, evler ve doğal alanlar yok oluyor. Küresel sıcaklıklar arttıkça yangınların şiddeti ve sıklığı da artarak büyük yıkımlara yol açıyor. Yangınlar kontrolden çıkmadan önlemek ve öngörmek artık tüm dünyada hükümetlerin önceliği. 2024'te de yoğun sıcaklıklar bekleniyor. Orman yangınlarıyla mücadele; karmaşık, tehlikeli ve ölümcül olabiliyor. Global Forest Watch verisine göre, artık 20 yıl öncesine oranla iki kat daha fazla ağaç örtüsü kaybediyoruz. Maryland Üniversitesi’nin son araştırmasına göre ise, orman yangınları 2001’e göre her yıl 3 milyon hektar daha fazla ağaç kaybına yol açıyor. Bu, Belçika büyüklüğünde bir alana denk ve son 20 yıldaki tüm ağaç kayıplarının dörtte birinden fazlasını oluşturuyor. 2023 yılında Kanada'da rekor seviyede yangınlar yaşanırken, Hawaii de ciddi şekilde etkilendi. Artışın başlıca sebepleri iklim değişikliği ve artık bir asır öncesine göre 5 kat daha olası olan aşırı sıcak dalgaları. ABD’de 2022 yılında yaşanan Kaliforniya Mosquito Yangını en büyüklerinden biriydi; binlerce hektar orman ve 78 yapı yok oldu. Aynı yıl ABD genelinde yaklaşık 1 milyon hektar orman yandı ve 3,2 milyar dolarlık hasar oluştu. Akdeniz’de sıcak hava dalgaları yeni büyük yangınlara yol açtı. İspanya 2022’de, 2001’den bu yana en yüksek orman kaybını görerek 70 bin hektarı yangında kaybetti. Portekiz ise beş yıl önce son on yılın en büyük kaybı olan 130 bin hektardan fazla ormanını kaybetti. Kanada ise özellikle 2023'te büyük zarar gördü; Kanada Orman Yangını Merkezi'ne göre 18,5 milyon hektar orman yandı—bu, 1983'ten bu yana en yüksek rakam. Yangın riskini tahmin etmek yıllardır gündemde, fakat yapay zeka (YZ) kullanımı yükselen yeni bir yöntem olarak dikkat çekiyor. İtfaiyeciler ve girişimler YZ destekli kameralarıyla dumanı tespit ediyor, bir Alman şirketi uydularla uzaydan yangınları izliyor, Microsoft ise potansiyel yangın bölgelerini öngören YZ modelleri geliştiriyor. Dünya Ekonomik Forumu'nun FireAId girişimi, YZ’yi kullanarak itfaiyecilere erken uyarılar sağlıyor ve daha iyi yanıt vermelerini hedefliyor. Bu araçlar, veri ve eğilimleri analiz ederek ekiplerin kaynakları verimli kullanmasına katkı sağlıyor. Amaç, kullanımı kolay ve sezgisel araçlarla itfaiye ekiplerine değerli zaman kazandırıp müdahaleyi en verimli hale getirmek. Kanada'nın yangınlardan en fazla etkilenen eyaleti Alberta, Edmonton merkezli AltaML şirketiyle işbirliği kurdu. Makine öğrenimi kullanan yapay zekâ modeli, on binlerce veri noktasını analiz ederek yangın riskini bölgesel olarak %80 doğrulukla tahmin edebiliyor. AltaML'ın sistemi, kaynakların daha iyi yönetimiyle Alberta'da yılda 2-5 milyon dolar tasarruf sağlayabilir. Ayrıca karbon salımı, haftalık düzen, yangınlar, iklim değişikliği ve insan davranışı ilişkisi üzerine de araştırmalar sürdürülüyor. Bir diğer yenilikçi çözüm de NASA'nın AUDREY isimli yazılımı. AUDREY; sıcaklık, gaz, gelişim hızı ve yanan maddelerin etkisi gibi hayati verileri toplayarak ilk müdahalecilere rehberlik ediyor. Gelecekte AUDREY’in tüm ekibi takip edip öneriler sunması hedefleniyor. Sera gazı emisyonları yükseldikçe yangınlar da artıyor. Yangınlar, ormanların kendini toparlamasını geciktiriyor, kaynakları azaltıyor ve hem itfaiyeciler hem de halk için risk oluşturuyor. Dünya ısınırken, hükümetler en yeni YZ teknolojisiyle yangınların önüne geçmeye çalışıyor. AltaML, Microsoft, NASA ve Dünya Ekonomik Forumu’nun çalışmaları, yangın tespit ve önlemede teknolojinin liderliğini gösteriyor.
