article_content: Britain faces an unusually wet start to June, with forecasts predicting further rain and the possibility of flooding across several regions. Today, torrential downpours are expected to bring over an inch of rainfall in some areas within 24 hours, leading the Environment Agency to issue 16 flood alerts for parts of the Midlands, East Anglia, and the South East. Families across the country may have to rethink their plans for barbecues, garden parties, local fetes, and festivals due to wet weather. Flooding has already been observed in Norwich, Norfolk, where nurse Lynsey Hannant shared photos of submerged roads and vehicles struggling through floodwaters, noting she had 'never seen it so bad.' Conditions have created hazardous travel, particularly on busy routes like the M25 near the Dartford Crossing, where speed restrictions are in place. Tourists and commuters in London have been pictured braving the rain, taking cover under umbrellas or donning ponchos near landmarks such as Tower Bridge and the Houses of Parliament. The heaviest rainfall is forecasted for Lincolnshire, North Yorkshire, and the east coast, where some areas could experience up to two weeks’ worth of rain in just a few hours. The Met Office has issued a yellow weather warning, signaling a moderate risk of severe weather and alerting the public to possible travel disruption and localized flooding of property and low-lying land. This unsettled weather is attributed to a pressure system moving in from the European continent. A Met Office spokesperson said more rain is expected through the rest of the week, particularly across eastern and northeastern England, while Scotland—especially the north—will enjoy warmer, sunnier weather. Suffolk has already recorded over 30mm (1.2 inches) of rain at Wattisham in the first nine hours of the day. Yorkshire may see similar amounts, with strengthening winds making the conditions feel particularly unpleasant. The Met Office forecast indicates a gradual improvement by the weekend, with drier and brighter conditions expected. However, the longer-term outlook for early to mid-June remains largely unsettled, with changeable weather and further showers or longer spells of rain, especially in western areas, only occasionally interrupted by brighter periods. Average temperatures for May usually range from 8°C to 18°C (46°F to 64°F). While some regions saw unseasonably warm, stormy weather over the previous weekend, temperatures are now set to return to average levels for this time of year. While Scotland is currently enjoying better conditions, the rest of the UK faces ongoing cloud, showers, and occasional sunshine, with risk of heavy rain at times. Later in June, more settled and warmer periods may develop, especially for northern areas. [Source: Met Office

Google has expanded access to its Car crash detection feature for Pixel smartphones, now bringing it to India, as well as Austria, Belgium, Portugal, and Switzerland. Originally launched in the United States in 2019, this feature uses the phone’s location data, motion sensors, and microphones to identify serious car accidents. It's available on Pixel 4a and newer models. To set it up, users need to open the Personal Safety app, enable Car crash detection, and grant permissions for location, physical activity, and microphone access.

If a crash is detected, the phone vibrates, sounds an alarm, and asks the user if emergency help is needed. If there's no response, it calls 112, India's emergency services number, and shares the user's location and crash details with authorities. The feature doesn’t currently support Indian languages, might not identify every crash, and could be accidentally triggered by other high-impact activities. A reliable mobile network connection is also necessary for successful emergency calls.

This expansion highlights Google’s ongoing efforts to use technology for road safety. The company recently unveiled the Pixel 8 and Pixel 8 Pro, featuring the new Tensor G3 chip and enhanced AI-driven camera improvements.

article_content: Boeing's High Energy Laser Mobile Demonstrator (HEL MD) is reshaping military defense with its truck-mounted 10-kilowatt laser, capable of destroying drones and mortars. Recent trials at Eglin Air Force Base showed the system performs reliably in challenging conditions—including fog, rain, and wind—while maintaining accuracy thanks to advanced sensors, a telescope, and a wide-field infrared camera. Powered by lithium-ion batteries and a 60 kW diesel generator, HEL MD can operate continuously as long as fuel is supplied. The innovative control system uses a laptop and an Xbox controller, managed by a driver and operator. The HEL MD, mounted on an Oshkosh tactical vehicle, is the U.S. Army's first mobile directed energy weapon for countering rockets, artillery, mortars (C-RAM), and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Boeing's Dave DeYoung highlights that this technology can lower costs, as it eliminates the need for conventional munitions and extra personnel. In recent demonstrations, HEL MD destroyed over 150 airborne targets, including more than 90 mortar rounds and several UAVs, under simulated battlefield conditions where mortars are notoriously difficult to defend against. Future upgrades will boost the laser's strength to 50 or 100 kilowatts, enabling engagement of faster and farther targets. For example, a 100 kW laser is expected to neutralize threats much more quickly than the current version. While the system now engages only one target at a time, planned multi-laser arrays aim to protect against multiple threats simultaneously. The HEL MD previews the next era of military defense, offering agile and cost-efficient protection for troops and bases against evolving threats like drones and cruise missiles.

article_content: Cricket legend Kapil Dev extended heartfelt support to Indian skipper Rohit Sharma after India’s defeat in the World Cup final. During the clash at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Rohit got India off to a flying start with an aggressive 47 from 31 balls, but was dismissed by Glenn Maxwell’s bowling with a sharp catch from Travis Head. Following his wicket, India’s run rate stalled and scoring became challenging for the rest of the lineup. Despite the loss, Kapil Dev’s Instagram message urged Rohit and the team to stay positive, underlining the nation’s pride and backing. Kapil wrote, ‘You’ve played like champions. Heads up, boys. The trophy was the goal, but you’ve still made the country proud. Rohit, you’re a master – there’s more success ahead. Keep your spirits up, India is with you.’ Rohit Sharma candidly admitted, ‘It wasn’t our day. We put in our all, but batting got easier later on. That’s no excuse, though – we didn’t post enough runs. Our seamers got early wickets, but Australia’s partnership turned it around. Full credit to them.’ India was bowled out for 240 in 50 overs—Sharma, Kohli (54 off 63), and KL Rahul (66 off 107) registered the top scores. Australia’s bowlers excelled, with Starc taking 3/55, Cummins 2/34, Hazlewood 2/60, and both Zampa and Maxwell claiming a wicket. In response, Australia recovered from 47/3 to win by six wickets, thanks to a dominant 137 from Travis Head and a steady 58 from Marnus Labuschagne. Next up, both teams will face off again in a five-match T20 series starting Thursday in Visakhapatnam.

article_content: Sydney (CNN) -- In 1981, Tony Abbott, then a recent graduate from Sydney University, backpacked across India and described it as 'a country of contrasts, where bullock carts would take supplies into nuclear power stations.' Now, as opinion polls suggest Abbott could become Australia’s next prime minister after the national election on September 7, he is prepared to allow Australian uranium to fuel those power stations—a move welcomed in New Delhi. Abbott, who spent six weeks at the Australian Jesuit mission in Bihar during his time in India, leads the conservative Liberal-National opposition, currently challenging the Labor government led by incumbent Prime Minister Kevin Rudd. Uranium policy is a key difference between the two leaders' approaches to India. Australia has about one-third of the world's recoverable low-cost uranium resources and exports the fuel to countries including China, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, the United States, Canada, and the European Union—but not yet to India. Both major Australian parties claim support for selling uranium to India, but Rudd, during his first term as Prime Minister (2007-2010), insisted on stringent conditions, citing India’s non-signatory status to the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT). Rudd maintained this approach was a global policy, not specifically against India. In 2011, when then-Prime Minister Julia Gillard pushed for a policy change to permit uranium sales to India, Rudd was not consulted. Rudd also argues India currently sources most of its uranium from Russia, France, and Kazakhstan, and does not need Australian uranium. In contrast, Abbott has expressed his willingness to export uranium to India, citing the country’s status as a major democracy. At the India Australia Friendship Fair in Sydney, he stated, 'Yes, we will sell uranium to India because we know that India is one of the world's great democracies.' Any uranium sales remain years away; negotiations around a civil nuclear cooperation agreement are ongoing, and India must guarantee it will not use Australian uranium for weapons. Rudd’s focus has historically included China—he speaks Mandarin and formerly served as a diplomat in Beijing—while Abbott has said he will prioritize India as a key partner if elected. Abbott has highlighted India's rising global status, noting its rapidly growing economy and projected population growth, and describing it as Asia’s emerging democratic and English-speaking superpower. Australia-India relations have generally strengthened since their low in 2009-10, when uranium policy and a series of attacks on South Asian students in Melbourne strained ties. India has also become one of Australia’s largest sources of new immigrants and continues to send many students. Trade and investment have risen; India is Australia’s fourth biggest export market, mainly for coal, gold, and copper, and has invested significantly in the Australian mining sector. A 'strategic partnership' started in 2009 and moved forward with high-level visits and ongoing free trade agreement talks. However, no Indian prime minister has visited Australia since Rajiv Gandhi in 1986, while there have been several Australian prime ministerial visits to India. When invited to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in Perth in 2011, Indian PM Singh sent Vice President Hamid Ansari instead. Some analysts suggest that Australia remains a lower strategic priority for India, which faces more immediate regional concerns, while for Australia, India ranks among its top priorities in Asia. If Abbott wins, Australia is expected to focus even more on India; if Rudd remains, the relationship will likely remain steady. Nonetheless, uranium will likely remain a challenging issue between the two countries.

Şimdi, anketler Abbott’un 7 Eylül’deki genel seçimden sonra Avustralya’nın yeni başbakanı olacağını öngörürken, o da Avustralya uranyumunun bu santrallerde kullanılması için hazır—bu da Yeni Delhi’de memnuniyetle karşılanıyor. Abbott, Hindistan’da geçirdiği dönemde Bihar’daki Avustralya Cizvit misyonunda altı hafta kaldı; şu anda, görevdeki Başbakan Kevin Rudd’un liderliğindeki İşçi Partisi hükümetine karşı muhafazakâr Liberal-Ulusal muhalefetin lideri olarak yarışıyor. Uranyum politikası, iki liderin Hindistan’a yaklaşımlarında önemli bir fark ortaya koyuyor. Avustralya, dünyanın düşük maliyetli kurtarılabilir uranyum kaynaklarının yaklaşık üçte birine sahip ve bu yakıtı Çin, Japonya, Güney Kore, Tayvan, ABD, Kanada ve Avrupa Birliği’ne satıyor—ancak henüz Hindistan’a satmıyor. Her iki büyük Avustralya partisi de Hindistan’a uranyum satışını desteklediğini beyan etse de, Rudd ilk başbakanlığı sırasında (2007-2010) Hindistan’ın Nükleer Silahların Yayılmasının Önlenmesi Anlaşması’na (NPT) taraf olmamasını gerekçe göstererek sıkı koşulların uygulanmasında ısrar etti. Rudd, bu yaklaşımın özellikle Hindistan’a değil, küresel olarak uygulandığını belirtti. 2011’de, dönemin Başbakanı Julia Gillard uranyum satışını onaylatan politika değişikliğini önerdiğinde Rudd’a danışılmadı. Rudd, ayrıca Hindistan’ın uranyumunun çoğunu şu anda Rusya, Fransa ve Kazakistan’dan temin ettiğini ve Avustralya uranyumuna ihtiyacı olmadığını savunuyor. Buna karşın Abbott, Hindistan’a uranyum ihraç etmeye olumlu bakıyor ve ülkenin büyük bir demokrasi olduğunu öne sürüyor. Sydney’deki Hindistan-Avustralya Dostluk Fuarı’nda şöyle dedi: 'Evet, Hindistan’a uranyum satacağız çünkü Hindistan’ın dünyanın büyük demokrasilerinden biri olduğunu biliyoruz.' Uranyum satışı ise hâlâ yıllar uzakta; sivil nükleer iş birliği anlaşmasıyla ilgili müzakereler sürüyor ve Hindistan’ın Avustralya uranyumunu silah amaçlı kullanmayacağı taahhüdü gerekiyor. Rudd’un odağı tarihsel olarak Çin’e de kaymış durumda—Mandarin dilini konuşuyor ve Pekin’de diplomatlık yaptı; Abbott ise seçilirse Hindistan’a önemli bir ortak olarak öncelik vereceğini belirtiyor. Abbott, Hindistan’ın yükselen küresel statüsünü vurgulayarak, hızla büyüyen ekonomisi ve beklenen nüfus artışıyla, Asya’nın gelişmekte olan demokratik ve İngilizce konuşan süper gücü olarak nitelendiriyor. 2009-10’daki düşük seviyeden sonra Avustralya-Hindistan ilişkileri genel olarak güçlendi; o dönemde uranyum politikası ve Melbourne’deki Güney Asyalı öğrencilere saldırılar gerginliğe yol açmıştı. Hindistan, Avustralya’nın en büyük yeni göçmen kaynağı oldu ve Hintli öğrenci sayısı yüksek seviyede devam ediyor. Ticaret ve yatırımlar artmaya devam etti; Hindistan, Avustralya’nın başlıca kömür, altın ve bakır ihracat pazarı olarak dördüncü sırada ve Avustralya maden sektöründe önemli yatırımlar yaptı. 2009’da başlayan ‘stratejik ortaklık’ üst düzey ziyaretlerle ve devam eden serbest ticaret anlaşması görüşmeleri ile gelişiyor. Ancak, Rajiv Gandhi’den bu yana hiçbir Hint başbakanı Avustralya’yı ziyaret etmedi, buna karşın birkaç Avustralya başbakanı Hindistan’a gitti. 2011’de Perth’teki CHOGM toplantısına davet edilen Hint Başbakanı Singh, yerine Başkan Yardımcısı Hamid Ansari’yi gönderdi. Bazı yorumcular, Avustralya’nın Hindistan için bölgedeki diğer komşulara kıyasla daha düşük stratejik önceliğe sahip olduğunu, fakat Avustralya açısından Hindistan’ın Asya’daki öncelikli ülkelerden biri olarak görüldüğünü belirtiyor. Abbott seçilirse, Avustralya’nın Hindistan’a çok daha fazla öncelik vermesi bekleniyor; Rudd kalırsa ilişkinin istikrarlı devam edeceği öngörülüyor. Yine de, uranyum konusu iki ülke arasında süregelen bir gündem maddesi olmaya devam edecek.

article_content: At the Electronic Entertainment Expo (E3) in Los Angeles, the debate over whether video games are art seems settled—video games are celebrated as art. The 'Into the Pixel' exhibit, now in its eighth year, opened on Tuesday to showcase this creative side. It's a juried art show that aims to bridge the gap between video-game artists and the traditional art world. Nora Dolan, an independent curator with experience at major galleries like the Ansel Adams Museum and the Whitney Museum, served as one of this year's jurors. She said, 'There is no real distinction between video-game artists and the fine-art world. The quality here is outstanding.' Out of hundreds of submissions, seventeen images were selected for the show. After its debut at E3, the exhibit will travel to festivals and conventions worldwide. Themes in the show include dragons, spaceships, monsters, and heroes, but some pieces are more abstract and might not immediately be recognized as video-game art. For example, David Guertin's 'Oktonok Cay Cannery,' from 'Ratchet & Clank: All 4 One,' offers an abstract shipyard reminiscent of Salvador Dali. Andrew Kim's 'The Pelican,' from 'Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception,' is a detailed scene inside an atmospheric London pub. The prints are from games both large and independent. Some artworks were slightly adjusted for gallery display, but many were taken directly from game play. Tyler Breon's 'Cronos Battle,' from 'God of War III,' shows a towering monster looming over the main character. Breon, a senior character artist at Sony, said this was his first gallery showing. He compared the acceptance of video-game art to how comic-book art was viewed in the past—often dismissed at first but recognized over time. 'With exposure, people become more comfortable with new media,' he explained. Over the past year, video-game art has gained more recognition. The Smithsonian Institution has announced 'The Art of Video Games' exhibition, which will open in 2012, and the National Endowment for the Arts has added video games to its list of media eligible for government funding. Martin Rae, president of the Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences and one of the 'Into the Pixel' sponsors, said, 'We now see governmental recognition that our work is art.' Rae likened the progression of video-game art to photography, which also struggled for acceptance before being recognized as an art form. By bringing video game art to traditional galleries and public exhibits, Rae and others hope to accelerate this acceptance. 'Every time fine arts professionals see our industry’s work, they immediately recognize the exceptional talents of our artists,' Rae said.
translated_content: Los Angeles'taki Electronic Entertainment Expo (E3)'de, video oyunlarının sanat olup olmadığı tartışması sona ermiş görünüyor—video oyunları bir sanat dalı olarak kabul ediliyor. Sekizinci yılında olan 'Into the Pixel' sergisi, bu yaratıcı yönü göstermek için Salı günü açıldı. Jürili bu sanat sergisi, video oyunlarının sanatçılarıyla geleneksel sanat dünyası arasındaki köprüyü kurmayı amaçlıyor. Büyük galerilerde deneyime sahip bağımsız küratör Nora Dolan (Ansel Adams Müzesi ve Whitney Müzesi dahil), bu yılın jüri üyelerinden biriydi. Dolan, 'Video oyun sanatçıları ile güzel sanatlar dünyası arasında gerçek bir ayrım yok. Buradaki kalite olağanüstü,' dedi. Yüzlerce başvuru arasından on yedi eser seçildi. E3'teki açılışın ardından sergi, dünya çapında festivaller ve fuarlarda gezici olarak sergilenecek. Serginin temalarında ejderhalar, uzay gemileri, canavarlar ve kahramanlar öne çıkıyor; ancak bazı eserler daha soyut ve ilk bakışta video oyun sanatı olarak fark edilmeyebilir. Örneğin, David Guertin’in 'Oktonok Cay Cannery'si ('Ratchet & Clank: All 4 One' oyunundan), Salvador Dali’yi andıran soyut bir tersane sunuyor. Andrew Kim’in, 'Uncharted 3: Drake’s Deception'dan 'The Pelican' eseri ise atmosferik bir Londra pub'ının detaylı bir sahnesini resmediyor. Baskılar hem büyük yapımlı oyunlardan hem de bağımsız oyunlardan alınmış. Bazı eserler galeriye özel olarak hafifçe düzenlenmiş, pek çoğu ise doğrudan oyun oynanışından alınmış. Tyler Breon’un 'God of War III'deki ‘Cronos Battle’ eseri, ana karakterin tepesinde duran devasa bir canavarı gösteriyor. Sony’de kıdemli karakter sanatçısı olan Breon, bunun ilk galeri deneyimi olduğunu söyledi. Video oyun sanatının kabulünü, geçmişte çizgi roman sanatının başta ciddiye alınmamasına ama zamanla değer görmesine benzetti. 'Yeni medya ile insanlar ona maruz kaldıkça daha rahat hissediyor,' dedi. Geçtiğimiz yıl video oyun sanatı daha fazla tanınmaya başladı. Smithsonian Enstitüsü, 2012’de açılacak 'Video Oyunlarının Sanatı' adlı bir sergi duyurdu ve Ulusal Sanat Vakfı ise video oyunlarını devlet desteğine uygun medya listesine ekledi. 'Into the Pixel' destekçisi ve Interactive Arts & Sciences Akademisi başkanı Martin Rae, 'Artık hükümetin yaptıklarımızın sanat olduğunun farkında olduğunu görüyoruz,' dedi. Rae, video oyun sanatının kabul edilmesini, başlangıçta basit görülen fotoğrafçılığın zamanla sanat olarak kabul edilmesine benzetti. Rae ve diğerleri, video oyun sanatını geleneksel galerilere ve halka açık sergilere taşıyarak bu kabulün daha da hızlanmasını umuyor. Rae, 'Her seferinde güzel sanatlar sektöründen birileri, sektörümüzdeki sanatçılara hayran kalıyor,' dedi.

article_content: Borno State Governor Babagana Zulum has ordered the closure of the Internally Displaced Persons (IDP) camp at the Government Senior Science Secondary School in Monguno, northern Borno State. This brings the number of IDP camps closed in the state since 2018 to about 13. The Monguno camp, located about 120 km from Maiduguri, previously sheltered over 100,000 displaced people from Kukawa, Nganzai, Marte, and Guzamala local government areas following the Boko Haram insurgency. Recent investigations report increased threats from terrorists, as arms and fighters from Sahel ISIS have strengthened ISWAP near the Lake Chad basin, targeting Monguno, Marte, and Abadan for possible attacks. Governor Zulum stated that, with improved security in some communities, closing the Monguno IDP camp will allow for rehabilitation of the school, paving the way for academic activities to resume. During a visit to the camp, Zulum assessed damage caused by Boko Haram attacks and prolonged occupancy by displaced people. He said that IDPs will be relocated to 1,000 new resettlement houses built in Monguno for those affected by the decade-long insurgency. These 1,000 houses are part of more than 10,000 resettlement homes constructed under Zulum’s administration since 2019. The governor noted that IDPs from relatively peaceful communities, such as Kekeno, Mile 90, and Yoyo, will be allowed to return home. Each returning IDP will be provided with a resettlement package to help rebuild their lives. Governor Zulum affirmed the government’s commitment to supporting voluntary returnees and emphasized continued efforts to restore peace, rebuild infrastructure, and assist communities affected by insurgency.
translated_content: Borno Eyaleti Valisi Babagana Zulum, Borno’nun kuzeyindeki Monguno’daki Hükümet Kıdemli Fen Lisesi’nde bulunan Yerinden Edilmiş Kişiler (YEK) kampının kapatılmasını emretti. Bu, 2018’den bu yana eyalette kapatılan YEK kamplarının sayısını yaklaşık 13’e çıkardı. Monguno kampı, Maiduguri’ye yaklaşık 120 km uzaklıkta olup, Boko Haram isyanı nedeniyle Kukawa, Nganzai, Marte ve Guzamala yerel yönetim alanlarından gelen 100.000’den fazla yerinden edilmiş kişiye geçici barınak sağlamıştı. Son araştırmalar, Sahel’deki IŞİD’den gelen silah ve savaşçı akışı sayesinde, ISWAP’ın Çad Gölü havzası civarında güçlendiğini ve teröristlerin Monguno, Marte ve Abadan’ı olası saldırılar için hedef aldığını bildiriyor. Vali Zulum, bazı topluluklarda güvenliğin iyileşmesiyle birlikte Monguno YEK kampının kapatılmasının okulun onarılmasına imkân tanıyacağını ve böylece eğitim faaliyetlerinin yeniden başlayabileceğini belirtti. Kampa yaptığı ziyarette Zulum, Boko Haram saldırıları ve yerinden edilmiş kişilerin uzun süreli kullanımı nedeniyle meydana gelen tahribatı inceledi. YEK’lerin, on yıldan uzun süren isyandan etkilenenler için Monguno’da inşa edilen 1.000 yeni yerleşim evine taşınacağını söyledi. Bu 1.000 ev, Zulum yönetimi tarafından 2019’dan bu yana inşa edilen 10.000’den fazla yerleşim konutunun bir parçasıdır. Vali, Kekeno, Mile 90 ve Yoyo gibi nispeten güvenli topluluklardan gelen YEK’lerin evlerine dönebileceğini açıkladı. Dönen her YEK’ye, hayatlarını yeniden kurmaları için bir yerleşim paketi sağlanacak. Vali Zulum, hükümetin gönüllü geri dönenleri destekleme taahhüdünü yineledi ve huzurun yeniden sağlanması, altyapının inşası ve isyandan etkilenen topluluklara yardım çalışmalarının devam ettiğini vurguladı.

article_content: BEIJING — A Chinese government official from the Tibetan region on Friday dismissed allegations of forced assimilation and restrictions on religious freedom, emphasizing that Tibetan Buddhism should adapt to the Chinese context. Xu Zhitao, vice chairman of the regional government, defended the boarding school system, which overseas activists claim separates children from their families and communities. He said that these schools are designed to improve educational access for children in remote areas. “The claim that Tibetan children are forced to attend boarding schools is a deliberate smear,” Xu said at a news conference presenting an official report on Communist Party policies in Tibet. The report highlighted economic development, social stability, and environmental protection under party rule. Infrastructure projects, such as highways and high-speed railways, have been built to support tourism and boost local incomes. However, activists and some Western governments accuse China of human rights violations and suppressing Tibetan culture to prevent separatism. This year, the boarding schools received criticism from U.N. human rights experts and the U.S. government, which announced visa restrictions on officials involved. Although such schools exist elsewhere in China, they are reportedly more common in Tibet. Xu maintained that these schools are essential for sparsely populated, remote regions. “If schools are too spread out, it is difficult to recruit enough teachers or guarantee quality education,” he said. “It is necessary to balance boarding and day schools to ensure educational quality and equal rights.” He added that the government manages religious matters related to state and public interests, but does not interfere in the internal affairs of religious groups. “We must continue to adapt religious practices to the Chinese context and guide Tibetan Buddhism to fit socialist society, helping it better suit China’s realities,” Xu stated. The English version of the official report referred to the region as Xizang instead of Tibet, reflecting the government’s increasing use of ‘Xizang’ in English documents.
translated_content: PEKİN — Çin’in Tibet bölgesinden bir hükümet yetkilisi, Cuma günü zorla asimilasyon ve dini özgürlüklerin kısıtlandığı iddialarını reddetti; bunun yerine Tibet Budizmi’nin Çin bağlamına uyum sağlaması gerektiğini vurguladı. Bölge hükümeti başkan yardımcısı Xu Zhitao, yurtdışındaki aktivistlerin yatılı okulların çocukları ailelerinden ve topluluklarından ayırdığı yönündeki iddialarına karşı çıkarak, bu okulların uzak bölgelerdeki çocuklar için eğitim erişimini geliştirmek üzere tasarlandığını söyledi. “Tibetli çocukların zorla yatılı okula gönderildiği iddiası kasıtlı bir karalamadır,” dedi Xu, Komünist Parti’nin Tibet politikalarına dair resmi bir raporu sunduğu basın toplantısında. Raporda, parti yönetimi altındaki ekonomik kalkınma, toplumsal istikrar ve çevre koruması vurgulandı. Altyapı projeleri kapsamında otoyollar ve hızlı trenler inşa edildi, turizmi desteklemek ve yerel gelirleri artırmak hedeflendi. Ancak aktivistler ve bazı Batılı hükümetler, Çin’i insan hakları ihlalleriyle ve Tibet kültürünü bastırmakla suçluyor. Bu yıl yatılı okullar, BM insan hakları uzmanları ve ABD hükümeti tarafından da eleştirildi; ABD, yatılı okullar ile ilgili yetkililere vize kısıtlamaları getirdi. Bu tür okullar Çin’in başka bölgelerinde de olmasına rağmen, Tibet’te daha yaygın olduğu bildiriliyor. Xu, bu okulların seyrek nüfuslu ve uzak bölgeler için zorunlu olduğunu belirtti. “Okullar çok yaygın olursa, yeterli öğretmen bulmak ve kaliteli eğitim sağlamak zor olur,” dedi. “Yatılı ve gündüzlü okullar arasında denge kurulmalı, eğitim kalitesi ve çocukların eşit hakları sağlanmalı.” Ayrıca hükümetin, devlet ve kamu çıkarlarıyla ilgili dini konuları yönettiğini, ancak dini grupların iç işlerine müdahale etmediğini ekledi. “Dini uygulamaları Çin’e uygun hale getirmeye ve Tibet Budizmi’ni sosyalist topluma uyumlu hale getirmeye devam etmeliyiz; böylece Tibet Budizmi Çin’in gerçeklerine daha iyi uyum sağlayabilir,” dedi Xu. Resmi raporun İngilizce versiyonunda bölge için Tibet yerine ‘Xizang’ adının kullanıldığı ve hükümetin İngilizce belgelerde bu adı giderek daha fazla tercih ettiği belirtildi.

article_content: The Petroleum and Natural Gas Senior Staff Association of Nigeria (PENGASSAN) has expressed optimism that local refining will help lower the current price of petroleum products in the country. Nnanna Okeke, Port Harcourt Zonal Secretary, stated this on Tuesday in Uyo at the opening of a three-day leadership retreat for zonal executives, organized by the Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board (NCDMB) and Facilitation and Training Services Limited. Okeke reported that the Federal Government has assured them that the Port Harcourt Refinery will commence operations by December. He emphasized that repairing local refineries and providing palliatives were priorities for the association to mitigate the negative effects of fuel subsidy removal. He said, 'As an association, we are not against fuel subsidy removal. However, we requested that specific measures be put in place to reduce the impact on citizens if the subsidy is removed. We requested palliative support and improvements to the public transport system, as workers need reliable ways to get to their jobs. Additionally, we urged the government to ensure our refineries become fully operational.' Okeke expressed hope that local refining would reduce dependency on fuel imports and help decrease prices. 'The Federal Government has promised that the Port Harcourt Refinery will be functional by December. We believe this will help lower fuel prices. We sympathize with the general public, as everyone is affected by these changes,' he said. Asked about the association’s response if the refinery does not begin operations by December, Okeke explained, 'We will revisit our strategy. Our national leadership told us that the Federal Government intends to deliver on this promise, so for now, we are giving the government the benefit of the doubt.' Olumide Ajomale, Chief Executive Officer of Facilitation and Training Services Limited, commented that the retreat was designed to enhance the leadership abilities of PENGASSAN’s zonal leaders. 'It provides an opportunity for officers to come together and learn about modern leadership challenges, communication, employment law, and industrial relations in the oil and gas industry,' he noted. Ajomale added that improved skills among union leaders would enable more effective management within their organizations. 'Continuous learning is vital as the sector changes. Well-informed leaders with proper skills can produce better outcomes and manage resources efficiently in a changing environment,' he concluded.
translated_content: Nijerya Petrol ve Doğalgaz Kıdemli Personel Derneği (PENGASSAN), yerel rafinajın ülkedeki petrol ürünleri fiyatlarını düşüreceğine dair iyimserliğini dile getirdi. Port Harcourt Bölge Sekreteri Nnanna Okeke, bu açıklamayı Uyo'da, Nijerya Yerel İçerik Geliştirme ve İzleme Kurulu (NCDMB) ile Facilitation and Training Services Limited'in düzenlediği üç günlük liderlik çalıştayının açılışında yaptı. Yerel rafinerilerin onarılması ve destek paketlerinin sağlanmasının, yakıt sübvansiyonunun kaldırılması sonrası olumsuz etkilerin azaltılması için öncelikleri olduğunu vurguladı. 'Bir dernek olarak yakıt sübvansiyonunun kaldırılmasına karşı değiliz. Ancak sübvansiyon kalkacaksa vatandaşların etkilenmemesi için belirli önlemlerin alınmasını talep ettik. Destek paketleri sağlanmasını ve çalışanların işe gidebilmesi için toplu taşımanın iyileştirilmesini istedik. Ayrıca, rafinerilerimizin tam kapasiteyle çalışmasını istedik.' dedi. 'Federal Hükümet Port Harcourt Rafinerisi'nin Aralık'ta faaliyete geçeceğine söz verdi. Bunun yakıt fiyatlarını düşüreceğine inanıyoruz. Ulusal liderliğimiz Federal Hükümet'in taahhüdüne güvendiğini iletti; şimdilik hükümete güveniyoruz.' şeklinde yanıt verdi. article_content: Kim Jong Il, who led North Korea for nearly twenty years after succeeding his father, has died at the age of 69, according to state media reports on Monday. Authorities in Pyongyang announced that Kim died on Saturday morning from a heart attack, said to be brought on by intense stress during a train journey on official business. KCNA indicated that Kim had a history of heart and brain ailments. Despite medical interventions, he could not be revived. His funeral is scheduled for December 28, with a national mourning period lasting until December 29. The government has notified citizens, party members, and the military about his death. In reaction, South Korea heightened security alerts for its military and police. President Lee Myung-bak canceled his appointments and oversaw emergency meetings. Authorities emphasized vigilance and are closely monitoring the North. The United States stated it is closely tracking developments, staying in contact with South Korea and Japan, and reaffirmed its dedication to stability in the region. Kim Jong Il had ruled since 1994 after the passing of his father, Kim Il Sung, the country’s founder. His leadership was characterized by international isolation, tense foreign relations, and domestic crises, including famine. Rumors about Kim's health and preparations for his son Kim Jong Un to inherit power have been ongoing, with the latter recently taking on more prominent responsibilities. North Korea had planned an extensive year-long celebration in 2012 to mark the 100th anniversary of Kim Il Sung’s birth and to bolster the image of national strength. During Kim’s rule, severe food shortages led to dependence on foreign aid, following widespread famine. While there were efforts at dialogue with South Korea and other nations, provocations such as the attack on Yeonpyeong strained relations. The country’s pursuit of nuclear weapons and missile capabilities has been a continued source of concern for the international community. U.S. Defense Secretary Leon Panetta recently identified North Korean WMDs as a grave threat. Experts assert Kim Jong Un is clearly positioned as successor, yet warn that sustaining unity without Kim Jong Il’s leadership may be difficult. The regime’s long-term stability remains uncertain.

article_content: Four days after winning Wimbledon, Novak Djokovic married his pregnant fiancée, Jelena Ristic, in a private ceremony in Montenegro. The couple were wed on Thursday at a luxury resort on the Adriatic coast. Local media reported that the intimate celebration was attended by family, friends, and notable guests, away from the public eye. Tennis legend Boris Becker attended the event, along with Viktor Troicki, Janko Tipsarevic and his wife Biljana, and Djokovic's brothers Djordje and Marko. Despite light rain, guests were seen enjoying themselves. Jelena looked radiant in a flowing printed maxi-dress, while Novak, fresh off his Wimbledon win against Roger Federer, celebrated with loved ones. Djokovic dedicated his Wimbledon title to Jelena and their future baby. The couple have been together for over eight years, after meeting in high school, and are expecting their first child later this year. The wedding was held at the exclusive Sveti Stefan resort, managed by Aman Resorts. Venue staff reportedly signed confidentiality agreements and were not permitted to use mobile phones during the event. The celebrations featured both family gatherings and time by the sea, with close friends and relatives preparing for the occasion. Djokovic's wedding concluded what has been an extraordinary week for the tennis star, following his second Wimbledon championship.

article_content: In India, the healthcare industry has been found to be the top violator of advertising standards, based on a half-yearly assessment by the Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI). Healthcare-related ads, particularly those promoting drugs and medicines on digital platforms, made up 21% of all scrutinized advertisements between April and September. ASCI investigated 3,501 complaints in this timeframe, with digital media responsible for nearly 80% of the problematic ads. Meanwhile, print accounted for 17% and television for just 3%. The report from ASCI highlighted a 34% increase in processed complaints, totaling 4,491, alongside a 27% jump in ads reviewed compared to the last year. A notable number of these advertisements violated regulations, especially those making illegal 'magic remedy' claims—16% of the ads reviewed fell into this group, up by 22% from the previous fiscal year. These types of ads directly contravene the Drug and Magic Remedies Act of 1954. In response, ASCI has issued notices advising advertisers to withdraw or amend such content. Additionally, 565 misleading advertisements were referred to the Ministry of AYUSH in the last six months, up from 464 in the prior year. Manisha Kapoor, ASCI's CEO and secretary-general, underscored the organization's ongoing dedication to addressing digital ad challenges and urged all stakeholders to join forces in protecting online consumer safety.

Özellikle dijital platformlarda ilaç ve tıbbi ürün tanıtımları, Nisan-Eylül ayları arasında incelenen reklamların %21'ini oluşturdu. article_content: On Tuesday, the BBC stated that two additional individuals have made complaints about Russell Brand amid its ongoing review into his conduct. This update means the broadcaster has recorded five complaints related to Brand, whose actions came under renewed scrutiny after media reports last September revealed four women had accused him of sexual assault between 2006 and 2013, during the height of his public profile. Brand, who is now 48, has denied these allegations. His tenure at the BBC as a radio presenter lasted from 2006 to 2008. The broadcaster clarified that two complaints were submitted during or shortly after Brand’s time with them, while another was made after he left. Following the launch of the BBC’s investigation in September, two more complaints were received. BBC News reported that these latest complaints are understood to concern workplace behavior rather than serious sexual misconduct. Allegations detailed by the press include one woman who says Brand sexually assaulted her while she was 16 and another who alleges he raped her in Los Angeles in 2012. The accusers remain anonymous. One claim also asserts Brand used BBC vehicles to drive a 16-year-old female from her school to his home, but the BBC indicated it no longer retains vehicle booking records from that era. According to Peter Johnston, director of editorial complaints, the investigation remains in progress, and no disciplinary action was taken against Brand during his employment. Additionally, both the Metropolitan Police and Thames Valley Police have launched investigations. Brand has maintained that all his relationships were consensual.

article_content: Kathleen Fitzgerald and Lizzy Showman are students at the School of Visual Arts in New York City. For a class project, they were challenged to see how their design skills could make a difference in someone's life. Because they both commute by bus, they decided to thank the M15 bus route drivers by creating and distributing custom-designed seat cushions. On November 18, 2011, they handed out more than 50 cushions to bus drivers, with Jeremiah Fabre photographing their reactions. The students felt their project was a success, demonstrating that small gestures can have a big impact. Fitzgerald and Showman shared their experience in a joint email interview with CNN. Below are highlights from the Q&A. CNN: How did it start? Fitzgerald and Showman: This project began as part of Stefan Sagmeister's class, 'Can Design Touch Someone’s Heart?' Our audience was a group we didn't know personally. During our first year at the School of Visual Arts, we realized we both commute daily on the M15, one of the busiest bus routes in North America with over 16.5 million annual riders. We saw bus drivers as a group who often go unnoticed, making them our focus for the project. CNN: Describe what you did. Fitzgerald and Showman: The work M15 bus drivers do often goes unrecognized, so we wanted to show our appreciation. As graduate design students, we made custom seat cushions to help make their rides more comfortable. We also encouraged riders and drivers to share their experiences on a social network site dedicated to the M15, where people could thank drivers and share commute stories. CNN: Why is it important? Fitzgerald and Showman: This project is important because it shines a light on an often-overlooked group and inspires others to show gratitude. We hope our efforts spark similar acts in other cities and create a broader movement of appreciation. CNN: How are you making an impact? Fitzgerald and Showman: We've received enthusiastic feedback through our blog and platforms such as CNN iReport. We believe our project encourages people to thank bus drivers and other service workers. We plan to expand to all 400+ M15 drivers and eventually reach other NYC bus routes. We will soon launch a Kickstarter to further support our efforts. CNN: Why should other people get involved? Fitzgerald and Showman: Showing appreciation for those who serve our communities fosters a better environment for everyone. Our efforts to raise awareness have been welcomed by the bus community, and we hope more commuters and cities will join in expressing thanks. We invite others to share how they impact their world on CNN iReport.

article_content: After spending a decade in prison, Mikhail Khodorkovsky says he sees time differently. The former Russian oligarch—unexpectedly pardoned by President Vladimir Putin in December 2013—is currently visiting Washington, sharing his insights with associates from his Moscow days, before his oil company Yukos was seized and his estimated $15 billion fortune lost. Following his release from a Siberian labor camp—where he served 10 years on tax evasion, embezzlement, and money laundering charges he denies—Khodorkovsky has generally avoided direct involvement in Russian domestic politics. Nevertheless, he has sharply criticized Putin’s handling of Ukraine, accusing the Russian president of ignoring major global challenges and using his position for personal retribution. Khodorkovsky is now reviving Open Russia, an organization he launched in 2001 to encourage the growth of civic institutions in Russia. The government shut down Open Russia in 2006 and froze its bank accounts, but Khodorkovsky now aims to unite Russians with a 'European mindset,' whom he estimates to be about 12% of the population. Currently, the environment for civic engagement in Russia remains challenging. Opposition protests against Putin in 2011-2012—which drew tens of thousands of demonstrators disputing alleged parliamentary election fraud—fizzled out, with many movement leaders detained or placed under house arrest. Though new protests erupted in 2014 over Russian military action in Ukraine, turnout was smaller. Stringent laws now limit demonstrations and the registration of political parties, while tighter restrictions on NGOs that receive foreign funding have led to accusations of being 'foreign agents.' Given these realities, Khodorkovsky argues that the opposition has little chance of prevailing in the 2016 elections. He estimates only a 10% chance Putin will lose power within two years, unless he makes a major mistake—which, in Khodorkovsky’s view, has yet to happen. Despite Western sanctions over Crimea and Ukraine, Putin’s narrative that 'hostile Americans' are punishing Russia for its independence still resonates with many citizens. A stoic attitude and historical endurance of hardship remain powerful forces in Russian society. Putin has cultivated nationalism and resentment among Russians after the Soviet Union’s collapse. There are concerns this government-fueled resentment, supported by state-run propaganda, is dangerous and potentially uncontrollable—even by Putin. Some nationalist supporters encourage more severe measures, raising the risk of unchecked anger. Khodorkovsky insists he does not plan to create a political party, citing previous failures and rapid government crackdown on such groups. Instead, he envisions a more flexible model, similar to how American political alliances organize temporarily during election campaigns. He does not announce any presidential ambitions, but says he is willing to represent pro-European Russians politically. 'I will give it a try,' he says, acknowledging uncertainty about success. Khodorkovsky’s public image is complex: many Russians see him as a billionaire who profited disproportionately during the turbulent post-Soviet years, and some of Putin’s allies accuse him of past vendettas during his rise. Skepticism persists even among liberal Russians. In Washington, Khodorkovsky says his goal is to help others understand his actions and challenge the notion that 'it is better to accept a known Putin than an unknown alternative.' He believes there is a 90% chance Putin will leave office within the next 20 years, but doubts the transition will be democratic. Putin’s popularity is attributed to high oil prices and rising incomes for both average Russians and those close to the government, especially in energy sectors. During the Ukraine crisis, Putin has also fueled fears about NATO and Western aggression. Whether someone like Khodorkovsky would want—or be able—to lead Russia through future changes remains unclear. He notes, 'I hope they find someone else. People leading transitions often end up in jail, and I have had enough of that.'
translated_content: On yıl hapiste kaldıktan sonra, Mikhail Khodorkovsky zamanı farklı görmeye başladığını söylüyor. Eski Rus oligarkı—Başkan Vladimir Putin tarafından Aralık 2013'te beklenmedik bir şekilde affedildi—şu sıralar Washington'da, Moskova'daki eski dostlarına, petrol şirketi Yukos'a el konulmadan ve 15 milyar dolarlık servetini kaybetmeden önceki düşüncelerini paylaşıyor. Vergi kaçakçılığı, zimmete para geçirme ve kara para aklama suçlamalarını reddeden Khodorkovsky, Sibirya'daki on yıllık mahkumiyetinin ardından serbest bırakıldıktan sonra genellikle Rusya'nın iç siyasetinde aktif olmaktan kaçındı. Yine de Putin'in Ukrayna politikasını sert şekilde eleştiriyor ve onu önemli küresel sorunları görmezden gelmekle ve makamını kişisel intikam için kullanmakla suçluyor. Khodorkovsky şimdi 2001 yılında Rusya'da sivil toplumun gelişimini desteklemek için kurduğu Open Russia hareketini yeniden canlandırıyor. 2006'da hükümet tarafından kapatılan ve hesapları dondurulan Open Russia şimdi 'Avrupai zihniyete sahip' Rusları bir araya getirmeye çalışıyor; bu grubu nüfusun yaklaşık %12'si olarak tahmin ediyor. Şu anda Rusya'da sivil katılımın koşulları oldukça zorlu. 2011-2012'de Putin'e karşı seçim yolsuzluğu iddiasıyla gerçekleştirilen ve on binlerce kişinin katıldığı protestolar zamanla etkisini kaybetti; liderlerin çoğu ev hapsine alındı ya da tutuklandı. 2014 yılındaki Ukrayna'ya askeri müdahaleye karşı protestolar ise daha az kalabalıktı. Gösteri ve siyasi parti kuruluşunu kısıtlayan yeni yasaların yanı sıra yurt dışından fon alan STK'lara karşı 'yabancı ajan' suçlamaları arttı. Bu koşullar altında Khodorkovsky, muhalefetin 2016 seçimlerinde başarı şansının düşük olduğunu savunuyor. Putin’in iki yıl içinde gücü kaybetme olasılığını yalnızca %10 olarak görüyor, bunun için büyük bir hata yapması gerektiğini düşünüyor ve şimdiye kadar böyle bir hata olmadığını belirtiyor. Kırım ve Ukrayna nedeniyle uygulanan Batı yaptırımlarına rağmen, Putin'in 'Rusya'nın bağımsızlığını' cezalandırmaya çalışan 'kötü Amerikalılar' anlatısı toplumda yankı buluyor. Tarihsel dayanıklılık ve stoacılık da halen Rusya’da önemli bir etki. Putin, Sovyetler Birliği'nin çöküşü sonrası milliyetçiliği ve toplumsal kırgınlığı körükledi. Devlet destekli bu duygular ve propagandanın tehlikeli ve Putin’in bile kontrol edemeyeceği bir noktaya ulaşabileceği kaygısı var. Daha aşırı milliyetçi çevreler de Putin’i daha sert adımlar atmaya teşvik ediyor. Khodorkovsky, geçmişteki başarısızlıklar ve devletin hızlı müdahaleleri nedeniyle siyasi parti kurma düşüncesinde değil. Onun modeli, Amerikan seçimlerindeki gibi, geçici siyasi ittifaklarla sorunlara çözüm aramak. Cumhurbaşkanlığı adaylığı düşünmüyor, ama Avrupai değerlere inanan Ruslar adına siyasi temsilci olmaya istekli. 'Deneyeceğim ama olur mu bilmiyorum,' diyor. Khodorkovsky'nin imajı karmaşık: Pek çok Rus onu zenginliğini hızlıca elde etmiş biri olarak görürken, Kremlin yanlıları ise eski iş rakiplerine karşı intikam güttüğünü öne sürüyor. Liberal Rusların bile tereddütleri var. Khodorkovsky, Washington'da insanlara ne yaptığını anlatmaya ve 'bilinen Putin, bilinmeyen alternatife tercih edilir' anlayışına karşı çıkmaya çalıştığını söylüyor. Putin’in önümüzdeki 20 yıl içinde görevi bırakma olasılığını %90 görüyor; ama bunun demokratik olmayacağı kanaatinde. Putin’in popülaritesi yüksek petrol fiyatları ve hem sıradan Ruslar hem de hükümete yakın enerji sektörü yöneticilerinin artan gelirleriyle ilişkilendiriliyor. Ukrayna krizinde ise NATO ve Batı tehdidi vurgulanıyor. Putin sonrası dönemde Khodorkovsky gibi birinin lider olup olmayacağı, onun isteyip istemeyeceği belirsiz. 'Umarım başkası çıkar, çünkü böyle geçişlerin liderleri genellikle hapse giriyor—benim bundan fazlasına tahammülüm yok,' diyor.

article_content: John Lennon, known for his iconic song 'Yellow Submarine,' once owned an actual yellow gypsy caravan adorned with psychedelic designs. In the 1960s, Lennon and his family used the caravan for holidays. After Lennon's death in 1980, fellow Beatle Ringo Starr inherited the vehicle. Eventually, it was left by the swimming pool at Starr's former house in Cranleigh, Surrey, and faded from public view as it fell into neglect. Unlike Lennon's famous psychedelic Rolls Royce, now displayed in a New York museum, the caravan remained largely forgotten. It was recently rediscovered still resting beside the pool at its last known location. Alan Carr, a charity fundraiser from Ascot, has now been entrusted with the restoration of the caravan, aiming to use its story to raise money for charities. There is hope that, once restored, it could be displayed in a Liverpool museum, recognizing its Beatles heritage. Lennon bought the caravan in 1967 for his son Julian's fourth birthday. Styled in the vibrant artwork characteristic of the Beatles’ 'Sgt. Pepper' era, it was repainted in Chertsey and brought to Tittenhurst Park, Lennon's home in Ascot. The caravan made its own 'Magical Mystery Tour,' traveling to Dorinish Island in Ireland before returning to Ascot. After Lennon's passing, Ringo Starr discovered the caravan in disrepair and commissioned vintage restorer John Pockett for repairs in the 1980s. After restoration, it was again left by Starr's pool, out of the public eye. The rediscovery of the caravan has inspired new plans for its restoration, celebrating its place in rock and roll history and supporting charitable causes.
translated_content: John Lennon, ikonik şarkısı 'Yellow Submarine' ile tanınan müzisyen, bir zamanlar psikodelik desenlerle süslenmiş sarı bir çingene karavanına sahipti. 1960'larda Lennon ve ailesi bu karavanı tatillerde kullandı. Lennon'un 1980'deki ölümünden sonra, bir diğer Beatle olan Ringo Starr bu aracı miras aldı. Sonunda, Starr'ın Cranleigh, Surrey'deki eski evinin havuz kenarına bırakıldı ve bakımsız kaldığı için gözlerden uzak kaldı. Lennon'un ünlü psikodelik Rolls Royce'u şu anda New York'taki bir müzede sergilenirken, karavan büyük ölçüde unutulmuştu. Ancak yakın zamanda, son bilinen yerinde, havuz kenarında yeniden keşfedildi. Ascot'tan hayırsever Alan Carr, şimdi karavanın restorasyonundan sorumlu oldu ve bu hikayeyi hayır kurumları için bağış toplamak amacıyla kullanmayı hedefliyor. Karavan restore edildikten sonra, Beatles mirasına atıfla Liverpool'daki bir müzede sergilenmesi umut ediliyor. Lennon, bu karavanı 1967'de oğlu Julian'ın dördüncü doğum günü için satın aldı. Beatles'ın 'Sgt. Pepper' döneminin canlı sanat eserleriyle bezenmiş şekilde Chertsey'de yeniden boyandı ve Lennon'un Ascot'taki evi olan Tittenhurst Park'a getirildi. Karavan, Dorinish Adası'na (İrlanda) yaptığı bir yolculuktan sonra Ascot'a döndü. Lennon'un ölümünden sonra Ringo Starr karavanı kötü durumda buldu ve 1980'lerde vintage restoratör John Pockett’e tamir ettirdi. Onarımdan sonra tekrar Starr’ın havuz kenarında bırakıldı ve kamuoyundan uzak kaldı. Karavanın yeniden keşfi, rock'n roll tarihindeki yerini onurlandıracak ve hayır kurumlarını destekleyecek şekilde yeni bir restorasyon sürecini başlattı.

Lee Tyers, a 40-year-old from Yarm, has been sentenced to two weeks in jail for attempting to dodge a restaurant bill through fraud. At Teesside Magistrates Court, it was revealed that Tyers had eaten a full meal at Jamal's Indian Restaurant in Middlesbrough before claiming he found a hair in his food and refusing to pay the £39.55 bill. CCTV footage showed Tyers placing his hand down his trousers and then into his dish, indicating he had planted the hair himself.

Jamal Chowdhury, the restaurant owner, testified that Tyers had been a customer for 18 years and already owed £110 for previous unpaid meals. Chowdhury offered to ignore the old debt if Tyers paid for his current meal. Tyers and a companion ordered several items, made their complaint after eating, and left without paying.

In court, Tyers and his friend insisted they tried to pay but that Chowdhury declined, demanding the total amount owed. Prosecutors argued that CCTV evidence showed no attempt to pay and no physical evidence of the hair was kept. Tyers was found guilty of fraud by false representation and ordered to pay £39.55 in compensation in addition to his jail sentence.

Yarm'dan 40 yaşındaki Lee Tyers, bir restoran faturasını dolandırıcılıkla ödememeye çalıştığı için iki hafta hapis cezasına çarptırıldı. Teesside Sulh Ceza Mahkemesi'nde ortaya konan bilgilere göre, Tyers Middlesbrough'daki Jamal's Indian Restaurant'ta bir öğünü tamamen yedikten sonra yemeğinde bir saç bulduğunu iddia ederek 39,55 sterlinlik hesabı ödemeyi reddetti. Güvenlik kamerası görüntüleri, Tyers'ın elini pantolonuna soktuğunu ve ardından tabağına dokunduğunu göstererek, saçı kendisinin koyduğunu ortaya çıkardı.

Restoran sahibi Jamal Chowdhury, Tyers'ın 18 yıldır müşterisi olduğunu ve daha önceki ödenmemiş yemekler için 110 sterlin borcu bulunduğunu mahkemede ifade etti. Chowdhury, Tyers güncel yemeğinin ücretini öderse önceki borcu görmezden geleceğini söyledi. Tyers ve arkadaşı birkaç yemek sipariş ettikten sonra yemeği yiyip şikayetlerini yaptı ve hesabı ödemeden ayrıldılar.

Mahkemede Tyers ve arkadaşı ödemeye çalıştıklarını, ancak Chowdhury'nin toplam borcun ödenmesini istediğini savundu. Savcılar ise güvenlik kamerası görüntülerinin herhangi bir ödeme girişimini göstermediğini ve saça dair fiziksel bir delilin saklanmadığını belirtti. Tyers, yanlış beyanla dolandırıcılıktan suçlu bulunarak iki hafta hapis cezası aldı ve restorana 39,55 sterlin tazminat ödemesine hükmedildi.

article_content: Fernando Torres is expected to receive fairer treatment at AC Milan than he did at Chelsea, according to former Milan winger Stefano Eranio. The Spanish striker recently joined the Italian club on a two-year loan, following a difficult period in west London where he struggled to find form. Eranio, who played for both Milan and Derby County, believes Torres is 'like a car'—he will perform well if he is cared for. "Torres is a very humble player with excellent technical and human qualities. In recent years, he has not had many opportunities and spent a lot of time on the Chelsea bench. But like a car, he needs regular playtime to regain his form. He requires the coach's confidence and an environment in which he can thrive," Eranio told Milan News. Eranio added, "As a coach, I would always want someone like Torres on my team. He arrives in Italy with great enthusiasm and has specific attributes that are a perfect fit for Milan." During most of his time at Chelsea, Torres struggled to secure a place in the starting lineup.
translated_content: Fernando Torres’in AC Milan’da, Chelsea’de olduğundan daha adil bir şekilde muamele göreceği Milan’ın eski kanat oyuncusu Stefano Eranio’ya göre bekleniyor. İspanyol forvet, form bulmakta zorlandığı Batı Londra’daki zorlu bir dönemden sonra, kısa süre önce İtalyan kulübüne iki yıllık kiralık olarak katıldı. Milan ve Derby County’de de oynamış olan Eranio, Torres için ‘bir araba gibi’ benzetmesini kullanıyor—iyi bakılırsa iyi performans göstereceğini söylüyor. "Torres çok mütevazı bir oyuncu; mükemmel teknik ve insani özelliklere sahip. Son yıllarda pek fazla şans bulamadı ve Chelsea’de sık sık yedek kulübesinde oturdu. Ama tıpkı bir araba gibi, formuna kavuşabilmek için düzenli olarak oynaması gerekiyor. Teknik direktörün güvenine ve en iyi performansını sergileyeceği bir ortama ihtiyaç duyuyor," dedi Eranio Milan News’a. Eranio ayrıca, "Bir antrenör olarak, her zaman takımımda Torres gibi birini isterim. İtalya’ya büyük bir heyecanla geliyor ve Milan için mükemmel şekilde uygun olan özel niteliklere sahip," diye ekledi. Torres, Chelsea’deki süresinin büyük bir bölümünde ilk 11’de kendine yer bulmakta zorlandı.

article_content: Rahul Gandhi, after reflecting on Hinduism's core tenets in The Indian Express last Sunday, visited the Golden Temple in Amritsar this week for a spiritual retreat. There, he participated in sewa at the community kitchen, carried the Palaki Sahib, served rotis at the langar, and shared meals with devotees. His visit, which took place on Monday and Tuesday, overlapped with Gandhi Jayanti, a day holding particular significance for the Nehru-Gandhi family due to the memory of Indira Gandhi’s assassination by her Sikh bodyguards on October 31, 1984. According to sources close to Rahul, history is not burdening him; he felt Gandhi Jayanti was a fitting occasion to offer sewa. They also highlighted Rahul's ongoing spiritual practice, including Vipassana meditation. Indira Gandhi’s 1984 decision to send the Army into the Golden Temple to remove militants, led by Jarnail Singh Bhindranwale, her assassination, and the anti-Sikh riots that followed, have significantly affected the Congress for four decades. Although the SGPC supported Rahul’s visit to the Darbar Sahib, they raised concerns about the visit’s purpose and length, noting that no non-Sikh politician had previously spent as much time at the shrine. Throughout his political career of nearly 20 years, Rahul Gandhi has made efforts to engage with the Sikh community and has expressed his pain over his grandmother’s assassination, occasionally making varying statements on the issue. The anti-Sikh riots continue to impact the Congress politically, even though the party gave India its only Sikh Prime Minister, Manmohan Singh, who apologized for the riots in Parliament. Among Rahul’s early public remarks was during a 2008 visit to Punjab, where he called the riots ‘wrong’ and urged justice for those involved. He mentioned his family never held resentment toward Sikhs, recalling how the Sikh community supported Indira Gandhi after her 1977 electoral defeat. In a 2013 AICC session in Jaipur, where he became Congress vice-president, Rahul spoke about playing badminton with his grandmother’s assassins and described his father Rajiv Gandhi’s profound grief after Indira’s death. He recounted experiencing the aftermath firsthand and described the hope he and his father felt during that dark period. During a Rajasthan election campaign in 2013, he remembered talking with Beant Singh and witnessing both his grandmother’s and her killers’ deaths, noting he understands the pain of such loss. He shared an incident where a Punjab MLA confessed that anger related to 1984 could have led to violence against Rahul himself, emphasizing how easily anger can be provoked for political gain. In 2014, questioned about the riots during a TV interview, Rahul referred to the Sikh community as industrious and reiterated that he no longer harbored anger. When asked to apologize, he insisted he was not involved in the riots and that all riots are tragic events. This response was viewed by some as unapologetic. Later, he clarified, expressing support for apologies by Manmohan Singh and Sonia Gandhi. In subsequent interactions, including in Berkeley and London, Rahul condemned the violence and supported justice for victims, although some of his remarks about the Congress’s role created debate. He recalled Manmohan Singh’s apology, recognizing the significance of acknowledging historical trauma. Earlier in 2023, Rahul again visited the Golden Temple during the Bharat Jodo Yatra, addressed questions about the 1984 riots, and reiterated endorsement of previous statements made by Manmohan Singh and Sonia Gandhi regarding justice and reconciliation with the Sikh community.
translated_content: Rahul Gandhi, geçtiğimiz pazar The Indian Express’te Hinduizmin temel ilkeleri üzerine yaptığı değerlendirmeden sonra bu hafta Amritsar’daki Altın Tapınak’a ruhani bir ziyaret gerçekleştirdi. Orada toplu mutfakta sewa yaptı, Palaki Sahib’i taşıdı, langarda roti servis etti ve cemaatle yemek paylaştı. Pazartesi ve Salı günleri olan bu ziyareti, Nehru-Gandhi ailesi için 31 Ekim 1984’te Indira Gandhi’nin Sih korumaları tarafından öldürülmesini anımsattığı için özel bir anlam taşıyan Gandhi Jayanti’ye denk geldi. Rahul’a yakın kaynaklara göre, tarih onu yük altında bırakmıyor; Gandhi Jayanti’de sewa yapmanın çok uygun bir gün olduğunu düşündü. Ayrıca Rahul’un Vipassana meditasyonu gibi manevi uygulamalarına devam ettiği vurgulandı. Indira Gandhi’nin 1984’te ordunun Altın Tapınak’a gönderilmesine karar vermesi, Jarnail Singh Bhindranwale liderliğindeki militanların çıkarılması, kendisinin suikasta uğraması ve sonrasında Sih karşıtı ayaklanmalar; tüm bu süreçler kırk yıl boyunca Kongre Partisi’ni derinden etkiledi. SGPC (Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Komitesi) Rahul’un Darbar Sahib ziyaretine destek verse de, ziyaretin amacı ve süresiyle ilgili soru işaretleri dile getirdi; daha önce hiçbir Sih olmayan politikacının tapınakta bu kadar uzun süre vakit geçirmediğini belirtti. Yaklaşık 20 yıllık siyasi yaşamı boyunca Rahul Gandhi, Sih topluluğu ile bağlar kurmaya çalıştı ve bazen değişken ifadeler kullanmış olsa da büyükannesinin suikastı nedeniyle hissettiği acıyı dile getirdi. Sih karşıtı ayaklanmalar, Hindistan’ın tek Sih başbakanı Manmohan Singh’in mecliste ayaklanmalar için özür dilemesine rağmen Kongre Partisi’ni siyaseten etkilemeyi sürdürüyor. Rahul’un 2008’de Pencap’a yaptığı ziyarette ayaklanmaların ‘yanlış’ olduğunu ve sorumluların adalete teslim edilmesi gerektiğini söylediği biliniyor. Ailesinin Sihlere karşı hiçbir zaman kin tutmadığını ve 1977’deki seçim yenilgisinden sonra Sih topluluğunun Indira Gandhi’ye destek verdiğini anlattı. 2013’te Jaipur’daki AICC oturumunda, genel başkan yardımcısı olurken, büyükannesinin suikastçılarıyla badminton oynadığından ve babası Rajiv Gandhi’nin Indira’nın ölümünden sonra yaşadığı derin üzüntüden bahsetti. O döneme dair yaşadıklarını paylaşırken, babasıyla birlikte o zor günlerde bir umut ışığı hissettiklerini aktardı. 2013 Rajasthan seçim kampanyasında Beant Singh ile konuşmasını, hem büyükannesinin hem de katillerinin kanını görmeyi hatırladı. Kayıp acısını anladığını belirtti ve 1984 olaylarına duyulan öfkenin, zamanında bir Punjab milletvekilinin kendisini öldürmesine bile neden olabileceğini paylaştı. Siyasette öfkenin hızlıca körüklenebileceğinin altını çizdi. 2014’te bir televizyon röportajında ayaklanmalara dair gelen sorularda, Sih toplumunu çalışkan bulduğunu ve artık öfke duymadığını belirtti. Özür dileyip dilemeyeceği sorusuna ise olaylarla bir ilgisinin olmadığını, tüm ayaklanmaların trajik olduğunu söyledi. Bu cevabı bazı kesimler yeterli bulmadı. Daha sonra Manmohan Singh ve Sonia Gandhi’nin kamuya yaptığı özürleri desteklediğini vurguladı. Berkeley ve Londra’daki görüşmelerde Rahul, şiddeti kınadığını ve mağdurlara adalet arayışında destek olduğunu yineledi; ancak Kongre’nin rolüyle ilgili bazı sözleri tartışma çıkardı. Manmohan Singh’in özrünü hatırlattı ve tarihsel travmanın kabul edilmesinin önemini vurguladı. 2023’te Bharat Jodo Yatra sırasında tekrar Altın Tapınak’ı ziyaret eden Rahul, 1984 olaylarıyla ilgili gelen soruları yanıtladı ve Manmohan Singh ile Sonia Gandhi’nin adalete ve uzlaşmaya dair önceki açıklamalarına tamamen katıldığını yineledi.

article_content: After his arrest last year, a suspected Massachusetts drug leader is reportedly struggling to adapt to prison life. Alexis 'Papi-Thing' Hidalgo, who awaits trial at Plymouth County Correctional Facility, has written a complaint about the poor food and limited soap supplies. Hidalgo, 32, is accused of using drug money to finance an extravagant lifestyle of expensive sports cars and luxury hotel stays. He has requested a transfer to another facility with better conditions. In a letter to District Court Magistrate Judge Robert B. Collings, Hidalgo described unsanitary circumstances and claimed they risked his health, according to the Boston Herald. He mentioned having to use cold sink water to cook food and claimed this could cause health issues. Hidalgo has pleaded not guilty to charges of conspiracy to distribute cocaine, oxycodone, and marijuana. He also stated that the tap water had an odd taste and caused rashes among inmates. Previously, law enforcement alleged that Hidalgo and co-defendant Jonathan 'The Don' DaSilva spent thousands of dollars during an 18-month investigation. The two reportedly rented luxury cars, stayed in high-end hotels, and spent on expensive tables at celebrity events. In his letter dated November 4, Hidalgo further complained that soap rations were small and infrequent, forcing him to use dishwashing liquid, which he considered unsanitary. He was not allowed to buy additional soap. He also pointed out the lack of microwaves in the facility, a fact confirmed by prison spokesman John Birtwell, who explained such amenities are not allowed for safety and security reasons. Hidalgo additionally claimed he was prevented from attending religious services and questioned whether his constitutional rights were being violated. He also noted a lack of educational and drug-counseling programs for pre-trial detainees, although the prison states these are only available to sentenced inmates. Judge Collings forwarded Hidalgo's letter to the U.S. Marshals Service. Hidalgo remains in custody at Plymouth.

article_content: Meta has announced a new global policy to address political advertisements created or altered by generative AI during the 2024 election cycle. Beginning in January, advertisers must ‘self-disclose’ when political or social-issue ads on Meta platforms are made or significantly changed using digital tools like generative AI. This policy will apply to photorealistic images, videos, and realistic audio content. The goal is for advertisers to voluntarily reveal when an ad made with generative AI or similar technology: depicts a real person saying or doing something they did not in reality; shows a realistic person or event that does not exist or did not happen; or alters footage of a real event in a way that could mislead viewers. If disclosure is made, Meta will label the ad to indicate it has been digitally created or altered. Meta has also barred political advertisers from using its own generative AI tools for ads. This policy mirrors measures recently introduced by Google and YouTube. With 2024 being an election year in the US and 39 other countries, the rise of generative AI has raised concerns over the influence of synthetic media on society and democratic processes. Deep fakes—media manipulated or created to mislead—are frequently produced intentionally. Therefore, requiring advertisers to self-report such use may counter their goals. Nick Clegg, Meta’s president of global affairs, commented on Threads that this policy further builds on Meta’s transparency standards, including mandatory advertiser authorization and ‘Paid for by’ notices. If an undisclosed, AI-altered ad becomes viral, Meta’s independent fact-checking partners will review it. Advertisements flagged as False, Altered, Partly False, or Missing Context will not be permitted to run. Misleading content can be removed, and repeated failure to disclose can result in penalties for the advertiser. News of his possible ownership has been approached with cautious optimism by those within the club. Meanwhile, in a recent match against West Bromwich Albion, Brede Hangeland and Marouane Chamakh scored for Crystal Palace.

article_content: 'Air' is set to receive a special honor at next month’s Gotham Awards. The film, which tells the story of how the Air Jordan brand was created, will receive the newly established Gotham Visionary Icon & Creator Tribute. This award recognizes director Ben Affleck’s film, as well as the real-life collaborators behind the Michael Jordan shoe phenomenon. The Gotham Film & Media Institute’s ceremony will take place on November 27 at Cipriani Wall Street in New York. The event marks the unofficial kickoff of awards season. Nominees for the competitive film and TV categories will be announced on October 24. “Both gripping and hilarious, 'Air' is a deeply refreshing reminder to the film industry that audiences respond to smart, original narratives,” said Jeffrey Sharp, the institute’s executive director. “By capturing the dramatic story behind the most monumental partnership in the history of sports marketing, the film highlights the power of knowing your worth and using that knowledge to take the right risks.” 'Air' was released in theaters by Amazon last spring and began streaming on Prime Video in May. The film is set in 1984, as Michael Jordan transitions from the national college basketball champion at North Carolina to the NBA’s Chicago Bulls. It portrays Jordan and his family’s then-unexpected decision to sign with Nike over rivals Converse or Adidas, who dominated the market at the time. This decision would ultimately change the landscape of sports and celebrity endorsements. Ben Affleck plays Nike founder Phil Knight, and the cast also features Matt Damon, Jason Bateman, Chris Messina, Marlon Wayans, Chris Tucker, Julius Tennon, and Viola Davis. 'Air' is the first production from Affleck and Damon’s new company, Artists Equity, and was backed by Skydance Sports and Mandalay Pictures.

Film ve televizyonun yarışmalı kategorilerinin adayları 24 Ekim’de açıklanacak. "Hem sürükleyici hem de eğlenceli olan 'Air', film sektörüne seyircilerin akıllı ve özgün hikâyelere tepki verdiğini etkileyici biçimde hatırlatıyor," dedi enstitünün genel müdürü Jeffrey Sharp. article_content: Years after making their mark, Steve McQueen, Frank Sinatra, Madonna, and Blondie are still considered among the top 100 coolest Americans. The 'American Cool' exhibit is on display at the National Portrait Gallery in Washington, D.C., until September 7. The exhibit features jazz legends like Miles Davis and Billie Holiday, actors such as Johnny Depp, and iconic musicians including Elvis Presley and Debbie Harry. Frank Sinatra, one of the best-selling artists of all time, is represented in the exhibit during a studio session. Debbie Harry, lead singer of Blondie, and Jimi Hendrix, the influential guitarist who passed away in 1970, are also featured. Elvis Presley—'The King of Rock and Roll'—remains an enduring symbol of cool long after his death in 1977. Curators chose individuals who fit at least three of four criteria: originality of artistic vision and signature style, cultural rebellion in a historic moment, iconic status, and a recognized cultural legacy of over a decade. The concept of 'cool' is believed to have originated in the United States in the early 1940s, introduced to popular jargon by jazz saxophonist Lester Young. Due to the sheer number of candidates, a secondary list was created for those not in the top 100, including Samuel L. Jackson, Gwen Stefani, and Tom Petty. Portraits in the exhibit were captured by celebrated photographers like Richard Avedon and Annie Leibovitz. Figures such as Kurt Cobain, Frederick Douglass, and Tony Hawk also appear in the collection. Nearly a quarter of those recognized as 'cool' are women, with Billie Holiday making the list. Miles Davis, a central figure in 20th-century jazz, and Muddy Waters, known as the father of modern Chicago blues, are recognized as well. James Dean is remembered for his role in 'Rebel Without a Cause' and his influence on youth culture. Kim Sajet, director of the National Portrait Gallery, highlighted that 'American Cool' explores the history of 'cool' in America and showcases prominent figures through acclaimed photography, sparking conversations about who defines 'cool.' Over 25 years after his death in 1980, Steve McQueen remains a symbol of enduring coolness. Bessie Smith, the 'Empress of the Blues,' and poet Walt Whitman, whose work was once considered controversial, are included. David Byrne, Scottish-born but a longstanding U.S. resident and founder of Talking Heads, along with Jean-Michel Basquiat, renowned American artist, both feature in the exhibit. Madonna's unprecedented power and influence as a woman in entertainment is acknowledged, and actor Benicio del Toro's award-winning career is represented. Curated lists highlight 'The Roots of Cool,' 'The Birth of Cool,' 'Cool and the Counterculture,' and 'The Legacy of Cool,' featuring a wide range of American cultural icons across generations and genres.

'American Cool' sergisi, 7 Eylül'e kadar Washington, D.C.'deki Ulusal Portre Galerisi'nde ziyaret edilebiliyor. Sergide caz efsaneleri Miles Davis ve Billie Holiday, oyuncu Johnny Depp ve ikonik müzisyenler Elvis Presley ile Debbie Harry öne çıkıyor. Tüm zamanların en çok satan sanatçılarından Frank Sinatra, stüdyo sahnesiyle sergide bulunuyor. Blondie'nin solisti Debbie Harry ve 1970'te hayatını kaybeden etkili gitarist Jimi Hendrix de sergide yer alıyor. 1977'de vefat eden 'Rock and Roll'un Kralı' Elvis Presley, ölümünden sonra da havalı olarak kabul ediliyor. Küratörler, seçilen isimlerin dört kriterden en az üçünü karşılamasına dikkat etti: sanatsal vizyonda özgünlük ve imza tarzı, dönemin kültürel başkaldırısı, ikoniklik ve on yılı aşan kültürel miras. 'Havalı' kavramının 1940'ların başında caz saksofoncusu Lester Young tarafından Amerikan gündelik diline kazandırıldığı belirtiliyor. Aday sayısının fazlalığı nedeniyle, ilk 100'e giremeyen Samuel L. Jackson, Gwen Stefani ve Tom Petty gibi isimlerin olduğu ek bir liste hazırlandı. Sergideki portreler Richard Avedon ve Annie Leibovitz gibi ünlü fotoğrafçılar tarafından çekilmiş. Koleksiyonda Kurt Cobain, Frederick Douglass ve Tony Hawk gibi isimler de yer alıyor. 'Havalı' olarak tanınanların neredeyse dörtte biri kadınlardan oluşuyor; Billie Holiday de listede. 20. yüzyıl cazının merkezi Miles Davis ve Chicago blues'un babası olarak anılan Muddy Waters da tanınıyor. James Dean, 'Rebel Without a Cause' filmindeki rolüyle ve gençlik kültüründeki etkisiyle biliniyor. Ulusal Portre Galerisi Direktörü Kim Sajet, 'American Cool' sergisinin Amerika'da 'havalı'nın tarihini inceleyip ünlü fotoğraflarla önemli ikonları bir araya getirerek bu kavram üzerine ulusal bir sohbet başlattığını belirtti. 1980'deki ölümünden 25 yılı aşkın süre sonra bile Steve McQueen, havalı olmanın simgelerinden biri. 'Blues'un İmparatoriçesi' Bessie Smith ve bir dönem tartışmalara yol açan şair Walt Whitman da sergide yer alıyor. article_content: Fukushima Industries, a Japanese refrigerator manufacturer, recently introduced a new mascot to greet visitors on its website. However, the egg-shaped character, named 'Fukuppy,' has attracted attention online for unintended reasons. The company is now considering rebranding its mascot after the name was ridiculed on Japanese social media. The mascot, which has wings and red shoes, was first unveiled in April and greets website visitors with, 'I'm Fukuppy. Nice to meet you.' The name combines the first part of the company's name, 'Fuku,' with the ending of the word 'happy,' reflecting what Fukushima Industries describes as its identity as a 'happiness-creating company.' Despite the intention, the name has failed to inspire confidence in some consumers. Fukushima Industries stated that the name was misunderstood as inappropriate by English speakers online. The company apologized for causing concern and said it would reconsider the mascot's name. The company, which manufactures industrial cooling systems and operates in China, Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, and Taiwan, clarified that it has no connection to the Fukushima nuclear power plant, which suffered major disasters following the 2011 tsunami. It is common in Japan for companies and organizations to use mascots as part of their branding. For example, last month Asahikawa Prison introduced 'Katakkuri-chan,' a large humanoid mascot designed to soften the prison's image. The Tokyo Metropolitan Police has had its own well-known crime-fighting mascot since the 1980s. The use of English or English-inspired words is widespread in Japan, even though English proficiency rates remain relatively low. This sometimes results in amusing product names for foreign visitors, such as 'Pocari Sweat' or 'Calpis,' and unusual English phrases on products and advertisements.

Fukushima Industries, bu ismin şirketlerinin 'mutluluk yaratan' kimliğini yansıttığını belirtiyor. Ancak, bu iyi niyetli girişim bazı tüketicilerin güvenini kazanamadı. Japonya'da şirketlerin ve kurumların marka çalışmaları kapsamında maskot kullanması yaygın bir uygulamadır. Bu nedenle, 'Pocari Sweat' veya 'Calpis' gibi yabancılara ilginç gelen ürün isimleri ya da alışılmadık İngilizce ifadeler, reklam ve ürünlerde sıkça karşılaşılmaktadır.

article_content: On Wednesday morning around 9:20am, the websites for all public hospitals and polyclinics in Singapore went down due to a major internet outage. Users saw error messages and were unable to access online services such as hospital websites, email, and the NUHS contact centre. The national health technology agency, Synapxe, confirmed at 1:45pm that the outage was affecting all public healthcare clusters. Crucially, clinical services—including access to patient records—remained fully operational. Restoration of internet service began at 4:30pm, with most websites and online functions back by 5:15pm. By 11pm, Synapxe reported full restoration and reassured the public that no data or internal networks had been compromised. Synapxe, which supports 46 public healthcare institutions and about 1,400 community partners, said investigations into the cause continue. Affected sites included Singapore General Hospital, National University Hospital, Tan Tock Seng Hospital, and the Agency for Integrated Care. The Ministry of Health and HealthHub websites were not impacted. NUHS and SingHealth stated that patient care and appointments proceeded as normal. While some features in the OneNUHS app were temporarily offline, patients were still able to manage appointments. NUHS emphasized ongoing collaboration with Synapxe to monitor the situation.
