Kullanıcılar hata mesajı aldı ve hastane sitelerine, e-postalara, NUHS iletişim merkezine erişemediler. Ulusal sağlık teknoloji ajansı Synapxe, saat 13:45’te tüm kamu sağlık klasterlerinin etkilendiğini doğruladı. En önemlisi; klinik hizmetler ile hasta kayıtları sorunsuz şekilde erişilebilir kaldı. İnternet hizmetinin yeniden sağlanmasına 16:30’da başlandı; 17:15’e kadar çoğu site ve çevrim içi hizmet tekrar erişime açıldı. 23:00’te Synapxe, internetin tamamen geri geldiğini ve veri ya da iç ağlarda herhangi bir güvenlik ihlaline rastlanmadığını duyurdu. 46 kamu sağlık kuruluşu ve yaklaşık 1.400 toplum ortağına destek veren Synapxe, kesintinin sebebiyle ilgili araştırmaların devam ettiğini belirtti. Etkilenen siteler arasında Singapore General Hospital, National University Hospital, Tan Tock Seng Hospital ve Agency for Integrated Care bulunuyordu. Sağlık Bakanlığı ile HealthHub’ın siteleri ise bu kesintiden etkilenmedi. NUHS ve SingHealth, hasta bakımı ve randevuların etkilenmediğini açıkladı. article_content: Vistara, the joint venture airline between Tata Group and Singapore Airlines, has launched non-stop weekly flights between Mumbai and Frankfurt. The inaugural flight, operated with a Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner, departed Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport at 1:00 PM IST on November 15, arriving at Frankfurt International Airport at 5:30 PM GMT. Vistara already operates six weekly flights between Frankfurt and Delhi. According to CEO Vinod Kannan, the airline identified a demand for world-class Indian carriers connecting Mumbai to long-haul European destinations. He cited Vistara’s five weekly direct flights from Mumbai to London Heathrow as an example.

Vistara, halihazırda Frankfurt ve Delhi arasında haftada altı sefer düzenliyor. CEO Vinod Kannan'a göre, şirket Mumbai'den Avrupa'daki uzun mesafeli destinasyonlara ulaşan dünya standartlarında bir Hint hava yolu ihtiyacı olduğunu belirledi. Kannan, Vistara'nın Mumbai'den Londra Heathrow'a haftada beş direkt uçuşunu buna örnek olarak gösterdi.

article_content: Nigeria's real estate market is undergoing transformation, as more Nigerians sell their properties to fund migration, while members of the diaspora are increasingly investing and buying from their compatriots. Felicia Adaobi, a chartered accountant in her mid-30s, inherited a family estate in Anambra State—a symbol of her family's deep roots and wealth. Confronted with Nigeria's economic crisis and inflation, Adaobi opted to sell the property to start her own business and pay for her younger brother's education in the United States. After news of the sale spread, Chinedu Nkem, a Nigerian entrepreneur based in London, saw a chance to invest in his homeland and connect with his roots. Believing in the promise of Nigeria's real estate sector, Nkem purchased Adaobi’s family property to contribute to Anambra’s development. The transaction benefited both parties: Adaobi launched her business and funded her brother’s studies abroad, while Nkem planned to build a modern apartment complex, creating jobs and providing new housing for the local community. This example reflects a broader trend: property has long symbolized wealth and security in Nigeria, but economic pressures and the need for liquidity now drive many Nigerians to sell real estate to support migration, education, or business. Diaspora Nigerians are seizing these sale opportunities, viewing property investments as both financial assets and a way to retain ties to home. Experts like Bayo Lawal of Dukiya Investments and Seyi Amusan of Space Button Architecture point out that high inflation, unemployment, and political and social factors are driving distress sales of luxury assets—sometimes below international market value. Migration is rising: as of 2020, 1.67 million Nigerians were international migrants (according to the United Nations). Digital tools and fintech innovations make property transactions more accessible and transparent, expanding public participation in the real estate market. Industry leaders agree that diaspora investments are positive for Nigeria’s property sector and economy, often driven by emotional and social motivations as well as prospects for solid long-term returns.

article_content: Major online content creators have recently become aware that tech companies have been using their copyrighted work for years to train AI models, often without permission or compensation. Some of these content owners are now taking steps to address this issue and are beginning to see results. The New York Times (NYT) discovered that Common Crawl, one of the largest AI training datasets, contained millions of URLs linking to its paywalled and copyrighted articles. Common Crawl is assembled by scraping the web with software called CCBot. Since 2007, the Common Crawl Foundation has collected more than 250 billion web pages, adding up to 5 billion new pages each month. This dataset forms the backbone of training data for many large language models, including OpenAI's GPT-3. Additionally, Google's Infiniset obtains 12.5% of its data from C4, a cleaned-up version of Common Crawl. High-quality training data like this is essential for AI model performance. However, The New York Times does not wish to be included in these datasets, as the AI models often deliver answers directly, bypassing the original sources and potentially diminishing NYT’s readership and subscription base. Earlier this year, the NYT reached out to the Common Crawl Foundation to request the removal of its content from the dataset. "We simply asked that our content be removed, and were pleased that Common Crawl complied with our request and recognized The Times's ownership of our quality journalistic content," said Charlie Stadtlander, a spokesperson for The New York Times, to Insider. According to a recent letter to the US Copyright Office, Common Crawl also agreed to stop scraping NYT content in the future. Other online publishers have also attempted to prevent Common Crawl from acquiring their content. As of late September, nearly 14% of the 1,000 most popular websites were blocking CCBot, according to Originality.ai. This group includes Amazon, Vimeo, Masterclass, Kelly Blue Book, The New Yorker, and The Atlantic. Common Crawl did not respond to a request for comment. NYT has also found its paywalled articles and other copyrighted material in additional AI training datasets. For example, a reconstituted version of WebText, which trained OpenAI’s ChatGPT-2, included NYT content accounting for 1.2% of the dataset, as referenced in their letter to the US Copyright Office. "Once powered with our content, GAI tools can do a number of things with it, including reciting it verbatim, summarizing it, drafting new content with a similar style of expression, and using it to generate misinformation attributed to The Times that appears to be fact," the NYT explained in the letter. It remains unclear whether NYT has been able to get its content removed from all datasets, such as WebText, used for AI training.

Bu içerik sahiplerinden bazıları, bu sorunu ele almak için adımlar atıyor ve sonuç almaya başlıyor. The New York Times (NYT), en büyük yapay zeka eğitim veri kümelerinden biri olan Common Crawl’un, ücretli ve telif hakkına sahip makalelerine bağlantı veren milyonlarca URL içerdiğini keşfetti. Common Crawl, CCBot adlı yazılımla web’in taranmasıyla oluşturuluyor. Common Crawl Vakfı, 2007’den bu yana 250 milyardan fazla web sayfası topladı ve her ay 5 milyara kadar yeni sayfa ekliyor. Bu veri seti, OpenAI’ın GPT-3’ü de dahil olmak üzere birçok büyük dil modelinin eğitim verisinin temelini oluşturuyor. Ayrıca Google’ın Infiniset’i, verisinin %12,5’ini Common Crawl’ın temizlenmiş bir sürümü olan C4’ten alıyor. Bu tür yüksek kaliteli eğitim verileri, yapay zekanın performansı için büyük önem taşıyor. Ancak NYT, bu veri kümelerinde yer almak istemiyor çünkü bu modeller cevapları doğrudan sunarak orijinal kaynağı atlıyor ve NYT’nin okuyucu ile abone tabanını azaltabiliyor. Bu yılın başlarında NYT, içeriğinin veri setinden çıkarılması için Common Crawl Vakfı’na başvurdu. "Sadece içeriğimizin kaldırılmasını istedik ve Common Crawl’ın isteğimizi yerine getirmesinden, Times’ın kaliteli gazetecilik içeriğinin mülkiyetini kabul etmesinden memnunuz," dedi The New York Times sözcüsü Charlie Stadtlander, Insider’a. ABD Telif Hakkı Bürosu’na yazılan yakın tarihli bir mektuba göre Common Crawl, gelecekte de NYT içeriğini taramama sözü verdi. Diğer internet yayıncıları da Common Crawl’ın içeriklerini almasını engellemeye çalıştı. Eylül sonu itibarıyla, en popüler 1.000 web sitesinin yaklaşık %14’ü CCBot’u engelliyor (Originality.ai verilerine göre). Engelleyenler arasında Amazon, Vimeo, Masterclass, Kelly Blue Book, The New Yorker ve The Atlantic var. Common Crawl, yorum talebine yanıt vermedi. NYT, ücretli ve telifli makalelerinin diğer popüler yapay zeka eğitim veri setlerinde de bulunduğunu tespit etti. Örneğin, OpenAI’nın ChatGPT-2’sini eğitmek için kullanılan WebText’in yeniden oluşturulan bir versiyonunda, NYT içeriği tüm veri setinin %1,2’sini oluşturuyor (ABD Telif Hakkı Bürosu’na yazılan mektuba göre). "Yapay zekâ araçları içeriğimizle çalışınca; onu aynen aktarabiliyor, özetleyebiliyor, benzer bir ifade tarzı ile yeni içerik üretebiliyor ya da Times’a atfedilen, gerçek gibi görünen yanlış bilgilere dönüştürebiliyor," diye belirtti NYT mektubunda. NYT’nin, WebText gibi tüm veri kümelerinden içeriğini kaldırtıp kaldırtmadığı ise belirsizliğini koruyor.

article_content: DENVER, Colorado (CNN) -- On a significant night for Sen. Hillary Clinton, former President Bill Clinton publicly displayed empathy by embracing Mervyn Jones Jr., the 25-year-old son of the recently deceased Ohio Representative Stephanie Tubbs Jones, before Hillary Clinton's speech at the Democratic National Convention. The moment, captured on television, resonated with viewers as Bill Clinton silently comforted Jones Jr. Rep. Tubbs Jones had been a steadfast and loyal supporter of the Clintons, maintaining her endorsement even as many African-American leaders shifted their support to Barack Obama during the primaries. In her speech, Hillary Clinton honored Tubbs Jones, describing her as 'steadfast in her beliefs, a fighter of uncommon grace, and an inspiration.' Clinton extended her condolences to Mervyn Jones Jr. as well. The bond between the Clintons and the Tubbs Jones family goes back years. Mervyn Jones Jr. recalled the first time his mother met Bill Clinton during his 1992 campaign and noted their enduring friendship. Tubbs Jones endorsed Hillary Clinton for president in April 2007, remaining loyal despite pressure as other African-American superdelegates switched allegiance to Obama. She told CNN’s Wolf Blitzer in March that she would stand by Clinton until told otherwise, emphasizing that in politics, one’s word is all that matters. She instilled this value in her son, who reiterated it after Clinton’s speech at the convention: 'If you give somebody your word, you're going to go ahead and do it. Otherwise, it's not worth anything.' When asked to sit with Bill Clinton during Hillary Clinton’s address, Jones Jr. agreed, reflecting his mother's beliefs about standing by people during difficult times. Stephanie Tubbs Jones, aged 58, died of a brain aneurysm one week prior to the convention. She was serving her fifth term in the House of Representatives and was the first African-American woman to represent Ohio in Congress. Mervyn Jones Jr. said his mother would have enthusiastically supported Hillary Clinton’s call for Democratic unity behind Barack Obama, celebrating her team-player spirit. Some analysts called Hillary Clinton’s speech the first in a potential second presidential campaign, while Bill Clinton’s embrace of Mervyn Jones Jr. was seen as a meaningful gesture that could impact the public image of the Clintons.

Televizyonda yayınlanan bu an, Bill Clinton’ın sessizce Jones Jr.'ı teselli etmesiyle izleyicilere dokundu. Temsilci Tubbs Jones, birçok Afrika kökenli Amerikalı lider Barack Obama’ya destek vermeye başlamışken, Clinton ailesine desteğini sürdüren kararlı ve sadık bir siyasetçiydi. Hillary Clinton konuşmasında Tubbs Jones’u 'inançlarında kararlı, olağanüstü bir zarafetin savaşçısı ve ilham kaynağı' olarak tanımlayarak andı ve Mervyn Jones Jr.’a taziyelerini iletti. Clinton ailesi ve Tubbs Jones ailesi arasındaki bağ yıllara dayanıyor. Mervyn Jones Jr., annesinin 1992’deki kampanyasında Bill Clinton ile ilk buluşmasını ve süregelen dostluklarını anlattı. Tubbs Jones, Nisan 2007’de başkanlık seçiminde Hillary Clinton’a destek verdi; diğer bazı süper delegelerin Obama’ya geçmesine rağmen Clinton’a olan sadakati devam etti. Mart ayında CNN’den Wolf Blitzer’a, Clinton’dan haber gelene kadar yanında olacağını, siyasette en önemli şeyin söz olduğunu söyledi. article_content: Recent research has revealed that sharks, when exposed to sunlight for extended periods, actually develop tans—yet, unlike humans, these marine animals show remarkable resistance to skin diseases. Scientists are intrigued by the unique qualities of shark skin, believing it could offer valuable clues for new methods to protect human skin from cancer. Dr. Michael Sweet from Newcastle University observed that sharks hardly ever display signs of skin damage or illness. While many scientists have tried and failed to induce melanoma in sharks, their skin's apparent resilience remains a mystery worth exploring. Australian researchers further noted that although sharks are fierce predators, their skin demonstrates built-in protection against disease, even as they tan under the sun. This has sparked interest in isolating what makes shark skin so special, with hopes of one day developing a 'shark lotion' for humans. Supporting these findings, a team at California State University's Shark Lab conducted an experiment involving hammerhead shark pups at the Hawaii Institute of Marine Biology. When kept in shallow, sunlit pools, the pups developed darker skin, especially where their bodies were directly exposed to high levels of ultraviolet light—up to 600 times what they'd usually encounter in the wild. Researchers placed opaque filters over parts of the sharks' skin to block UV rays, confirming that only unshielded areas darkened, leaving visible 'tan lines.' The study found that the sharks' melanin content increased by 14 percent over three weeks, and up to 28 percent over several months. To date, only mammals besides sharks are known to undergo tanning, making these results especially compelling. As investigations continue, scientists hope the secrets of shark skin may one day lead to breakthroughs in human skin protection.

Bilim insanları, köpekbalığı derisinin benzersiz özelliklerinin insan cildini kansere karşı koruyacak yeni yöntemler geliştirilmesine ışık tutabileceğine inanıyor. Avustralyalı araştırmacılar ise köpekbalıklarının sert avcılar olmalarına rağmen, güneş altında bronzlaşsalar da derilerinin hastalığa karşı doğal bir korumaya sahip olduğunu ortaya koydu. Bu durum, köpekbalığı derisinin özel tarafını ortaya çıkarmak için ilgiyi artırdı ve günün birinde insanlar için bir 'köpekbalığı losyonu' geliştirilmesi umudunu doğurdu. Bulguları destekleyen California Eyalet Üniversitesi Köpekbalığı Laboratuvarı ekibi, Hawaii Deniz Biyolojisi Enstitüsü'nde çekiçbaş köpekbalığı yavrularıyla bir deney yaptı. Bugüne dek, köpekbalıkları dışında yalnızca memelilerin bronzlaştığı biliniyor; bu da elde edilen bulguları oldukça etkileyici kılıyor. Araştırmalar sürdükçe, bilim insanları köpekbalığı derisinin sırlarının bir gün insan cilt korumasında çığır açabileceğini umuyor.

article_content: Jordan Torunarigha is proudly following in his father’s footsteps after making his debut for the Nigerian national football team. While pursuing a career in football has its advantages, reaching the highest levels of the sport demands immense character and conviction. The path can be even more challenging for those whose family members have already set high standards. Jordan joins a select group of players who have honored their family legacy by representing their national teams. By becoming a professional footballer, he continued the journey started by his father, Ojokolo, and his older brother, Junior. On Monday, Jordan achieved a significant milestone in Nigerian football history when he played for Nigeria during their tense 3-2 international friendly win over Mozambique. He played 75 minutes before being replaced by Calvin Bassey—this was Nigeria’s first friendly win in 55 months. Ojokolo Torunarigha played for Nigeria in the 1990s and represented Shooting Stars before moving to Germany, where Jordan was born. Before switching allegiance to Nigeria, Jordan played for Germany’s youth teams, amassing 30 appearances, including at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics and the U-20 World Cup. Jordan joins the likes of Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang, the Ayew brothers, and others who have followed in their fathers’ footsteps to play for their national teams in Africa. Jordan originally hoped to represent Germany at the senior level, inspired by players like Patrick Owomoyela, Jamal Musiala, and Karim Adeyemi, but eventually answered the call from Nigeria after careful consideration and discussions with coaches. He stated, “After a lot of consideration and good talks with the coach and all the people in charge, I decided to play for the country for which my father already stood on the pitch, Nigeria.” He was included in Nigeria’s squad for an Africa Cup of Nations qualifier against Sao Tome and Principe in September, though he did not play. After his debut, Jordan continues to rely on his father’s wisdom and advice as part of his development, and currently still lives with his parents and his sister in Spandau. Jordan aims to become a key player for both Gent and the Super Eagles, guided by his father’s words: “If you want to become one of the best, then you also have to think like one of the best.” He hopes to secure his place in Nigeria’s squad for the 2026 World Cup qualifiers and the upcoming Africa Cup of Nations, aspiring to reach heights his father never did.

article_content: John Motson admitted, 'I am still a bit embarrassed to be talking about it 43 years on, but Ronnie Radford’s goal changed my life.' At the time, Motson was still establishing himself in television broadcasting. He recalled, 'The match was supposed to be a formality, which is why I was assigned to it. But it turned into an unforgettable national event.' Afterwards, Motson watched the game recap with Hereford striker Billy Meadows, enjoying fish and chips. Ronnie Radford’s stunning goal against Newcastle United in the FA Cup became the defining moment of Motson’s career. 'What a goal, what a goal,' Motson exclaimed live. 'Radford the scorer. Ronnie Radford.' Wearing No. 11, Radford celebrated with both hands in the air as fans in green parkas and black-and-white scarves flooded the muddy pitch. In extra time, substitute Ricky George scored Hereford’s winning goal, slotting the ball low into the far corner. The Southern League underdogs had achieved a famous upset. Colin Addison, the player-manager in 1972, still organizes reunions for the legendary team. 'They say I’m their No. 13,' Motson joked. Hereford fans famously stormed the pitch after the historic win against Newcastle. The goalscorers, Ricky George and Ronnie Radford, were photographed smiling after the match. Three years ago, on the 40th anniversary, the FA Cup was brought to Hereford and paraded through the city. Photos of the reunited team, including Motson in his iconic sheepskin coat, are displayed in a glass case at the Green Dragon Hotel. Radford, a retired carpenter who now lives in Yorkshire, occasionally visits Hereford and says, 'The response is absolutely fantastic every time—just as it was back then. The supporters feel it as much as the players because they were a part of it. We couldn’t have done it without them. It will never be forgotten. Giantkilling—past, present, and future—is what the FA Cup is all about.' Colin Addison continues to bring the Hereford team together for reunions. Radford points out that the 1972 win over Newcastle was just one of Hereford’s memorable FA Cup moments. The club has also defeated West Ham, drawn with Arsenal and Tottenham, and narrowly lost to Leicester City, Nottingham Forest, and Manchester United. Hereford made history in 1952 with a 0-0 draw against Leyton, reportedly the first FA Cup match broadcast live other than the final. Radford remains captivated by recent FA Cup feats of teams like Warrington Town and Cambridge United. These moments contribute to the ongoing romance of the world’s oldest knockout competition, which the late Geoffrey Green of The Times once described as 'the spark that set the whole bonfire of football alight.'

O dönemde Motson, televizyon yayıncılığında kendini kanıtlamaya çalışıyordu. 'Maç formalite olarak görülüyordu, bu yüzden bana verilmişti. Ama unutulmaz bir ulusal olaya dönüştü,' diye hatırladı. Daha sonra Motson, Hereford forveti Billy Meadows ile maç özetini izleyip balık ve patates kızartması yedi. Ronnie Radford'ın Newcastle United'a FA Cup'ta attığı muhteşem gol, Motson’ın kariyerini tanımlayan an oldu. 'Ne gol ama, ne gol!' diye maç sırasında haykırdı Motson. 'Golü atan Radford, Ronnie Radford.' 11 numaralı formasıyla Radford, kolları havada kutlarken yeşil parka giymiş taraftarlar ve siyah-beyaz atkılı insanlar çamurlu sahaya akın etti. Uzatmalarda, yedek oyuncu Ricky George Hereford için galibiyet golünü uzak köşeye düzgün bir vuruşla gönderdi. Southern League'nin zayıf görülen takımı, ünlü bir sürprize imza atmıştı. 1972’de oyuncu-menajer olan Colin Addison, efsanevi takımı hâlâ buluşturuyor. 'Beni onların 13 numarası diyorlar,' diye şaka yaptı Motson. Hereford taraftarları, Newcastle'a karşı tarihi galibiyetin ardından sahaya akın etti. Golleri atan Ricky George ve Ronnie Radford, maç sonrası gülümseyerek fotoğraf çektirdi. Üç yıl önce, 40. yıl dönümünde FA Cup Hereford’a getirildi ve şehirde gezdirildi. Yeniden bir araya gelen takımın fotoğrafları ve Motson’un meşhur koyun postu paltosuyla görüntüsü Green Dragon Oteli’nde cam bir vitrinde sergileniyor. Şimdi Yorkshire’da yaşayan emekli marangoz Radford, zaman zaman Hereford’a dönüyor ve şöyle diyor: 'Her seferinde tepki harika—tıpkı o zamanki gibi. Taraftarlar bunu en az oyuncular kadar hissediyor çünkü onlar da bir parçasıydı. Onlar olmasaydı başaramazdık. Bu asla unutulmayacak. Sürpriz zaferler—geçmişten bugüne ve geleceğe—FA Cup'ın ruhudur.' Colin Addison takım buluşmalarını düzenlemeye devam ediyor. Radford, 1972'deki Newcastle galibiyetinin Hereford'un unutulmaz FA Cup anlarından sadece biri olduğunu vurguluyor. Kulüp ayrıca West Ham'ı yendi, Arsenal ve Tottenham ile berabere kaldı, Leicester City, Nottingham Forest ve Manchester United'a ise az farkla kaybetti. Hereford, 1952'de Leyton'a karşı oynadığı 0-0'lık maçla, final dışında ilk canlı yayınlanan FA Cup maçına imza atmıştı (rivayete göre). Radford, bu sezon Warrington Town ve Cambridge United gibi takımların FA Cup başarılarını hayranlıkla izledi. Bu anlar, The Times’tan merhum Geoffrey Green’in 'Futbol ateşinin tamamını tutuşturan kıvılcım' diye tanımladığı, dünyanın en eski eleme turnuvasının büyüsünün bir parçası.

article_content: Singer Casandra Ventura, known professionally as Cassie, and Sean 'Diddy' Combs settled a lawsuit only a day after its filing. Cassie accused Combs of years of abuse, including physical violence and sexual assault. The specifics of the settlement remain confidential, with both sides confirming that an agreement was reached to their mutual satisfaction. Cassie thanked her supporters and noted she resolved the matter in a way that gave her some control over the outcome. Combs also issued a short statement wishing Cassie and her family well and describing the settlement as amicable. Combs' attorney, Ben Brafman, previously stated that Combs strongly denies the accusations. The claims in the lawsuit date back to 2005, when Cassie, then 19, signed with Combs' label. The filing alleges abuse began in 2007 during their intermittent relationship, including violent incidents, drug use, and coerced sexual situations. Cassie also claimed that in 2018, as she tried to leave the relationship, Combs assaulted her in her Los Angeles home. Combs is a well-known producer, founder of Bad Boy Records, and a multi-Grammy winner, having collaborated with artists like Notorious B.I.G., Mary J. Blige, and Usher. He released a Grammy-nominated album in 2023 and received recognition from New York City Mayor Eric Adams for his influence. Cassie rose to prominence with her 2006 hit 'Me&U' and has appeared in film and television. Her attorney, Douglas Wigdor, commended her for the strength to speak out publicly against abuse. Prior to the suit, Combs’ legal team accused Cassie of seeking $30 million by threatening to write a revealing book, calling the demands blackmail. Wigdor replied that Combs had tried to pay Cassie for her silence, but she declined in favor of speaking up for women experiencing abuse. Wigdor praised Cassie’s bravery in filing the lawsuit.

article_content: In 2010, Rachelle Friedman's life changed dramatically when a friend playfully pushed her into a pool at her bachelorette party, leaving her a quadriplegic. Now a wife and advocate for people with spinal cord injuries, Rachelle is hoping for another life-changing act from a friend—one who has offered to carry her first child as a gestational surrogate. Rachelle, 28, and her husband Chris Chapman are working with Laurel Humes, a 31-year-old friend from East Carolina University, who has agreed to be their surrogate. Despite the support, Rachelle’s plans have faced criticism from some who doubt her parenting abilities due to her physical disability. When she shared her hopes for motherhood through surrogacy on her blog last March, she received both negative and positive responses. 'People will say, "She can’t be a mom; she’s in a wheelchair." That’s frustrating,' Rachelle said. 'No one judges a single mother or father’s physical ability to raise a child, so why am I seen as a hindrance? I can hold the baby, change diapers, feed, comfort, and dress it. Everything may take longer, but I can do it. I know many parents in wheelchairs who are amazing.' Laurel Humes, who lives in Asheville with her husband and young son, will travel to California for the embryo transfer. Rachelle started a GoFundMe account to help manage costs. She wanted a surrogate who had experience with pregnancy and felt more comfortable with Laurel, a mom herself. 'I feel really good about it,' Humes said. 'They will be great parents, and I’m excited to watch their family grow.' Rachelle and Chris are also considering keeping one embryo for a future child or even donating embryos to other couples who are struggling to conceive. In the four years since the accident, Rachelle married Chris, became an advocate, and published a book, 'The Promise,' which recounts her journey. Although writing was never her passion, she co-authored the book with Stephanie Krikorian to share her story—not only about the accident but also about the love and friendship that guided her through. She continues to keep the identity of the friend who pushed her into the pool private to protect her friend's well-being. The book details Rachelle's relationship with Chris, from their meeting at East Carolina University to their wedding. None of the women at the bachelorette party have ever revealed the identity of the friend who pushed her, choosing instead to focus on healing and support. Rachelle turned down media offers that required exposing her friend's identity. Since the accident, Rachelle has taken part in adaptive sports like wheelchair rugby and hand cycling, learned to surf and drive again, and become a motivational speaker and advocate for others with spinal cord injuries. She offers support to others both in person and online, and fans of her book are already asking for a sequel about motherhood, which she may consider in the future.

Şimdi spinal kord yaralanmaları olan insanlar için savunuculuk yapan ve evli olan Rachelle, hayatında yeni bir değişiklik yapılmasını umuyor: Bir arkadaşının onun ilk çocuğunu taşıması. 28 yaşındaki Rachelle ve eşi Chris Chapman, Doğu Carolina Üniversitesi'nden 31 yaşındaki arkadaşı Laurel Humes ile birlikte çalışıyor. Rachelle, geçen mart ayında blogunda taşıyıcı annelikle anne olma umudunu paylaştığında hem olumlu hem de olumsuz tepki aldı. Rachelle, 'Bazı insanlar, "O anne olamaz; tekerlekli sandalyede" diyecek. Bu gerçekten üzücü,' dedi. 'Tek başına olan bir annenin ya da babanın fiziksel uygunluğu sorgulanmıyor, o halde benim neden anneliğim bir engel olarak görülüyor? Bebeğimi tutabilirim, altını değiştirebilirim, besleyebilirim, rahatlatabilirim ve giydirebilirim. Belki her şey biraz daha uzun sürebilir ama yapabilirim. Tekerlekli sandalyede olup harika ebeveyn olan çok kişi tanıyorum.' Şu anda Asheville'de eşi ve küçük oğluyla yaşayan Laurel Humes, embriyo transferi için Kaliforniya'ya gidecek. Rachelle, masrafları karşılamak için GoFundMe hesabı açtı. Hamilelik tecrübesi olan ve anne olan biriyle daha rahat hissettiği için Laurel'i tercih etti. Laurel Humes, 'Bunun için kendimi çok iyi hissediyorum,' dedi. 'Onların harika ebeveyn olacağına ve ailelerinin büyümesini izlemekten dolayı çok heyecanlıyım.' Rachelle ve Chris, ileride ikinci bir çocuk için bir embriyoyu saklamayı veya çocuk sahibi olmakta güçlük çeken başka çiftlere embriyo bağışlamayı düşünüyor. Yazmak hiç tutkusu olmamasına rağmen Stephanie Krikorian ile birlikte bu kitabı yazarak yalnızca kazayı değil, ona yol gösteren dostluk ve sevgiyi de anlattı. Havuzda onu iten arkadaşının kimliğini korunmak amacıyla açıklamıyor. Kitap, Rachelle ve Chris'in Doğu Carolina Üniversitesi'nde ilk tanışmalarından düğünlerine kadar olan ilişkisini anlatıyor. Bekarlığa veda partisindeki kadınların hiçbiri, onu havuza iten arkadaşın kimliğini açıklamadı; odak noktaları iyileşmek ve destek oldu. Rachelle, arkadaşının ismi açıklanırsa katılması gereken medya tekliflerini de reddetti. Kazadan sonra Rachelle; tekerlekli sandalye ragbisi ve el bisikleti gibi adaptif sporlara katıldı, tekrar sörf yapmayı ve araba kullanmayı öğrendi ve omurilik yaralanmaları olan başkalarına motivasyon konuşmaları ve savunuculuk yapmaya başladı. article_content: A new study by the AAA Foundation for Traffic Safety reveals that drowsy or exhausted drivers are involved in 21% of fatal car crashes—far more than previously reported. The analysis examined 14,268 car crashes involving vehicle towing between 2009 and 2013. The report found that sleepy drivers played a role in approximately 6% of crashes where vehicles were towed, 7% of crashes with injury treatment, 13% of crashes resulting in hospitalization, and 21% of crashes that led to fatalities. When these figures are extrapolated nationwide, the research estimates that drowsy drivers are involved in an average of 328,000 crashes each year, leading to 109,000 injuries and 6,400 deaths. AAA Foundation President and CEO Peter Kissinger emphasized that drowsy driving is a serious safety concern, noting that many drivers underestimate the dangers and overestimate their ability to stay alert behind the wheel. Despite 95% of Americans considering it 'unacceptable' to drive while too tired to keep their eyes open, over 28% acknowledge having done so in the past month. Young adults aged 19–24 are most likely to admit drowsy driving (33% in the last month), while the youngest (16–18) and oldest (75+) drivers are least likely. The foundation released these findings to draw attention to Drowsy Driving Prevention Week, organized by the National Sleep Foundation from November 2–9.

Araştırma, 2009 ile 2013 yılları arasında çekiciyle taşınan 14.268 trafik kazasını inceledi. Rapor, uykulu sürücülerin araçların çekildiği kazaların yaklaşık %6’sında, yaralanma tedavisi gerektiren kazaların %7’sinde, hastaneye yatışla sonuçlananların %13’ünde ve ölümle sonuçlanan kazaların %21’inde rol oynadığını gösteriyor. article_content: Liberians are set to vote in a major election on October 10, in which President George Weah seeks a second term. Along with the presidency, all 15 Senate seats and 73 House seats are at stake, but the presidential race draws the most focus. Weah, representing the Coalition for Democratic Change and elected in 2017, competes against 19 contenders, most notably former Vice President Joseph Boakai and businessman Alexander Cummings. This will be Liberia’s fourth post-war general election and its first without the United Nations’ direct involvement. Major issues influencing the vote include economic grievances, increased drug trafficking, and unresolved consequences of past civil wars. Analysts believe voters will largely decide based on their satisfaction with the ruling party's record, rather than opposition promises. Drug abuse has become a serious concern, with a UN report in 2022 stating that 20% of Liberian youths use narcotics. A 520 kg cocaine seizure last October spotlighted the issue further, but controversy erupted when those arrested were acquitted and then lost track of by authorities, raising questions about accountability. All major candidates acknowledge the drug crisis. Boakai criticizes national leadership and the justice system, calling for structural reforms. Weah vows to treat addiction as a health emergency and boost law enforcement, while Cummings also stresses the need for stronger interventions. The legacy of Liberia’s civil wars persists. Although the Truth and Reconciliation Commission’s 2009 report recommended a war Crimes court and political bans for individuals linked to wartime abuses, these have not materialized. Cummings and Weah support creating a court to address past crimes. Boakai favors reconciliation conferences, but his ally Prince Johnson, a former warlord, opposes prosecutions and rejects any candidate supporting a war crimes court. Corruption remains widespread, with scandals and U.S. sanctions against officials fueling distrust. In his defense, Weah cites new laws enhancing the powers of the anticorruption body, while critics note that some sanctioned figures are still linked to the ruling party. The faltering economy is the primary issue for most voters. Inflation topped 12% in June 2023, the majority of jobs are informal, and staple prices have climbed since subsidy removals—fueling protests and hardship. Wage harmonization in 2019 further strained public sector incomes. Experts expect economic challenges and concerns about governance will strongly impact the outcome. Persistent insecurity and low foreign investment continue to threaten Liberia’s future stability.

article_content: When Bridget and Scott Bear from Omaha were expecting their son, Lawson, they wanted to avoid surprise medical bills. Using Alegent Health's 'My Cost' website tool, they entered insurance info and discovered that delivering Lawson at Lakeside Hospital would cost about $2,500. This helped them enjoy preparing for parenthood without worrying about expenses. More hospitals, online services, and even state groups are noticing that patients—especially those with high-deductible insurance—want transparent pricing. Alegent Health’s tool is one example. At Bellin Health in Wisconsin, patients began requesting price estimates in the early 2000s, but the process was complicated by varying costs for surgeons, facilities, and supplies, recalls Jeff Hampton, Bellin's revenue cycle director. To help, Bellin launched the 'Compare Care Line,' offering patients average procedure prices based on recent data to assist with budgeting. Other health systems are following suit. Integris Health in Oklahoma City started the 'Consumer Price Line' in July 2007, after secret shopper tests. The hotline now gets up to 1,000 calls a month from patients comparing procedure costs. Sixteen state hospital associations now provide online comparison tools for common procedures like appendectomies or joint replacements, allowing the public to see and compare prices. Other resources include Minnesota’s HealthScores and Pennsylvania’s Health Care Cost Containment Council, which show insurance payments and highlight big price differences—knee replacements in Pennsylvania, for example, have ranged from $11,243 to over $97,000. Individual hospitals are also boosting transparency. Dartmouth-Hitchcock Medical Center in New Hampshire posts detailed pricing on its website. Spokesperson Jason Aldous says these resources help patients have more informed discussions with their doctors, as each medical situation is different. Online platforms—such as New Choice Health—now make it possible for uninsured and high-deductible customers to cross-shop procedure costs nationwide. The site features average insurer payments for hundreds of services. Co-founder Brad Myers says many patients who negotiate can get significant discounts. Despite these tools, experts like Paul Fronstin (Employee Benefit Research Institute) note that such sites don’t always reflect what patients with traditional insurance will actually pay, due to variables like how much of their deductible they’ve met. Others, including Kathleen Stoll (Families USA), point out that advance pricing works best for predictable procedures (like childbirth), while costs for surgeries can vary due to unknowns and complications. For families like the Bears, having advance pricing information took major stress out of the birth experience, shifting their focus to the joy of welcoming a new child.

Yeni çevrimiçi platformlar—örneğin New Choice Health—artık sigortasız veya yüksek muafiyetli kişiler için ülke genelinde işlem maliyetlerini karşılaştırma olanağı sunuyor. Site, yüzlerce hizmette ortalama sigorta ödemesini sıralıyor. Kurucu ortak Brad Myers’a göre pazarlık yapan hastalar genellikle ciddi indirimler elde edebiliyor. Camden Council has acknowledged its involvement in the removal and destruction of tents belonging to homeless people in central London. Refuse workers were seen discarding the tents into a lorry on Huntley Street, Camden, around 3:00 pm GMT on Friday. In response, the council's acting leader ordered an urgent investigation into the incident. Deputy leader Adam Harrison stated that initial inquiries showed there was operational involvement from Camden Council. 

The tents were cleared after the Metropolitan Police issued a Section 35 dispersal order, requiring people to vacate the area for up to 48 hours. The police stated they worked in coordination with University College London Hospital (UCLH) and other partners due to concerns raised. Harrison acknowledged the situation on Friday was unacceptable and said something had clearly gone wrong. He clarified that while the dispersal order was requested by UCLH and enforced by police, waste collection was managed via the council, and support services were available for affected individuals.

A spokesperson for Veolia, the waste company, said they acted on behalf of and under the supervision of Camden Council and the police, following all required procedures for removing sensitive items. They added that the company is working with Camden Council to review future procedures. 

Elodie Berland, a volunteer with outreach group Streets Kitchen, documented the event after being alerted by some of the homeless men. According to police, one man was arrested for allegedly breaching the dispersal order. The force said hospital security had requested police assistance due to concerns for patient welfare, as the tents were on private land near the hospital entrance and had been there for up to nine months. Reports had also been received about anti-social behavior including drug use, public urination, defecation, and instances of patients and staff being intimidated or verbally abused. 

Authorities stated that on 6 and 7 November, partner organizations informed occupants about the hospital’s intention to clear the area on 10 November. A Section 35 Dispersal Order was then authorized on 10 November, and individuals were given two hours’ notice before clearance. Most left the site, some taking their tents, others leaving them behind. Veolia staff removed any tents left behind, but the tent and belongings of the man who was arrested were not discarded since he was present and had not abandoned them. Aid was provided to those impacted, authorities said.

A spokesperson for UCLH cited public health concerns, especially as the hospital treats immunocompromised patients. The hospital emphasized its commitment to supporting the health and wellbeing of homeless individuals, providing several services aimed at this group. 

Streets Kitchen founder Jon Glackin rejected the suggestion that the homeless individuals were dirty, calling for a constructive community response after the tent removal. The organization will co-host a public meeting at St Michael’s Church on Camden Road alongside other groups. 

Adam Harrison noted that the recent incident does not reflect the council’s values and stressed a commitment to improving support for rough sleepers in Camden. 

For further updates, listeners can tune in to BBC Radio London or follow BBC London on social media.

Camden Belediyesi, Londra merkezinde evsizlere ait çadırların kaldırılıp imha edilmesinde rol oynadığını kabul etti. Cuma günü saat 15:00 civarında Camden’daki Huntley Street’te çöpçülerin çadırları bir kamyonete attığı görüldü. Olayın ardından belediyenin geçici lideri acil soruşturma başlattı. Belediye başkan yardımcısı Adam Harrison, ilk incelemelerde Camden Belediyesi’nin operasyonel olarak dahil olduğunu belirtti.

Çadırlar, Metropolitan Polis’in 48 saate kadar alanı terk etmelerini emreden 35. Madde dağıtma kararı sonrasında kaldırıldı. Polis, bu kararın University College London Hospital (UCLH) ve diğer ortaklarla yapılan işbirliği sonucu oluşan endişeler nedeniyle alındığını açıkladı. Harrison, cuma günü yaşananların kabul edilemez olduğunu, bir şeylerin yanlış gittiğini söyledi. Ayrıca dağıtma kararının UCLH tarafından talep edilip polis tarafından uygulandığını, ancak atık toplamanın belediyece düzenlendiğini ve etkilenen kişiler için destek hizmetlerinin devrede olduğunu ifade etti.

Atık şirketi Veolia sözcüsü, Camden Belediyesi ve gerektiğinde polis denetiminde hareket ettiklerini ve hassas malların kaldırılmasında tüm prosedürlere uyduklarını bildirdi. Ayrıca, benzer taleplerin gelecekte nasıl ele alınacağını belediye ile birlikte gözden geçirdiklerini ekledi.

Streets Kitchen adlı yardım kuruluşundan gönüllü Elodie Berland, bazı evsizlerin çağrısı üzerine olayı kaydetti. Polis, bir kişinin dağıtma kararını ihlal ettiği gerekçesiyle gözaltına alındığını belirtti. Hastanenin güvenlik birimi, hasta güvenliği nedeniyle polisten yardım istemiş; çadırların girişteki özel mülkte dokuz aya kadar kaldığı bildirildi. Ayrıca, uyuşturucu kullanımı, halka açık yerde tuvalet ihtiyacı, ve bazı dilenciler ya da evsizler tarafından hasta ve personelin korkutulup sözlü saldırıya uğradığı gibi şikayetler olduğu aktarıldı.

Yetkililer, 6-7 Kasım’da partner kurumların, hastanenin 10 Kasım’da alanı boşaltmak istediği bilgisini alandaki insanlara ilettiklerini belirtti. 10 Kasım’da 35. Madde dağıtma kararı yürürlüğe girdi ve tahliyeden iki saat önce insanlara ayrılmaları için süre tanındı. Çoğu kişi giderken çadırını aldı, bazıları çadırını bıraktı. Alanı terk etmeyen kişinin çadırı ve eşyaları ise atılmadı. Yetkililer, etkilenenlere uygun desteğin sağlandığını bildirdi.

UCLH sözcüsü, özellikle bağışıklığı düşük hastaların tedavi edildiği bir hastane olduklarını, bu nedenle kamu sağlığı endişesiyle hareket ettiklerini kaydetti. Hastanenin evsizlere yönelik çeşitli hizmetleri olduğu, onların sağlığı ve refahını önemsedikleri de vurgulandı.

Streets Kitchen kurucusu Jon Glackin, evsizlerin ‘kirli’ olduğu iddiasını reddetti ve çadırların kaldırılması sonrası toplumda yapıcı bir tepki gösterilmesi çağrısı yaptı. Kuruluş, diğer gruplarla birlikte Camden Road’daki St Michael’s Kilisesi’nde halka açık bir toplantı düzenleyecek.

Adam Harrison, bu olayın belediyenin değerleriyle uyuşmadığını ve Camden’da sokakta yaşayanlara verilen destekleri artırmak için kararlı olduklarını söyledi.

Daha fazla bilgi ve güncelleme için BBC Radio London’ı dinleyebilir, BBC London’ı sosyal medyadan takip edebilirsiniz.

article_content: Karen Whitefield, a campaigns officer for the office and shopworkers’ union Usdaw, has been selected as the Labour candidate for a Scottish parliamentary seat. Her appointment comes after allegations earlier this year that another union, Unite, manipulated Labour’s candidate selection process in Falkirk to favor Karie Murphy by signing up local people as Labour members without their knowledge.  Despite the controversy and the party's subsequent search for a new candidate, Labour has chosen another union-affiliated woman, rather than distancing itself from union influence. Whitefield, who previously served as an MSP for Airdrie and Shotts until losing her seat in 2011, won against two other female contenders.  Whitefield stated that Labour must work hard to rebuild public trust after the difficult selection process prompted by the departure of MP Eric Joyce, who left the party following a bar-related incident in the House of Commons. 'It’s time to move forward and look to the future,' she said. 'We’ll be working hard to regain people’s trust and earn it for the future.'  In July, Labour leader Ed Miliband launched a strong critique of the Falkirk selection process after allegations of vote-rigging to ensure Karie Murphy’s selection. Internal investigations were reportedly discontinued after witnesses withdrew their evidence, and Miliband declined to publish the inquiry’s report or reopen it despite new calls and further leaked evidence.  Leaked documents indicated that Unite members were recruited to influence the party process and revealed evidence of forged signatures. Emails also reportedly claimed that some Labour leaders knew of and approved this strategy, even though it contravened party rules.  The local party was subsequently put under 'special measures,' and Linda Gow, the former Falkirk Council leader who highlighted the alleged vote-rigging, was not shortlisted as a candidate. Gow expressed disappointment at her exclusion.  Conservative MP Priti Patel criticized Labour leader Miliband for not reducing union influence, stating, 'Despite Ed Miliband promising to cut his links with his union paymasters, clearly nothing has changed as they parachute in another of their chosen candidates. If he can’t stand up to the unions, he’ll never be able to stand up for Britain on the world stage.'
translated_content: Ofis ve mağaza çalışanları sendikası Usdaw’da kampanyalar sorumlusu olan Karen Whitefield, İskoçya’daki bir parlamento koltuğu için İşçi Partisi adayı olarak seçildi. Bu atama, bu yılın başlarında başka bir sendika olan Unite’ın, Falkirk’te Karie Murphy’i desteklemek için İşçi Partisi’nin aday seçimini manipüle etmekle suçlanmasının ardından geldi. İddialara göre, Unite bazı yerel halkı bilgisi dışında İşçi Partisi üyesi olarak kaydetmişti.  Tartışmalara ve partinin yeni aday aramasına rağmen, İşçi Partisi sendika ile bağlantılı bir başka kadını tercih ederek sendikalardan uzaklaşmayı seçmedi. Whitefield, 2011’de koltuğunu kaybetmeden önce Airdrie ve Shotts bölgesinde İskoçya Parlamentosu üyesi olarak görev yapmıştı ve iki kadın aday arasından seçildi.  Whitefield, yerine geçtiği milletvekili Eric Joyce’un Avam Kamarası’ndaki bar olayının ardından partiden ayrılmasıyla başlayan zorlu seçim sürecinden sonra İşçi Partisi’nin toplumun güvenini yeniden kazanmak için çok çalışması gerektiğini söyledi. 'Artık ileriye bakma zamanı,' dedi. 'Halkın bize geçmişte verdiği güveni tekrar kazanmak ve geleceğe taşımak için çok çalışacağız.'  Temmuz ayında, İşçi Partisi lideri Ed Miliband, Karie Murphy’nin tercih edilmesi için oylamanın manipüle edildiğine dair iddialar üzerine Falkirk’teki aday belirleme sürecine sert eleştirilerde bulundu. Tanıkların ifadelerini geri çekmesinin ardından başlatılan iç soruşturmanın sessizce sona erdirildiği, ayrıca Miliband’ın soruşturma raporunu yayımlamayı ya da yeni gelişmelere rağmen konuyu yeniden incelemeyi reddettiği bildirildi.  Sızan belgeler, Unite üyelerinin parti içi süreçleri etkilemek için işe alındığını ve bazı imzaların sahte olduğuna dair kanıtlar ortaya koydu. Ayrıca bazı İşçi Partisi yöneticilerinin, parti kurallarına aykırı olmasına rağmen bu stratejiyi bildiği ve onayladığı iddia edildi.  Ardından yerel parti 'özel gözetim' altına alındı; iddiaları gündeme getiren eski Falkirk Konsey lideri Linda Gow’a nihai aday listesinde yer verilmedi. Gow, bu duruma üzüldüğünü belirtti.  Muhafazakar milletvekili Priti Patel ise Ed Miliband’ı sendika etkisini azaltmadığı için eleştirerek şöyle dedi: 'Ed Miliband, sendika finansörleriyle olan bağlarını koparacağını vaat etmesine rağmen, görünen o ki hiçbir şey değişmedi; yine adaylarını tepeden indiriyorlar. Sendikalara karşı duramıyorsa, Britanya’yı da uluslararası arenada savunamaz.'

During a recent interview on The Jonathan Ross Show, Sir Paul McCartney opened up about the profound shock he felt upon hearing that John Lennon had been murdered in December 1980. He recalled being at home in the countryside when he got the call, admitting that it was incredibly difficult to process and to inform his family. McCartney compared the tragedy’s impact to that of President Kennedy’s assassination, noting how it affected countless people.

McCartney did not mince words about Lennon’s killer, Mark Chapman, whom he labeled as 'the jerk of all jerks,' emphasizing his frustration over the lack of meaningful reason behind the murder. He explained that the act wasn’t born out of politics or ideology but was simply a random tragedy.

Reflecting on his relationship with Lennon, McCartney described how the two were able to overcome the bitterness that followed The Beatles’ breakup in 1970. As both became fathers, they reconnected over shared experiences, discussing everyday life and even bread recipes. McCartney expressed sincere gratitude for having restored their friendship before Lennon’s untimely death, stating that affection ultimately prevailed over past disagreements.

He also addressed the ongoing attention that Chapman receives due to the crime, criticizing the notoriety that has followed.
translated_content:
Sir Paul McCartney, geçtiğimiz günlerde The Jonathan Ross Show’da Aralık 1980’de John Lennon’ın öldürüldüğünü öğrendiğinde yaşadığı büyük şoku anlattı. McCartney, kırsalda evindeyken aldığı bu haberin ardından bunu kabullenmenin ve ailesine söylemenin son derece zor olduğunu ifade etti. Olayın etkisini Başkan Kennedy’nin suikastine benzetti ve bunun çoğu insanı çok derinden etkilediğini vurguladı.

McCartney, Lennon’ın katili Mark Chapman’a 'aptalların en aptalı' diyerek, cinayetin ardında hiçbir anlamlı neden olmamasının kendisini öfkelendirdiğini söyledi. Bu cinayetin ne politik ne de ideolojik bir motivasyondan, tamamen rastgele bir trajediden kaynaklandığını belirtti.

The Beatles’ın 1970’te dağılmasından sonra Lennon’la yaşanan kırgınlığın zamanla aşıldığını dile getiren McCartney, ikisinin de baba olmasının ardından günlük hayatla ilgili, hatta ekmek tarifleri gibi konularla tekrar yakınlaştıklarını anlattı. Lennon’ın talihsiz ölümü öncesinde dostluklarını yeniden kurabilmiş olmaktan dolayı çok müteşekkir olduğunu; geçmişteki anlaşmazlıklardan ziyade aralarındaki sevgi ve bağlılığın daha önemli olduğunu vurguladı.

Ayrıca, Chapman’ın bu suça olan ilgiden hâlâ faydalanmasını ve medyada gündemde kalmasını da eleştirdi.

article_content: With energy bills soaring, inventive solutions for low-cost heating are gaining attention. Journalist and boat owner Dylan Winter, known on YouTube as KeepTurningLeft, has demonstrated a DIY heater costing just 8p a day to operate. His setup uses four tealights placed inside a standard loaf tin, covered by two differently sized ceramic flowerpots. The candles’ heat is concentrated and released through a system of convection heat transfer, which Winter reports is enough to heat a room or his boat’s interior for about eight hours daily. To assemble the heater, Winter lights four tealights in the tin, places a small upside-down flowerpot over them, and covers the top hole with a metal tealight casing. A larger flowerpot is positioned over the smaller one, with the upper hole left open to allow hot air to escape. The system works by channeling heated air up through the pots, creating a convection current that distributes warmth into the room. Winter, who uses the heater both at home and on his boat, sourced his tealights from Ikea—£1 buys a pack of 100. He claims the simple device can provide continuous heat throughout the day by burning two sets of four tealights, one in the morning and another in the afternoon. However, fire safety experts caution against using homemade heaters containing open flames. Charlie Pugsley, Station Manager with the London Fire Brigade, warned that such systems are unsafe as they dramatically increase the risk of accidental fires. He advised the public to prioritize safety, noting that candles and tealights are a common cause of household fires and fatalities. While creative approaches to reducing heating costs are appealing, authorities urge caution and recommend considering safer, approved alternatives.

article_content: Cadillac has announced the addition of a new electric vehicle model, the Optiq, to its lineup. Owned by General Motors, Cadillac stated the Optiq will serve as the entry-level option in its electric vehicle range and promises 'spirited driving dynamics.' More details are expected to be released next year, according to a press release. The Optiq will be Cadillac’s fourth electric vehicle and is positioned as a more accessible model, likely debuting at a lower price than the Lyriq, currently the brand’s most affordable EV at $58,590. At the higher end, Cadillac offers the 2025 Escalade IQ SUV, priced at $130,000, and the Celestiq sedan, starting at around $340,000. This announcement comes as General Motors continues to increase electric vehicle production across all its main brands, including Chevrolet, Buick, and GMC. The automaker previously declared an ambitious goal in 2021 to transition to an all-electric lineup by 2035. However, supply chain complications and challenges with battery cell production have slowed progress. Recent strikes organized by the United Auto Workers (UAW), partly over concerns about job reductions from GM’s electrification plans, occurred in September and October of this year and reportedly cost GM $200 million per week, according to the BBC. In the US, consumer demand for electric vehicles has plateaued in 2023 as high prices have made them less accessible to average buyers. EVs accounted for 9% of new car sales through September. As Washington, D.C. area dealer Vince Sheehy noted to Business Insider, 'No matter what claim somebody can make about the long-term ownership cost of a vehicle, if the entry point is $45,000-plus, that’s still steep.'

General Motors'un sahibi olduğu Cadillac, Optiq'in elektrikli araç serisindeki giriş seviyesi seçenek olacağını ve 'dinamik bir sürüş deneyimi' sunacağını belirtti. Şirketin basın açıklamasına göre, modelle ilgili daha fazla ayrıntı gelecek yıl paylaşılacak. Üst segmentte ise Cadillac, 130.000 dolarlık 2025 Escalade IQ SUV ve yaklaşık 340.000 dolardan başlayan Celestiq sedanı sunuyor. Bu duyuru, General Motors’un Chevrolet, Buick ve GMC gibi ana markalarında elektrikli araç üretimini artırmaya devam ettiği bir döneme denk geliyor. Otomobil üreticisi, 2021 yılında tamamıyla elektrikli araçlara geçme hedefini duyurmuştu. Ancak tedarik zinciri sorunları ve batarya hücresi üretimiyle ilgili sıkıntılar ilerlemeyi yavaşlattı. Birleşik Otomobil İşçileri Sendikası (UAW) tarafından Eylül ve Ekim aylarında düzenlenen ve GM’nin elektrikleşme planları nedeniyle işten çıkarmalara dair endişeleri de içeren grevlerin, BBC’ye göre, GM’ye haftalık 200 milyon dolara mal olduğu bildirildi. ABD’de, elektrikli araçlara olan tüketici talebi 2023’te durağanlaştı; yüksek fiyatlar bu araçları ortalama tüketici için ulaşılması zor hale getirdi. article_content: Surprise attacks by Hamas militants in Israel over the weekend have raised significant concerns about disruptions and security risks for the nation's vital high-tech sector. According to a Reuters report published on Oct. 9, Israeli tech companies are expected to increase security protocols and could encounter staffing challenges as military reservists are mobilized, investors and analysts say. Israel's high-tech industries constitute 14 percent of the country's jobs and contribute nearly 20 percent of its GDP. As a key driver of economic growth, the sector encompasses thousands of startups and R&D centers operated by global multinationals. Following the attacks—during which Hamas gunmen rampaged through Israeli towns and fired thousands of rockets, some reaching Tel Aviv—stock prices fell and many businesses closed. The scale and coordination of these attacks marked a significant escalation compared to previous conflicts. Airlines also halted flights to Israel due to safety concerns. Hamas, the Palestinian militant group controlling Gaza, has fought several conflicts with Israel in the past. However, this weekend's attacks stand out as particularly broad and well-organized. The ongoing violence has resulted in hundreds of deaths. Israel's substantial military reserve force could mean more tech workers being called up for active duty, putting additional strain on companies trying to maintain operations amid a shrinking workforce. Major technology firms like Intel, Nvidia, and Microsoft, all of which have significant operations and R&D hubs in Israel, could be directly affected. Intel, the country's largest private employer and exporter, stated it is monitoring the situation and taking steps to protect its staff. Nvidia has canceled an AI conference in Tel Aviv scheduled for next week, citing safety concerns. Some analysts suggest the conflict could eventually spur investment in Israeli tech and artificial intelligence firms tied to defense and security. Still, the sector was already facing a slowdown ahead of the attacks, due to domestic political turmoil and protests. Recently, more Israeli startups have chosen to incorporate in the United States. Analysts note that Israel’s technology sector has shown resilience following previous conflicts and is expected to recover once security stabilizes. However, the unprecedented scope of the recent violence may present new challenges for the industry.
translated_content: Hafta sonu Hamas militanlarının İsrail'de düzenlediği sürpriz saldırılar, ülkenin hayati derecede önemli yüksek teknoloji sektöründe aksaklıklar ve güvenlik riskleri konusunda ciddi endişelere yol açtı. 9 Ekim'de yayımlanan Reuters haberine göre, İsrailli teknoloji şirketlerinin güvenlik protokollerini artırması ve yedek askerlerin orduya çağrılmasıyla personel sıkıntısı yaşaması bekleniyor; bu görüş yatırımcılar ve analistler tarafından paylaşılıyor. İsrail'in yüksek teknoloji endüstrisi, ülke istihdamının %14'ünü sağlar ve GSYİH'nın neredeyse %20'sine katkıda bulunur. Ekonomik büyümenin ana itici güçlerinden biri olan bu sektörde binlerce girişim ve çok uluslu şirketlerin AR-GE merkezleri yer almaktadır. Hamas militanlarının İsrail kasabalarında dolaşıp binlerce roket fırlatmasının ardından, bazı roketlerin Tel Aviv'e ulaşmasıyla borsalar geriledi ve birçok işletme kapandı. Bu saldırıların ölçeği ve koordinasyonu, önceki çatışmalara kıyasla önemli düzeyde bir tırmanma olarak değerlendiriliyor. Havayolu şirketleri de güvenlik kaygıları nedeniyle İsrail seferlerini durdurdu. Gazze'yi kontrol eden Filistinli silahlı grup Hamas, daha önce de İsrail ile birçok defa çatıştı. Ancak bu hafta sonu gerçekleştirilen saldırılar, özellikle geniş kapsamı ve koordinasyonu ile öne çıkıyor. Devam eden şiddet olaylarında yüzlerce kişi hayatını kaybetti. İsrail'in büyük yedek asker gücü dikkate alındığında, daha fazla teknoloji çalışanının aktif göreve çağrılması şirketlerin azalan personelle faaliyetlerini sürdürmesini zorlaştırabilir. Intel, Nvidia ve Microsoft gibi büyük teknoloji şirketlerinin İsrail'de önemli operasyonları ve AR-GE merkezleri bulunuyor. Ülkenin en büyük özel işvereni ve ihracatçısı olan Intel, durumu yakından izlediğini ve çalışanlarının güvenliği için önlemler aldığını açıkladı. Nvidia ise saldırılar nedeniyle gelecek hafta Tel Aviv'de düzenlenecek yapay zeka konferansını iptal etti. Bazı analistler, bu çatışmanın uzun vadede savunma ve güvenlik amaçlı teknoloji ve yapay zeka şirketlerine yatırımı artırabileceğini ileri sürüyor; ancak sektör, saldırılardan önce de iç siyasi çekişmeler ve protestolar nedeniyle yavaşlama eğilimindeydi. Son yıllarda daha çok İsrailli girişim şirketlerini ABD'de kurmayı tercih ediyor. Analistlere göre, İsrail'in teknoloji sektörü daha önceki çatışmaların ardından toparlanmayı başardı ve güvenlik koşulları düzeldiğinde yeniden toparlanması bekleniyor. Ancak, bu son şiddet dalgasının benzeri görülmemiş boyutu sektör için yeni zorluklar yaratabilir.

article_content: A remarkable collection of mid-19th-century photographs depicting daily life in China and Japan sold for £12,500 at an auction in Cirencester, far exceeding the initial £2,000 guide price. Taken from 'China Magazine,' published between 1868 and 1870, these images provide rare glimpses into daily scenes, including villagers at work, street barbers, fruit sellers, gamblers, and a military mandarin. Unlike other period collections focusing on emperors and military figures, these photographs highlight ordinary people engaged in everyday activities. Noteworthy subjects include markets, a village council, and Hong Kong’s Tai Ping Shan Street. The album comprises 46 photographs of various sizes—four are duplicates and one is defective—and is accompanied by articles detailing life in mid-19th-century China. Some images feature significant figures, such as a town council and a village elder with his son from Annam (modern Vietnam). Historians describe these prints as exceptionally rare. Terry Bennett, author of 'History of Photography in China: Western Photographers,' notes that 'China Magazine' may have been the first publication in the Far East to incorporate pasted-in photographs. The collection is thought to have inspired John Reddie Black’s better-known 'Far East' magazine. The photographs were taken during the reign of the Tongzhi Emperor (1861–1875) of the Qing Dynasty, a period largely dominated by his mother, Empress Dowager Cixi. These years saw the violent conclusion of the Taiping Rebellion, followed by the Dungan Revolt in the northwest, both resulting in significant migration and loss of life. The era also marked a surge in Western missionary activity throughout China after the Second Opium War, leading to extensive Christian evangelism by the end of the 19th century.

article_content: The Nigeria Football Federation has released the list of players invited by Super Eagles head coach Jose Peseiro for the upcoming international friendlies against Saudi Arabia and Mozambique. Once again, long-time captain Ahmed Musa misses out. Nigeria will face the Green Falcons of Saudi Arabia in Portimão, Portugal, on Friday, October 13, followed by another match against Mozambique in the same city three days later. Players are expected to arrive in Faro, Portugal, on Tuesday, October 10. Musa was absent from Nigeria’s last Africa Cup of Nations qualifier against Sao Tome and Principe due to injury. His omission this time is unsurprising, as the 30-year-old has only played a total of nine minutes across Sivasspor’s last three games in the Turkish league, often remaining an unused substitute. Reactions on social media have trended towards celebration over Musa's exclusion. On the Super Eagles’ X (formerly Twitter) handle, fans like Faith Collins wrote, 'Thank God Ahmed Musa is dropped. We move.' Another user, Igbobadboye, added, 'Finally free from Ahmed Musa’s grasp. Thank you.' Other comments displayed both humor and sarcasm. Meanwhile, coach Peseiro has handed a first-ever call-up to Hatayspor midfielder Fisayo Dele-Bashiru, who has impressed in Turkey this season with four goals and two assists in seven matches. Returning to the squad are defenders Kenneth Omeruo and Bright Osayi-Samuel, midfielder Alex Iwobi, and forward Terem Moffi. First-choice goalkeepers Francis Uzoho, Adebayo Adeleye, and Olorunleke Ojo retain their spots, and talented yet-to-be-capped defender Jordan Torunnarigha joins the roster. Notable regulars such as Wilfred Ndidi, Raphael Onyedika, Joe Aribo, Frank Onyeka, Kelechi Iheanacho, Samuel Chukwueze, Moses Simon, Ademola Lookman, Victor Osimhen, Taiwo Awoniyi, and Victor Boniface all feature in the squad.

Germany’s Bundestag has approved a second bailout for Greece, totaling £108 billion, despite strong opposition from its citizens. Chancellor Angela Merkel argued in favor of the aid, stating that allowing Greece to default would be irresponsible, although she admitted the plan carries risks and no guaranteed success. The measure passed with 496 votes in favor and 90 against, with five abstentions; support from opposition parties ensured its passage, even though approximately 80% of Germans were opposed.

Doubts remain among German leaders and experts. Interior Minister Hans-Peter Friedrich controversially suggested Greece’s recovery might be better outside the eurozone, contrary to Merkel’s position. The popular newspaper Bild urged lawmakers to block the package and published critiques from prominent economists who believe the bailout will not solve Greece’s underlying problems.

Norbert Barthle, a spokesperson from Merkel’s CDU party, questioned whether Greece could realistically reduce its debt to the target 120.5% of GDP by 2020, as intended by the bailout terms. International concerns have mounted, with the G20 urging Germany to bolster the European rescue fund for broader global support. Stock indexes in Germany and France dropped over 1% as financial uncertainty over the effectiveness of the bailout persisted.

While Merkel maintains that aiding Greece is essential for the stability of the European Union, skepticism among the German public and doubts about the long-term success of repeated bailouts continue to grow.

article_content: Wayne Rooney has suggested that his former Manchester United teammate Cristiano Ronaldo is primarily driven by a desire for personal recognition. As the World Cup approaches, Rooney commented that Ronaldo is focused on his own achievements, mentioning the Portuguese star’s dramatic celebration after scoring in the Champions League final for Real Madrid. Rooney, who played with Ronaldo from 2004 to 2009, contrasted their approaches: 'I’m not someone who needs a legacy – Cristiano does. I care more about winning as a team. Individual accolades aren’t as valuable to me as lifting a trophy with United.' Looking ahead to England’s World Cup opener against Italy in Manaus, Rooney expressed confidence about facing Juventus defenders Leonardo Bonucci and Giorgio Chiellini. He noted, 'When you play with high tempo, they’ve struggled. The Italian league isn’t as fast as the Premier League. We even saw players like Nesta and Maldini find it difficult when we increased the pace.' Rooney also believes this England squad is stronger and more dynamic than those from 2006 and 2010. He highlighted the impact of young talents Ross Barkley and Raheem Sterling, stating that their fearlessness and energy could be crucial. Despite his success at club level, including five Premier League titles and a Champions League win, Rooney has not scored at a World Cup. He said, 'I’ve had a good record in qualifiers, but now I want to help England succeed by scoring goals. I feel better than I have in years and I’m ready for this tournament.' Rooney is close to surpassing Michael Owen’s 40-goal mark and hopes to eventually catch Sir Bobby Charlton’s all-time England scoring record. He added, 'Reaching Bobby’s record would be a huge achievement for me.'

article_content: ADDIS ABABA, Ethiopia (CNN) — Libyan President Moammar Gadhafi has been elected chairman of the African Union (AU), according to official news agencies from Ethiopia and Libya. Gadhafi will serve a one-year term, replacing Tanzanian President Jakaya Kikwete, who held the position for the previous year. The chairmanship of the AU is a rotating post, assigned annually to a head of state. At a closed session on Monday, the Assembly of the African Union Heads of State and Government, which includes 53 member nations, selected Gadhafi as the new chair. Libya’s official news agency reported that Gadhafi’s goals in his new role include establishing an executive authority for the AU, with the ambition of propelling the continent toward greater unity, specifically the idea of a 'United States of Africa.' Regarding Gadhafi’s appointment, U.S. State Department spokesman Robert Wood commented that the United States would continue working with the AU to promote peace, stability, economic development, and humanitarian aid in Africa, emphasizing the AU’s importance as an American partner. The United States had previously designated Libya a state sponsor of terrorism in 1979 and severed diplomatic ties in 1981 following years of tension that began after Gadhafi took power in a 1969 coup. Relations improved after Libya agreed to compensate families of the 1988 Pan Am bombing over Lockerbie, Scotland, and announced it would dismantle its weapons of mass destruction program. As a result, the U.S. removed Libya from its list of state sponsors of terrorism and restored full diplomatic relations in 2006.

Kaddafi, bir yıl süreyle görev yapacak ve önceki yıl bu görevi üstlenen Tanzanya Devlet Başkanı Jakaya Kikwete'nin yerini alacak. Afrika Birliği başkanlığı, her yıl bir devlet başkanına devredilen döner bir görevdir. Pazartesi günü kapalı oturumda, 53 üyeli Afrika Birliği Devlet ve Hükümet Başkanları Meclisi, yeni başkan olarak Kaddafi’yi seçti. Libya’nın resmi haber ajansına göre, Kaddafi'nin yeni görevindeki hedefleri arasında Afrika Birliği için yürütme yetkisine sahip bir otorite oluşturmak ve kıtayı daha fazla bütünleşmeye yönlendirmek, özellikle de 'Afrika Birleşik Devletleri' fikrini hayata geçirmek var. Kaddafi’nin seçilmesiyle ilgili olarak ABD Dışişleri Bakanlığı Sözcüsü Robert Wood, Amerika Birleşik Devletleri’nin Afrika’da barış, istikrar, ekonomik kalkınma ve insani yardım sağlama çabalarında Afrika Birliği ile işbirliğini sürdüreceğini, AU'nun ABD için önemli bir ortak olmaya devam edeceğini belirtti. Amerika Birleşik Devletleri, Libya’yı 1979’da terörü destekleyen devlet olarak tanımlamış ve 1981’de diplomatik ilişkileri kesmişti; bu gerilimler, Kaddafi’nin 1969’daki darbe ile başa gelmesinden sonra başlamıştı. article_content: Helen Fielding, the bestselling author behind Bridget Jones, is set to release 'Mad About The Boy', her first Bridget Jones novel in over a decade. Despite blending in on the school run, Fielding stands apart for her literary fame and financial success. At 55, Fielding reconnects with the beloved Bridget, now depicted as an older mother dealing with the realities of parenting, social media, and online relationships. Instead of focusing on diet and drinking, the new book explores Bridget’s experiences with motherhood and technology. Fielding's earlier books were major bestsellers exceeding 16 million copies sold and became hit films. She admits experiencing a period of creative pause after those successes but rediscovered her inspiration when daily life began to feel funny and worth writing about again. Her professional achievements brought her from London to Los Angeles, where she lived with TV executive Kevin Curran and had two children, Dashiell and Romy. Although engagement was proposed, the couple never married. They eventually separated in 2009, after which Fielding relocated back to London. While in LA, Fielding enjoyed a vibrant social life, befriending stars like Carrie Fisher and Tracey Ullman, but she now lives a more independent lifestyle in London. Distinct at the school gate for her fashion and single status, she’s also known for her assertive approach and direct involvement in both personal and creative matters. Fielding admits being anxious about the response to her upcoming novel, seeking reassurance from her goddaughter Scarlett Curtis. While Scarlett was encouraging, wider public opinion has been mixed, with some questioning Bridget Jones’s continued relevance. Drawing from her own experiences as a single mother, Fielding’s latest novel will cover themes of online dating, modern parenting, and technology’s effects on relationships—all told through Bridget’s humorous voice. Although Fielding continues to deny that Bridget is her alter ego, Bridget’s story increasingly parallels her own as a strong, independent, and accomplished woman.

Yeni romanda artık kilo ve alkol yerine, annelik ve teknoloji deneyimleri ön planda. Fielding’in önceki kitapları 16 milyondan fazla sattı ve sinemaya uyarlandı. Başarılarının ardından kısa bir yaratıcı durgunluk yaşadığını itiraf eden yazar, sonradan günlük hayatında yaşadığı komik anlarla ilhamını yeniden bulduğunu söylüyor. article_content: The Detroit Tigers have made Major League Baseball history by becoming the first team with three pitchers who have all won the prestigious Cy Young Award. On Thursday’s trade deadline, the Tigers acquired David Price from the Tampa Bay Rays in a major multi-team deal. Price now joins fellow Cy Young winners Max Scherzer and Justin Verlander, giving Detroit a rotation stacked with star power. Each pitcher claimed the award in the last three seasons. Currently leading the AL Central, the Tigers are striving for their fourth straight division title and have assembled one of the league’s most formidable pitching squads to boost their chances. General Manager Dave Dombrowski said, 'The question that we asked ourselves is: What gives us the best chance of winning the world championship this year? We thought adding him to our rotation at this point would give us the best chance to do that.' He added, 'Today it’s great. I love to have David Price. If we win, then I’ll be very satisfied.' Price responded to the move with gratitude on Twitter, writing, 'Wow...what a day!! Rays fans THANK YOU!! Great Chapter of my life just ended … ready to start a new one with the Tigers!! Thanks again.' The trade, which also involved the Seattle Mariners, saw Detroit send outfielder Austin Jackson to Seattle. The Tigers’ pitcher Drew Smyly and the Mariners’ infielder Nick Franklin went to the Rays, along with Tigers minor-league shortstop Willy Adames. Andrew Friedman, Tampa Bay’s vice-president of baseball operations, explained, 'Compared to the other possibilities, it was by far the most prudent thing that we could do for the best interests of the franchise. If you look ahead to next year, it would have been really challenging to be as good as we want to be within our situation, with David taking up that meaningful of a percentage of our payroll. So everything we do is in the vein of how to be competitive in the near term and also the long term.' Detroit plans to use Price alongside Verlander, Scherzer, Anibal Sanchez, and Rick Porcello. Price, 28, currently leads the American League in innings and strikeouts, ranks seventh in WHIP, third in strikeouts per walk, and fifth in strikeouts per nine innings.
