article_content: The U.S. figure skating team won bronze by finishing third in the first Olympic team skating event at the 2014 Sochi Winter Games. Gracie Gold, age 18, delivered a spectacular long program, landing all 11 jumps and earning a personal best score of 129.36. Her effort helped secure second place individually and was key to the team’s overall result. While the American team didn’t clinch gold, Gold’s stellar performance raised hopes for her prospects in the upcoming individual events. The Russian team, powered by 15-year-old Julia Lipnitskaya’s dominant display and veteran Evgeny Plushenko’s experienced execution, took the gold medal, with Canada earning silver. Lipnitskaya outscored Gold by 12 points and became the youngest Olympic figure skating champion in 78 years. Ashley Wagner’s spot on the U.S. team, chosen over Mirai Nagasu despite placing lower at Nationals, drew attention. Wagner’s fourth place finish in the short program and her vocal dissatisfaction with the marks fueled further discussion. Nevertheless, her score was crucial for the U.S. team’s advance to the finals and subsequent podium finish. The event was highlighted by mutual respect among competitors. Following Russia’s victory, President Vladimir Putin congratulated the U.S. skaters. Evgeny Plushenko received commendation for his comeback and competitive performance at age 31, despite lingering injury concerns. The final team standings were: Russia first (75 points), Canada second (65), and the United States third (60), followed by Italy and Japan. The Olympic debut of the team event promised an exciting lead-up to the individual figure skating contests.

Bu performansıyla bireysel olarak ikinci oldu ve takımın başarısına önemli katkı sağladı. PARIS – The French government has accused Russia of orchestrating an online destabilization campaign that leveraged automated social media accounts to stoke controversy and confusion about spray-painted Stars of David appearing on the streets of Paris. The graffiti, quickly removed by authorities, is now under investigation by French police to determine if it was antisemitic in nature and whether it was organized from outside the country.

The stenciled blue stars, which appeared on walls across Paris and its suburbs last month, rapidly sparked debate and concern on social media, raising fears for the safety of France’s Jewish community—the largest in Europe. In the wake of Hamas's October 7 attack on Israel, which ignited a new and deadly phase of the conflict, French authorities have recorded over 1,150 antisemitic incidents, nearly triple the total from 2022, according to the Interior Ministry.

In a statement Thursday, the Foreign Ministry attributed the online uproar to a Russian bot network, Recent Reliable News (also known as Doppelgänger), which used thousands of posts on X (formerly Twitter) to fuel the controversy. Bots—automated accounts programmed to mimic human behavior and amplify messages—can be used for malicious purposes.

“This new operation of Russian digital interference against France demonstrates a persistent and opportunistic strategy to exploit international crises, sow confusion, and create tension in public discourse both in France and Europe,” the Ministry stated. The French digital watchdog Viginum, established in 2021 after foreign interference in the 2017 presidential election, uncovered a network of 1,095 bots publishing 2,589 posts on X in less than two weeks, significantly contributing to the debate surrounding the graffiti. Viginum also reported that the RRN network appeared to have inside knowledge of the graffiti, posting about the stars nearly 48 hours before other users.

The European Union has designated RRN as part of a wider Russian information manipulation campaign that has also spread pro-invasion propaganda concerning Ukraine. The network is said to use not just fake social media accounts, but imitation news outlets and government websites. In July, the Council of the EU announced sanctions against Russian individuals and entities linked to these actions.

AP journalists John Leicester in Le Pecq, France, and Kelvin Chan in London contributed to this report.

PARİS – Fransız hükümeti, Rusya'yı Paris sokaklarında sprey boyayla çizilen Davut Yıldızları üzerinden tartışma ve kafa karışıklığı yaratmak amacıyla otomatik sosyal medya hesaplarını kullanan bir çevrim içi istikrarsızlaştırma kampanyası yürütmekle suçladı. Yetkililer tarafından hızla silinen bu grafitiler, şu anda Fransız polisinin antisemitik olup olmadıkları ve ülke dışından organize edilip edilmedikleri yönündeki soruşturması altında.

Geçen ay Paris ve banliyölerinin duvarlarında görünen mavi şablon yıldızlar, sosyal medyada hızla tartışma ve endişe yaratırken, Avrupa'nın en büyük Yahudi topluluğu olan Fransa’daki Yahudilerin güvenliği hakkındaki kaygıları artırdı. Hamas’ın 7 Ekim’de İsrail’e gerçekleştirdiği saldırı sonrası başlayan ve çatışmanın yeni ve ölümcül bir evreye geçmesine yol açan süreçte, İçişleri Bakanlığı'na göre Fransız yetkililer 1.150’den fazla antisemitik olay kaydetti. Bu, 2022’deki vakaların neredeyse üç katı.

Perşembe günü yapılan açıklamada Dışişleri Bakanlığı, çevrim içi tartışmanın fitilini ateşleyen Rus bot ağına (Recent Reliable News ya da diğer adıyla Doppelgänger) dikkat çekti; binlerce gönderiyle tartışmayı alevlendirdiklerini belirtti. İnsan davranışını taklit ederek mesajları yayan ve genellikle kötü niyetli amaçlar için kullanılan botlar, otomatik hesaplardan oluşuyor.

“Rusya’nın Fransa’ya karşı yürüttüğü bu yeni dijital müdahale operasyonu, uluslararası krizleri fırsata çeviren ve kamuoyunda kafa karışıklığı ile gerginlik yaratmayı amaçlayan kalıcı ve oportünist bir stratejinin göstergesidir,” denildi. 2017 Cumhurbaşkanlığı seçimindeki dış saldırılardan sonra 2021’de kurulan Fransız dijital gözlem kuruluşu Viginum, 1.095 botun iki haftadan kısa sürede X’te 2.589 paylaşım yaptığını ve tartışmaya önemli ölçüde katkı sağladığını tespit etti. Viginum ayrıca, RRN ağının grafitilerle ilgili bilgiyi diğer kullanıcılardan yaklaşık 48 saat önce paylaştığını bildirdi.

Avrupa Birliği ise RRN’yi, Rusya'nın Ukrayna işgaline destek veren propagandaları da içeren daha geniş bir bilgi manipülasyonu kampanyasının parçası olarak tanımlıyor. Ağ, sahte sosyal medya hesaplarının yanı sıra medya ve hükümet internet sitelerini taklit eden sahte web sayfalarını da kullanıyor. Temmuz ayında, AB Konseyi, bu eylemlerden sorumlu tutulan Rus kişi ve kuruluşlara yaptırım uyguladı.

AP muhabirleri John Leicester (Le Pecq, Fransa) ve Kelvin Chan (Londra) bu habere katkı sağladı.

Many parents are familiar with the challenge: putting their child to bed at a reasonable hour, only to discover they've secretly stayed up using the internet. Inventors now hope to solve this with a new set of 'spy' bedroom tools designed to help parents monitor their children's online activity. Developed by Qualcomm, the system relies on the AllJoyn platform, connecting household devices through Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Parents can receive real-time alerts when a child is online and have the ability to remotely switch off internet access, lights, or music in the child's room from their smartphone or other smart devices.

One standout feature is a concept 'talking teddy bear' that parents can activate to gently remind their child to go to bed. Conversely, it can also help wake them in the morning by saying 'wake up' as part of an automated routine, activated alongside lights and alarm clocks.

The system was showcased at the Mobile World Conference in Barcelona as part of Qualcomm's broader SmartHome vision. It works by connecting a parent’s device to various electronics in the child’s bedroom—including a smart router that can identify which apps are running. Notifications can also appear on TVs or tablets throughout the home, with messages such as 'Bobby is watching YouTube or playing Minecraft when he should be sleeping.' All commands occur securely within the home network.

Qualcomm’s project demonstrates the integration possibilities for smart devices through the AllJoyn system, supporting a broader trend towards the 'internet of everything.' Similar smart teddies, such as Teddy the Guardian from London-based IDX Labs, are already on the market. Other innovations include a smoke alarm that displays fire alerts on connected TVs, flashing lights if the fridge door is left open, and smartphone-controlled air conditioning—all emphasizing the growing connectivity in modern homes.

article_content: Arsenal manager Arsene Wenger celebrated ending his nine-year trophy drought after leading his team to a dramatic 3-2 victory over Hull City in the FA Cup final, marking the greatest comeback in the final since 1966. Following the celebrations, Wenger confirmed he intends to sign a new contract, extending his 18-year tenure at the club. 'This should normally happen — and we are in very normal circumstances,' he said as he toasted his fifth FA Cup triumph, equaling the record. 'It was never about leaving, only about doing what’s right for this club.' After Arsenal’s victory, players Lukas Podolski and Per Mertesacker covered Wenger in beer and champagne, celebrating his decision to stay on as manager. Earlier in the season, Wenger had been called a ‘specialist in failure’ by Jose Mourinho, but he watched his team recover from a 2-0 deficit to win, with Aaron Ramsey scoring the decisive goal in extra time. The match was Wenger's 512th since his last trophy in 2005. England manager Roy Hodgson hoped the comeback would be a good omen for his national team, recalling that a similar FA Cup turnaround occurred when Everton beat Sheffield Wednesday, after which Bobby Moore lifted the World Cup. Hull stunned Arsenal early on, with James Chester and Curtis Davies scoring twice in the first eight minutes, as Hull sought their first major trophy in 110 years. Arsenal responded with a brilliant free-kick from Santi Cazorla and an equalizer by Laurent Koscielny, sending the game into extra time. Ramsey scored after 109 minutes from an Olivier Giroud backheel. Steve Bruce, Hull’s manager, praised his players’ courage, saying, 'I couldn't ask for more from my players. The majority are the ones who got us out of the Championship. It could have been a memorable season. In terms of effort and determination, you couldn't fault them; we didn’t have enough, but I'm proud — they were magnificent.' Bruce also commented on refereeing decisions, saying, 'Their first goal wasn't a free-kick, the second wasn't a corner. But now is not the time to complain; we had a wonderful opportunity.' The match ended with emotional scenes as Aaron Ramsey secured the win for Arsenal, causing relief for the team and their fans, while Bruce praised Hull’s spirit despite the defeat.

Bu galibiyet, 1966'dan bu yana finallerdeki en büyük geri dönüş olarak kayıtlara geçti. Kutlamaların ardından Wenger, kulüpteki 18 yıllık görev süresini uzatacak yeni bir sözleşme imzalamayı düşündüğünü doğruladı. Hull, maçın başında James Chester ve Curtis Davies’in ilk sekiz dakikada attığı gollerle Arsenal’i şaşkına çevirdi. Hull, 110 yıllık tarihinde ilk büyük kupasının peşindeydi. Karşılaşma, Aaron Ramsey’in galibiyet golüyle Arsenal ve taraftarlarında büyük rahatlama yaratırken, Bruce da Hull’un ruhunu övdü.

article_content: Longtime friend and historian Wayne Flynt, who visited 'To Kill a Mockingbird' author Harper Lee the day before news broke about her upcoming sequel, insists Lee was mentally sound. He emphasized that, despite conversations requiring raised voices due to her hearing loss, Lee was lucid and engaged during his visit. Flynt dismissed rumors that Lee, age 88, was manipulated into agreeing to the publication of 'Go Set a Watchman', the long-hidden manuscript. He noted Lee was discussing books by C.S. Lewis, reading with the help of a magnifying machine, and making jokes. Flynt said Lee did not mention the new book during their visit at her assisted living facility in Monroeville, Alabama, the day before HarperCollins announced the page-turner's publication. Charles J. Shields, Lee's biographer, initially expressed concerns about possible coercion, particularly after the recent death of Lee’s sister and legal guardian, Alice Lee. However, Shields later retracted his doubts, saying Lee's own statement expressing happiness about the sequel convinced him of her willingness. Despite these assurances, several hometown friends, including Janet Sawyer, continue to question Lee’s ability to make such a decision, especially following her stroke and advancing age. Some accuse Lee’s attorney, Tonja Carter, of isolating her and controlling access. Publisher Jonathan Burnham confirmed the publisher has communicated with Lee only indirectly, through attorney Tonja Carter and literary agent Andrew Nurnburg. Nonetheless, both the publisher’s spokesman and Burnham expressed confidence that Lee is pleased with the release, highlighting her zest and continued love for reading. 'Go Set a Watchman', written before 'To Kill a Mockingbird' but previously unpublished, features the adult Scout returning home to Alabama. William Heinemann, Lee’s original UK publisher, will publish the novel on July 14. The manuscript was discovered attached to the typescript of 'To Kill a Mockingbird' in a secure location. 'To Kill a Mockingbird', published in 1960, has sold over 40 million copies worldwide and was adapted into a 1962 film featuring Gregory Peck as Atticus Finch.
translated_content: 'Bülbülü Öldürmek' kitabının yazarı Harper Lee’yi, yeni romanı duyurulmadan bir gün önce ziyaret eden eski dostu ve tarihçi Wayne Flynt, Lee’nin zihinsel olarak tamamen sağlıklı olduğunu belirtti. Flynt, işitme kaybı nedeniyle yüksek sesle konuşmak gerekmesine rağmen, Lee’nin ziyaret sırasında gayet açık ve ilgili olduğunu vurguladı. Flynt, 88 yaşındaki Lee'nin yıllarca saklanan 'Go Set a Watchman' adlı romanını yayımlamaya zorlandığı söylentilerini reddetti. Lee'nin C.S. Lewis'in kitaplarından konuştuğunu, büyüteçle kitap okuduğunu ve espri yaptığını belirtti. Flynt, HarperCollins yayınevinin yeni kitabın yayınlanacağını açıklamasından bir gün önce, Monroeville, Alabama’daki destekli yaşam tesisinde Lee’yi ziyaret ettiğini ve o gün Lee'nin kitabı hiç anmadığını söyledi. Harper Lee’nin biyografi yazarı Charles J. Shields, özellikle Lee’nin kız kardeşi ve yasal vasisi Alice Lee'nin vefatından sonra olası baskıdan endişe ettiğini ifade etmişti. Ancak Shields, Lee’nin kitap hakkındaki mutluluğunu belirten açıklamasının ardından endişelerini geri çekti. Tüm bu güvencelere rağmen, Janet Sawyer gibi çocukluk arkadaşları, geçirdiği felcin ve ilerleyen yaşının Lee’nin böyle bir kararı alabilecek durumda olup olmadığı konusunda şüpheli olduklarını belirtiyor. Bazıları Lee’nin avukatı Tonja Carter’ı onu dış dünyadan izole etmekle ve erişimini kontrol etmekle suçluyor. Yayıncı Jonathan Burnham, Lee ile yalnızca avukatı Tonja Carter ve edebiyat ajanı Andrew Nurnburg aracılığıyla dolaylı olarak iletişim kurabildiklerini doğruladı. Buna rağmen, yayıncı sözcüsü ve Burnham, Lee’nin kitabın yayımlanmasından memnun olduğunu ve okumaya olan tutkusunun devam ettiğini söyledi. 'Go Set a Watchman', 'Bülbülü Öldürmek'ten önce yazılmış fakat daha önce yayımlanmamıştı. Roman, yetişkin Scout’un Alabama’daki memleketine dönüşünü konu alıyor. Lee'nin orijinal Birleşik Krallık yayıncısı William Heinemann, romanı 14 Temmuz’da yayımlayacak. El yazması, ‘Bülbülü Öldürmek’in asıl daktilo nüshasına iliştirilmiş halde, güvenli bir yerde bulundu. 'Bülbülü Öldürmek', 1960 yılında yayımlandı, dünya çapında 40 milyondan fazla sattı ve 1962’de Gregory Peck'in Atticus Finch’i canlandırdığı bir filme uyarlandı.

article_content: Bebo, widely recognized as one of the original social networks, was launched in 2005 and rapidly gained popularity. At its peak, Bebo had around 40 million users and allowed people to upload blogs, photos, music, and videos. It competed with Facebook and MySpace in the early 2000s. In 2008, Bebo was sold by its founders, Michael and Xochi Birch, to AOL for $850 million. As Facebook and platforms like Twitter, YouTube, and Tumblr grew, Bebo's user base declined, with some attributing this to AOL's limited investment in the platform. After filing for bankruptcy protection in 2013, the Birches bought Bebo back for $1 million. Bebo has since been relaunched as an iOS and Android app, with a web version planned. Current CEO Shaan Puri manages the site for Michael and Xochi Birch. The new version emphasizes playful chat, letting users create avatars and use hashtags to interact in creative ways—for example, changing expressions, sharing locations, playing music, or launching games. The company plans to introduce additional features regularly via hashtags, encouraging users to share them with friends. Unlike other social networks that sell emoji or sticker packs, Bebo enables users to access new features through hashtags at no extra cost. The relaunch aims to bring back the fun, social feel that made Bebo popular, especially for interactions with close friends. Michael and Xochi Birch, who met while studying at Imperial College London, have continued investing in technology startups since selling Bebo. They are associated with the London-based venture capital firm PROfounders, the San Francisco software incubator Monkey Inferno, and a private members club called The Battery. They have also acquired the Farmers Arms pub in Woolsery, Devon, intending to restore it. Bebo has announced that users will soon be able to download their old photos, stating that a solution will be available by January 31.

Zirvesinde yaklaşık 40 milyon kullanıcısı olan Bebo, kullanıcıların blog, fotoğraf, müzik ve video yüklemesine olanak tanıdı. 2000'li yılların başında Facebook ve MySpace ile birlikte rekabet etti. 2008’de kurucuları Michael ve Xochi Birch tarafından 850 milyon dolara AOL’a satıldı. Facebook ile Twitter, YouTube, Tumblr gibi platformlar büyüdükçe Bebo’nun kullanıcı sayısı azaldı; bazıları bu düşüşte AOL’un sınırlı yatırımlarını neden olarak gösteriyor. 2013’te iflas koruması başvurusunda bulunan Bebo, ardından Birch ailesi tarafından 1 milyon dolara tekrar satın alındı. Bebo, iOS ve Android uygulaması olarak yeniden piyasaya sürüldü ve web versiyonu yakında çıkacak. Şu anda CEO’su Shaan Puri, siteyi Michael ve Xochi Birch adına yönetiyor. Yeni sürüm, kullanıcıların avatar oluşturup hashtag’lerle yaratıcı şekilde etkileşim kurabildiği eğlenceli sohbetlere odaklanıyor. article_content: President Barack Obama has informed Congress that the U.S. may take further military action in South Sudan to protect Americans as violence worsens. He revealed that 46 American troops were deployed Saturday to aid evacuation efforts. During one such mission, three military aircraft came under fire, injuring four service members who are now in stable condition. While on vacation in Hawaii, Obama stated he is closely monitoring the crisis and could take additional steps to ensure the safety of U.S. citizens, property, and the embassy in Juba. Fierce clashes in South Sudan have resulted in government forces losing key territories, including the capital of an important oil-producing state, raising fears of a possible civil war. The unrest erupted after former Vice President Riek Machar announced plans to run in the 2015 election, which led to violent clashes. An estimated 500 people have already lost their lives. The fighting escalated when Machar's loyalists allegedly tried to force President Salva Kiir out by opening fire at a government meeting. Evacuation missions remain perilous; during one attempt to rescue Americans from Bor in Jonglei state, three CV-22 Osprey aircraft were attacked and had to divert to Uganda. The wounded soldiers received treatment in Kenya. Similarly, a UN helicopter was fired on while evacuating civilians and peacekeepers. Hundreds are reportedly trapped in rebel-held Bor, and thousands of South Sudanese have sought refuge at UN compounds. The U.S. has advised its citizens to evacuate immediately and continues to monitor the volatile situation. Britain and other nations have also sent troops for similar evacuation operations. President Obama cautioned that South Sudan is on the brink of civil war, recalling the country's hard-won progress since its 2011 independence and expressing deep concern that renewed violence threatens to undo those advances.

article_content: Brazil has emerged as one of the world’s top agricultural powers, leading in the production and export of key commodities like soybeans, beef, corn, cotton, sugar, and coffee. In recent years, Brazil surpassed the United States as the largest exporter of soy and beef, and is set to overtake the US in corn exports as well. Brazil’s agriculture ministry reports that the sector is expected to achieve a record 1.15 trillion reais (approximately $230 billion) in output this year. Agriculture now makes up about one-fourth of the country’s economy and accounted for half of Brazil’s exports in the year’s first half. The country is the world’s top supplier of chicken and beef and ranks second in cotton exports after the United States. The foundations of Brazil’s agricultural rise date back to colonial times, producing sugarcane, cotton, rubber, and coffee. The 1960s and 70s marked a significant shift when the military government launched the 'green revolution,' promoting expansion into the Amazon and Cerrado. Driven by international demand—especially from China—Brazil became the leading global producer of soybeans, widely used in animal feed. Advances in genetic improvements, soil correction, fertilizers, pesticides, and GMOs have let Brazil expand soy, corn, and cotton production into tropical regions. Favorable climate and advanced techniques enable two or three harvests per year, boosting production of these crops threefold in twenty years. Currently, GMO varieties account for 80–90% of soy, corn, and cotton output. However, the sector’s growth has spurred controversy, especially over deforestation in the Amazon. President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has pledged to halt deforestation, seeking to reverse increases that occurred under previous president Jair Bolsonaro. Concerns about high rates of deforestation, pesticide and GMO use have harmed Brazil’s international image. The European Union has postponed a trade deal with Mercosur over environmental concerns, and the industry’s association with Bolsonaro has attracted further criticism. Lula must balance keeping the influential agribusiness sector onside to grow the economy while aiming to stop Amazon deforestation by 2030. The sector is working to improve its image, as international buyers increasingly demand deforestation-free products. Efforts are underway to ensure supply chain traceability and promote sustainable farming, including protecting the Cerrado. Nonetheless, environmentalists argue that these measures are insufficient, advocating for zero deforestation and greater efforts to protect biodiversity. These concerns grow as climate change already begins impacting agricultural productivity. As environmental modeling expert Britaldo Soares Filho warns: 'When agribusiness harms the environment, it’s shooting itself in the foot.'

Brezilya ayrıca tavuk ve sığır eti ihracatında dünyada birinci, pamukta ise ABD’den sonra ikinci sırada. Ancak büyük sıçrama, askeri rejimin başlattığı ‘yeşil devrim’ ile 1960’lar ve 70’lerde Amazon ve Cerrado bölgelerinde tarımın genişlemesiyle yaşandı. Elverişli iklim ve tekniklerle yılda iki-üç ürün alınabiliyor; son yirmi yılda üretim üç katına çıktı. Şu anda bu ürünlerin %80-90’ı GDO’lu çeşitlerden elde ediliyor. Ancak, sektör büyürken özellikle Amazon’daki ormansızlaşma nedeniyle tartışmalar sürüyor. Sektörün Bolsonaro ile yakınlığı da ayrıca eleştirildi. Lula, Amazon’da ormansızlaşmayı 2030’a kadar sona erdirme sözünü yerine getirmek için güçlü tarım lobisini karşısına almadan ekonomiyle denge kurmak zorunda. Sektör ise, alıcıların deforestasyonsuz ürün talepleriyle, tedarik zinciri izlenebilirliği ve sürdürülebilir uygulamalarla imajını düzeltmeye uğraşıyor. Cerrado için yapılan anlaşmalar da buna örnek. Fakat çevreciler, bunların yetmediğini; sıfır ormansızlaşma ve biyolojik çeşitliliğin korunmasını istiyor. İklim değişikliği tarımsal verimi etkilerken, bu sorunlar gittikçe daha acil hale geliyor. article_content: In a recent appearance on The Today Show, former First Lady Michelle Obama discussed how she encourages her daughters, Sasha and Malia, to build healthy habits. She shared that her family avoids conversations about weight or looks, instead focusing on health and internal well-being. Michelle aims to guide her daughters toward becoming confident and active young women who enjoy exercise. She acknowledged that while she tries to protect her daughters from public scrutiny, living in the White House makes that challenging. Jenna Bush Hager, the interviewer and also a former First Daughter, related to growing up under public attention. Michelle admitted that people often focus on her fashion, but she uses this attention to highlight important causes such as children's health. This week marks the fourth anniversary of Michelle Obama's Let's Move campaign, which encourages children to eat healthily and stay active. The occasion was celebrated through events along the East Coast. Recalling her own childhood, Michelle noted that families rarely ate at fast food restaurants and typically had home-cooked meals with vegetables. She believes changes in these habits have affected American families' health but feels that with the right information, parents can help steer families back on course. Leading by example, Michelle is known for her commitment to fitness and healthy eating, sometimes engaging in lighthearted public performances, like a recent dance skit with Jimmy Fallon and Will Ferrell. She said her daughters have grown used to her entertaining efforts, which she uses to connect with the public and promote wellness.

article_content: Sam Allardyce described fielding the most inexperienced team of his managerial career when West Ham United, featuring numerous teenagers from their development squads, suffered a 5-0 defeat to Nottingham Forest in the FA Cup third round last season. Five of the starting lineup and all seven substitutes were products of the youth system, with three coming off the bench during the match. West Ham trailed by a single goal at halftime after Djamel Abdoun's penalty, but Jamie Paterson scored a 14-minute hat-trick starting in the 65th minute, and Andy Reid finished the rout in stoppage time. Allardyce later called the defeat, followed by a 6-0 loss to Manchester City, a particularly dark period—one that nearly cost him his job before he kept the club up. The loss was especially tough for the 12 young players involved. Here's how their careers have developed since: Danny Whitehead (21, midfielder): Continued gaining experience with senior pre-season friendlies and remains with the development squad, but hasn't appeared for the senior team since the Forest game. Sebastian Lletget (22, midfielder): The American attacking midfielder scored three goals in 19 development squad matches last season and played in pre-season friendlies, but is yet to make another senior competitive appearance. George Moncur (21, midfielder): After loan spells at Partick and then Colchester United—where he later signed permanently—Moncur scored four goals in 28 games as of November. Dan Potts (20, defender): Son of Steve Potts, he signed a two-year deal and has featured for the senior team, including a start in the Capital One Cup against Sheffield United. Callum Driver (22, defender): The Forest match was his only senior appearance; he was released in the summer, briefly joined Whitehawk, and later played for Dartford. Blair Turgott (20, midfielder): Came off the bench, went on loan to Rotherham United and Dagenham & Redbridge, and now plays for West Ham’s Under-21s. Reece Burke (18, defender): After an impressive stint post-Forest, he featured in senior friendlies and scored the winner against Sampdoria, going on to make more first-team appearances. Matthias Fanimo (20, midfielder): Made his last senior appearance against Forest, played for the Under-21s, and made a loan move to Tranmere Rovers with one appearance. Also among the unused substitutes: Raphael Spiegel (22, goalkeeper): Swiss keeper who remains with West Ham but is yet to make a first-team appearance. He’s had loans at Crawley Town and Barnet, playing once for the latter. Elliott Lee (20, forward): Scored eight goals in 14 Under-21 games and went on loan to Southend United, currently sidelined by injury. He debuted for West Ham’s first team at 18. Sean Maguire (20, forward): Scored four goals on loan at Accrington Stanley, previously played over 20 matches for Sligo Rovers, including two Europa League appearances. Jaanai Gordon (19, forward): Recently signed from Peterborough United, went on loan to Chelmsford City, where he scored five goals in four games and contributed two assists.

article_content: One of the Internet’s greatest promises is its role as a global democratizer—open to everyone and enabling worldwide communication. Both Facebook and Google have recently updated their translation services to overcome language barriers, though they use different methods. Despite this promise, important challenges remain. Access to computers and high-speed internet is still limited for many, online censorship continues in some countries, and language differences are an ongoing obstacle. For the web to become truly global, people who speak different languages should be able to communicate freely online. Both Facebook and Google have released updates to their translation tools, taking distinct approaches. Facebook emphasizes a combination of volunteer and professional human translators, while Google relies mainly on automated computer systems. Facebook's translation feature is powered by its users, who suggest and vote on phrase translations, leading to improvements over time, much like Wikipedia. Facebook now supports more than 65 languages, with plans to add at least 30 more. The company has extended its community-driven translation tool to other websites through a translation gadget available via Facebook Connect. Additionally, new languages such as Latin and even a playful 'Pirate' option have been introduced. The advantage of Facebook’s system is a better grasp of idioms and slang, but progress depends on the interest of multilingual volunteers. Notably, most user-generated content like wall posts and comments aren’t translated, limiting cross-language communication. By contrast, Google employs advanced computer models to translate web content, consistent with its mission to make information universally accessible. Google supports automatic translation for 51 languages and over 2,500 language pairs, with its interface available in 130 languages, thanks to user contributions. Recently, Google launched a widget for website owners to add translation to their sites, offered document translation via Google Docs, and released a Firefox extension for quick webpage translation. Real-time translation for online chat and more languages are in development. While Google’s automated approach allows for quick, widespread translation, it can miss nuances in modern or informal language, sometimes resulting in errors. However, the system improves as more data and user feedback are integrated.

Birçok kişi hâlâ bilgisayar ve yüksek hızlı internete ulaşamıyor, bazı ülkelerde çevrimiçi sansür sürüyor ve dil farklılıkları hâlâ engel oluşturuyor. Web’in gerçekten küresel hale gelebilmesi için farklı dilleri konuşan insanların çevrimiçi ortamda özgürce iletişim kurabilmeleri gerekiyor. Hem Facebook hem de Google, çeviri araçlarında güncellemeler yaptı ve farklı yaklaşımlar kullanıyor. Facebook’un çeviri özelliği, kullanıcılar tarafından önerilen ve oylanan çevirilerle zamanla gelişiyor; bu süreç Wikipedia’ya benziyor. Facebook şu anda 65’ten fazla dili destekliyor ve en az 30 dili daha eklemeyi planlıyor. Ancak sistem, daha fazla veri ve kullanıcı geri bildirimiyle gelişmeye devam ediyor.

article_content: Several former soldiers have voiced concerns over the Pentagon's decision to lift the ban on women serving in combat roles, citing demanding and unhygienic frontline conditions. While many see Defense Secretary Leon Panetta’s move as progressive, critics argue it overlooks harsh realities such as lack of privacy and challenging sanitary conditions. For example, Ryan Smith described in a Wall Street Journal letter how Marines were often packed into vehicles designed for 15 but carried up to 25, with unsanitary conditions leading to illness like dysentery. Smith recalled that during the 2003 invasion of Iraq, his unit wore chemical protective suits for nearly a month, resulting in sores, peeling feet, and serious discomfort. Once their mission ended in Baghdad, they had to remove the contaminated suits in a walled compound, standing naked while being hosed off with pressure washers. Supporters of Panetta's decision—including women’s rights advocates—say the military has already developed solutions for many hygiene and privacy issues. Nancy Duff Campbell of the National Women’s Law Center explained that women are trained in gender-specific hygiene and can use devices such as the Female Urinary Diversion Device to manage in difficult conditions. Menstruation is often managed through medication to suppress cycles. The policy change, recommended by the Joint Chiefs of Staff, overturns the 1994 rule preventing women from serving in smaller ground combat units. Military service chiefs have until January 2016 to propose whether any positions should remain closed to women, such as special operations units. Some combat jobs could open soon, while assessments for roles like special forces may take longer. Reactions from active service members and veterans are mixed. Some female soldiers question their own physical readiness for certain roles, while others assert that equal standards should apply to all. Women’s rights groups argue that concerns about logistics and privacy are not new and have largely been managed. The move has garnered support from leaders such as Senator Carl Levin and UN Ambassador Susan Rice. Former POW Jessica Lynch also welcomed the shift, emphasizing women’s vital contributions to military efforts. Opponents like Jerry Boykin from the Family Research Council argue that integrating women in combat may impose additional burdens and distractions on commanders. Previously, women were barred from being assigned to ground combat units below the brigade level, though they frequently served in attached roles as medics, police, and intelligence officers. Recent conflicts have made it difficult to keep women away from direct combat. While there are concerns about the transition—including physical requirements, morale, and potential public reluctance regarding female casualties—supporters contend it reflects the current realities of military operations. By the end of the decade, women may be allowed in nearly all combat positions, depending on further evaluations. Currently, women represent about 14% of the 1.4 million active U.S. military personnel, with over 280,000 women having served in Iraq, Afghanistan, or nearby regions. Of the more than 6,600 U.S. troops killed in these conflicts, 152 have been women. The military branches must submit initial implementation plans for the policy by May 15.

article_content: With spring arriving early this weekend, it's time to put away your winter wardrobe. Forecasters expect the mild weather to continue for at least the next two weeks, with temperatures reaching up to 18C (64F) in some areas on Saturday and Sunday. Most of the UK will experience cloudy but warm conditions, with temperatures between 13C (55F) and 15C (59F), though parts of the northeast may see some sunshine break through. In St James's Park, London, people are already enjoying the spring blooms and pleasant weather. The Met Office forecasts that the fair and settled conditions are likely to persist in the coming weeks. Chris Bulmer, a Met Office forecaster, said, 'Certainly through the next couple of weeks it will be fair and settled, and that’s not going to change. It will be rather cloudy but with some brighter days, and it will feel mild.' Despite the early arrival of spring, there is little rain expected, especially in the east of England, where drought conditions are ongoing. Mr. Bulmer added, 'There could be spots of rain in the west, but there will not even be showers; it is predominantly dry, certainly in the east over the next week.' Due to the dry weather, some areas have already experienced gorse fires, which are more common in summer. On Mulfra Moor near Penzance, Cornwall, twenty-seven firefighters were called out when planned burning got out of control, causing a fire to sweep across 100 metres of moorland.

Cheri Parker, a grandmother from Havelock, North Carolina, is selling a one-of-a-kind supercar modeled after Grand Theft Auto’s iconic Bravado Banshee. Parker won the car, valued at $180,000, after her teenage son purchased the game with her credit card in 2012—unknowingly entering her into a competition. She was stunned when the high-performance vehicle was delivered to her home.

The grand-prize car was built by West Coast Customs, commissioned by GTA developers Rockstar Games. The team modified a Dodge Viper SRT-10 to replicate the legendary in-game Banshee, known for its speed and style. This real-life version boasts a twin-turbocharged 8.4-liter V8 engine, accelerates from 0-60 mph in 4.3 seconds, and reaches a top speed of 174 mph—the fifth-fastest in the game.

After three years, Parker finds the flashy car impractical for everyday use. 'It’s not a practical car. I prefer driving my mini SUV—there’s hardly any space, and the entire trunk is filled with stereo equipment,' she said. Parker admits to enjoying the attention the car brought her: 'Everywhere you go it turns heads. People are always surprised to see a 56-year-old woman behind the wheel.'

Her 19-year-old son Austin, a lifelong GTA fan, is disappointed but understands the decision. 'I’d rather go to college than keep the car,' he said, noting the car’s sale will help fund his education. Parker hopes to get at least $70,000 for the car, though it’s valued much higher. She reflects, 'Selling it is bittersweet, but it takes up space and just isn’t practical for grocery trips.' 

Custom parts make repairs costly, and owners need specialized collectors’ resources to maintain the car. The family is now seeking a buyer who’ll appreciate the unique GTA legacy.

Parker, 2012’de oğlunun kredi kartıyla GTA oyununu satın almasının ardından farkında olmadan katıldığı bir yarışmada bu aracı kazandı. Gerçek hayattaki bu versiyon, çift turbo 8.4 litrelik V8 motoruyla 0’dan 100 km/saate 4,3 saniyede ulaşabiliyor ve 280 km/saate kadar çıkabiliyor—oyunda beşinci en hızlı araç.

Bununla birlikte Parker, arabanın dikkat çekmesinden keyif aldığını da ekliyor: “Nereye gitsem herkes bakıyor. Direksiyon başında 56 yaşında bir kadın görünce insanlar şaşırıyor.”

Özel parçalarının bakımının pahalı ve zor olması nedeniyle, aile şimdi aracı GTA mirasını takdir edecek koleksiyoncu bir alıcıya satmak istiyor.

article_content: Pop superstar Lady Gaga visited WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange at the Ecuadorian embassy in London, spending about five hours with him on Monday. Gaga was in the city to promote her new perfume, 'Fame,' at Harrods in Knightsbridge and stopped by the nearby embassy at around 7 p.m., leaving after midnight, according to media reports. Gaga shared photos of herself and Assange online, where she was seen wearing a black gown and a witch's hat. Assange, 41, has been living in the embassy under Ecuador's asylum since June, after facing extradition requests from Sweden over allegations of sexual assault and rape. Assange's legal team contends that he is being targeted due to WikiLeaks' publication of confidential U.S. diplomatic cables, which caused embarrassment for the U.S. government. The story has drawn significant attention due to both Lady Gaga's celebrity visit and the ongoing legal issues involving Assange.

article_content: CVS Health (NYSE: CVS) recently announced third quarter 2023 results that surpassed Wall Street forecasts for both revenue and earnings. The company generated $89.8 billion in revenue and posted adjusted earnings per share of $2.21, outperforming expectations of $88.2 billion in revenue and $2.13 per share. Despite solid financial results, CVS's stock price has stayed nearly unchanged since early 2021, hovering around $70. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 grew roughly 20% in the same period. CVS saw major swings in its returns: climbing 51% in 2021, falling 10% in 2022, and dropping 27% in 2023. In comparison, the S&P 500 delivered gains of 27% in 2021, lost 19% in 2022, and rose 15% in 2023. CVS underperformed the index over the last year. Leaders in health care and major tech firms also found it difficult to consistently beat the index. The Trefis High Quality Portfolio, however, has managed to outperform the S&P 500 annually during this period, and with less volatility. Given the current economic climate—marked by elevated oil prices and interest rates—it's unclear whether CVS will see a rebound or continue to trail the S&P 500 going forward. From a valuation view, analysts suggest CVS stock is undervalued. Trefis sets its fair value at $89 per share, implying a 30% potential rise from current levels. This estimate uses a 10x price-to-earnings ratio, in line with CVS's five-year average, and uses a forecast for 2023 adjusted earnings of $8.55 per share. The company reaffirmed its adjusted earnings guidance at $8.50 to $8.70 per share for 2023. Q3 revenue grew 11% year-over-year, with growth across main business segments: Health Care Benefits up 17%, Health Services up 8%, and Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness up 6%. However, adjusted profit for the quarter fell 1% to $2.85 billion, reflecting increased medical costs—a trend seen in the higher medical benefit ratio. Adjusted earnings per share increased due to a lower total share count. Looking ahead, CVS expects gains from rising prescription volumes, more pharmacy claims (excluding COVID-19 vaccines), and ongoing drug price inflation—but warns that medical costs may remain high. The company's 27% stock decline this year is attributed mainly to a downgrade in its largest Medicare insurance plan, affecting 1.9 million members. The lowered rating disqualifies the plan from government-linked bonus payments in 2024. Despite these setbacks, analysts remain optimistic about CVS's growth, and peer comparisons may shed further light on its position.

Değerleme açısından, analistler CVS hisselerinin düşük değerli olduğunu düşünüyor. Trefis’e göre firmanın adil değeri hisse başına 89 dolar ve bu mevcut fiyatın yaklaşık %30 üzerinde bir potansiyele işaret ediyor. Bu öngörü, CVS’nin son beş yıllık ortalamasına uygun 10x fiyat/kazanç oranı ve 2023 için 8,55 dolar düzeltilmiş hisse başı kâr beklentisine dayanıyor. Şirket, yıl için 8,50 – 8,70 dolar arası düzeltilmiş kâr hedefini korudu. Üçüncü çeyrek gelirleri yıllık bazda %11 arttı ve bütün ana iş kollarında büyüme gerçekleşti: Sağlık Sigortası %17, Sağlık Hizmetleri %8, Eczane ve Tüketici Sağlığı %6 büyüdü. Ancak çeyreklik düzeltilmiş kâr %1 azalarak 2,85 milyar dolara düştü; bu, artan tıbbi maliyetleri (yükselen medikal fayda oranı) yansıtıyor. Toplam hisse sayısındaki azalma sayesinde, düzeltilmiş hisse başı kazanç ise yükseldi. İleriye dönük, CVS reçete sayılarının artışı, daha fazla eczane işlemi (COVID-19 aşıları hariç) ve ilaca gelen zamlar sayesinde pozitif gelişme bekliyor. Ancak, tıbbi maliyetlerin kısa vadede yüksek kalmaya devam edebileceğini de belirtiyor. Şirketin bu yılki %27’lik hisse düşüşü esas olarak 1,9 milyon üyeye sahip en büyük Medicare sigorta planının derecesinin düşürülmesinden kaynaklandı. Bu düşüş, planı 2024 yılında devlet kaynaklı bonus ödemelerine uygun olmaktan çıkarıyor. Tüm bu zorluklara rağmen, analistler CVS’nin büyüme potansiyelini yüksek görüyor ve rakiplerle yapılan karşılaştırmalar da şirketin durumu hakkında daha fazla bilgi sunabilir.

article_content: For the first time since the 1980s, Formula One returned to Las Vegas with its most expensive North American event, but has been beset by problems. On the initial practice day, a manhole cover—loosened by faulty screws—seriously damaged Carlos Sainz Jr.’s Ferrari, halting the session and prompting organizers to close the circuit for full inspection. This safety failure was only the latest challenge for the $500 million race, which has grappled with sluggish ticket sales, criticism from champion Max Verstappen (who called it '99% show, 1% sport'), and grumbling from local residents. Ticket prices have largely excluded American fans, as race schedules aim to suit European viewers. In response to the canceled practice, officials offered a $200 merchandise store credit to ticket holders, which many fans considered inadequate, leading to a lawsuit. Organizers faced further criticism for not accounting for cold Las Vegas nights, which posed additional safety risks. Despite statements from event leaders seeking to explain these missteps—without issuing a direct apology—fan discontent remains high. Whether the main race will improve the event's tarnished image is yet to be determined.
translated_content: Formula 1, 1980’lerden bu yana ilk kez Las Vegas’a dönüyor ancak organizasyon birçok sorunla boğuşuyor. İlk antrenman gününde gevşek vidaların sebep olduğu bir rögar kapağı, Carlos Sainz Jr.’ın Ferrari’sinde büyük hasara yol açtı; seans iptal edildi ve yetkililer pistin tamamında inceleme yaptı. Bu güvenlik zafiyeti, 500 milyon dolarlık etkinliği saran aksiliklerin son örneği oldu. Etkinlik; düşük bilet satışları, şampiyon Max Verstappen’in ‘%99 şov, %1 spor’ yorumu ve Las Vegaslıların tepkileriyle sarsıldı. Yüksek bilet fiyatları çoğu Amerikalı taraftarı dışarıda bırakırken, yarış saatlerinin Avrupalı izleyicilere göre ayarlanması da eleştirildi. İptal edilen seans sonrası verilen 200 dolarlık mağaza çeki birçok taraftarı tatmin etmedi ve bu durum davaya dönüştü. Organizatörler, Las Vegas gecelerinin beklenenden soğuk olmasını hesaba katmadıkları için de eleştirildi. Etkinlik yöneticileri hata açıklamaları yaptı ancak net bir özür gelmedi. Ana yarış, etkinliğin yıpranan imajını toparlayacak mı, henüz belli değil.
post_content: Formula 1’s big return to Vegas hit speed bumps—practice crashed by a loose manhole cover, fans mad over lame compensation, and even Max Verstappen called it ‘99% show, 1% sport’. Can the main race save the show? #F1Vegas #RaceDrama #Formula1

article_content: The parents of murdered schoolgirl Alice Gross have shared how the future feels bleak without their daughter, who is believed to have been killed by a convicted murderer. At her memorial service today, hundreds of mourners were moved to tears as a recording of Alice, a talented musician, singing Leonard Cohen's Hallelujah was played. Alice’s mother, Rosalind Hodgkiss, described the deep pain she feels when talking about Alice, saying she 'cannot imagine life without her.' Alice, 14, disappeared in August, and despite the biggest police search since the July 7 bombings, her body was not found until over a month later. Rosalind Hodgkiss expressed that the killing of her daughter left her numb with grief and the future appeared bleak. She recounted the anguish and sadness from the loss and reflected on the 'what ifs' of that day. 'I cannot imagine life without Alice,' she said. Alice was a talented musician who played piano, violin, ukulele, and had recently started learning guitar. During the memorial, a recording of her singing Hallelujah was played, with her father accompanying her on guitar. A video also showed Alice performing her own song, Don't Go Away. Dozens attended the memorial service in Middlesex, organized by her family to express gratitude to the community. The humanist service was led by her mother and father, after Alice’s tragic death. Rosalind Hodgkiss reminisced about everyday moments with Alice, like shared jokes, baking, and snuggling on the sofa, highlighting the emptiness left by her absence. She spoke of missing celebrations such as birthdays and holidays, and noted that Alice could be shy, often underestimating her musical talent. Alice was last seen alive on August 28 on CCTV. Her mother mentioned the little acts of kindness Alice did, her lively humor, and the joy her laughter brought. Alice was buried privately ten days before the memorial service, which was held to thank the community for their support. Ms Hodgkiss said public support had not lessened the pain but had restored some faith in humanity. Her father, Jose Gross, told the service it had been very difficult to cope with the sudden and tragic loss. He recalled fond memories of walking Alice to primary school and their plans to perform at open mic nights together, which drew some laughter from attendees. Violinist Fenella Humphreys performed at the service. Family, friends, teachers, and mourners gathered at Greenford Town Hall to pay tribute, with music teachers and others also performing. A tribute from Alice's sister Nina, read by humanist Caroline Black, described Alice as a kind and thoughtful sister who always brought laughter. Nina said she finds peace in knowing her sister is no longer in pain. Arnis Zalkalns, a convicted killer from Latvia, is believed to have murdered Alice. She was last seen walking along a towpath in west London on August 28. Her body was found over a month later in the River Brent near her home. Zalkalns, previously convicted for murdering his wife in Latvia, was found dead in Boston Manor Park weeks after Alice's disappearance. Detectives reportedly found DNA evidence linking Zalkalns to the murder and are reviewing unsolved cases since 2007, when he moved to the UK. Following the discovery of Alice's body, Hanwell’s clock tower became a focal point for tributes, with yellow ribbons and flowers left in her memory. Her father said the ribbons were a powerful display of community support. The service included photos of Alice at Disneyland, performances by friends and family, a poem by William Wordsworth, a special sonnet by Brian Clark read by Julian Bell of Ealing Council, and a song from 'The Snowman' sung by her teacher Serena Kay. The highly emotional event was attended by family, friends, local MPs, police, fire brigade, Youth Music, and Ealing Council representatives. The community rallied around the family, with public tributes including a Facebook page with 22,000 followers and yellow ribbons throughout the area. Around 6,000 Ealing Half Marathon runners wore ribbons for Alice. A donations page for Alice’s Youth Music Memorial Fund was launched. David O’Keeffe from the National Foundation for Youth Music expressed gratitude to the family, saying the fund would help more young people access music opportunities, a legacy Alice herself would have valued.
translated_content: Öldürülen okul öğrencisi Alice Gross'un ailesi, kızları olmadan geleceğin ne kadar kasvetli göründüğünü paylaştı. Alice'in muhtemelen sabıkalı bir katil tarafından öldürüldüğü düşünülüyor. Anma töreninde, Alice’in Leonard Cohen'in Hallelujah şarkısını seslendirdiği kaydı dinletildi ve yüzlerce kişi gözyaşlarına boğuldu. Alice’in annesi Rosalind Hodgkiss, Alice hakkında konuşurken hissettiği derin acıyı şu sözlerle anlattı: 'Onsuz hayatı hayal bile edemiyorum.' 14 yaşındaki Alice, Ağustos ayında kayboldu ve 7 Temmuz bombalamalarından bu yana yapılan en büyük polis aramasına rağmen, cesedi bir aydan fazla sürenin ardından bulundu. Rosalind Hodgkiss, kızının ölümüyle duyduğu kederin kendisini adeta hissizleştirdiğini ve geleceğin karanlık göründüğünü belirtti. O günü düşünerek 'keşke' dedirten birçok şeyi aklından geçirdiğini söyledi ve 'Alice'siz bir hayatı hayal edemiyorum,' dedi. Alice; piyano, keman ve ukulele çalıyor, yakın zamanda gitar öğrenmeye başlamıştı. Anma töreninde babasının gitarıyla eşlik ettiği Hallelujah performansının kaydı dinletildi. Alice'in yazıp söylediği Don't Go Away şarkısının da videosu izlendi. Middlesex'te aile tarafından topluluğa teşekkür amacıyla düzenlenen anma törenine onlarca kişi katıldı. Hümanist tören, Alice'in trajik ölümünün ardından annesi ve babası tarafından gerçekleştirildi. Rosalind Hodgkiss, Alice ile birlikte geçirilen sıradan anları—şakalar, yemek pişirme, koltukta sarılarak oturma—anımsayarak, onsuzluğun bıraktığı boşluğu vurguladı. Doğum günleri ve bayramlar gibi özel günleri kutlamayı özleyeceğini belirten Hodgkiss, Alice’in bazen yeteneğinin farkında olmadığına değindi. Alice, 28 Ağustos’ta son kez CCTV’de görüldü. Annesi, Alice’in küçük iyiliklerini, enerjik mizahını ve kahkahalarının neşe verdiğini söyledi. Alice, anma töreninden on gün önce özel bir şekilde defnedildi. Bu tören ise topluluğa desteklerinden dolayı teşekkür etmek amacıyla düzenlendi. Hodgkiss, halk desteğinin acısını hafifletmediğini ancak insanlığa olan inançlarını bir miktar tazelediğini belirtti. Babası Jose Gross, ani ve trajik kaybın üstesinden gelmenin çok zor olduğunu ifade etti. Onu ilkokula götürdüğü keyifli anıları ve birlikte sahneye çıkma hayallerini anlattı; bu sözler dinleyiciler arasında hafif bir tebessüm oluşturdu. Keman sanatçısı Fenella Humphreys törene katılarak performans sergiledi. Greenford Town Hall'da aile, arkadaşlar, öğretmenler ve müzik eğitmenleri de dahil olmak üzere pek çok kişi Alice’e saygı duruşunda bulundu. Alice’in kız kardeşi Nina'nın, hümanist Caroline Black tarafından okunan anısında, Alice’in düşünceli ve neşeli bir kardeş olduğu vurgulandı. Nina, kardeşinin artık acı çekmediğini bilmenin huzur verdiğini dile getirdi. Letonyalı sabıkalı katil Arnis Zalkalns’ın Alice’i öldürdüğü düşünülüyor. Alice, 28 Ağustos’ta batı Londra’da bir kanal yolunda yürürken son kez görüldü. Cesedi, Hanwell’de yaşadığı evine yakın River Brent’te bir ayı aşkın süre sonra bulundu. Zalkalns, Letonya’da eşini öldürdüğü için hüküm giymişti ve Alice’in kaybolmasının birkaç hafta ardından Boston Manor Park’ta ölü bulundu. Dedektifler, Zalkalns’ı cinayete bağlayan DNA bulguları tespit ettiklerini ve 2007’de İngiltere’ye taşınmasından bu yana kayıp kadın davalarını tekrar incelediklerini belirtti. Alice'in cesedinin bulunmasının ardından Hanwell saat kulesi anmaya dönüştü; sarı kurdeleler ve çiçekler Alice’in anısı için bırakıldı. Babası, kurdelelerin toplumsal desteğin güçlü bir göstergesi olduğunu söyledi. Törende, Alice’in Disneyland gezisinden fotoğraflar, arkadaşlarının ve ailesinin performansları, William Wordsworth’dan bir şiir, şair Brian Clark’ın onuruna yazdığı bir sonet (Ealing Belediye Başkanı Julian Bell tarafından okundu) ve öğretmeni Serena Kay’in seslendirdiği 'The Snowman' şarkısı yer aldı. Duygu dolu törene aile, arkadaşlar, milletvekilleri, polisler, itfaiyeciler, Youth Music ve Ealing Belediyesi temsilcileri katıldı. Toplum, 22.000 takipçili Facebook sayfası ve her yere bağlanan sarı kurdelelerle aileye destek oldu. Ealing Yarı Maratonu’nda yaklaşık 6.000 koşucu Alice için sarı kurdele taktı. Alice’in Hatırasına Youth Music Vakfı’na bağış sayfası açıldı. Youth Music Ulusal Vakfı adına David O’Keeffe aileye teşekkür ederek, bu fon sayesinde daha fazla gencin müziğe erişebileceğini ve Alice’in de bundan memnun olacağını belirtti.
post_content: Family, friends, and the whole Hanwell community said a heartfelt goodbye to Alice Gross, 14, who touched many with her music. Her story inspires a new Youth Music Fund in her memory. #RememberAlice #CommunitySupport

article_content:
J. Michael Evans, vice chairman and global head of growth markets at Goldman Sachs, has purchased a luxurious full-floor apartment on Manhattan’s Upper East Side. Located just steps from Central Park, the residence was bought for $27 million. The expansive apartment features seven bedrooms, nine and a half bathrooms, and panoramic views of Central Park, the George Washington Bridge, and the Metropolitan Museum of Art.

Evans will share the home, which spans over 8,300 square feet, with his wife, Olympic gold medalist Lise Evans. Notable features include a formal dining room, a 42-foot-wide living room filled with natural light, a study, media room, library with a working fireplace, and dressing rooms.

The kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances such as a wine cooler, warming drawer, and built-in coffee maker. There is also a casual dining area with window seating and custom cabinetry. Residents benefit from a 24-hour doorman and a 16-hour concierge service for added comfort and security.

Designed by renowned architect Rosario Candela, the building opened in 1927 as the Stanhope Hotel. The building has a rich history, with jazz legend Charlie Parker dying in one of its suites in 1955, and socialite Kiki Preston passing away there in 1946.

Evans, who joined Goldman Sachs in 1993 and became vice chairman in 2011, has been active at charity events in recent years. According to Bloomberg, he won an auction for chef Eric Ripert to prepare a $22,000 private dinner in his home.

Goldman Sachs'ın başkan yardımcısı ve küresel büyüme piyasalarının başkanı J. Michael Evans, Manhattan'ın Upper East Side bölgesinde lüks bir tam kat daire satın aldı. Central Park'a yalnızca birkaç adım uzaklıktaki bu daireye Evans 27 milyon dolar ödedi. Geniş dairede yedi yatak odası, dokuz buçuk banyo ve Central Park, George Washington Köprüsü ve Metropolitan Sanat Müzesi'ne panoramik manzaralar bulunuyor.

Evans, 8.300 metrekareden büyük bu evi Olimpiyat altın madalyalı eşi Lise Evans ile paylaşacak. Evin öne çıkan özellikleri arasında resmi yemek odası, doğal ışıkla dolu 42 fit genişliğinde bir oturma odası, çalışma odası, medya odası, şömineli kütüphane ve giyinme odaları yer alıyor.

Mutfakta şarap soğutucu, ısıtıcı çekmece ve gömme kahve makinesi gibi üst düzey cihazlar var. Ayrıca pencere kenarında oturma alanı ve özel dolaplarıyla daha rahat bir yemek köşesi bulunuyor. Sakinler, 24 saat kapıcı ve 16 saatlik konsiyerj hizmetinden yararlanıyor; bu da ekstra konfor ve güvenlik sağlıyor.

Ünlü mimar Rosario Candela tarafından tasarlanan bina, 1927'de Stanhope Oteli olarak inşa edildi. Bina zengin bir tarihe sahip; 1955'te caz efsanesi Charlie Parker burada hayatını kaybetti, sosyalit Kiki Preston ise 1946'da aynı binada yaşamını yitirdi.

Evans, 1993'te Goldman Sachs'a katıldı ve 2011'de başkan yardımcısı oldu; son yıllarda hayır etkinliklerinde sıkça yer aldı. Bloomberg'e göre, Evans, dünyaca ünlü şef Eric Ripert'in evinde 22.000 dolarlık özel bir akşam yemeği hazırlaması için açık artırmayı kazandı.

Following his exceptional showing at the ICC World Cup 2023, Mohammed Shami made headlines again, this time for an act of bravery. While traveling through Nainital in Uttarakhand, Shami and his companions witnessed a car accident—right before their eyes, a car slid off a hill road. Shami and his team acted swiftly to rescue the trapped man, pulling him to safety. He posted a video online, expressing gratitude that the man survived and describing it as a 'second life' for him.

Shami is currently resting after standing out as the leading wicket-taker of the World Cup, recording 24 wickets in seven matches. Although he missed the India-Australia series, he could be back for the South Africa tour. With his recent achievements, including overtaking Zaheer Khan and Javagal Srinath as India’s top ODI World Cup wicket-taker, Shami continues to make positive headlines—on and off the cricket field.

(Note: Coverage unrelated to the main story, such as business news and company updates, has been excluded.)
translated_content:
ICC Dünya Kupası 2023’teki olağanüstü performansından sonra Mohammed Shami bu kez sahada değil, cesaretiyle gündem oldu. Uttarakhand’daki Nainital’de seyahat ederken, Shami ve yanındakiler, bir arabanın tepe yolundan aşağıya yuvarlandığını gördü. Hemen harekete geçip araçta sıkışan adamı kurtarıp güvenliğe çıkardılar. Shami yaşananları Instagram’da paylaştığı bir video ile anlattı ve adamın kurtulmasını 'ikinci bir hayat' olarak ifade etti.

Shami, Dünya Kupası’ndaki yedi maçta aldığı 24 wicket ile turnuvanın en çok wicket alan oyuncusu olduktan sonra şu anda dinleniyor. Hindistan–Avustralya serisinde oynamadı ama Güney Afrika turu için tekrar kadroda olabilir. Zaheer Khan ve Javagal Srinath’ı geride bırakarak Hindistan’ın ODI Dünya Kupaları’ndaki en çok wicket alan oyuncusu unvanını kazandı. article_content: A renewed search is set for this weekend to find Hazel Nairn, who vanished during severe flooding in Aberdeenshire a year ago. Hazel, aged 71, was last seen with her dog at the River Don near Monymusk last November. While her dog’s body was quickly recovered, Hazel remains missing, and her family still believes she could be somewhere along the river. Volunteers from the specialist underwater search group Beneath the Surface initially combed parts of the river in October and are now returning. Hazel’s daughter, Anneka, expressed the family’s ongoing pain as the anniversary approaches: 'It’s difficult to believe we’re still searching for my mum after all this time. We just hope people will remember Hazel and watch out for any of her missing belongings, as nothing has turned up throughout the year.' The search will cover stretches of the 31-mile River Don, especially areas where currents may have trapped remains. The team plans to focus on a previously identified seven-mile section, moving carefully due to the challenging environment. Beneath the Surface team leader Phil Jones explained that weather and flooding have often delayed their efforts. He said rivers present tough search conditions and results take time and care, with no guaranteed outcome. The volunteers fund the search themselves, aiming to bring answers and closure to families like Hazel’s.
translated_content: Geçen yıl Aberdeenshire’da meydana gelen şiddetli sel felaketinde kaybolan Hazel Nairn’i bulmak için bu hafta sonu yeniden arama yapılacak. 71 yaşındaki Hazel, geçen kasım ayında Monymusk yakınlarındaki River Don’da köpeğiyle birlikte en son görüldü. Köpeğinin cansız bedenine kısa sürede ulaşılırken, Hazel hâlâ kayıp ve ailesi onun hâlâ nehrin bir yerlerinde olabileceğini düşünüyor. Uzman su altı arama ekibi Beneath the Surface, ekim ayında nehirde ilk arama çalışmasını gerçekleştirmişti ve şimdi yeniden dönüyorlar. Hazel’in kızı Anneka, annesinin kayboluşunun yıldönümünde ailenin yaşadığı acıyı dile getirdi: 'Bunca zaman sonra hâlâ annemi arıyor olmamıza inanmak zor. Tek umudumuz, insanların Hazel’i hatırlayıp eksik eşyalarını görürlerse bize haber vermeleri. Tüm yıl boyunca hiçbir şey bulunamadı.' Aramalar, 31 mil uzunluğundaki River Don’un özellikle akıntının kalıntıları sıkıştırabileceği bölümlerinde yoğunlaşacak. Ekip, daha önce belirlenen yedi millik bir kesime dikkatlice ve aşama aşama ilerlemeyi planlıyor. Beneath the Surface ekip lideri Phil Jones, kötü hava ve selin çalışmaları sıkça engellediğini belirtti. Nehirde kayıpları bulmanın çok zor olduğunu, aramaların dikkatle ve zaman alarak yapılması gerektiğini, sonucun ise garanti edilemeyeceğini söyledi. Gönüllüler kendi imkanlarıyla bu aramaları sürdürüyor ve Hazel’in ailesi gibi ailelere yanıt ve huzur ulaştırmayı amaçlıyor.
post_content: It’s been a year since Hazel Nairn went missing in Aberdeenshire floods, and volunteers are resuming the river search this weekend. Still hoping for answers for Hazel’s family. #Hope #CommunitySupport #Aberdeenshire

article_content: According to former Newcastle United favourite Warren Barton, Alan Pardew never lost the support of his players during the team's difficult run of form earlier this season. Newcastle failed to secure a win in their opening seven Premier League games, increasing fan pressure on club owner Mike Ashley to replace Pardew, with supporters protesting against the manager during matches. Prior to October, Newcastle had managed only six wins in 28 fixtures that calendar year. However, the team's fortunes improved with league victories at home against Leicester City and away to Tottenham Hotspur. Pardew's strong relationship with his squad was underlined by Wednesday's impressive 2-0 Carling Cup fourth-round win away at Manchester City, which continued the momentum Newcastle had been building. Warren Barton told TalkSPORT: 'Even in their hardest moments, like the away match at Stoke when the pressure was highest, the players still showed effort and commitment. I don’t think the players will turn their backs on Alan Pardew—he brought many of them to the club and they believed in his vision.' Moussa Sissoko scored Newcastle’s second goal during their Capital One Cup victory at Manchester City.

article_content: Officials are investigating claims that two New York Fire Department dispatchers, both trained as emergency medical technicians, refused to help a pregnant woman who collapsed at a Brooklyn cafe where they were present. The woman, Eutisha Rennix, later died at Long Island College Hospital. The Brooklyn District Attorney's office, which is leading the investigation, confirmed that Rennix was pregnant. The dispatchers, identified as Jason Green and Melissa Jackson, have been suspended without pay pending the outcome of a departmental investigation, according to FDNY spokesman Frank Dwyer. Despite being dispatchers, both Green and Jackson had completed emergency medical technician training, which includes several weeks of instruction in medical care, according to another FDNY spokesperson, Steve Ritea. Coworkers at the Au Bon Pain cafe said that Green and Jackson were at the scene when Rennix collapsed, but left after instructing other staff to call 911, local media reported. Rennix's mother, Cynthia, told CNN affiliate NY1 that coworkers attempted to get the two dispatchers to assist, but they allegedly refused. Jeff Samerson, the union spokesperson representing Green and Jackson, told NY1 that Jackson called 911 herself, and highlighted that neither dispatcher had been in patient-contact roles for years. He emphasized that they acted as best they could under the circumstances. The FDNY issued a statement reasserting that all members have sworn an oath to provide aid in medical emergencies. Cynthia Rennix criticized the dispatchers as 'heartless' and 'uncaring' and expressed hope that the city would implement better training to prevent similar cases in the future. Rennix's brother, Eudane, who was serving in Kuwait with the U.S. Army, recounted the family's devastation upon learning of her death. 'If this is your job, why wouldn't you want to help someone in need?' he said. Eutisha Rennix's fiancé, Harry Woodsen, described the loss of both his future wife and unborn child as incredibly hard for the family. He noted the multiple losses suffered by each family member. The incident has attracted widespread attention. At a news conference, Mayor Michael Bloomberg strongly criticized the EMTs, saying, 'Somebody's dying down the street and they say ‘Help them,’ and they just sat there. There’s no excuse whatsoever, as far as I can see.'
translated_content: Yetkililer, acil tıbbi müdahale eğitimi almış iki New York İtfaiyesi operatörünün, bulundukları Brooklyn'deki kafede fenalaşan hamile bir kadına yardım etmeyi reddettikleri iddiasını soruşturuyor. Kadın, Eutisha Rennix, daha sonra Long Island College Hastanesinde hayatını kaybetti. Soruşturmayı sürdüren Brooklyn Savcılığı, Rennix'in hamile olduğunu doğruladı. FDNY sözcüsü Frank Dwyer'a göre, Jason Green ve Melissa Jackson olarak açıklanan operatörler, soruşturma sonuçlanana dek maaşsız açığa alındı. FDNY'den Steve Ritea'ya göre, Green ve Jackson görevleri gereği operatör olmakla birlikte, acil tıp teknisyeni olarak da birkaç hafta süren tıbbi eğitimden geçmişlerdi. Au Bon Pain kafe çalışanları, Green ve Jackson'ın Rennix bayıldığında orada olduklarını fakat diğer çalışanlara 911'i aramalarını söyledikten sonra kafeden ayrıldıklarını ifade etti. Rennix'in annesi Cynthia ise, CNN'in bağlı kuruluşu NY1'a, kızının iş arkadaşlarının iki operatöre yardım etmeleri için yalvardığını ancak iddiaya göre onların yardım etmeyi reddettiklerini söyledi. Green ve Jackson temsilcisi sendika sözcüsü Jeff Samerson, NY1'a yaptığı açıklamada, Jackson'ın kendisinin 911'i aradığını ve iki operatörün de yıllardır hastalarla doğrudan temasta olmadığını belirtti. Koşullara göre en iyisini yapmaya çalıştıklarını vurguladı. FDNY'den yapılan açıklamada ise, tüm üyelerin acil tıbbi durumda yardım etmeye yemin ettiği bir kez daha hatırlatıldı. Cynthia Rennix, operatörleri 'vicdansız' ve 'umursamaz' olarak nitelendirirken; şehrin benzer olayların önüne geçmesi için daha iyi eğitim uygulamaları başlatmasını umut ettiğini söyledi. Kardeşi Eudane Rennix ise ABD ordusunda Kuveyt'te görevdeyken ölüm haberini aldığında ailenin yıkıldığını anlattı. 'Bu senin işin ise, neden yardıma muhtaç birine yardım etmek istemezsin?' dedi. Eutisha Rennix'in nişanlısı Harry Woodsen, hem nişanlısını hem de doğmamış çocuklarını kaybetmenin aile için çok ağır olduğunu söyledi. Ailede herkesin birden fazla kaybı olduğunu belirtti. Olay şehir dışında da tepki topladı. Bir basın toplantısında New York Belediye Başkanı Michael Bloomberg, EMT'leri sert dille eleştirerek, 'Sokağın aşağısında biri ölürken “yardım edin” diyorlar ve onlar sadece oturuyorlar. Benim görebildiğim kadarıyla hiçbir mazeret yok.' dedi.

article_content: Planning a New Year's Eve party? Start off with Prosecco, move on to gin or vodka, toast 2015 with Champagne, and finish with a classic Martini. To make it through the night and stay in your friends' good graces in the morning, skip beer, red wine, and shots. Ruairi Giles, owner of The Bonneville French restaurant and cocktail bar in Hackney, shares his top cocktail recipes for the festive season. Kick off 2015 with a spicy Bloody Mary—or a Virgin Mary if you’re going alcohol-free. Giles recommends the Negroni Sbagliato for a festive twist on a classic aperitif. This variant omits gin, saving it for later, and uses Prosecco or Champagne instead. Even without dinner, it’s a safe, low-alcohol way to begin the night. To keep up your stamina throughout the evening, Giles suggests long drinks such as gin and tonic. Save complex cocktails for later in the night. Gin and tonics or vodka tonics may seem simple but help you pace yourself, and adding a dash of Angostura bitters can liven them up. Top picks include the Clover Club—a gin cocktail with lemon, sugar, egg white, and raspberry syrup—and The Twinkle, which combines vodka, elderflower, and Champagne or Prosecco for a sparkling finish. As midnight draws near, Giles recommends Champagne—especially blanc de blancs made exclusively from Chardonnay grapes—as a preferable option for a long night over very dry brut styles, which can dry your mouth and contribute to hangovers. To close out the celebrations, a classic Martini is a refined choice, while darker spirits are best avoided to prevent harsher hangovers or an early end to your night. Ruairi Giles’s featured cocktail recipes: Negroni Sbagliato: Mix equal parts Campari, sweet vermouth, and sparkling wine over ice in a rocks glass. Garnish with an orange slice. For a less bitter taste, swap Campari with Aperol. Clover Club: Combine 2oz gin, juice of half a lemon, 1 tsp sugar, egg white, and 0.25oz raspberry syrup in a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake well, then strain into a chilled cocktail glass. The Twinkle: Shake 25ml vodka and 15ml elderflower cordial, strain into a chilled coupette or champagne flute, top with Champagne, and garnish with a lemon twist. Classic Martini: Stir 2.5oz gin, 0.5oz dry vermouth, and, optionally, Angostura bitters with ice. Strain into a chilled glass and garnish with an olive or lemon twist. Bloody Mary (makes up to 40): Blend 2 sticks celery, 1 inch horseradish, 1 cucumber, 2 garlic cloves, 2 red chilies, bunches of basil and coriander, black pepper, sea salt, juice of 1 lemon, and a glass of red wine. Add 1 liter Worcestershire sauce, chill for at least 24 hours, then strain. When serving, use 20–40ml of this mix, add 50ml vodka, and top with tomato juice over ice.
translated_content: Yılbaşı gecesi partisi mi planlıyorsunuz? Prosecco ile başlayın, ardından cin veya votka ile devam edin, 2015’e şampanya ile kadeh kaldırın ve geceyi klasik bir Martini ile noktalayın. Geceyi güzel geçirmek ve sabah arkadaşlarınızla aranızı bozmamak için bira, kırmızı şarap ve shotlardan uzak durun. Hackney’de bulunan The Bonneville Fransız restoranı ve kokteyl barının sahibi Ruairi Giles, yılbaşı için en sevdiği kokteyl tariflerini paylaşıyor. 2015’e baharatlı bir Bloody Mary ile başlayın—alkolsüz bir seçenek istiyorsanız Virgin Mary de yapabilirsiniz. Giles, klasik bir aperatifin yılbaşı yorumu olarak Negroni Sbagliato’yu öneriyor. Bu tarifte cin yok; cin’i daha sonraya saklayıp yerine Prosecco veya Şampanya kullanılıyor. Akşam yemeği olmasa bile bu düşük alkollü içki geceye başlamak için güvenli bir tercih. Gece boyu temponuzu korumak için Giles, gin-tonik gibi uzun bardak içkiler tercih etmenizi öneriyor. Daha karmaşık kokteylleri ise gece ilerledikçe deneyin. Cin tonik veya votka tonik her ne kadar basit görünse de sizi dengede tutar. Birkaç damla Angostura bitters eklemek bu içkileri canlandırabilir. Giles’ın favori tarifleri arasında Clover Club (cin, limon, şeker, yumurta beyazı ve frambuaz şurubu ile hazırlanır) ve The Twinkle (votka, mürver çiçeği likörü ve Prosecco veya Şampanya ile yapılır) bulunuyor. Gece yarısına yaklaşırken Giles, özellikle sadece Chardonnay üzümlerinden yapılan blanc de blancs Şampanya’yı öneriyor; bu türler uzun bir gece için daha uygundur. Çok kuru brut şampanyalar ise ağzınızı kurutur ve daha fazla baş ağrısına yol açabilir. Kutlamaları sonlandırmak için klasik bir Martini şık bir tercih olurken, geceyi daha erken bitirmenize ve daha ağır bir sabah yaşamanıza neden olabileceği için koyu renkli içkilerden uzak durmanızı tavsiye ediyor. Ruairi Giles’ın öne çıkan kokteyl tarifleri: Negroni Sbagliato: Eşit miktarda Campari, tatlı vermut ve köpüklü şarabı buzla dolu bir kısa bardakta karıştırın. Portakal dilimiyle süsleyin. Daha az acı bir tat için Campari yerine Aperol kullanabilirsiniz. Clover Club: 2 oz cin, yarım limonun suyu, 1 tatlı kaşığı şeker, 1 yumurta beyazı ve 0,25 oz frambuaz şurubunu buzla dolu bir kokteyl shaker’ına ekleyin. Güzelce çalkalayıp süzün ve soğutulmuş kokteyl bardağına alın. The Twinkle: 25 ml votka ve 15 ml mürver çiçeği şurubunu kısa bir süre çalkalayın, soğuk bir coupette ya da şampanya kadehine süzerek alın, şampanya ile tamamlayın ve limon kabuğu rendesiyle süsleyin. Klasik Martini: 2,5 oz cin, 0,5 oz sek vermut ve isteğe bağlı olarak Angostura bitters’i buzla dolu bir karıştırma bardağında karıştırın. Süzüp soğutulmuş kadehe alın ve zeytin veya limon kabuğu ile süsleyin. Bloody Mary (yaklaşık 40 kişilik): 2 dal kereviz, 2,5 cm kadar yaban turpu, 1 salatalık, 2 diş sarımsak, 2 kırmızı acı biber, birer demet fesleğen ve kişniş, karabiber, deniz tuzu, 1 limonun suyu ve 1 bardak kırmızı şarabı blender’dan geçirin. 1 litre Worcestershire sos ekleyip en az 24 saat dolapta bekletin, sonra süzün. Servis için, 20-40 ml karışıma 50 ml votka ekleyip iyi bir domates suyu ile buz üzerinde tamamlayın.
