article_content: After having difficulty finding clear, practical information on purchasing an engagement ring, Alastair Smith—a Londoner living in Sydney—committed six months to researching the process. Dissatisfied with strictly technical guides, he traveled between Sydney, New York, and London and interviewed gemologists and jewelers to better understand his options. Smith eventually found success buying his ring online, discovering greater selection and lower prices compared to brick-and-mortar stores. This personal journey motivated him to write 'How to buy an engagement ring,' an accessible guidebook designed to help men find the perfect ring. His book shares several core recommendations: utilize online retailers for wider choices and cost savings, set a budget that feels comfortable, pay attention to your partner’s style, don’t obsess over diamond clarity, and consider purchasing just the stone and selecting the final setting together after the proposal. Smith also suggests that when secrecy isn’t crucial, discussing ring preferences with your partner can lead to the best outcome. To help grooms keep their secrets, Smith’s book comes with covert covers. He supports his points with stories like that of his friend Sam Lyons, who, after using the guide, saved money and delighted his fiancee with a surprise proposal and ring. Smith notes that men typically spend four months choosing an engagement ring, and surveys show one in ten women might reject a proposal if unhappy with the ring. The average engagement ring costs about $5,300, but smart choices—like selecting certain diamond shapes—can save up to 42%. With hundreds of thousands of diamonds available from recommended retailers, Smith emphasizes that a wider search yields better and more affordable rings. Above all, he urges buyers to spend within their means and make sure the purchase is meaningful for the couple.

article_content: Space travel is inherently risky, in part because leaving Earth’s surface deprives astronauts of familiar orientation cues, making spatial disorientation a serious hazard. While astronauts typically undergo extensive training to combat this issue, new research shows that wearable vibrating devices—called vibrotactors—could make this training significantly more effective and improve safety for space missions. “Long-duration spaceflight will cause many physiological and psychological stressors, making astronauts highly susceptible to spatial disorientation,” explained Dr. Vivekanand P. Vimal of Brandeis University, lead author of an article in Frontiers in Physiology. “When disoriented, astronauts cannot rely on their internal senses as they normally would.” For the study, researchers simulated the effects of spaceflight using sensory deprivation and a multi-axis rotation device. The aim was to test whether vibrotactors could help correct the misleading orientation cues received by the vestibular system and whether participants could learn to trust these devices. The experiment involved 30 participants split into three groups: one received training on the rotation device, another used vibrotactors, and the third received both. All participants watched a video demonstration of the rotation device, which behaves like an inverted pendulum that could crash if not properly stabilized using a joystick. For those who received additional training, exercises were designed to teach them to ignore their vestibular sense and depend on the vibrotactors instead. This included searching for balance points that were intentionally not aligned with upright, forcing participants to focus on the vibrotactors' vibrations. All participants wore blindfolds, earplugs, and listened to white noise to prevent sensory input. Those with vibrotactors had four strapped to each arm, which buzzed when they moved away from the balance point. Each participant completed 40 attempts to keep the rotation device balanced. Half of the trials were on a vertical roll plane (Earth analog, where natural cues are present), while the other half simulated spaceflight conditions with a horizontal roll plane (removing helpful gravitational cues). After each block, participants rated their sense of disorientation and trust in the vibrotactors. Their success was assessed by how often they crashed and how well they maintained balance. Initially, all groups reported disorientation during the spaceflight analog trials, as expected due to the lack of reliable gravitational cues. Most participants indicated trust in the vibrotactors, though some experienced confusion from conflicting cues. Those using vibrotactors performed better than those who received only training. The training-only group crashed more frequently and had greater difficulty maintaining balance. However, participants who received both training and vibrotactors achieved the best results over time. Despite improvements, performance with vibrotactors in simulated space conditions did not reach the level seen in the Earth analog. Researchers believe additional time or more pronounced alert signals may be needed for adaptation. “A pilot’s cognitive trust in this external device will most likely not be enough,” Vimal noted. “Instead, trust must be at a deeper, almost sub-cognitive level, which requires specialized training.” If these sensors continue to show success in broader studies, their applications in spaceflight could be wide-ranging—from aiding planetary landings to supporting astronauts moving outside spacecraft.
translated_content: Uzay yolculuğu doğası gereği risklidir; çünkü Dünya yüzeyinden ayrılmak, astronotları çoğu zaman uzaysal olarak yönlerini bulmalarını sağlayan alışılmış ipuçlarından mahrum bırakıyor ve bu da ciddi bir dezavantaja yol açıyor. Astronotlar tipik olarak bu sorunun üstesinden gelmek için kapsamlı eğitim alıyorlar, fakat yeni araştırmalar, titreşim sinyalleriyle yönlendiren giyilebilir cihazların, bu eğitimi çok daha verimli hâle getirip uzay görevlerinde güvenliği artırabileceğini gösteriyor. "Uzun süreli uzay yolculukları çok sayıda fizyolojik ve psikolojik strese neden olur ve bu da astronotları uzaysal dezoryantasyona karşı oldukça hassas hâle getirir," diyor Brandeis Üniversitesi’nden Dr. Vivekanand P. Vimal, Frontiers in Physiology dergisinde yayımlanan makalenin başyazarı. “Dezoryante olduklarında, astronotlar normalde güvendikleri içsel duyularına artık güvenemez.” Çalışmada, araştırmacılar duyusal yoksunluk ve çok eksenli bir döndürme cihazı kullanarak uzay yolculuğunun etkilerini simüle etti. Amaç, titreşimli cihazların (vibrotaktörlerin) vestibüler sistemin verdiği yanıltıcı ipuçlarını düzeltebilir mi ve katılımcıların bu cihazlara güvenmeyi öğrenip öğrenemeyeceklerini test etmekti. Deneyde, 30 katılımcı üç gruba ayrıldı: Biri döndürme cihazıyla eğitim aldı, diğeri sadece vibrotaktörleri kullandı, üçüncü grup ise her iki yöntemi de uyguladı. Tüm katılımcılar, bir joystick yardımıyla dengede tutulmadığında ters sarkaç gibi hareket eden döndürme cihazı hakkında bilgilendirici bir video izledi. Ekstra eğitim alan gruplar için, vestibüler duyularını göz ardı edip yerine vibrotaktörlere güvenmeleri amaçlanan egzersizler uygulandı. Bunlar, dikeyle hizalanmayan denge noktalarını aramayı içerdi ve katılımcıların yalnızca titreşim sinyallerine odaklanmalarını gerektirdi. Tüm katılımcılar gözleri bağlı, kulak tıkacı takılı ve beyaz gürültü dinleyerek duyusal girdileri engelledi. Vibrotaktör kullananlar ise kollarına dörder adet cihaz taktı; denge noktasından uzaklaştıklarında cihazlar titreşerek uyarı veriyordu. Katılımcıların her biri, döndürme cihazını dengede tutmaya çalışarak 40 deneme yaptı. Denemelerin yarısı dikey dönüş eksenindeydi (Dünya analoğu; doğal ipuçları mevcut), diğer yarısı ise (uzay analogunda) yatay dönüş eksenindeydi ve burada yerçekimi hisleri devre dışı kaldı. Her bloktan sonra katılımcılar ne kadar dezoryante olduklarını ve vibrotaktörlere ne kadar güvendiklerini puanladı. Başarı, yapılan çarpışma sayısı ve dengede kalma ile ölçüldü. Başlangıçta tüm gruplar, uzay yolculuğu benzetimlerinde beklenildiği gibi, yön bulmada zorluk yaşadı. Katılımcıların çoğu vibrotaktörlere güvendiklerini belirtti, ancak bazıları iç dürtüleriyle cihazın sinyalleri arasında kararsızlık yaşadı. Vibrotaktör kullananlar, sadece eğitim alanlara kıyasla daha iyi performans gösterdi. Sadece eğitim alan grup daha sık dengeyi kaybetti ve dengesini sürdürmekte zorlandı. Hem eğitim hem de vibrotaktör kullananlar ise zamanla en iyi sonuçlara ulaştı. İyileşmelere rağmen, vibrotaktörle yapılan denemelerde elde edilen performans, Dünya benzetimi kadar yüksek olmadı. Araştırmacılar, katılımcıların cihazlara uyum sağlaması için daha fazla zamana veya daha güçlü uyarı sinyallerine ihtiyaç olabileceğini düşünüyor. "Bir pilotun, bu harici cihaza yalnızca bilişsel olarak güvenmesi yeterli olmayacaktır," diyor Vimal. “Asıl gerekli olan, daha derin, neredeyse bilinçaltı bir güven seviyesi ve bu da özel bir eğitim gerektiriyor.” Bu sensörler daha kapsamlı çalışmalarda da başarılı olursa, uygulama alanları geniş olabilir; gezegen yüzeyine inişte veya uzay aracının dışında hareket eden astronotlara destek olmak gibi birçok görevde kullanılabilirler.

article_content:
The UK's Online Safety Bill officially became law yesterday, introducing new requirements for internet service providers to proactively block illegal and harmful online material. This includes content supporting terrorism, deepfake revenge pornography, and posts that encourage eating disorders. The law also mandates that adult users prove their age online and sets up reporting mechanisms for problematic content.

Social media platforms are now legally responsible for the content shared on their sites. Companies that fail to meet these new standards can be fined or have executives face imprisonment. One of the most contentious aspects of the bill is the potential requirement for messaging platforms to provide authorities with access to private communications, effectively limiting end-to-end encryption. However, the government has acknowledged that implementing this measure is not currently technically feasible.

Some technology companies have expressed concerns about the enforceability of certain provisions. Digital rights advocates warn that the bill could pose a threat to freedom of expression. Despite these debates, Technology Secretary Michelle Donelan described the passage of the bill as “an historic moment that ensures the online safety of British society not only now, but for decades to come.” The closing remark suggests skepticism about the gap between appearing to take action and actual effectiveness.

Ayrıca, yetişkin internet kullanıcılarının yaşlarını kanıtlaması zorunlu tutuluyor ve sorunlu içeriklerin bildirilebilmesi için raporlama mekanizmaları kuruluyor.

Vanessa Dennis, a former lawyer at Napoli Bern Ripka Shkolnik LLP, has sued her ex-employer, partner Paul Napoli, his wife Marie, and the law firm for defamation. Dennis claims that after Marie Napoli discovered her affair with Paul, she faced a sustained campaign of harassment, including being followed by a private investigator, receiving threatening emails and messages, and being contacted at work and at home. 

According to legal filings, Marie Napoli confronted Dennis’ husband and family, publicized private information to Dennis' new colleagues in Texas, and sent messages about Dennis' personal life. Dennis alleges this harassment persisted even after she was let go from the firm with a $150,000 severance, with continued efforts to harm her reputation and bizarre texts regarding her missing cat.

Paul Napoli, notable for high-profile legal work for 9/11 victims and others, denies wrongdoing and says his wife’s statements were factually accurate. He also denies any prior affairs or involvement in the disappearance of Dennis’ cat. 

Marie Napoli has countersued Dennis under the Illinois Alienation of Affections Act, claiming Dennis pursued Paul. Paul and Marie Napoli remain married and have declined detailed public comment, insisting that any confrontations and statements from Marie were truthful.

article_content: China will require export permits for certain graphite products starting December 1, aiming to protect its national security, according to the country’s commerce ministry. The decision comes as foreign governments increase scrutiny of Chinese industrial practices. As the world’s largest producer and exporter, China refines over 90% of global graphite, which is vital for use in electric vehicle (EV) battery anodes. Under the new rules, exporters must secure permits to ship high-purity, high-hardness, high-intensity synthetic graphite, as well as natural flake graphite and their products. At the same time, China is dropping temporary controls on five types of less sensitive graphite used in basic industries like steel, metallurgy, and chemicals. Chang Ke, an analyst at consultancy Mysteel, explained to Reuters that these measures seek to safeguard graphite supplies for domestic military applications, such as aerospace, and for battery manufacturing. Natural graphite is classified as a critical raw material by the EU, Japan, Canada, and the US. The International Energy Agency projects graphite demand could rise 20 to 25 times between 2020 and 2040. Ivan Lam, senior analyst at Counterpoint Research, noted graphite’s high performance and its wide use in industries such as semiconductors, automobiles, aerospace, battery production, and chemicals. Many countries, including in Europe, rely heavily on imports to meet their graphite needs. Top buyers from China include Japan, the US, India, and South Korea, based on Chinese customs data. China’s move is widely seen as a response to escalating trade tensions with the US and EU. The announcement closely follows new US export controls on semiconductors to China, including advanced AI chips, while the EU considers tariffs on Chinese-made EVs. Since August 1, China has also imposed similar restrictions on exporting gallium and germanium, two metals crucial for chip-making, which has reduced exports and pushed up global prices. Christopher Richter, Deputy Head of Research at CLSA in Tokyo, suggested that cutting off global access to graphite outright would disrupt EV production worldwide and heighten existing trade disputes. Industry observers expect the price of graphite to rise. Carmakers are already seeking alternative graphite sources to secure their supply chains and control costs. The extent and impact of China’s restrictions remain uncertain, but growing demand and supply concerns point to higher prices. Ivan Lam added that Russia was a key supplier before the Russia-Ukraine war. Manufacturers are diversifying supply chains, exploring both new sources and alternative materials. While China currently produces two-thirds of the world’s graphite, Turkey and Brazil possess about half of global reserves, according to the United States Geological Survey. China holds 16%, followed by Madagascar, Mozambique, Tanzania, and Russia. The move could especially affect the US, which relies on China for a third of its graphite imports and has limited alternative sources among available graphite-rich countries.
translated_content: Çin, 1 Aralık'tan itibaren bazı grafit ürünlerinin ihracatı için izin şartı getirecek. Ülkenin ticaret bakanlığına göre, bu adım ulusal güvenliği korumak amacıyla atılıyor. Karar, yabancı hükümetlerin Çin’in endüstriyel uygulamalarına yönelik denetimlerini artırdığı bir dönemde alındı. Dünyanın en büyük üreticisi ve ihracatçısı olan Çin, küresel grafitin %90'ından fazlasını rafine ederek elektrikli araç (EV) batarya anotlarında kullanılan kritik bir malzeme hâline getiriyor. Yeni kurallara göre, yüksek saflıkta, yüksek sertlikte ve yüksek yoğunlukta sentetik grafit ile doğal pul grafit ve bunların ürünlerinin ihracı için ihracatçıların izin alması gerekecek. Aynı zamanda, Çin çelik, metalurji ve kimya gibi temel sektörlerde kullanılan beş daha az hassas grafit ürünündeki geçici kontrolleri de kaldırıyor. Mysteel danışmanlık şirketinden analist Chang Ke, Reuters’a bu önlemlerin grafitin askeri uygulamalarda –özellikle havacılık sektöründe– ve batarya üretiminde ülke içi tedarikini güvence altına almayı amaçladığını söyledi. Doğal grafit, AB, Japonya, Kanada ve ABD tarafından kritik ham madde olarak sınıflandırılıyor. Uluslararası Enerji Ajansı’na göre, 2020-2040 arasında grafit talebinin 20 ila 25 kat artması bekleniyor. Counterpoint Research’te kıdemli analist olan Ivan Lam, grafitin üstün performanslı olduğunu ve yarı iletken, otomotiv, havacılık, batarya ve kimya gibi birçok sektörde yaygın olarak kullanıldığını aktardı. Avrupa dahil çok sayıda ülke, grafit ihtiyacını karşılamak için ithalata büyük ölçüde bağımlı durumda. Çin’in gümrük verilerine göre başlıca alıcılar Japonya, ABD, Hindistan ve Güney Kore. Çin’in bu adımı, ABD ve AB ile artan ticari gerilimlere yanıt olarak görülüyor. Duyuru, ABD'nin Çin'e yarı iletken ve ileri AI çip ihracatına yeni kısıtlamalar getirmesinin ve AB’nin Çin üretimi elektrikli araçlara gümrük vergisi uygulamayı tartışmasının hemen ardından geldi. Çin ayrıca, 1 Ağustos’tan bu yana, yonga üretiminde kritik olan galyum ve germanyum için de benzer ihracat kontrolleri uygulamakta; bu da ihracatların düşmesine ve dünya fiyatlarının artmasına yol açtı. CLSA Tokyo Araştırma Başkan Yardımcısı Christopher Richter, dünya çapında grafit tedarikinin tamamen kesilmesinin EV üretimini durdurabileceğini ve mevcut ticari gerginliği tırmandırabileceğini öne sürdü. Sektör gözlemcileri grafit fiyatlarının artmasını bekliyor. Oto üreticileri ise tedarik zincirini korumak ve maliyetleri kontrol altında tutmak için Çin dışındaki alternatif grafit kaynaklarına yöneliyor. Çin’in bu kısıtlamalarının ne kadar ileri gideceği ve etkisi belirsiz olsa da, artan talep ve tedarik endişeleri fiyatları yükseltiyor. Ivan Lam, Rusya-Ukrayna savaşı öncesinde Rusya’nın ana tedarikçilerden biri olduğunu ekledi. Üreticiler, yeni kaynaklar ve alternatif malzemeler arayarak tedarik zincirlerini çeşitlendiriyor. Çin şu anda dünya grafitinin üçte ikisini üretirken, Türkiye ve Brezilya dünya rezervlerinin yaklaşık yarısına sahip. Bu bilgi Amerikan Jeoloji Araştırmaları Kurumu’na dayanıyor. Çin’in payı %16, onu Madagaskar, Mozambik, Tanzanya ve Rusya takip ediyor. Bu gelişme özellikle ithalatının üçte birini Çin’den sağlayan ve alternatif tedarikçi bulmakta zorlanan ABD’yi etkileyebilir.

article_content: Roger Federer delivered a straightforward win at Wimbledon, quickly overcoming Colombia’s Santiago Giraldo in only 81 minutes. In the Royal Box, Federer's parents Lynette and Robert watched alongside sports celebrities including Sachin Tendulkar and David Beckham. Giraldo, ranked 35 in the world and with little third-round Grand Slam experience, struggled from the outset. Federer broke Giraldo’s serve early, eventually securing a 6-3, 6-1, 6-3 victory. Federer's Wimbledon legacy is remarkable—he's won the tournament seven times and continues to adapt his style as he ages, increasingly using serve-and-volley tactics. Despite a surprising early exit last year, Federer has not lost a set in this year’s tournament. Federer’s next opponent is Tommy Robredo, who previously defeated him at the 2013 US Open. After his win, Federer emphasized family, enjoying moments with his wife Mirka and their two sets of twins, who keep him occupied and happy off the court. Federer plans to continue his morning practices and spend time with his family before his next match at Wimbledon.

Dünya sıralamasında 35'inci olan ve Grand Slam'de üçüncü tur deneyimi olmayan Giraldo, ilk anlardan itibaren zorlandı. Federer, Giraldo’nun servisini erken bir şekilde kırdı ve mücadeleyi 6-3, 6-1, 6-3’lük setlerle kazandı. Federer’in Wimbledon’daki mirası dikkat çekici—turnuvayı yedi kez kazandı ve yaş aldıkça servisten fileye gelen oyunu daha sık kullanarak stilini geliştirmeye devam ediyor. Geçen yıl beklenmedik şekilde erken elendiği turnuvada bu sene henüz set vermedi. Federer’in sıradaki rakibi, 2013 ABD Açık'ta kendisini eleyen Tommy Robredo. Zaferinin ardından Federer, kort dışında ailesiyle vakit geçirmeye ağırlık verdiğini ve özellikle eşi Mirka ile iki ikiz çiftiyle birlikte olmaktan büyük mutluluk duyduğunu söyledi. Federer, sabah antrenmanlarını sürdürecek ve ailesiyle vakit geçirip ardından Wimbledon’daki bir sonraki maçına çıkacak.

article_content: Abdul Musa, a postman in Blackburn, Lancashire, received a £100,000 payout after exposing chronic racism at the Canterbury Street sorting office where he worked between 2006 and 2007. An employment tribunal heard that Asian workers, including Mr Musa, were subjected to slurs such as ‘cockroaches’, ‘vermin’, and other racist insults. An Italian worker was also targeted with derogatory language. After Musa reported the abuse, he faced a series of racial and sexual counter-accusations and was dismissed in early 2007. Another postal worker, Christopher Eccles, was also dismissed amid ongoing abuse, and several colleagues were disciplined. The events led to strike action in support of Mr Eccles, and racist graffiti appeared in staff restrooms. A tribunal judge later ruled that Mr Musa was racially victimized by his colleagues and described Royal Mail's investigation as 'shambolic.' The five-day tribunal, held in Manchester in January 2012, found Mr Musa had been unfairly dismissed and upheld his claims of racial discrimination. The Equality and Human Rights Commission criticized Royal Mail for failing to protect Mr Musa, pointing out that management at the Blackburn depot was aware of the racism but did not act. Judge Mrs C Porter highlighted the lack of investigation into the origins of racist graffiti. Regardless of the internal inquiries, a later Royal Mail investigation into the broader issues was reportedly not disclosed to the tribunal. Neil Donovan, an independent investigator, found that Mr Musa was racially, verbally, and physically harassed by more than a dozen colleagues. The tribunal also raised concerns about the actions of the Communication Workers Union during internal investigations. Mr Musa claimed he was deliberately isolated at work, received threatening calls, and experienced breaches of confidentiality when his complaints were shared among staff, resulting in retaliation and further intimidation. He maintained that he never used racist or sexual language against colleagues and saw the counter-accusations as retribution for exposing the workplace culture. The EHRC supported Mr Musa’s case after his initial legal representation withdrew. John Wadham, EHRC general counsel, emphasized the importance of advocacy for people facing discrimination. In response, a Royal Mail spokesperson said, 'There is no room in Royal Mail for racism or any other form of discrimination. We are committed to investigating any complaint of discrimination fairly and thoroughly.'
translated_content: Blackburn, Lancashire'de postacı olarak çalışan Abdul Musa, 2006 ile 2007 yılları arasında görev yaptığı Canterbury Street ayrım merkezinde kronik ırkçılığı ifşa etmesinin ardından £100,000 tazminat aldı. Bir iş mahkemesinde, Abdul Musa dahil Asyalı çalışanların ‘hamamböceği’, ‘haşere’ ve başka ırkçı hakaretlere maruz kaldığı anlatıldı. Ayrıca bir İtalyan çalışan da aşağılayıcı ifadelere hedef oldu. Musa, bu durumu bildirince bir dizi ırkçı ve cinsel karşı-suçlamalarla karşılaştı ve 2007 başında işten çıkarıldı. Süregelen taciz ortamında bir diğer posta çalışanı Christopher Eccles da işten çıkarılırken, birkaç çalışan disipline sevk edildi. Bu olaylar üzerine Eccles’in desteklenmesi için işyerinde grev başlatıldı ve personele ait tuvaletlerde ırkçı yazılar görüldü. Daha sonra bir mahkeme hakimi, Musa’nın meslektaşları tarafından ırkçı mağduriyete uğradığına ve Royal Mail’in soruşturmasını ‘başarısız’ olarak nitelendirdiğine hükmetti. Ocak 2012’de Manchester’da yapılan beş günlük mahkeme sonucunda Musa’nın haksız yere işten çıkarıldığı ve ırk ayrımcılığı iddialarının doğru olduğu belirlendi. Eşitlik ve İnsan Hakları Komisyonu, Blackburn birimindeki yöneticilerin ırkçılığın farkında olmalarına rağmen Abdul Musa’yı koruyamadığı için Royal Mail’i eleştirdi. Hakim Mrs C Porter, ırkçı grafitilerin kaynağına dair yeterli bir soruşturma yürütülmediğine dikkati çekti. İç soruşturmalara rağmen, Royal Mail’in daha sonra yaptığı daha kapsamlı bir incelemenin mahkemeye açıklanmadığı iddia edildi. Bağımsız araştırmacı Neil Donovan, Musa’nın ondan fazla çalışan tarafından ırkçı, sözlü ve fiziksel tacize uğradığını saptadı. Mahkeme ayrıca, dahili soruşturmalar sırasında İletişim İşçileri Sendikası’nın davranışlarına dair endişelere vurgu yaptı. Musa, çalışma ortamında kasıtlı olarak dışlandığını, tehdit içerikli telefonlar aldığını, şikayetlerinin gizli tutulmayıp diğer personele dağıtılması sonucu misillemeye ve başka baskıya uğradığını söyledi. Kendisinin meslektaşlarını küçük düşürücü veya cinsel bir dil kullanmadığını ve kendisine yöneltilen karşı-suçlamaların, işyerindeki ırkçı yapıyı ortaya çıkarmasının bir intikamı olduğunu savundu. EHRC, Musa'nın ilk hukuk temsilciliği çekilince davayı finanse etti. EHRC genel hukuki danışmanı John Wadham, ayrımcılığa uğrayan kişilerin yanında hukuki bir savunucu olmasının önemini vurguladı. Royal Mail sözcüsü ise, 'Royal Mail'de ırkçılığa ya da başka bir ayrımcılığa asla yer yok. Her türlü ayrımcılık şikâyetini adil ve titizlikle soruşturmayı taahhüt ediyoruz.' dedi.

article_content: The Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority (GNIDA) has described the ongoing strike by safai karamcharis as illegal and warned that workers will not receive their salaries unless they immediately resume work. GNIDA also instructed contractors to quickly hire new staff to replace those participating in the strike, which began on November 6. According to a GNIDA statement, the authority has already met many of the workers' demands, but the strike continues. It added that a meeting was held with the striking workers on Friday, during which officials assured them that a committee meeting would soon be convened to discuss their remaining demands. The main demand from workers is for their salaries to be raised from the current Rs 17,170 per month to approximately Rs 20,000. GNIDA says that a provision already exists for a 5% salary increase every two years, and assured workers that this would be applied as stipulated in the contracts. On the issue of a Diwali bonus, GNIDA stated that it has already been paid. For the demand regarding insurance of Rs 10 lakh in the event of a workplace fatality, the authority claims that such a provision has also been made. Ranbeer Janghara, district president of Sanyukt Morcha Safai Karamchari, said that the workers would not be swayed by GNIDA's directive. 'We feel bad if the city remains dirty, but we cannot continue cleaning unless we are paid better,' he stated. Currently, around 1,400 safai karamcharis employed by six contractors serve the Greater Noida Authority area. With their strike ongoing, cleaning work is being carried out by daily wage laborers. Mahesh Chandelia, another leader among the workers, said: 'The authority asked for a week, we are willing to give a month. We said if we can receive a written promise that our demands will be fulfilled, ten workers will continue the protest while the others return to work.' Other worker demands include the provision of safety equipment, comprehensive health check-ups three times a year, dedicated spaces for food storage and changing clothes, as well as proper restroom facilities.
translated_content: Greater Noida Endüstriyel Kalkınma Kurumu (GNIDA), devam eden safai karamchari (temizlik işçileri) grevini yasa dışı olarak nitelendirdi ve işçilerin hemen işbaşı yapmadıkları takdirde maaşlarını alamayacaklarını açıkladı. GNIDA ayrıca grevdeki işçilerin yerine hızlıca yeni personel alması için müteahhitlere talimat verdi. Grev 6 Kasım'da başladı. GNIDA'nın açıklamasına göre, işçilerin taleplerinin çoğu karşılandı fakat grev sürüyor. Cuma günü grevdeki işçilerle yapılan toplantıda yetkililer, kalan taleplerin görüşüleceği bir komitenin yakında toplanacağı sözünü verdi. İşçilerin başlıca isteği, mevcutta aylık 17.170 Rs olan maaşlarının yaklaşık 20.000 Rs'ye yükseltilmesi. GNIDA, her iki yılda bir %5 zam öngörüldüğünü ve bunun sözleşmelerde belirtildiği şekilde uygulanacağını vurguladı. Diwali bonusuna ilişkin GNIDA, ödemenin zaten yapıldığını duyurdu. Görev sırasında ölüm durumunda 10 lakh Rs tutarında sigorta için de gerekli düzenlemenin yapıldığını belirtti. Sanyukt Morcha Safai Karamchari'nin ilçe başkanı Ranbeer Janghara, GNIDA’nın talimatından etkilenmeyeceklerini söyledi. 'Şehir kirli kalırsa üzülürüz ama daha iyi maaş almazsak temizlik yapmaya devam edemeyiz' dedi. Şu anda altı müteahhit tarafından çalıştırılan yaklaşık 1.400 safai karamchari, Greater Noida Authority bölgesinde görev yapıyor. Grev sürerken temizlik işleri günlük yevmiyeli işçilere yaptırılıyor. İşçi liderlerinden Mahesh Chandelia, 'Kurum bir hafta istedi, biz bir ay vermeye hazırız. Taleplerimizin yazılı olarak yerine getirileceği taahhüt edilirse, 10 işçi protestoya devam edecek, diğerleri ise işbaşı yapacak' dedi. İşçilerin diğer talepleri arasında; güvenlik ekipmanı, yılda üç kez tam sağlık kontrolü, yiyecek ve kıyafet koymak için özel alanlar ile uygun tuvaletler bulunuyor.

article_content: Susan Hodgson of Atlanta, Georgia was on vacation when a neighbor called to ask if she had authorized the demolition of her unoccupied family home. Unfortunately, the call came too late—the house had already been reduced to rubble. When the neighbor confronted the demolition crew, they checked their permit and realized they were at the wrong address. "It's been boarded up for about 15 years, and we keep it covered, maintain the grass, and the yard is always clean," Hodgson said. "The taxes are paid and everything is current on it." According to the Associated Press, as of now, the Atlanta-based company responsible, You Call It We Haul It, has not contacted Hodgson. The company also did not return a phone message left on Saturday. In a statement to WAGA-TV, the company said it is investigating and working to resolve the mistake.
translated_content: Atlanta, Georgia'dan Susan Hodgson, komşusundan boş olan aile evinin yıkımını onaylayıp onaylamadığını soran bir telefon aldığında tatildeydi. Ne yazık ki, bu arama için çok geçti—ev zaten moloz yığınına dönmüştü. Komşu yıkım ekibiyle yüzleştiğinde, izinlerini kontrol ettiler ve yanlış adreste olduklarını fark ettiler. "Ev yaklaşık 15 yıldır kapalı duruyordu, üzerini kapalı tutuyoruz, çimleri biçiyoruz ve bahçe her zaman temiz," dedi Hodgson. "Vergileri yatırıyoruz ve her şey güncel." Associated Press'e göre, şu anda sorumlu olan Atlanta merkezli şirket You Call It We Haul It, Hodgson ile iletişime geçmedi. Şirket ayrıca cumartesi günü bırakılan telefon mesajına da geri dönmedi. Şirket, WAGA-TV'ye yaptığı açıklamada olayla ilgili bir soruşturma başlattıklarını ve hatayı düzeltmek için çalıştıklarını belirtti.

article_content: Top Gear presenter Jeremy Clarkson has been granted permission to demolish a five-bedroom farmhouse in the Cotswolds and replace it with his dream luxury home. The 53-year-old plans to develop a larger property on the 70-hectare site, which will include a swimming pool and tennis court. According to documents from West Oxfordshire District Council, Clarkson plans to name his new residence 'Diddly Squat Farm.' The council approved the application with no objections during the consultation period, under the condition that construction begins within three years. Relocating from his current home in Oldner near Chipping Norton, Oxfordshire, will bring Clarkson several miles closer to Prime Minister David Cameron, who lives in the nearby village of Dean. Clarkson's new luxury home will also feature its own orchard and croquet lawn, and the renovation of a derelict barn to accommodate a snooker room and two extra bedrooms. The property will cater to animals, boasting existing stables and plans for a kennel. Design plans by Portus+Whitton include a gravelled courtyard and five on-site parking spaces to house Clarkson’s collection of luxury vehicles. Clarkson purchased the Chipping Norton farmhouse in 2009, with initial intentions to use quad bikes and grow his own food. An advertisement for the farm and land once appeared on Rightmove.com, inviting offers over £4.25 million for the freehold, but was removed by the agent. The listing suggested there was potential for creating a party barn on the 312-acre property, with the option to buy the estate as a whole or in four separate lots. In a 2009 blog post on the Top Gear website, Clarkson discussed his reasons for purchasing the farm, highlighting its value as an investment, opportunities for food production, and personal enjoyment, such as quad biking with his children. He remarked that, in addition to these practical reasons, owning a quad bike was a major draw, calling them enjoyable and practical for the countryside.
translated_content: Top Gear sunucusu Jeremy Clarkson, Cotswolds’daki beş odalı bir çiftlik evini yıkıp yerine hayalindeki lüks evi yapmak için izin aldı. 53 yaşındaki Clarkson, 70 hektarlık arazide daha büyük bir mülk inşa etmeyi planlıyor; evde yüzme havuzu ve tenis kortu da olacak. West Oxfordshire Bölge Konseyi belgelerine göre Clarkson, yeni evine ‘Diddly Squat Çiftliği’ adını vermeyi planlıyor. Konsey, başvuruyu istişare sürecinde hiçbir itiraz gelmemesi üzerine, inşaatın önümüzdeki üç yıl içinde başlaması şartıyla onayladı. Clarkson’ın şu anki evi Oldner, Chipping Norton, Oxfordshire’da bulunuyor. Yeni evine taşınması, kendisini yakınlardaki Dean köyünde yaşayan Başbakan David Cameron’a birkaç mil daha yaklaştıracak. Clarkson’ın yeni lüks evi ayrıca kendi meyve bahçesi ve kroket çim alanına sahip olacak; harabe haldeki bir ahır ise ıslah edilerek bilardo odası ve iki ek yatak odası içerecek. Mülk, mevcut ahırlarla ve köpek kulübesi planlarıyla hayvanlara da hitap edecek. Portus+Whitton peyzaj mimarları tarafından tasarlanan projede, çakıllı bir avlu ve Clarkson’ın lüks araçlarını barındırmak için beş araçlık otopark yer alıyor. Clarkson, Chipping Norton’daki çiftlik evini 2009 yılında satın aldı; ilk amacı arazide çocuklarıyla birlikte ATV kullanmak ve kendi yiyeceğini yetiştirmekti. Çiftlik ve arazisi, bir süreliğine Rightmove.com’da 4,25 milyon sterlinden yüksek teklifler beklenerek listelenmişti, fakat ilan daha sonra kaldırıldı. Ayrıca pratik sebeplerin yanında, ATV sahibi olmanın kendisi için büyük bir cazibe olduğunu ve bunların kırsal için eğlenceli ve pratik olduğunu söyledi.

article_content: North Korea’s space agency announced the successful launch of its first spy satellite, Malligyong-1, which was sent into orbit from the Sohae launch site late Tuesday. According to North Korean state media, the satellite reached orbit approximately 12 minutes after liftoff. Officials indicated this satellite is the first of several planned launches designed to strengthen North Korea’s surveillance over South Korea and other areas important to its military. The United States and its allies quickly condemned the launch, calling it a clear violation of United Nations resolutions. A spokesperson for the US National Security Council warned that this action raises tensions and threatens regional stability. Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida also strongly denounced the launch and said Japan had filed a formal protest. Authorities in South Korea and Japan, who first reported the launch, noted that they could not immediately confirm if the satellite made it into orbit. North Korea had earlier informed Japan of potential launch dates between November 22 and December 1, and had failed in two previous satellite launches this year. Responding to criticism, North Korea maintains that developing military satellites is part of its sovereign rights needed to observe the activities of the US and South Korean forces.
translated_content: Kuzey Kore'nin uzay ajansı, ilk casus uydusu Malligyong-1'i Salı gecesi Sohae fırlatma sahasından başarıyla yörüngeye gönderdiğini açıkladı. Devlet medyasına göre, uydu kalkıştan yaklaşık 12 dakika sonra yörüngeye ulaştı. Yetkililer, bu uydunun; Güney Kore ve ordu için önemli olan diğer bölgeler üzerinde Kuzey Kore'nin gözetleme kapasitesini güçlendirmek amacıyla planlanan birkaç fırlatmadan ilki olduğunu belirtti. ABD ve müttefikleri, bu fırlatmayı Birleşmiş Milletler kararlarının açık bir ihlali olarak hızlıca kınadı. article_content: Liverpool manager Brendan Rodgers praised the impact of summer signings Javi Manquillo and Dejan Lovren following their 2-1 victory over Southampton on Sunday. Of Liverpool’s seven summer additions, Manquillo and Lovren were the only newcomers to start at Anfield, and Rodgers expressed his satisfaction with their performances. 'I thought Lovren was excellent,' Rodgers told reporters. Lovren joined Liverpool from Southampton for £20 million this summer, and Rodgers added, 'It's always difficult when you play against your previous team.' Rodgers further stated, 'I thought he handled it really well. He's a real leader for us.' Javi Manquillo, on loan from Atletico Madrid, also received praise from Rodgers: 'I thought young Manquillo did well, especially after picking up an early booking. At 19 years old, he was very impressive.' Rodgers mentioned that left-back Alberto Moreno, recently signed from Sevilla, is close to making his debut. He also revealed that new arrivals Lazar Markovic and Adam Lallana will soon be available for selection. 'Thankfully, we have young Moreno coming in as well; he's a big talent,' said Rodgers. 'Markovic is now available, and Adam Lallana should return in the next few weeks, so overall, the squad is shaping up very well.'

article_content: Drones are showing up with increasing frequency in American airspace, now posing potential hazards to commercial flights. Many times, these unmanned vehicles go unseen by pilots, which has heightened safety concerns despite regulations intended to prevent such incidents. Michael Huerta, who leads the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), recently explained on CNN that expanding public outreach and stricter law enforcement are vital for keeping the skies safe. Huerta emphasized that reckless drone use is a real danger. The FAA has opened hundreds of enforcement cases against operators acting irresponsibly. Since drones became widely available, pilots are reporting up to 25 monthly incidents of drones exceeding the FAA’s height limit, sometimes flying as high as 2,000 feet. To help new, often inexperienced drone users, the FAA is partnering with organizations like the Model Aeronautics Association for educational outreach. Although current rules ban flights over 400 feet, near airports, or beyond visual contact, these laws are difficult to enforce as drone use climbs—especially because many operators are hobbyists without aviation training. To handle these challenges and integrate drones safely, the FAA committed to establishing comprehensive guidelines for commercial drone operations by September 2015. While supporters champion the technology for business and surveillance, urging swift regulatory action, pilots worry about drone visibility and the critical safety rule of 'see and avoid.' In response, the FAA is introducing drones through measured steps, beginning with operations deemed least risky. Security threats, including possible terrorist activity, are also being considered. Future FAA rules will set standards for both drone certification and operator qualifications, ensuring technology can expand without putting people in danger.

Huerta, dikkatsiz drone kullanımının gerçek bir tehlike olduğunu vurguladı. FAA, sorumsuzca hareket eden drone kullanıcılarına karşı yüzlerce inceleme başlattı. Bu zorluklarla başa çıkmak ve droneları güvenli şekilde entegre edebilmek için FAA, ticari drone operasyonları için kapsamlı düzenlemeleri Eylül 2015’e kadar yürürlüğe koymayı taahhüt etti. FAA bu nedenle ilk etapta en düşük riskli operasyonlarla başlamak üzere kademeli bir entegrasyon planlıyor. Potansiyel terörist faaliyetler gibi güvenlik tehditleri de hesaba katılıyor. Gelecek FAA düzenlemeleri, drone sertifikasyonu ve operatör yeterliliklerini kapsayarak teknolojinin insanları riske atmadan gelişmesini sağlamayı amaçlıyor.

article_content: At least 870 people have died and 2,530 have received treatment for injuries at the Indonesia Hospital in Beit Lahia, according to a volunteer. The hospital, funded by Indonesian donations, is struggling to care for an influx of wounded patients amid severe shortages of medical supplies and fuel that have led to power outages. These conditions have forced doctors to perform surgeries in darkness, a volunteer organization reports. Fikri Rofiul Haq from the Medical Emergency Rescue Committee (MER-C) told Al Jazeera that the hospital has faced a surge in patients following weeks of sustained Israeli airstrikes. Currently, 164 patients remain hospitalized. Due to ongoing conflict, around half of Gaza’s population has evacuated to what they hope are safer locations such as schools and medical facilities, including the Indonesia Hospital. Over 1,500 people are now taking shelter at the hospital. Last week, the hospital experienced a power outage lasting more than an hour due to fuel shortages caused by Israel’s blockade, which has prevented essential supplies from entering Gaza. Doctors were forced to continue treating patients without electric lighting until a limited supply of fuel was located. Medical staff have been stretched to their limits, working around the clock. Despite the challenges, MER-C has managed to coordinate some aid deliveries with the help of Indonesian citizens and other organizations in Gaza. Supplies, including some medicines and medical equipment, were delivered to the hospital on October 19 and 24, though many essentials remain out of stock. As per Indonesia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, there are currently 45 Indonesians living in Palestine—10 in Gaza and 35 in the West Bank—along with approximately 230 Indonesians in Israel, most of whom are there for religious tourism. Indonesia Hospital sits on land donated by the Gaza government in 2011 and serves the city of Beit Lahia in northern Gaza, which has a population of about 90,000. Construction of the hospital, funded primarily by Indonesian donors and organizations like the Indonesian Red Cross Society and Muhammadiyah Society, cost nearly $8 million. The facility includes about 100 beds, four operating theaters, and an intensive care unit, and was officially opened by then-Vice President Jusuf Kalla in 2016. MER-C was established by University of Indonesia students after their medical work during the sectarian conflict in Maluku in 1999. Since then, it has provided humanitarian medical aid in multiple conflict zones, including Afghanistan, Iraq, Iran, Palestine, Lebanon, Sudan, the Philippines, and Thailand. The hospital also received over $63,000 in donations from the Islamic Defenders Front, which was banned in Indonesia in 2020, to set up a blood bank. MER-C’s humanitarian assistance has occasionally extended to controversial individuals in line with their mission to help vulnerable people regardless of background or status. On Friday, communications were cut throughout Gaza, hindering aid organizations like MER-C from reaching their staff on the ground. Rima Manzanaris, MER-C’s operational manager in Indonesia, expressed grave concern over intensified military actions near the hospital and difficulties in maintaining reliable contact. MER-C is preparing to send a team to Egypt to collect and distribute further aid, including medicines, clothing, food, and fuel for generators. Communications in Gaza resumed after nearly 36 hours of blackouts. Haq described recent Israeli shelling that damaged parts of the hospital building and forced staff and patients to shelter in the basement. He added that aid trucks from Egypt had been delayed by congestion at the border, and he hoped a ceasefire would be declared soon. With winter approaching, Haq warned that conditions for Gaza’s displaced people would become even more dire due to shortages of basic necessities like bedding and warm clothing.
translated_content: Bir gönüllüye göre Beit Lahia'daki Endonezya Hastanesi'nde en az 870 kişi hayatını kaybetti ve 2.530 kişi yaralanarak tedavi edildi. Endonezya bağışlarıyla finanse edilen hastane, ciddi tıbbi malzeme ve yakıt sıkıntısıyla karşı karşıya ve artan yaralı sayısına yetişmekte zorlanıyor. Bu koşullar, doktorları ameliyatları karanlıkta yapmaya zorladı, gönüllü bir kuruluş rapor ediyor. MER-C (Medical Emergency Rescue Committee) üyesi Fikri Rofiul Haq, Al Jazeera'ye verdiği demeçte, hastanenin haftalar süren yoğun İsrail hava saldırıları sonrası büyük bir hasta akınıyla karşı karşıya olduğunu söyledi. Şu anda 164 hasta hastanede tedavi görüyor. Devam eden çatışmalar nedeniyle Gazze nüfusunun yaklaşık yarısı, okullar ve hastaneler gibi daha güvenli olduğuna inanılan yerlere, özellikle de Endonezya Hastanesi'ne tahliye edildi. Şu anda 1.500'den fazla kişi hastaneye sığınıyor. Geçen hafta, İsrail ablukası nedeniyle ihtiyaç duyulan yakıtın tükenmesi sonucu temel malzemelerin Gazze'ye girişi engellendiği için hastanede bir saatten uzun süren elektrik kesintisi yaşandı. Doktorlar, sınırlı yakıt bulunana kadar elektrik olmadan hastaları tedavi etmeye devam etmek zorunda kaldı. Sağlık çalışanları 24 saat aralıksız çalışarak sınırlarını zorluyor. Zorluklara rağmen, MER-C, Endonezyalı vatandaşlar ve Gazze'deki diğer kuruluşların yardımıyla hastaneye bazı yardımlar ulaştırmayı başardı. 19 ve 24 Ekim'de hastaneye ilaç ve tıbbi ekipman dahil çeşitli malzemeler teslim edildi, ancak birçok temel ihtiyaç halen eksik. Endonezya Dışişleri Bakanlığı'na göre, şu anda Filistin'de 45 Endonezyalı—10'u Gazze'de ve 35'i Batı Şeria'da— ve ayrıca çoğu dini turizm için orada bulunan yaklaşık 230 Endonezyalı İsrail'de bulunuyor. 2011 yılında Gazze hükümeti tarafından bağışlanan arazide kurulan Endonezya Hastanesi, yaklaşık 90.000 nüfuslu kuzey Gazze'nin Beit Lahia şehrine hizmet veriyor. Endonezyalı bağışçılar ve Endonezya Kızılayı ile Muhammadiye Topluluğu gibi kuruluşlar tarafından finanse edilen hastanenin inşaatı yaklaşık 8 milyon dolara mal oldu. Hastanede yaklaşık 100 yatak, dört ameliyathane ve bir yoğun bakım ünitesi bulunuyor ve 2016'da dönemin Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Jusuf Kalla tarafından resmen açıldı. MER-C, Maluku'daki mezhep çatışmasındaki tıbbi çalışmalarının ardından Endonezya Üniversitesi öğrencileri tarafından kuruldu. O zamandan bu yana Afganistan, Irak, İran, Filistin, Lübnan, Sudan, Filipinler ve Tayland da dahil olmak üzere birçok çatışma bölgesinde insani tıbbi yardım sağladı. Hastane, Endonezya'da 2020'de yasaklanan İslam Savunucuları Cephesi'nden gelen 63.000 doların üzerindeki bağışla bir kan bankası kurdu. MER-C'nin insani yardımı, zaman zaman arka planı veya statüsüne bakılmaksızın mağdur kişilere yardım etme misyonu doğrultusunda tartışmalı bireylere de uzandı. Cuma günü, Gazze genelinde iletişim kesintisi yaşandı ve bu durum, MER-C gibi yardım kuruluşlarının sahadaki personeline ulaşmasını engelledi. MER-C'nin Endonezya'daki operasyonlardan sorumlu yöneticisi Rima Manzanaris, hastane yakınlarındaki askeri saldırıların yoğunlaşmasından ve iletişimde yaşanan sıkıntılardan dolayı endişeli olduklarını dile getirdi. MER-C, ilaç, kıyafet, yiyecek ve hastane jeneratörleri için yakıt gibi daha fazla yardımı toplamak ve dağıtmak üzere Mısır'a bir ekip göndermeye hazırlanıyor. Gazze'deki iletişim, yaklaşık 36 saatlik bir kesintinin ardından tekrar sağlandı. Haq, yakın zamanlı İsrail bombardımanlarının hastanenin bazı bölümlerine zarar verdiğini ve personel ile hastaların bodruma sığınmak zorunda kaldığını anlattı. Ayrıca, Mısır'dan gelen yardım kamyonlarının sınırdaki yoğunluk nedeniyle geciktiğini ve en kısa sürede bir ateşkes ilan edilmesini umduklarını söyledi. Kış yaklaşırken Haq, battaniye ve sıcak giysi gibi temel ihtiyaçların eksikliği nedeniyle Gazze'deki yerinden edilmiş insanların çok daha zorlu şartlarla karşılaşacağını vurguladı.

article_content: SAN FRANCISCO, California (CNN) -- Oakland police officer John Hege has died following a gunfight over the weekend, the Alameda County Coroner's Office told CNN on Tuesday. Hege, 41, was declared brain dead on Sunday after being critically wounded. Although police initially listed Hege as the fourth officer killed, they later clarified he had been kept on life support pending an organ donation decision. The San Francisco Chronicle cited John S. Hege, the officer’s father, saying his son’s organs would be donated. Oakland police did not immediately reply to CNN’s inquiry about the decision. The incident began around 1 p.m. Saturday in east Oakland during what police described as a routine traffic stop. Motorcycle officers John Hege and 18-year veteran Sgt. Mark Dunakin, 40, attempted to pull over a car. Soon after, dispatchers received reports of both officers being shot. Dunakin was killed at the scene. Following the initial shootings, police launched a manhunt for the suspect, identified as Lovelle Mixon, 26, of Oakland. Authorities were tipped off by an anonymous caller about Mixon's location in a nearby apartment complex. When SWAT officers entered, Mixon opened fire, injuring two additional officers. Police returned fire, killing Mixon. The two officers who died during the SWAT operation were Sgt. Ervin Romans, 43, who joined the department in 1996, and Sgt. Daniel Sakai, 35, an officer since 2000. A fifth officer was treated and released after being grazed by a bullet, according to police spokesman Jeff Thomason. Officials noted this was the deadliest assault on California law enforcement since 1970, when four highway patrol officers were killed in the Santa Clarita Valley. Authorities also revealed that Mixon, who had an extensive criminal record and was on parole for assault with a deadly weapon, was a ‘tentative match’ from evidence in a February sexual assault case. The Oakland Police Department indicated that further DNA testing would be conducted. Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger ordered flags at the state capitol flown at half-staff in honor of the fallen officers.

Polis ilk başta Hege’yi dördüncü ölen memur olarak duyurdu, fakat daha sonra organ bağışı kararı beklenirken yaşam desteğinde tutulduğunu açıkladı. San Francisco Chronicle'a konuşan memurun babası John S. Hege, oğlunun organlarının bağışlanacağını söyledi. Oakland polisi, konuyla ilgili CNN’in sorusuna hemen yanıt vermedi. Olay, polislerin rutin bir trafik kontrolü olarak tanımladıkları şekilde Cumartesi günü saat 13.00 civarında doğu Oakland'da başladı. Motorize polisler John Hege ve 18 yıllık tecrübesiyle Çavuş Mark Dunakin (40), bir aracı durdurmaya çalıştı. Kısa süre sonra, her iki polisin de vurulduğu ve yardım gerektiği bildirildi. Dunakin olay yerinde hayatını kaybetti. İlk ateş açılmasının ardından, polis saldırganın peşine düştü. Şüpheli, Oakland'dan 26 yaşındaki Lovelle Mixon olarak tanımlandı. Kimliği bilinmeyen bir kişi, Mixon'ın yakındaki bir apartmanda olduğu bilgisini paylaştı. SWAT polisleri içeri girdiğinde Mixon ateş açtı, iki memuru daha yaraladı. Polis karşılık vererek Mixon'ı öldürdü. SWAT operasyonunda hayatını kaybeden iki polis, 1996’dan beri bölgede görev yapan Çavuş Ervin Romans (43) ve 2000 yılından beri görev yapan Çavuş Daniel Sakai (35) olarak açıklandı. Beşinci bir polis memuru ise bir kurşunla hafif yaralandıktan sonra hastanede tedavi edilip taburcu edildi; bu bilgiyi polis sözcüsü Jeff Thomason verdi. Yetkililer, bunun 1970’ten bu yana Kaliforniya kolluk kuvvetlerine yönelik en ölümcül saldırı olduğunu belirtti. O yılda Santa Clarita Vadisi’nde dört otoyol polisi öldürülmüştü. Yetkililer ayrıca, daha önce saldırı suçundan şartlı tahliyede olduğu bilinen Mixon’ın şubat ayında gerçekleşen bir cinsel saldırı davasında kanıtlardan elde edilen 'ön bulgu' ile şüpheli olarak tespit edildiğini açıkladı. Oakland Polis Departmanı, DNA üzerinde daha fazla test yapılacağını belirtti. Vali Arnold Schwarzenegger, yaşamını yitiren polislerin anısına Eyalet Meclisi’nde bayrakların yarıya indirilmesi talimatını verdi.

Prince William emphasized that the pressing issue of Scotland’s potential independence takes precedence over his family’s personal matters, as his wife Catherine—the Duchess of Cambridge—continues to recover from severe morning sickness. At a University of Oxford event, he noted Catherine was feeling better but stressed that more significant, ongoing national and international events deserved attention. His comments follow reports that Queen Elizabeth is increasingly concerned about the growing support for Scottish independence ahead of the forthcoming referendum.

The approaching vote has sparked intense debate over whether Queen Elizabeth would remain Scotland’s head of state if it becomes independent. Recent YouGov polling shows a split: 46% of independence supporters want to cut royal ties, 40% prefer to keep the Queen, while 14% remain undecided. On the other hand, 69% of those favoring the Union believe the Queen should stay as head of state.

As political leaders—including Prime Minister David Cameron and former Prime Minister Gordon Brown—campaign energetically for Scotland to remain in the UK, emotions and tensions are rising. Some observers note that news like the announcement of a royal baby could sway undecided voters due to public warmth toward the younger royals.

Within the Scottish National Party (SNP), leader Alex Salmond has backed keeping the monarchy, but other figures have floated the idea of a future referendum on the issue. Pro-union politicians, meanwhile, warn about possible republican trends after independence. The Palace maintains that the Queen is politically neutral regarding the referendum, although sources indicate her strong preference for the Union.

With the race tightening, as shown by polls giving independence a narrow lead, the UK government is offering further devolved powers to Scotland if it chooses to stay in the Union. The campaign has become a contest of both emotional appeals and reasoned arguments, with both sides shaping Scotland’s historic decision.

Oxford Üniversitesi’ndeki bir etkinlikte Catherine’in kendini daha iyi hissettiğini ama asıl dikkat edilmesi gerekenin ulusal ve uluslararası gelişmeler olduğunu belirtti. Bu açıklamalar, Kraliçe Elizabeth’in yaklaşan referandum öncesinde İskoç bağımsızlığına artan desteğe dair endişeli olduğuna dair haberlerin ardından geldi.

Başbakan David Cameron ve eski Başbakan Gordon Brown gibi siyasi isimler, İskoçya’nın Birleşik Krallık’ta kalması için aktif şekilde kampanya yürütüyor ve ortamda artan bir duygusal gerilim var. Bazı yorumcular, yeni bir kraliyet bebeği haberinin, halka duyulan sempati sebebiyle kararsız seçmenleri Birliğe çekebileceğini belirtiyor.

İskoç Ulusal Partisi’nde (SNP) lider Alex Salmond monarşiyi sürdürmeyi savunurken, bazı üyeler Kraliçe sonrası için gelecekte referandum yapılmasını öneriyor. Birlik yanlıları ise bağımsızlık sonrası cumhuriyetçi eğilimlerin güçlenmesinden endişe duyuyor. Saray, Kraliçe’nin referandumda siyasi tarafsızlığını koruduğunu vurgulasa da, bazı kaynaklar Kraliçe’nin Birlikten yana açık bir eğilimi olduğunu aktarıyor.

article_content: India will face Australia for the second time in the ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup final on Sunday at the Narendra Modi Stadium. Indian captain Rohit Sharma aims to create his own legacy, supported by ten skilled teammates and over a billion passionate fans, as they take on the five-time champions in this winner-takes-all clash. Virat Kohli and Ravichandran Ashwin have experienced ODI World Cup triumph before, while Rohit Sharma contributed to India’s 2007 T20 World Cup victory. This final is different—it’s about more than winning; it’s about the hopes and emotions of all who love the game. Rohit and his squad often claim indifference to outside noise, but such fervor helps keep the game and the team relevant. Stakeholders—including fans, broadcasters investing heavily, and sponsors—are all dedicated to Indian cricket’s success. Kapil Dev’s iconic smile at Lord’s in 1983 began a new era, while Dhoni’s winning shot in the 2011 final cemented India’s place at the top of world cricket. In 2023, India not only aims for a third ODI World Cup title but also seeks to reinvigorate the 50-over format, which has faced challenges in recent years. An Indian triumph could provide much-needed impetus for the one-day format. No team has ever won the World Cup with 11 consecutive victories; Rohit and his team are close to breaking new ground. Rohit Sharma (550 runs at a 124 strike rate) has led with aggressive intent, allowing Virat Kohli (711 runs, over 90 strike rate) to display his trademark consistency. Shubman Gill has performed well despite illness, and Shreyas Iyer overcame past struggles to score a century in the semifinal. Mohammed Shami, with 23 wickets after initially being left out, has proved instrumental. As often said, batters win matches but bowlers win tournaments—Shami exemplifies this point. KL Rahul’s calmness, Ravindra Jadeja’s all-round abilities, Suryakumar Yadav’s unpredictability, and the bowling threats of Kuldeep Yadav and Jasprit Bumrah complete the lineup. The pitch, made of black soil, is expected to be slow, making the inclusion of a third spinner (such as Ashwin) unlikely. Post-'Sandpaper' scandal, the Australian team has changed, but remains formidable. Pat Cummins’ side knows how to win under pressure, and they won an ODI series in India earlier this year. Cummins pointed to a dropped catch of Kohli in their opening match as a turning point, highlighting how close previous encounters have been. Despite a large, supportive home crowd, Cummins is optimistic due to Australia’s prior successes in India. Full squads for both India and Australia are listed for the final encounter. In other news: The Indian government is reviewing the transfer of unclaimed Sahara-Sebi Refund Account funds. Apple aims to manufacture close to ₹1 lakh crore worth of iPhones in India by March 2024. Nawaz Modi seeks a family settlement following her separation from Gautam Singhania. The match begins at 2 pm.

Former England all-rounder Andrew Flintoff will be available to play for the Brisbane Heat throughout the upcoming KFC T20 Big Bash League season. The 37-year-old was initially scheduled to join for the latter part of the competition, serving as a replacement for fellow overseas player Daniel Vettori, who will be departing to join New Zealand's World Cup preparations. However, an injury to West Indian spinner Samuel Badree means Flintoff will now take Badree's place in the squad for the full tournament.

Cricket Australia has approved this roster change, and Brisbane Heat general manager Andrew Blucher expressed his disappointment for Badree but noted his excitement about Flintoff's full-season participation. Blucher commented on the club's website: "It is very unfortunate for Samuel, who was looking forward to playing in the BBL with us and would have been an exciting player to watch for our fans. But the upside for the Heat is that we have come to terms with Andrew to play the full season for us, which is a wonderful result."

Flintoff recently came out of retirement and returned to action this summer, making several T20 appearances for Lancashire. He nearly helped Lancashire secure a win over Birmingham Bears in the T20 finals. Photos show Flintoff posing with his wife Rachael and their three children at the Brisbane Heat Big Bash League season launch in Southbank, Brisbane, as well as alongside team-mates Shane Watson and James Hopes.

article_content: Insulin, essential for diabetics to manage their blood sugar, is much more expensive in the U.S. than in other countries. Recently, California Governor Gavin Newsom announced a state-supported nonprofit supplier of insulin but vetoed a law that would have capped the price at $35 a month. The bill, authored by State Senator Scott Wiener, would have prevented health plans and disability insurance policies from charging more than $35 a month out-of-pocket — including deductibles and co-pays — for a 30-day supply of insulin. Senator Wiener, a Democrat from San Francisco, called Newsom's veto 'a major setback that will keep tens of thousands of diabetic Californians trapped in the terrible choice between buying insulin and buying food.' Newsom explained his veto by stating that the law was unnecessary because the state’s insulin (through CalRx) would be low-cost, and a price cap could encourage insurers to shift costs to consumers via higher premiums. 'With CalRx, we are addressing the underlying cost, which is the real sustainable solution to expensive pharmaceuticals,' Newsom wrote in his message explaining the veto. 'However, co-pay caps can still result in higher premiums for consumers.'

article_content: France will begin withdrawing its troops from Afghanistan, following a timeline similar to the one announced by U.S. President Barack Obama, the office of French President Nicolas Sarkozy said Thursday. "This withdrawal will take place in consultation with our allies and Afghan authorities," the statement added. According to French Defense Minister Gerard Longuet, all French troops could leave Afghanistan by 2013. Speaking to France Info radio, Longuet declined to provide specific details due to the safety of French soldiers and those they protect. "We cannot specify locations or types of troops, as we do not want to give any information to our adversaries, the Taliban," he said. Longuet also noted that while NATO had initially planned a complete transition in Afghanistan by 2014, "it now appears that we will likely achieve our objectives a year earlier." France currently has 3,935 troops stationed in Afghanistan, according to NATO. On Wednesday, President Obama announced that the U.S. will withdraw 33,000 troops by September 2012, leaving just under 70,000 American forces on the ground. British Prime Minister David Cameron, whose country maintains the second largest foreign military presence in Afghanistan, welcomed Obama's announcement. Cameron stated that British troop levels will remain under constant review and reiterated that there will be no UK troops in combat roles in Afghanistan by 2015. He added that, conditions permitting, the withdrawal could occur sooner. CNN's Saskya Vandoorne contributed to this report.

article_content: As Founder and Financial Advisor of DBHW Wealth Partners, an independent wealth management and tax/accounting firm in Texas, I understand that financial planning is essential when starting a business. Reflecting on my own journey, I recall launching my first venture—a Venus de Milo exercise salon for women—where I often relied on advice from others, not all of whom were qualified to provide valuable guidance. One of my biggest regrets was not consulting a financial advisor to help inform crucial decisions that impacted my business's success. Based on my experiences, here are key tips to help entrepreneurs succeed: 1. Find a Mentor: Early in your business journey, seek a mentor with relevant experience in a similar industry. A mentor offers insights, guidance, and support to avoid common pitfalls and make sound decisions. If a mentor is hard to find, participate in local networking groups or your Chamber of Commerce. 2. Create a Business Plan: While many projects can be tackled independently, handling your business finances requires clear goal setting and documented steps. Start by registering your business name, obtaining a tax ID, choosing a structure, and securing permits. Most importantly, develop a comprehensive business plan. Share it with trusted leaders or a financial advisor, who can assist with budgeting, payroll, retirement plans, debt strategies, and introduce you to valuable local contacts. 3. Plan for Taxes: Many business owners consider tax deductions only after receiving a tax bill, which is often too late for meaningful changes. Proactive tax planning is essential. The SECURE Act 2.0, passed in late 2022, makes it easier for small businesses to offer retirement plans to employees and increases credits for new plans’ startup costs, benefiting small businesses. 4. Invest in Marketing: Marketing is an investment, not just a cost. Strong marketing strategies are vital for reaching your audience and fostering growth. My firm has benefited from working with agencies to produce tailored content, keeping clients informed. Study competitors and choose marketing approaches that fit your business and community. 5. Focus on Culture: Building a strong culture attracts and retains talented employees. Investing in staff development, recognizing hard work, and promoting open communication contribute to a successful team. Initiatives like annual retreats focused on education and engagement can enhance employee satisfaction and business outcomes. 6. Think Long Term: Beyond daily operations, plan for your future with retirement, succession, and exit strategies. Consider working with an attorney to identify successors and establish buy-sell agreements, which determine your business’s value at various stages and ensure a smooth transition. Remember: With the right financial guidance, you’re not alone in building your business. Securities offered through Avantax Investment Services℠, Member FINRA, SIPC. Investment advisory services through Avantax Advisory Services℠. Insurance available through an Avantax-affiliated insurance agency. Deneyimlerime dayanarak girişimcilere yardımcı olacak temel önerilerim şunlar: 1. Mentor Bulun: İş yolculuğunuzun başlarında, benzer sektörde deneyimi olan bir mentordan destek alın. Mentorlar, sık yapılan hatalardan kaçınmanızı sağlarken, size değerli içgörüler ve rehberlik sunar. Mentor bulmakta zorlanırsanız yerel ağ gruplarına veya Ticaret Odası’na katılabilirsiniz. 2. Bunu güvenilir liderlerle veya bir finansal danışmanla paylaşın; nakit akışı, bordro, emeklilik planları ve borç stratejileri gibi konularda destek alabilir, yerel bağlantılar edinebilirsiniz. 3. article_content: Bewick's swans are flying shorter distances during their autumn migration when weather is warmer, a change attributed to climate change which has shifted their wintering locations. For the first time, researchers from the University of Amsterdam (UvA) and the Netherlands Institute of Ecology (NIOO-KNAW) have used long-term GPS data to identify how individual swans make migration decisions. Their findings were published on October 5 in the journal Global Change Biology. Bewick's swans, migratory water birds breeding south of the Barents Sea in European Russia, are now far less common in the Netherlands than before. Hans Linssen, a Ph.D. candidate at the UvA, explains: 'Over several decades, the swans’ wintering grounds have shifted hundreds of kilometers northeast. While the core area used to be in southern England, it is now northern Germany. The birds simply end their migration earlier in the autumn.' Until now, the mechanisms driving this shift were unclear. Linssen asks whether younger generations are choosing new locations or whether individuals adjust bit by bit each year. Bart Nolet, senior researcher at NIOO-KNAW and professor at UvA, began tracking Bewick's swans with GPS 25 years ago. 'Initially, we aimed just to map autumn migration, but for this research, it was necessary to follow individual swans for at least two consecutive years.' Analysis shows that cygnets (young swans) fly farther southwest during cold autumn days, but their sensitivity to temperature decreases as autumn progresses. Later in the season, swans only travel deeper into wintering areas when temperatures drop below freezing. Linssen summarizes: 'When it’s warm, they remain in place.' The study finds that, on average, Bewick’s swans now hibernate 120 km closer to their breeding grounds for each 1°C increase in winter temperature – 240 km closer for a 2°C rise, and so on. This demonstrates significant individual flexibility among the swans. Combined with milder winters due to climate change, this flexibility explains much of the northeast shift in the species’ winter range and their decline in the Netherlands. The GPS data also revealed that swans flew longer distances when aided by tailwinds, but this effect diminished later in autumn. Therefore, wind serves to assist migration, but temperature largely determines where swans stop. Food availability is another factor: Linssen notes that Bewick's swans in eastern Netherlands and northern Germany increasingly feed on corn residues. This change in diet, along with warmer winters, may also contribute to the shift. The published study focuses on wintering grounds, but the swans’ breeding area is also gradually shifting northeast. However, breeding site fidelity remains high, with individuals returning to established sites each year. Changes in breeding area appear only between generations. Traditionally, migratory birds have been monitored via leg rings, a method providing limited data. With modern GPS tracking, researchers now have much more detailed insight into birds’ year-round movements.
translated_content: Bewick kuğuları, sonbahar göçleri sırasında hava daha sıcak olduğunda daha kısa mesafeler kat ediyor; bu değişim, kışlama bölgelerinin kaymasına neden olan iklim değişikliğine bağlanıyor. Amsterdam Üniversitesi (UvA) ve Hollanda Ekoloji Enstitüsü’nden (NIOO-KNAW) araştırmacılar, ilk kez uzun vadeli GPS verileriyle bireysel kuğuların göç kararlarını nasıl aldıklarını belirledi. Araştırmanın sonuçları 5 Ekim’de Global Change Biology dergisinde yayımlandı. Barents Denizi'nin güneyinde, Avrupa Rusyası’nda üreyen göçmen bir su kuşu olan Bewick kuğuları, artık Hollanda’da eskisine göre çok daha az görülüyor. UvA’dan doktora öğrencisi Hans Linssen şöyle diyor: 'Onlarca yıl boyunca kuğuların kışlama alanları yüzlerce kilometre kuzeye kaydı. Ana bölge eskiden güney İngiltere’ydi, şimdi ise kuzey Almanya. Kuğular artık sonbaharda göçlerini daha erken bitiriyor.' Bu değişimi neyin tetiklediği şimdiye kadar tam olarak bilinmiyordu. Linssen, yeni yerleri hep genç kuğuların mı seçtiğini, yoksa bireysel kuğuların her yıl adım adım konumunu ayarlayıp ayarlamadığını sorguluyor. NIOO-KNAW’da kıdemli araştırmacı ve UvA’da profesör olan Bart Nolet, 25 yıl önce Bewick kuğularını GPS ile takip etmeye başladı. 'Başlarda, kuğuların sonbahar göçünü tamamen haritalayabilsek memnun oluyorduk; fakat bu araştırmada her bir kuğuyu en az iki yıl üst üste takip etmek gerekti.' Analizler, yavru kuğuların (cygnet) soğuk sonbahar günlerinde daha batıya uçtuğunu, ancak bu sıcaklık hassasiyetinin sonbaharın ilerleyen zamanlarında azaldığını gösteriyor. Mevsim ilerleyince kuğular sadece sıcaklık sıfırın altına düştüğünde kışlama alanlarına doğru daha ileri gidiyor. Linssen şöyle özetliyor: 'Hava sıcaksa yerlerinde kalıyorlar.' Araştırmaya göre, Bewick kuğuları artık kış sıcaklığı her 1°C arttığında ortalama 120 km, 2°C arttığında ise 240 km daha yakın mesafede kışlıyor. Bu da, kuğular arasında yıllar içinde önemli bir bireysel esneklik olduğunu gösteriyor. İklim değişikliğiyle gelen daha ılıman kışlarla birlikte, bu esneklik türün kışlama aralığının kuzeydoğuya kaymasının ve Hollanda’da azalmasının ana nedenlerinden biri. GPS verileri, kuğuların arkadan rüzgar estiğinde daha uzun mesafeler uçtuğunu fakat bu etkinin sonbaharda azaldığını gösterdi. Yani rüzgar, göçü kolaylaştırırken, sıcaklık kuğuların nerede duracağını belirliyor. Gıda kaynakları da etkili: Linssen, Doğu Hollanda ve Kuzey Almanya’daki Bewick kuğularının mısır artıklarını daha fazla tükettiğine dikkat çekiyor. Bu beslenme değişimi de, artan sıcaklıklarla birlikte, kaymanın bir başka nedeni olabilir. Yayımlanan çalışma kışlama alanlarına odaklanıyor; fakat kuğuların üreme alanları da kademeli olarak kuzeydoğuya kayıyor. Buna rağmen, bireysel kuğuların çoğu her yıl aynı üreme alanına geri dönüyor. Üreme bölgesindeki değişiklikler sadece nesiller arasında görülüyor. Göçmen kuşlar geleneksel olarak bacak halkalarıyla izleniyordu, ki bu yöntem sınırlı bilgi sunuyordu. Günümüzde GPS takibi ise kuşların yıl boyunca hareketlerini çok daha ayrıntılı inceleme imkanı sağlıyor.

article_content: West Ham loanee Carl Jenkinson is set to miss the start of the season after suffering a hamstring injury during his debut match in Germany. The Arsenal defender joined the Hammers on a season-long loan on Thursday but was forced off after 60 minutes in a 2-0 defeat to Malaga in Gelsenkirchen. Jenkinson's setback is the latest problem for manager Sam Allardyce, who is already without striker Andy Carroll until at least December due to ankle surgery and right-back Guy Demel because of a hamstring injury. Enner Valencia was signed for £12 million to help replace Carroll, but the Ecuadorian striker is not yet fully fit and will also miss the opening game against Tottenham Hotspur. Midfielder Mark Noble admitted that the team is looking to Valencia for solutions in attack. ‘We need him at the moment,’ Noble said after the squad returned to London, having failed to score at the Schalke 04 Cup. West Ham's squad is short-handed, and Allardyce may look to bring in new signings. Peter Crouch and Sunderland’s Connor Wickham are being considered as potential options if available.

article_content: Bill Bryson’s book, 'One Summer: America, 1927,' explores the remarkable and tumultuous events of the summer of 1927 in the United States. In an interview, Bryson calls it an extraordinarily eventful period in modern history. Notable events from that summer include Charles Lindbergh’s historic solo transatlantic flight, Babe Ruth’s record-setting 60 home runs, and the debut of the first sound film, 'The Jazz Singer.' The book also brings attention to lesser-known tragedies, such as Ruth Brown Snyder’s murder trial and Andrew Kehoe’s bombing of the Bath, Michigan school—the deadliest school massacre in U.S. history. Bryson discusses the rise and fall of the Van Sweringen brothers, whose creation of Cleveland’s Terminal Tower was the peak of a vast, leveraged business empire that collapsed during the Great Depression. A central theme of the book is the daring aviators of the era—not only Lindbergh but also pioneers like Clarence Chamberlin—who undertook risky and often fatal flights at a time when aviation was still perilous. Many aviators did not survive their attempts. Bryson reflects on Lindbergh’s unprecedented global fame after his flight, as well as his later notoriety due to controversial political views prior to World War II. Initially, Bryson considered writing a dual biography of Lindbergh and Ruth but discovered through research that the summer of 1927 held many significant stories and personalities. He examines the financial climate of the era, comparing the Van Sweringens’ risky business tactics to those of Charles Ponzi and describing the era’s speculative atmosphere. Bryson also considers the era’s spirit of fearlessness, particularly among aviators, and shares a story about the surprisingly fragile construction of Lindbergh’s Spirit of St. Louis.

Bryson, bir röportajında bu dönemi modern tarihin en olağanüstü yazı olarak tanımlıyor. O yazın öne çıkan olayları arasında Charles Lindbergh’in tarihi solo Atlantik uçuşu, Babe Ruth’un rekor kıran 60 home run’ı ve ilk sesli film ‘The Jazz Singer’ın galası bulunuyor. Kitap ayrıca daha az hatırlanan trajedilere de ışık tutuyor; bunlar arasında Ruth Brown Snyder’ın cinayet davası ve Andrew Kehoe’nun Bath, Michigan’daki okula gerçekleştirdiği, ABD tarihinin en ölümcül okul saldırısı da var. Bryson, Cleveland’daki Terminal Tower’ı inşa eden Van Sweringen kardeşlerin yükselişine ve Büyük Buhran’da çöken, borçla kurulmuş iş imparatorluklarına değiniyor. Yazar, dönemin mali ortamını inceliyor; Van Sweringen’lerin riskli iş yöntemlerini Charles Ponzi’ninkilerle kıyaslayıp o zamanki spekülatif atmosferi betimliyor. article_content: Sunday night’s Academy Awards show attracted massive attention on Twitter, bringing added excitement to the long and at times awkward broadcast. Twitter reported that 6.8 million tweets were posted during the ceremony, with 2.1 million more during the red carpet events. The biggest spike came when 'Argo' took home Best Picture, reaching 85,300 tweets per minute—almost as fast as Ben Affleck’s acceptance speech. Music was more prominent at this year’s Oscars, with memorable performances from Shirley Bassey, Jennifer Hudson, and Adele. Adele’s 'Skyfall' performance was the second most-discussed moment on Twitter, and her win for Best Original Song was the fourth most popular. Other major moments that sparked conversation included Jennifer Lawrence’s win for Best Actress (and her likable stumble up the stage) and Anne Hathaway’s win for Best Supporting Actress. Meanwhile, Google reported spikes in searches at key moments. When William Shatner popped up as Captain Kirk, searches for 'kirk' shot up to 1,500 per minute. The tie for Best Sound Editing drove people to look up 'tie,' and Michelle Obama’s White House appearance to help present Best Picture sent searches for her name soaring. These were just some of the big highlights of the night, according to Twitter’s vibrant community.

article_content: Michele Leonhart, head of the Drug Enforcement Administration, has voiced her disagreement with President Barack Obama’s position on marijuana, particularly following his remarks downplaying the drug’s dangers. At a closed meeting with sheriffs, Leonhart expressed concerns over the federal government’s growing acceptance of state-level marijuana legalization and noted her dissatisfaction with shifting national attitudes toward the substance. Leonhart is reported to have criticized the administration’s understanding of marijuana science, highlighting that her lowest moment in 33 years with the DEA was witnessing a hemp flag being flown over the Capitol on July 4th at the request of Colorado Rep. Jared Polis, albeit the flag was legally made from industrial hemp. She also objected to actions like the White House participating in a softball game with pro-legalization advocates. President Obama’s recent comments equating marijuana’s risk to that of alcohol raised alarm among Leonhart and other law enforcement leaders, who believe such comparisons could mislead the public, especially youth. Sheriffs like Thomas Hodgson and Donny Youngblood echoed Leonhart’s concerns, contending that marijuana is a gateway drug and criticizing the president’s stance as undermining anti-drug efforts. Leonhart’s forthright address was met with a standing ovation from her audience. Despite these concerns, public attitudes appear to be shifting; Gallup reports nearly 60 percent of Americans now support legalizing marijuana. After news of Leonhart’s remarks surfaced, a DEA spokesperson clarified that her statements were not intended as personal criticism of President Obama but reaffirmed the agency’s ongoing opposition to legalization.

Leonhart, şeriflerle kapalı kapılar ardında yaptığı toplantıda, federal hükümetin eyalet düzeyinde marihuana yasallaştırılmasını kabul etmesinden ve ülke çapında değişen tutumlardan duyduğu memnuniyetsizliği dile getirdi.
