article_content: In Bilwi, Nicaragua, a boy stands where his home once was before it was destroyed by Hurricane Iota’s fierce winds and torrential rains. A new report highlights the massive, ongoing impact of extreme weather linked to climate change: 43 million children globally have been displaced between 2016 and 2022 – roughly 20,000 children every day. Most of these displacements were caused by floods and storms, with droughts and wildfires also contributing. The report, titled 'Children Displaced in a Changing Climate,' is the result of a partnership between UNICEF, the Internal Displacement Monitoring Center, and the Patrick J. McGovern Foundation. It provides the first detailed data set to specifically track child displacement — filling a previous gap where children’s experience often went uncounted. In places like Legazpi City in the Philippines, hundreds of families sought refuge in schools as Typhoon Vamco hit, following devastation from Typhoon Goni just a week prior. The Philippines, India, and China account for over half of all climate-related child displacements during the study period. The risks are compounded in countries facing poverty, conflict, or rapid urbanization, where children are even more vulnerable. In regions like Mozambique and Haiti, recurring storms and limited resources intensify these dangers. For example, in Mozambique, Francelina Antonio and her young children sheltered at a school after Cyclone Freddy destroyed their home. Pakistan’s catastrophic flooding in 2022 continues to affect families, with many schools still closed and families living in temporary shelters. Temporary learning centers supported by UNICEF have been set up to ensure children continue receiving an education. Displacement exposes children to significant risks: family separation, higher vulnerability to exploitation and abuse, disrupted schooling, and lack of access to clean water, healthcare, and nutrition. Locations where displaced families settle may be equally, or more, vulnerable to future climate-related disasters. Certain regions are disproportionately affected. Small Island Developing States like Dominica, Saint Maarten, and Vanuatu face high storm-driven displacement. South Sudan and Somalia report the largest child displacements due to flooding — often without advance evacuations. Drought has triggered more than 1.3 million child displacements across 15 countries since 2016, with Somalia, Ethiopia, and Afghanistan especially impacted. Yet, researchers say the total is likely underreported because of slow-onset disaster characteristics and inadequate monitoring. Over the next 30 years, the report projects that tens of millions more children may be displaced by river flooding, with regions at highest risk including South Asia, East Asia and the Pacific, and Latin America and the Caribbean. UNICEF emphasizes the urgent need to protect, prepare, and prioritize children amid worsening climate impacts. This includes ensuring essential child-focused services such as health, education, and protection are adaptable, inclusive, and accessible. Policies must anticipate children’s unique vulnerabilities, and children must have opportunities to be part of climate action. UNICEF continues to work with at-risk governments and communities around the world to design resilient emergency responses and long-term support for the most vulnerable children affected by climate change. Children, particularly those in the poorest areas, bear the greatest burden in climate-related crises. UNICEF urges support for its ongoing mission to keep children’s needs at the forefront of climate adaptation and disaster relief.
translated_content: Nikaragua'nın Bilwi kentinde bir çocuk, evinin önceden bulunduğu yerde duruyor; evi, Kasırga Iota'nın şiddetli rüzgarları ve yoğun yağmurlarıyla yıkılmıştı. Yeni bir rapor, iklim değişikliğiyle bağlantılı aşırı hava olaylarının devam eden devasa etkisini vurguluyor: 2016-2022 yılları arasında dünya genelinde 43 milyon çocuk yerinden oldu – bu, günde yaklaşık 20.000 çocuk anlamına geliyor. Bu yerinden edilmelerin çoğu sel ve fırtınalardan kaynaklanırken kuraklık ve orman yangınları da etkili oldu. 'Değişen Bir İklimde Yerinden Edilen Çocuklar' başlıklı rapor, UNICEF, İç Yerinden Edilmeyi İzleme Merkezi ve Patrick J. McGovern Vakfı ortaklığıyla hazırlandı. Rapor, özellikle çocukların yerinden edilmesini izleyen ilk ayrıntılı veri setini sunuyor ve daha önce göz ardı edilen çocukların deneyimlerine ışık tutuyor. Filipinler'deki Legazpi şehrinde, Typhoon Vamco vurduğunda yüzlerce aile okullarda sığınak buldu; bir hafta önce de Typhoon Goni bölgede yıkıma neden olmuştu.  Çalışma döneminde, Filipinler, Hindistan ve Çin iklimle ilgili çocuk yerinden edilmelerinin yarısından fazlasından sorumlu. Yoksulluk, çatışma veya hızlı kentleşme yaşayan ülkelerde riskler büyüyor ve çocuklar daha da savunmasız hale geliyor. Mozambik ve Haiti gibi bölgelerde tekrar eden fırtınalar ve sınırlı kaynaklar bu tehlikeleri artırıyor. Örneğin Mozambik’te, Francelina Antonio ve küçük çocukları, Cyclone Freddy evlerini yok ettikten sonra bir okulda sığınak buldu. 2022'de Pakistan'da yaşanan yıkıcı sel felaketi aileleri etkilemeye devam ediyor, okulların birçoğu hâlâ kapalı ve aileler geçici barınaklarda yaşıyor. UNICEF destekli geçici öğrenme merkezleri, çocukların eğitimlerine devam etmelerini sağlamak için kuruldu. Yerinden edilme, çocukları önemli risklerle karşı karşıya bırakıyor: ailelerinden ayrılma, istismar ve suistimal riskinin artması, eğitimde aksamalar ve temiz su, sağlık hizmetleri ile beslenmeye erişimde zorluklar. Yer değiştiren ailelerin gittiği yerler, iklim felaketlerine karşı en az eskisi kadar savunmasız olabiliyor. Bazı bölgeler ise orantısız şekilde etkileniyor. Dominika, Saint Maarten ve Vanuatu gibi Küçük Ada Devletleri, fırtına kaynaklı yerinden edilmelerden büyük zarar görüyor. Güney Sudan ve Somali, genellikle önceden tahliye yapılmadan, sel nedeniyle en fazla yerinden edilen çocuğa sahip. Kuraklık, 2016’dan bu yana 15 ülkede 1,3 milyondan fazla çocuğun yerinden edilmesine neden oldu; en çok etkilenenler Somali, Etiyopya ve Afganistan. Ancak araştırmacılar, durumun yavaş ilerlemesi ve yetersiz izleme nedeniyle gerçek sayının çok daha fazla olabileceğini belirtiyor. Raporda, önümüzdeki 30 yılda nehir taşkınları nedeniyle on milyonlarca çocuğun daha yerinden edilebileceği, en riskli bölgelerin ise Güney Asya, Doğu Asya ve Pasifik ile Latin Amerika ve Karayipler olduğu tahmin ediliyor. UNICEF, kötüleşen iklim etkileri karşısında çocukların korunması, hazırlanması ve önceliklendirilmesi için acil eylem çağrısı yapıyor. Buna, sağlık, eğitim ve koruma gibi temel, çocuk odaklı hizmetlerin uyarlanabilir, kapsayıcı ve erişilebilir olması da dahil. article_content: Breathe ESG, a startup providing sustainability management SaaS (software as a service) solutions for enterprises, has raised USD 315,000 (about Rs 2.61 crore) in a pre-seed funding round led by 100X.VC. The capital will be used to enhance Breathe ESG’s product capabilities, expand its suite of services, and facilitate global expansion, according to a company release. 100X.VC was the first institutional investor in Breathe ESG. Following 100X.VC’s pitch day, KANJ Realty Ventures, Hyderabad Angels, and notable angel investors Vipul Jain (Chairman, Kale Logistics and Partner, Hearth Ventures), Pradeep Lala (Managing Director and CEO at Embassy Services), and Prashant Naik (Managing Partner, GRICAA) also invested in the company. Founded in July 2022 by Karantaj Singh and Shaayak Chatterjee, Breathe ESG aims to help companies streamline their sustainability initiatives, making the shift to sustainable practices easier, more efficient, and affordable. Integrating sustainability management into business strategy is increasingly essential for companies, as it helps strengthen reputation and attract both consumers and investors.

article_content: Wayne Kinvig, 18, from Burnley, was sentenced to eight months in jail after posing as a door-to-door charity collector. Kinvig admitted to eight counts of fraud by false representation, deceiving residents into donating money by claiming it was for his sick brother or charitable events, while actually spending the money on cannabis and items for his unborn child. The court heard that Kinvig targeted vulnerable people, including pensioners—some as old as 77—by fabricating stories about needing funds for causes like cerebral palsy treatments and the Duke of Edinburgh Award scheme. He carried a clipboard, sponsor sheet, and information about charitable tax claims to appear legitimate. Kinvig was caught after knocking on the door of off-duty Police Community Support Officer Tracy Parkes, who recognized him from a police mugshot. Further investigations revealed that Kinvig had a history of 39 offenses, mostly related to theft. On several occasions, victims gave him money from their pensions, moved by his appeals. One woman donated £4, believing it was for a friend's brother needing stem cell treatment. Another victim, Mark Lumsden, who has a disabled son, almost donated £5 for alleged stem cell therapy but became suspicious and did not hand over the money. Prosecutor Julian Goode described how Kinvig gained a sense of excitement by seeing the reactions of people he was tricking for money. The judge, Mr Recorder Robert Crawford, described Kinvig's actions as organized, spiteful, and harmful to public confidence in genuine charities. Defense lawyer Tim Brennand explained that Kinvig was under financial pressure, about to become a father, and wanted to prove to his girlfriend he could provide for their child. The judge concluded that Kinvig’s manipulative tactics—inventing stories about children with serious illnesses—made people less likely to donate to legitimate charitable causes. Kinvig's persistence and deceit rendered the offenses particularly egregious.

Kinvig, hasta kardeşi veya çeşitli yardım etkinlikleri için para topladığını iddia ederek sekiz kez sahtekârlıktan suçunu kabul etti; ancak parayı esrar ve doğacak çocuğu için harcadı. Mahkemede, Kinvig’in aralarında 77 yaşına kadar yaşlıların da olduğu savunmasız insanları hedef aldığı, beyin felci tedavileri ve Duke of Edinburgh Ödülü gibi amaçlar için para gerektiğini uydurduğu belirtildi. Resmi görünmek için bir evrak takımı, sponsorluk formu ve bağışlardaki vergi iadesi hakkında bilgi taşıyordu. Kinvig, görevde olmayan Polis Toplum Destek Görevlisi Tracy Parkes’in kapısını çaldığında ve onun, kendisini bir polis fotoğrafından tanımasıyla yakalandı. Araştırma sonrasında, Kinvig’in çoğunluğu hırsızlıktan oluşan 39 suç kaydı olduğu ortaya çıktı. Bazı mağdurlar, onun inandırıcı hikâyelerine kanıp emekli maaşlarından para verdi. Savcı Julian Goode, Kinvig’in insanları kandırırken onların tepkilerini görmekten heyecan duyduğunu söyledi. Kinvig’in ısrarcı ve aldatıcı tutumu, suçlarını özellikle ağırlaştırıcı kıldı.

Christopher Spivey, a 51-year-old blogger and tattoo artist from Rochford, Essex, was arrested in a pre-dawn police raid on suspicion of harassment through social media. The arrest occurred after Spivey published repeated claims on his blog asserting that the murder of British soldier Lee Rigby in Woolwich, London, in May 2013 was staged to provoke anti-Muslim sentiment. In his posts, Spivey cast doubt on the official account by highlighting alleged missing CCTV footage and providing his own theories on the events.

Police did not confirm if Spivey's arrest was directly related to these conspiracy-focused blog articles or to a separate allegation of harassment. Following a referral from Greater Manchester Police, Essex Police seized computer equipment from Spivey's home. He was held at Southend Police Station but later released on bail pending further inquiry.

Spivey has publicly received support from conspiracy theory proponent David Icke. Discussions on Spivey’s website have included claims that his arrest was politically motivated. He has also gained attention for online criticism of public figures, such as portraying deputy prime minister Nick Clegg in a negative light. In contrast, the convictions of Michael Adebolajo and Michael Adebowale for the murder of Lee Rigby remain undisputed; both men were sentenced to life in prison after being found guilty of attacking Rigby in 2013. Authorities have not stated whether complaints from Rigby’s family were a factor in Spivey's arrest.

Spivey, blogunda İngiliz askeri Lee Rigby’nin Mayıs 2013’te Woolwich, Londra’da öldürülmesinin Müslümanlara karşı nefreti tetiklemek için kurgulandığını iddia etmişti. Europe’s top golfers are on the verge of setting a new record at the US PGA Championship, looking to capture a third major victory in a row—something the continent has never achieved before. Rory McIlroy leads a strong group of European contenders all aiming for the historic Wanamaker Trophy, hoping to crown a summer of dominance in just nine weeks.

The quest takes place at Valhalla Golf Club, a site of past disappointment for Europe after their 2008 Ryder Cup loss. Now, this venue could mark a thrilling reversal as the stage for European triumph.

European players have posted impressive results recently: Martin Kaymer won both the Players Championship and the US Open, Justin Rose collected major wins across the Atlantic, and McIlroy claimed the Open Championship before following up with victory at the WGC-Bridgestone Invitational.

Golf legend Jack Nicklaus has praised McIlroy’s talent, suggesting he could win 15–20 majors in his career. McIlroy made history as the first European in the modern era to secure three different major titles.

But Europe’s bench is deep: Justin Rose remains a formidable challenger, Sergio Garcia is determined after several close calls, and quietly consistent players like Henrik Stenson, Ian Poulter, and Graeme McDowell all remain in the mix. McDowell’s French Open win and strong finishes at The Open and Bridgestone further underscore Europe’s strength.

By contrast, leading Americans face tough times: Tiger Woods is out of form, Jason Dufner deals with injury, and Dustin Johnson is away from the game. Rickie Fowler’s major performances have been solid, but the European contingent currently holds the highest world rankings. Australian Adam Scott is widely considered the biggest threat outside Europe.

With European golfers performing at their peak and poised to make history, all eyes are on Valhalla for what could be a legendary tournament.

article_content: One year ago, America received a wake-up call about a core problem in our political system—how closed partisan primaries can empower ideological extremists and special interests. On September 14, 2010, Delaware Rep. Mike Castle and Washington, DC, Mayor Adrian Fenty both lost closed primaries in their respective parties, preventing most voters from having a say in the general election. Castle, a Republican, and Fenty, a Democrat, were both victims of a system that often punishes political independence and contributes to the polarization of American politics. Mike Castle, a former Delaware governor and longtime Republican congressman, had a fiscally conservative record, focusing on balancing budgets and cutting taxes. In Congress, he opposed President Barack Obama's health care bill and the economic stimulus bill, but he held centrist positions on social issues, such as supporting abortion rights and gay rights, and was attentive to environmental concerns. Despite being a strong fit for Delaware and widely popular, Castle was targeted by the Tea Party movement in 2010 for his willingness to work across party lines. Christine O'Donnell, a political activist without prior elected experience and a history of controversial statements, became the Tea Party-backed candidate. She received substantial funding from national activists during the primary. O'Donnell's victory came in a closed Republican primary with low turnout. As a result, Republicans lost a Senate seat in the general election that they were favored to win, as O'Donnell was viewed as too extreme for most voters. Similarly, Adrian Fenty, during his first term as mayor of Washington, DC, faced a primary challenge from City Council President Vincent Gray. Fenty's support for education reform—championed by his schools chancellor, Michelle Rhee—drew opposition from teachers unions, which invested significantly in the primary. Fenty lost the closed primary despite improvements in the city under his leadership, and many independent and Republican voters had no say in the outcome. After the election, Michelle Rhee left her post, and under Vincent Gray, the mayor's office soon faced scandals and low approval ratings. These cases highlight how closed partisan primaries can be unrepresentative, often dominated by ideological activists and special interests. The author advocates for replacing closed primaries with open primaries, as seen in states like California and New Hampshire, along with redistricting reform, as steps toward reducing political polarization. The opinions expressed in this commentary are solely those of John Avlon.
translated_content: Bir yıl önce, Amerika siyasi sistemimizdeki temel bir sorun hakkında bir uyanış yaşadı: Kapalı parti ön seçimleri, ideolojik aşırılık yanlılarını ve özel çıkar gruplarını güçlendirebiliyor. 14 Eylül 2010’da Delaware Temsilcisi Mike Castle ve Washington DC Belediye Başkanı Adrian Fenty, kendi partilerinin kapalı ön seçimlerinde kaybetti ve çoğu seçmenin genel seçimde oy kullanmasının önüne geçildi. Castle bir Cumhuriyetçi, Fenty ise bir Demokrat olarak, siyasi bağımsızlığın cezalandırıldığı ve Amerikan siyasetinin kutuplaştığı bir sistemin mağdurlarıydı. Delaware'nin eski valisi ve uzun süreli Cumhuriyetçi Kongre üyesi Mike Castle, bütçe dengeleme ve vergi indirimleriyle tanınan mali açıdan muhafazakâr bir geçmişe sahipti. Kongrede, Başkan Barack Obama'nın sağlık yasasına ve teşvik paketine karşı çıktı, ancak kürtaj ve eşcinsel hakları gibi sosyal konularda merkezi bir pozisyon aldı ve çevreye duyarlıydı. Delaware için çok uygun ve oldukça popüler olmasına rağmen, Castle 2010 yılında karşı tarafla iş birliği yaptığı için Tea Party hareketi tarafından hedef alındı. Önceki seçilmiş bir görevi olmayan siyasi aktivist Christine O'Donnell, Tea Party destekli aday olarak öne çıktı ve ön seçim sırasında ulusal destekçilerden önemli miktarda finansal yardım aldı. O'Donnell’in galibiyeti, az katılımın olduğu kapalı Cumhuriyetçi ön seçiminde gerçekleşti. Bunun sonucunda, O'Donnell’in çoğunluk için fazla aşırı bulunması nedeniyle Cumhuriyetçiler, genel seçimde kazanma ihtimali yüksek olan Senato sandalyesini kaybetti. Benzer şekilde, Washington DC Belediye Başkanı Adrian Fenty, ilk döneminde Belediye Meclisi Başkanı Vincent Gray ile ön seçimde yarıştı. Fenty’nin eğitim reformuna verdiği destek—okul müdürü Michelle Rhee’nin liderliğinde—öğretmen sendikalarının karşıtlığını topladı ve ön seçime ciddi finansal yatırım yaptılar. Şehirdeki gelişmelere rağmen, Fenty kapalı ön seçimde kaybetti ve birçok bağımsız ve Cumhuriyetçi seçmen sandığa gidemedi. Seçimin ardından Michelle Rhee görevinden ayrıldı ve Vincent Gray’in belediye başkanlığı dönemi kısa sürede skandallar ve düşük onay oranlarıyla karşılaştı. Bu örnekler kapalı parti ön seçimlerinin, genellikle ideolojik aktivistler ve özel çıkar grupları tarafından yönlendirildiği için temsil gücünün düşük olabileceğini gösteriyor. Yazar, California ve New Hampshire gibi eyaletlerde olduğu gibi açık ön seçimler ve seçim bölgesi düzenlemeleriyle siyasi kutuplaşmanın azaltılabileceğini savunuyor. Bu yorumdaki görüşler yalnızca John Avlon’a aittir.

article_content: Afghan officials allege that recent deadly rocket attacks in eastern Afghanistan were orchestrated by the Pakistani military, while Islamabad denies any responsibility. On Monday, Aminullah Amarkhil, Afghan chief of eastern border police, reported that Pakistani forces fired 35 artillery shells into Kunar province on Sunday, killing 20 civilians according to preliminary reports. Amarkhil stated the bombardment started at 4 p.m. and continued until midnight. He further claimed that, over the past month, shelling in five districts of Kunar province has led to people fleeing their homes, resulting in 36 deaths and 30 injuries. Amarkhil also reported that the Pakistani military fired 37 rockets into Goshta district in Nangarhar province during the past week. In response to the attacks, Afghan President Hamid Karzai met with Pakistani President Asif Ali Zardari in Tehran, Iran, seeking clarification and more information about incidents along the shared border. President Zardari asserted that Pakistani authorities were unaware of these attacks and denied they were carried out by the Pakistani army.

Pazartesi günü, Afgan doğu sınır polis şefi Aminullah Amarkhil, Pakistan kuvvetlerinin Pazar günü Kunar vilayetine 35 top mermisi attığını ve ilk raporlara göre 20 sivilin hayatını kaybettiğini bildirdi. Amarkhil, bombardımanın saat 16.00'da başladığını ve gece yarısına kadar devam ettiğini belirtti. Ayrıca, son bir ay içinde Kunar vilayetindeki beş ilçeye yapılan bu bombardımanlar nedeniyle halkın evlerini terk ettiği, toplamda 36 kişinin öldüğü ve 30 kişinin yaralandığı söylendi. Amarkhil ayrıca, geçen hafta Pakistan ordusunun Nangarhar vilayetindeki Goshta ilçesine 37 roket attığını rapor etti. article_content: Lacework, a cloud security provider, has expanded its platform to include code security, now covering the entire application lifecycle. The newly launched features give customers deeper visibility throughout the development process, allowing them to identify and resolve security issues before deploying their applications. Lacework introduced Software Composition Analysis (SCA) and Static Application Security Testing (SAST), bringing major enhancements to its platform. The SCA feature continuously monitors third-party software libraries within customer code repositories, strengthening software supply chain security. It assists organizations in maintaining accurate software bills of materials (SBOMs), staying aware of open-source licensing risks, and tracking vulnerabilities in third-party code. Lacework’s SAST capability improves detection of complex vulnerabilities in internet-facing applications. The tool deeply analyzes call chains and control paths, aiming for high accuracy with minimal false positives or negatives. These capabilities help secure enterprise applications while reducing operational complexity. With these additions, Lacework claims to be one of the few vendors offering complete application lifecycle protection—uniting code and cloud security into a single platform. While other players, including Snyk, Rapid7, and Palo Alto Networks, offer parts of this solution, Lacework’s integrated approach is highlighted as a key differentiator. Disclosure: Steve McDowell, an industry analyst at NAND Research, notes prior engagements with various technology companies, potentially including those mentioned in this article. He does not hold equity in any company discussed.

article_content: The UK government plans to challenge a ruling from the European Court of Human Rights, which found that the country's use of police stop-and-search powers can violate individual rights. Section 44 of the Terrorism Act 2000 allows officers to stop and search anyone without needing reasonable suspicion. Officials claim these powers are vital for fighting terrorism, but human rights advocates argue they can be misused. Home Secretary Alan Johnson voiced disappointment with the ruling, noting that previous UK court cases had upheld the law. The authorities intend to appeal, and until a new decision is reached, the police will keep using these powers. Following earlier public concerns, London’s Metropolitan Police now mainly use stop-and-search at major public areas like landmarks or events with large crowds. This legal dispute began in 2003 when Kevin Gillan and Pennie Quinton were stopped by police on their way to a London protest. Gillan, on his bicycle, was searched and released after about 20 minutes. Quinton, a journalist, was held and prevented from filming, despite showing her press ID. The police record said the search lasted about five minutes, though Quinton estimated it was nearly half an hour. Both argued the stops breached their human rights, especially rights to privacy, liberty, free expression, and assembly. After losing in UK courts, they appealed to the European Court. The court ruled that the broad scope of these police powers interfered with individuals’ privacy and could cause public embarrassment, in part because officers often acted on personal instinct without any factual suspicion. Liberty, the rights group that backed the applicants, hailed the decision and urged the government to restrict Section 44’s use—keeping it time-limited, applied only in specific areas, and with clear public notification when put into effect.

article_content: Popular culture often casts prep-school life in a gloomy light, marked by absent parents, dismal faculty, and entitled classmates. Alexander Payne’s film 'The Holdovers', written by David Hemingson, draws on these stereotypes but anchors its story in genuine, real-life pain. The distinctiveness of 'The Holdovers' isn’t in its narrative, but in how Payne handles it. Known for his dry wit and sharp observations of flawed characters, Payne employs a familiar pattern—starting with cynicism and gradually exposing authentic emotion. This approach echoes his previous works like 'Sideways' and 'Nebraska.' Paul Giamatti plays Paul Hunham, a weary ancient history teacher at the fictional Barton Academy in New England during Christmas 1969. As punishment for failing a privileged student whose father supports the school, Hunham must oversee students with nowhere to go during the holidays. Eventually, all but one student, Angus Tully (Dominic Sessa), are whisked away by wealthy parents for a ski trip, leaving Hunham and Tully behind. Also present is Mary Lamb (Da’Vine Joy Randolph), the cook privately grieving her son’s death in Vietnam. Angus wrestles with his mother's recent remarriage and his absent father, masking his pain behind bravado. His mother’s broken promise to take him to Boston during the holiday deeply wounds him. Though Hunham distances himself from students, bonding only with Mary, his defenses begin to erode. A road trip to Boston—posing as an academic outing—becomes an opportunity for Hunham and Tully to face their emotional realities. The film leans into vintage details—retro styling, period music, and era-appropriate aesthetics—creating a nostalgic atmosphere. Yet the emotional resonance is carefully orchestrated and sometimes lacks spontaneity. A scene in which Hunham rebuffs a sex worker in Boston receives criticism for feeling forced and overly symbolic. Standout performances drive the film; Giamatti captures Hunham’s complexities, and Sessa presents Tully as both challenging and sympathetic. Ultimately, while 'The Holdovers' offers an engaging and emotional holiday narrative, its heartfelt moments often seem planned, delivering comfort yet missing the unpredictability of genuine warmth.
translated_content: Popüler kültür, hazırlık okulu hayatını çoğunlukla kasvetli bir şekilde yansıtır: ilgisiz anne-babalar, mutsuz öğretmenler ve şımarık öğrenciler… Alexander Payne’in David Hemingson imzalı filmi 'The Holdovers' da bu klişelere dokunuyor fakat hikayesini gerçek hayatın acısıyla temellendiriyor. 'The Holdovers'ın farkı, olay örgüsünden ziyade Payne’in yaklaşımında öne çıkıyor. Kuru mizahı ve kusurlu karakterlere dair keskin gözlemleriyle tanınan Payne, önce alaycılıkla başlayıp ardından gerçek duyguları ortaya çıkaran klasik tarzını yine gösteriyor. Bu, 'Sideways' ve 'Nebraska' gibi önceki filmlerini de anımsatıyor. Paul Giamatti, 1969 Noel’inde New England’daki kurgusal Barton Akademisi’nde, hayatından bıkmış bir antik tarih öğretmeni Paul Hunham olarak karşımıza çıkıyor. Okula maddi destek veren bir öğrenciyi sınıfta bıraktığı için Hunham, tatili çoğunluğun aksine okulda geçirmek zorunda kalan öğrencilerle ilgilenmekle görevlendiriliyor. Başlangıçta zengin aileler çocuklarını tatil için alırken, Angus Tully (Dominic Sessa) isimli öğrenci, ailesine ulaşılamadığı için Hunham ile okulda kalıyor. Onlara, Vietnam’da oğlunu kaybeden ve yasını içine atan okul aşçısı Mary Lamb (Da'Vine Joy Randolph) eşlik ediyor. Angus, annesinin kısa süre önce yeniden evlenmesi ve babasının ortadan kaybolmasıyla baş etmeye çalışıyor; duygusal yaralarını ukalalığının arkasına gizliyor. Annesinin Boston’a götürme sözü ise yerine getirilmediği için Angus’a çok ağır geliyor. Hunham öğrencilerden uzak duran biri olsa da, yalnızca Mary ile dostluk kurabiliyor. Ancak zamanla bu mesafe azalıyor. Sözde eğitim amaçlı yapılan bir Boston gezisi, hem Hunham hem de Tully açısından duygularla yüzleşme fırsatı sunuyor. Film, dönem atmosferini retro detaylar, müzikler ve görsellerle başarıyla yansıtıyor, bu da hoş bir nostalji yaratıyor. Ancak duygusal anların çoğu özenle planlanmış ve biraz yapay hissettirebiliyor. Boston’da Hunham’ın bir seks işçisini geri çevirdiği sahne fazlasıyla sembolik ve yapay geldiği için eleştiriliyor. Oyunculuklar filmi taşıyor; Giamatti Hunham’ın karmaşıklığını yansıtırken, Sessa ise Angus’un hem zor hem de empati uyandıran yönünü başarıyla oynuyor. Sonuç olarak, 'The Holdovers' duygusal ve sıcak bir yılbaşı hikayesi sunarken, samimi anlarının çoğu planlı bir his veriyor; seyirciye rahatlık sunuyor ama spontane bir sıcaklık hissi vermekte eksik kalıyor.

Fifteen-year-old Katie Littlewood lost her life after being hit by a train at a railway crossing in Bishop’s Stortford, Hertfordshire, according to an inquest. On her way to volunteer at a British Heart Foundation charity shop, Katie may have been listening to music and texting, possibly preventing her from noticing a train approaching at up to 60mph. Train driver Steven Trumm reported that Katie stepped onto the crossing without looking, and turned toward the train only moments before impact. Trumm, who had experienced a similar incident before, said she seemed to think it was safe, but looked shocked when she finally saw the train.

Investigators found headphones, an iPod Nano, and Katie’s phone at the scene, with phone records showing normal texting activity just before the accident. All safety measures—including a green light for safe crossing and an audible alarm—were confirmed to be fully functional. The crossing had previously been the site of other fatal accidents, and though Network Rail had approved a footbridge years prior, it was only built nine months after Katie’s death.

Katie’s family attended the inquest, expressing their sympathy for the train driver and hope that her death could serve as a warning. The official cause of death was ruled accidental. Following her mother's death in 2009, Katie and her sisters had moved to Hertfordshire.

article_content: A new report reveals that just one in ten mothers believe politicians genuinely have their best interests at heart. The Asda Mumdex survey, which questioned 11,000 customers, found that many mothers feel disconnected from MPs and think political language is out of touch. Almost three-quarters of respondents believe current political party policies are too male-centric. More than 80 percent said they plan to vote in 2015, but only 2 percent feel represented by the political system. In Scotland and Wales, one in five mothers feel alienated by politics, rising to 30 percent in Northern Ireland. The survey also found that more than half do not think MPs understand the financial pressures faced by families. Nearly three-quarters of mothers want the government to focus on solving the cost of living crisis, and 65 percent support efforts to limit energy prices—a key policy announced by Labour leader Ed Miliband. Almost half of those surveyed back the Liberal Democrats’ proposal to increase the personal tax allowance to reduce income tax bills, and 42 percent want improved rights for working families. Additionally, 73 percent desire greater honesty from politicians about what they can realistically achieve. Esther McVey, the Conservative employment minister, acknowledged that politicians sometimes use complex language, which can make them seem out of touch. At the launch of the report in Parliament, Asda chief executive Andy Clarke emphasized the vital role mothers play, while Storm Townend, a mother from Wakefield, commented that politicians often use inaccessible language that has little meaning for everyday people.

article_content: Four days after she went missing from her home in Willis, Texas, 14-year-old Evelyn Carrillo and her stepfather, Edgar Soto, were both located safe. Evelyn left home on Sunday, and her 40-year-old stepfather disappeared soon after going after her. The Montgomery County Sheriff's Office reported finding them separately on Thursday, following tips from the community. Lieutenant Brady Fitzgerald said that even though Evelyn and Soto were discovered in different locations, investigators believe they may have spent some time together while missing. Both are now in contact with authorities as officials try to piece together what occurred in the intervening days. Mary Hernandez Soto, Evelyn’s mother, recounted that Evelyn was upset when Soto prepared to leave for work as a truck driver, which prompted her to run away. Both parents tried to find her—initially on foot, then by car—but they became separated, and Mary lost contact with Edgar. She later speculated that Edgar might have found Evelyn before authorities did. Residents helped with the effort by distributing missing person flyers, and one McDonald's worker thought she'd seen Evelyn with a man, though this could not be confirmed on security cameras. Detectives investigated various leads, though they did not believe Evelyn was in grave danger at any point. Her mother stayed home in hopes her daughter would return and spoke of her distress at the situation. As of now, it's unclear if Evelyn has been reunited with her mother.

article_content: AMC has greenlit two new drama pilots that blend ambitious concepts with rich historical settings, both from acclaimed producers. The first, 'Halt & Catch Fire,' explores the personal computing boom of the 1980s—not in Silicon Valley, but in Texas' 'Silicon Prairie,' which refers to the tech communities around Dallas and Fort Worth. The series follows a fictional visionary, an engineer, and a prodigy, whose groundbreaking innovations challenge the decade's dominant corporations. Chris Cantwell and Chris Rodgers created the pilot, with Mark Johnson and Melissa Bernstein ('Breaking Bad') serving as executive producers. The second pilot, 'Turn,' is based on Alexander Rose’s book, 'Washington’s Spies.' Set in 1778, it follows New York farmer Abe Woodhull, who teams up with childhood friends to form The Culper Ring—a group of unlikely spies who influence the outcome of America’s battle for independence. 'Turn' is written by showrunner Craig Silverstein ('Nikita') and executive produced by Barry Josephson ('Bones'). Susie Fitzgerald, AMC’s Senior Vice President of scripted development and current programming, said, 'These additional pilot orders demonstrate AMC’s investment in our original scripted programming. Both projects offer viewers unique worlds through compelling characters and original storytelling. We are privileged to work with such outstanding talent.' The pilots will vie for a series order alongside two previously announced projects: the Detroit-set drama 'Low Winter Sun' and the untitled LaGravenese/Tony Goldwyn project, both of which have recently completed production.

AMC'nin Senaryo Geliştirme ve Güncel Programlamadan Sorumlu Kıdemli Başkan Yardımcısı Susie Fitzgerald şöyle dedi: 'Bu ek pilot onayları, AMC'nin orijinal senaryolu programlarımıza yaptığı yatırımın bir göstergesidir. Her iki proje de izleyicilere özgün anlatımlarla benzersiz dünyalar ve etkileyici karakterler sunuyor. Böyle olağanüstü bir ekiple çalışma ayrıcalığına sahip olduğumuz için şanslıyız.' Bu pilotlar, kısa süre önce yapımı tamamlanan Detroit’te geçen polisiye drama 'Low Winter Sun' ve adı henüz belirlenmeyen LaGravenese/Tony Goldwyn projesiyle birlikte dizi siparişi için yarışacak.

article_content: President Barack Obama found himself in a lighthearted situation yesterday when he shook hands with a man wearing a horse mask while meeting the public in Denver, Colorado. Obama was seen smiling and greeting the prankster during an unscheduled walk through the city. The horse mask gained popularity as an internet meme several years ago, with people sharing photos online of themselves wearing it in unconventional places. The President's security team kept a close watch during the encounter. Obama seemed amused as he continued greeting others. Obama also laughed off an apparent offer of marijuana, which became legally available in Colorado in January. An Instagram video by user manton89 shows him smiling as someone seems to offer marijuana, to which Obama responded with laughter. The evening was part of Obama's ongoing efforts to escape the constraints of the White House and connect with Americans. He visited the crowded Wazee Supper Club for dinner with local residents who had written him letters, followed by a walk down 15th Street, shaking hands and interacting with passersby, closely accompanied by Secret Service agents. Later, Obama visited Wynkoop Brewing Co., founded by Colorado Governor John Hickenlooper. There, Obama had a beer with the governor and played a game of pool, ultimately winning the game. The visit was marked by laughter and casual conversation, with the President even joking with a giant gorilla sculpture inside the pub. Obama was also seen presenting a challenge coin to Kalynne May Arrick in honor of her brother, Marine Sgt. Kenneth May, who died serving in Afghanistan. Throughout his visit, Obama expressed a desire to spend more time outside Washington and with the public, describing himself as a 'bear on the loose.'

article_content: Two young brothers lost their lives after being swept 50 feet by an avalanche during a family snowmobiling trip near their home in Utah. Coleman Sweat, 14, and his seven-year-old brother, Trevan Sweat, were with their parents and sisters when the snow beneath them gave way as they stopped to enjoy the view. The boys were carried down a hillside in Wasatch County and buried under two feet of snow. Their family found them unconscious 30 minutes later, but despite efforts, they could not be revived. The incident occurred on a Friday afternoon while the Sweat family, all experienced snowmobile riders, were snowmobiling in Duchesne and had stopped to rest. Coleman and Trevan walked to the edge of a ledge when the cornice collapsed, according to police. Jared Rigby, Wasatch County Sheriff Chief Deputy, explained that the boys could not have known they would trigger an avalanche, as conditions were considered moderate risk. Craig Gordon, Utah Avalanche Center Forecaster, noted the location was not considered classic avalanche terrain but a steep, wind-loaded bowl. Following the accident, parents Jason and Janette Sweat called for help, while their daughters, Kylee and Jaylee, waited for authorities. The boys were found unconscious and were airlifted to Primary Children's Medical Center, but could not be saved. On Monday, nearly 200 family members and friends attended a memorial at Rocky Mountain Middle School, where Coleman was a student. Jason Sweat, the boys' father, spoke at the vigil, expressing gratitude for the community's support and sharing memories of his sons. He described Trevan as 'my little shadow' and recalled time spent together. Community members and local deputies expressed how deeply the loss was felt. Memorial funds have been set up at Wells Fargo Bank and Utah Community Credit Union under the name Coleman and Trevan Sweat Memorial Fund to help the family.

Sweat ailesine yardımcı olmak amacıyla, Coleman ve Trevan Sweat Anma Fonu adıyla Wells Fargo Bankası ve Utah Community Credit Union’da bağış hesapları açıldı.

article_content: Todd Harrell, bassist for the rock band 3 Doors Down, was arrested in D'Iberville, Mississippi, on Tuesday, accused of driving under the influence for a second time. According to local police, the 42-year-old musician was found slumped over his steering wheel at an intersection and showed clear signs of impairment before being taken into custody. This is not Harrell’s first encounter with the law. In April, he was charged in Nashville, Tennessee, with vehicular homicide after his car, allegedly speeding, struck a pickup truck. The collision caused the pickup to veer off the road, resulting in the driver's death. Authorities reported that Harrell admitted to consuming hard cider and taking prescription medications, including Lortab and Xanax, around the time of the incident. That case is ongoing. 3 Doors Down rose to fame with hits such as 'Kryptonite,' 'When I'm Gone,' and 'Here Without You.' Formed in 1994 in Escatawpa, Mississippi, by Harrell and two others, the band broke out after performing at a New York music showcase. Their debut album, 'The Better Life,' has sold more than six million copies, as noted by the Recording Industry Association of America.

Yerel polise göre, 42 yaşındaki müzisyen bir kavşakta direksiyon başında baygın şekilde bulundu ve bariz şekilde yeti kaybı sergilediği için tutuklandı. Harrell’ın yasal sorunları bununla sınırlı değil. Nisan ayında Nashville, Tennessee’de, arabasının aşırı hız yaparken bir kamyonete çarpması sonucu kamyonetin yoldan çıkarak sürücünün hayatını kaybetmesine neden olduğu için ‘taşıtla adam öldürme’yle suçlandı. article_content: Building an innovative AI startup and sharing his journey on LinkedIn, the author previously served as CTO of Paus, a Web3 platform later acquired by CINDIE. Web3, considered the next evolution of the internet, has gained significant momentum in recent years due to its potential to revolutionize web interactions, enhance user control over data and privacy, and foster new forms of peer-to-peer collaboration. However, like any emerging technology, Web3 comes with questions about its robustness and efficiency. A recent survey by the Coinbase Institute shows that many early Web3 adopters acknowledge a degree of ambiguity surrounding the technology. This article reviews some of the primary concerns caused by this ambiguity and assesses whether the potential benefits of Web3 justify the risks of early adoption. 1. Stability Risks: No technology is entirely risk-free. Web3 also faces stability challenges, particularly due to its early stage, complexity, and open-source approach. For example, the decentralized network Solana has experienced seven network outages since 2020. Despite these setbacks, the Solana team has restored the network each time, and the system itself has not been compromised. These experiences help Web3 providers like Solana learn from issues to reinforce their systems and reduce future risks. Possible ways to address stability concerns are being explored. 2. Security Issues: Web3’s decentralized structure can increase the impact of cyberattacks, making it possible for attacks to spread across the network rather than affecting a single node as in traditional systems. Nonetheless, the Web3 community is developing robust security measures and data protection strategies. Examples of these data protection methods are emerging. 3. Efficiency Challenges: The decentralized application (dApp) ecosystem currently depends on a limited number of key data providers, which may introduce issues with data biases, relevance, and accuracy. The lack of standard output practices further complicates data comparison between providers. Given Web3's early development stage, more alternatives are expected to emerge to fill these gaps. Adopters can presently address the issues in several ways. 4. Legal Considerations: Data privacy, virtual governance, regulatory compliance, and intellectual property protections are still developing within Web3. Progress is being made: BlackRock, Fidelity, and ARK Invest have filed for Ethereum and Bitcoin ETFs to help track blockchain-related investments. The US Securities and Exchange Commission is working on regulatory frameworks for exchanges, and Australia and Canada are implementing Bitcoin tax policies. It’s expected these regulations will gain further momentum. 5. Change Management: Due to the decentralized, community-driven nature of Web3, making changes or expansions to protocols becomes more challenging as systems grow. More stakeholders mean more time and effort required for consensus and implementation. Addressing these management challenges involves specific ongoing strategies. 6. Technical Expertise: Widespread adoption of Web3 requires more people to develop and use decentralized apps. The complexity of underlying code demands significant time, skill, and motivation, which could hinder broader user adoption. Several approaches can help resolve this barrier. Final Notes: The concerns discussed here are not exhaustive and could include issues like crypto volatility and centralization risks. Nevertheless, Web3 has the potential to transform the digital landscape by granting users greater control, autonomy, and new forms of digital asset ownership. By following best practices, staying active in the community, and keeping up with industry updates, early adopters can maximize the benefits of Web3. Forbes Technology Council is an invitation-only community for leading technology executives.
translated_content: Yenilikçi bir yapay zeka girişimi kuran ve LinkedIn’de yolculuğunu paylaşan yazar, önceden CINDIE tarafından satın alınan bir Web3 platformu olan Paus’un CTO’suydu. Web3, internetin bir sonraki evrimi olarak görülüyor ve son yıllarda, web etkileşimlerini kökten değiştirme, kullanıcıların verileri ve gizliliği üzerindeki kontrolünü artırma ve yeni eşler arası işbirliği olanakları sunma potansiyeliyle büyük bir ivme kazandı. Ancak, her yeni teknolojide olduğu gibi Web3 de dayanıklılık ve verimlilik konusunda soru işaretleri taşıyor. Coinbase Institute’un yakın tarihli bir anketi, birçok erken Web3 benimseyicisinin teknolojiye dair belli bir belirsizlik hissettiğini gösteriyor. Bu makale, bu belirsizlikten doğan bazı başlıca endişeleri gözden geçiriyor ve Web3’ün potansiyel avantajlarının erken benimsemenin risklerine değer olup olmadığını inceliyor. 1. İstikrar Riskleri: Hiçbir teknoloji tamamen risksiz değildir. Web3 de özellikle erken aşaması, karmaşıklığı ve açık kaynaklı yaklaşımı nedeniyle istikrar sorunlarıyla karşı karşıyadır. Örneğin, merkeziyetsiz ağlardan biri olan Solana, 2020’den bu yana yedi ağ kesintisi yaşadı. Bu kesintilere rağmen Solana ekibi her defasında ağı tekrar devreye aldı ve sistemde güvenlik ihlali yaşanmadı. Bu deneyimler, Solana ve benzeri Web3 sağlayıcılarının karşılaştıkları sorunlardan ders çıkararak sistemlerini güçlendirmelerine yardımcı oldu. Gelecekte istikrar sorunlarının çözümü için farklı yollar araştırılmakta. 2. Güvenlik Sorunları: Web3’ün merkeziyetsiz yapısı, siber saldırıların ağın geneline yayılma ihtimalini artırarak geleneksel webde olduğu gibi belirli bir düğümü hedeflemekten fazlasını mümkün kılar. Bununla birlikte Web3 topluluğu, güçlü veri koruma stratejileri ve güvenlik önlemleri geliştirmeye devam ediyor. Bu veri koruma yöntemlerine dair örnek uygulamalar ortaya çıkıyor. 3. Verimlilik Sıkıntıları: Merkeziyetsiz uygulama (dApp) ekosistemi şu anda sınırlı sayıda ana veri sağlayıcısına bağımlı ve bu durum veri yanlılığı, alaka düzeyi ve doğruluk konusunda sorunlar yaratabiliyor. Standart veri çıktı uygulamalarının eksikliği, sağlayıcılar arası veri karşılaştırmasını daha da güçleştiriyor. Web3’ün erken aşamasında olunması nedeniyle bu sorunları giderecek daha fazla alternatifin yakın gelecekte çıkması bekleniyor. Şu an için benimseyenler farklı çözümler geliştirebilir. 4. Hukuki Açılımlar: Veri gizliliği, sanal yönetim, düzenleyici uyumluluk ve fikri mülkiyetin korunması Web3’te halen gelişmekte olan alanlardır. Önemli ilerlemeler kaydediliyor: BlackRock, Fidelity ve ARK Invest, blockchain yatırımlarının takibi için Ethereum ve Bitcoin ETF başvuruları yaptı. ABD Menkul Kıymetler ve Borsa Komisyonu düzenleme çerçevesi üzerinde çalışıyor, Avustralya ve Kanada’ya ise Bitcoin’e yönelik vergi politikaları getiriyor. Bunların gelecekte daha da fazla gündemde olması bekleniyor. 5. Değişim Yönetimi Endişeleri: Web3’ün merkeziyetsiz ve topluluk tabanlı yapısı, sistemler büyüdükçe protokol değişikliklerinin uygulanmasını daha da zorlaştırıyor. Daha fazla paydaşın olması, karar almayı ve uygulamayı daha uzun hale getiriyor. Bu yönetimsel zorlukları aşmak için çeşitli çözümler uygulanmakta. 6. Teknik Uzmanlık Eksikliği: Web3’ün yaygınlaşması için daha fazla kişinin merkeziyetsiz uygulama geliştirmesi ve kullanması gerekiyor. Altta yatan kodun karmaşıklığı, zaman, bilgi ve motivasyon gerektiriyor; bu da kullanıcı havuzunun büyümesini engelleyebilir. Bu sorunu aşmak için çeşitli yöntemler mevcut. Son Notlar: Buradaki endişeler kapsamlı değildir; kripto oynaklığı ve merkezileşme riski gibi konu başlıkları da eklenebilir. Tüm bu zorluklara rağmen Web3, kullanıcıya daha fazla kontrol, özgürlük ve dijital varlıklara sahip olma fırsatı vererek dijital dünyada devrim yaratma potansiyeline sahip. En iyi uygulamaları takip ederek, toplulukta aktif olarak ve gelişmeleri yakından izleyerek, erken kullanıcılar Web3’ten maksimum fayda sağlayabilir. Forbes Technology Council, seçkin teknoloji yöneticilerinin davetle katıldığı bir topluluktur.

article_content: The music of Woodstock drew hundreds of thousands to the iconic 1969 festival. Similarly, director Ang Lee's name attracted talented actors to his latest film, 'Taking Woodstock.' The film, released on August 28, stars Emile Hirsch, Demetri Martin, and Jonathan Groff, among others. Many cast members were either not born yet or were very young during the original festival, but Ang Lee’s involvement served as a major draw. Liev Schreiber, who portrays a transvestite in the film, said, 'I would do anything for Ang Lee. He’s a director I’ve always admired and was eager to work with. When he asked me, I said I’d wear whatever he needed.' Ang Lee, renowned for films such as 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon' and 'Brokeback Mountain,' has received three Oscar nominations. 'Taking Woodstock' marks a lighter departure for the typically serious director. The story follows Elliot Tiber (Demetri Martin), whose family owned a struggling Catskills hotel and helped bring the Woodstock festival to the region. The film is based on Tiber’s memoir and also features Eugene Levy. Martin, best known for his comedy, his work on 'The Daily Show,' and hosting 'Important Things with Demetri Martin,' had his first starring film role here. Martin explained that Ang Lee guided actors with a tough-love approach, challenging them to trust his direction. Jonathan Groff, with limited film experience, plays Woodstock co-founder Michael Lang. Groff met Lang, who shared memories and supported the cast during filming. Groff believes Woodstock’s legacy still resonates, symbolizing unity and passion. Both Groff and Schreiber see parallels between the spirit of Woodstock and the optimism experienced during Barack Obama’s 2008 election campaign. In addition to Schreiber’s role in a dress, Emile Hirsch appeared nude in a scene, reflecting the festival’s spirit of liberation. Schreiber noted that his children were frightened by his costume, while his partner, Naomi Watts, was surprised. Schreiber believes the film conveys a message of acceptance. CNN’s Katie Walmsley contributed to this article.

article_content: During a recent conversation about his administration's goals, Mitt Romney said his policies could reduce unemployment to 6%—or possibly lower—over the next four years. Is this possible? Yes, it’s not particularly difficult if the U.S. avoids implementing new growth-limiting policies, like the tax hikes set for the beginning of next year. Natural economic adjustments, such as wage declines, movement of workers to growing industries and regions, changing migration patterns, and some people leaving the labor force, are likely to lower unemployment. While these shifts are not always quick or practical for everyone—not every former construction worker can become a tech worker—history shows they do occur. Over four years, such trends are likely to push unemployment down to around 6% or near it. The greater challenge for the next president will be getting the country back to its old growth path before the recession. The U.S. economy has historically grown at about 3% annually, bouncing back quickly after major downturns. Usually, the economy returns to its pre-slump trajectory within two to three years. This time, though, the rebound has been missing—GDP remains well below pre-2008 forecasts, and with below-average growth since the recession ended, the gap gets larger every quarter. Can Romney, or anyone, return to higher growth rates? Yes, with certain steps. Here’s a plan that could help restore U.S. economic performance: - Eliminate the tax increases planned for late 2012 and provide consistent, stable tax policy. Make the Bush tax cuts permanent and end the alternative minimum tax. Repeal hospital insurance tax hikes from the healthcare law. These measures should stimulate short-term growth and support long-term recovery. - Simplify the tax code by getting rid of unnecessary deductions, credits, exemptions, and loopholes that distort incentives and benefit select groups. Notable examples include the mortgage interest deduction and tax-free employer health insurance, plus many other smaller exceptions. - Lower the corporate income tax rate. The current system drives investment overseas—as the U.S. is seen as having an unfriendly corporate tax environment. - Slow the growth of entitlement programs. While a safety net is important, current levels aren’t sustainable, even in a robust economy. At minimum, cuts are needed to prevent Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security from straining the budget. - Welcome more immigrants. The U.S. continues to attract those looking for better lives. Allowing more entrants—both low-skill workers (which helps keep labor costs down) and high-skill workers (often trained at U.S. universities)—will retain valuable talent and help innovation. - Reduce military commitments abroad. Strong defense should protect the U.S., not bear the burden of defending other nations or enforcing democracy on unwilling countries. - Don’t restrict traditional energy (coal, oil, gas). Green energy may become more important someday, but for now, fossil fuels are plentiful and cheaper. Subsidies for alternatives currently don’t make sense. - Don’t blame the wealthy or act as if higher taxes on the top 1% can fix the deficit—the sums simply don’t match. - Recognize the benefits of capitalism and entrepreneurship. Belittling business achievement drives away talent and harms the economy. If the U.S. adopts these approaches, it can not only meet Romney’s 6% unemployment pledge but also restore its status as a global economic leader. All views expressed are those of Jeffrey Miron.

Bu mümkün mü? Evet, ABD önümüzdeki yıl başında yürürlüğe girecek vergi artışları gibi büyümeyi kısıtlayacak yeni politikaları uygulamaktan kaçınırsa bu çok da zor değil. İş dünyasındaki başarıyı küçümseyen yaklaşım, yetenekli insanları uzaklaştırır ve ekonomiye zarar verir. article_content: At a recent industry event in Doha, Alexandre de Juniac, the CEO of Air France-KLM, pointed out that a significant number of passengers feel uncomfortable during flights. He noted that even providing more legroom often fails to address the underlying unease, suggesting that passenger discomfort is psychological as well as physical. Cramped conditions, especially in economy class, continue to make flying an unpleasant experience for many. A survey by Ketchum revealed that 42% of Americans have a negative view of airlines—putting the sector just above banks, government, and tobacco companies. In comparison, 61% of respondents felt positive about the broader travel and tourism industry. Airlines like Air New Zealand have tried to improve their image with creative branding tools and amenities such as the 'skycouch' and playful safety videos. However, CEO Christopher Luxon believes the industry as a whole lacks sufficient focus on customer experience and is not innovative enough for average long-haul passengers. Luxury upgrades often capture headlines, but most passengers never experience them. De Juniac argued that airlines should make improvements throughout the travel process—from booking to arrival—even though some challenges, such as airport facilities and immigration waits, are beyond their control. Global attitudes toward airlines vary: according to Oxford’s Rowena Olegario, airline reputation is notably poor in the United States but remains more aspirational worldwide. Olegario also observed that industry insiders themselves often express dissatisfaction with flying, underscoring that discomfort is shared from passengers to airline executives.

Daha fazla diz mesafesi sunmanın bile asıl huzursuzluğa çare olmadığını; yolcu rahatsızlığının hem psikolojik hem de fiziksel bir boyutu olduğunu aktardı. Oysa katılımcıların %61’i ise genel olarak seyahat ve turizm sektörünü olumlu değerlendiriyor. Manşetlere çıkan lüks kabin yenilikleri çoğu yolcunun erişemediği hizmetler olarak kalıyor. Havayollarına yönelik algı küresel olarak değişiyor: Oxford Üniversitesi’nden Rowena Olegario, ABD’de havayolu itibarı düşük olsa da dünyanın başka birçok yerinde uçmak halen prestijli ve arzu edilen bir deneyim olarak görülüyor. In the much-anticipated Cricket World Cup match between India and Pakistan, India’s captain Rohit Sharma won the toss and elected to bowl first. This decision drew criticism from former Pakistan fast bowler Shoaib Akhtar, who called it a mistake. “Rohit Sharma won the toss and chose to bowl on such a good wicket. I can’t understand why he made that choice. It wasn’t wise; in fact, it was the wrong decision,” Akhtar shared on platform X (formerly Twitter). “I’m pleased Pakistan will bat first. It’s a flat wicket and India may have handed Pakistan an opportunity for a high score,” he added.

India made a single change to their lineup, bringing back fit-again opener Shubman Gill, who had missed the first two matches due to illness. He will open the batting with Rohit Sharma. Pakistan has kept the same team that beat Sri Lanka in their previous match.

Both India and Pakistan have started the tournament strongly, each winning their opening two matches. India defeated Australia in their opener followed by a win against Afghanistan, while Pakistan beat the Netherlands and then chased down a World Cup record target to beat Sri Lanka.

India boasts a 7-0 record against Pakistan in Cricket World Cup history. Even during Pakistan’s trophy-winning campaign in 1992, they lost to India in Sydney. This trend continued through 1996, 1999, 2003, 2011, 2015, and 2019, making the head-to-head record a central topic among fans.

Bu karar, eski Pakistanlı hızlı topçu Shoaib Akhtar'dan eleştiri aldı. Akhtar, sosyal medya platformu X’te (eski adıyla Twitter) "Rohit Sharma kura atışını kazandı ve bu kadar iyi bir sahada önce savunma yapmayı seçti. Neden böyle bir seçim yaptığına anlam veremiyorum. Akıllıca değildi; aslında yanlış bir karardı," dedi. "Pakistan’ın önce bat atacak olmasından memnunum. Düz bir saha, Hindistan Pakistan’a yüksek skor yapma fırsatı verdi," diye ekledi.

Hindistan, kadrosunda tek bir değişiklik yaptı ve sağlığına kavuşan Shubman Gill, hastalık nedeniyle ilk iki maçı kaçırdıktan sonra takıma dönüp Rohit Sharma ile açılışı yapacak. Pakistan, Sri Lanka'ya karşı çıktığı aynı kadroyla sahada yer alıyor.

Hem Hindistan hem de Pakistan turnuvaya güçlü bir başlangıç yaptı ve ilk iki maçlarını kazandılar. Hindistan, açılış maçında Avustralya’yı ardından Afganistan’ı mağlup etti. Pakistan ise sırasıyla Hollanda’yı yenip, ardından Dünya Kupası rekoru kırarak Sri Lanka’yı geçti.

Hindistan, Kriket Dünya Kupası tarihinde Pakistan’a karşı 7-0’lık yenilmez bir seriye sahip. Hatta Pakistan’ın 1992’de şampiyon olduğu turnuvada bile Sydney’de Hindistan’a yenildiler. Bu trend 1996, 1999, 2003, 2011, 2015 ve 2019’da da devam etti ve bu skor taraftarlar arasında önemli bir tartışma konusu haline geldi.

article_content: Manchester City's recent transformation was on display when manager Manuel Pellegrini interrupted his post-match press conference to greet Spain's former king, a sign of the club’s elevated status. This marks a stark contrast to earlier days when the most well-known guest at City's home games was comedian Eddie Large. Pellegrini now faces the surreal reality of playing in an empty stadium, as City head to Russia to take on CSKA Moscow in a Champions League fixture with no fans present, due to CSKA's UEFA ban for repeated racist behavior. The match is critical for City’s hopes to advance, especially after their earlier defeat to Bayern Munich and draw with Roma. Pellegrini stressed the importance of winning to keep qualification hopes alive. Sergio Aguero’s stunning four-goal performance against Tottenham in a 4-1 victory not only clinched the match but also cemented his place as City’s highest-ever Premier League goal scorer, surpassing Carlos Tevez. The game was notable for its rarity: four penalties were awarded, something seen only once before in Premier League history. However, not all the decisions by referee Jonathan Moss were clear-cut, with debate around the legitimacy of some calls. Despite their attacking excellence, City’s defense remains a question mark, with previous Champions League opponents exposing gaps. Tottenham’s manager, Mauricio Pochettino, admitted his players sought to exploit these vulnerabilities. Goalkeeper Joe Hart recognized the need for defensive discipline and highlighted the odd circumstances—playing without fans due to the ban—as a challenge the team must manage. CSKA Moscow, for their part, are coming off a strong 6-0 win over Kuban Krasnodar, keeping pace with league leaders Zenit St Petersburg. Forwards Ahmed Mousa and Seydou Doumbia each netted braces, demonstrating CSKA’s own attacking threat. Looking ahead, Pellegrini plans to reintroduce midfielder Yaya Toure to the starting lineup after resting him during the Tottenham match. Given Aguero’s form and the cold Moscow temperatures, both players will be vital. Pellegrini reiterated the importance of balancing City’s attacking flair with greater focus and concentration to avoid costly errors near their own goal area. Aguero expressed gratitude to his teammates and supporters for helping him achieve his scoring milestone, calling it a point of pride. Reviewing the Tottenham match, some penalties caused controversy: Frank Lampard's fall from slight contact, Kaboul’s clear foul on Silva, Demichelis's challenge on Soldado that may have occurred outside the box, and Fazio’s tackle on Aguero which also resulted in a debated red card. Pellegrini concluded that remaining balanced and improving concentration will be key to City’s success going forward, particularly in the pivotal Champions League tie.

Kulübün seviyesinin ne kadar yükseldiğini gösteren bu durum, geçmişte en ünlü ziyaretçinin komedyen Eddie Large olduğu günlerden büyük bir değişim. Tottenham’ın teknik direktörü Mauricio Pochettino oyuncularının bu açıkları değerlendirmek için özellikle plan yaptıklarını söyledi. Kaleci Joe Hart ise savunmada daha dikkatli olunması gerektiğinin altını çizdi ve seyircisiz ortamda oynamanın getirdiği zorluklara değindi. Aguero, rekorunu takım arkadaşlarına ve taraftarlara teşekkür ederek kutladı ve bunun kendisi için bir gurur kaynağı olduğunu söyledi. Tottenham maçındaki penaltılar ise hâlâ tartışılıyor: Frank Lampard’ın hafif temasla yerde kalışı, Kaboul’un Silva’ya net faulü, Demichelis’in ceza sahası dışında Soldado’ya müdahalesi ve Fazio’nun Aguero’ya faulü sonrası tartışmalı kırmızı kart. article_content: In Chicago on November 20, 2023, shoppers searched for turkeys in preparation for Thanksgiving. While turkey prices have dropped, many grocery items still cost more than in previous years. As families and friends get ready to celebrate Thanksgiving, some are thankful that inflation has eased. Although grocery prices remain elevated, their rate of increase has slowed, and the cost of a traditional Thanksgiving dinner has decreased slightly from last year. According to the American Farm Bureau Federation, a Thanksgiving meal for ten people this year costs $61.16—4.5% less than in 2022—but it's still the second most expensive in their records going back to 1986. Turkey remains the centerpiece of the holiday feast, and there's good news: turkey prices have declined. 'There's a lot of turkey available right now,' said Michael Swanson, an agricultural economist at Wells Fargo. 'They just have to price it down to move it.' The Farm Bureau reports the average price for a 16-pound turkey in early November was $27.35, down 5.6% from last year. Many stores also offer extra discounts on turkeys in the days before Thanksgiving. Turkeys aren't the only relative bargain this season. Fresh cranberries are cheaper because of a bumper crop, but those who prefer canned cranberries will pay more due to increased processing and packaging costs. 'The entire canned market is up, whether you’re talking about beans, cranberries, or pumpkins,' Swanson said. 'Can prices really shot up.' The price of canned goods could rise further next year if the Biden administration imposes new tariffs on imported steel, which is used in making cans. 'We've been pleased that the Department of Commerce has held off on those tariffs for the most part,' said David Chavern, CEO of the Consumer Brands Association. 'But there's going to be a final determination at the beginning of 2024 that we're watching very closely.' Even with savings on turkey, shoppers may see higher prices elsewhere. Sweet potatoes and pumpkin pie filling remain more expensive than last year. Grocery prices have increased 2.1% in the past year, following a 12.4% jump the year before, according to the Labor Department. 'That's the cost of living,' said Angelina Murray outside a Washington, D.C., supermarket shortly before Thanksgiving. 'Nothing we can do until prices come down. We're just going to have to deal.' Some consumers shared with NPR that they're opting for store-brand items instead of national brands and seeking produce deals. Most, however, say Thanksgiving is a time to count blessings more than hunt for bargains. Carrie Murray was happy to find some produce discounts, even if she ended up paying more for staples like olive oil. 'Things that are expensive—it’s the stuff that has been expensive for a while,' Murray said while loading groceries with Colton Parker. 'Looking at the receipt you say, "Oh wow,"' Parker agreed. 'But you know, it’s for families. It’s for the holidays.'

Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg’s brief nap during President Barack Obama’s State of the Union address unexpectedly shone a spotlight on a California vineyard. Ginsburg later admitted she wasn’t “100 percent sober” at the time, attributing her sleepiness to a bottle of wine brought to dinner by fellow Justice Anthony Kennedy. Sharing the story at a Smithsonian Associates event in Washington, D.C., the 81-year-old identified the wine as an “Opus something or other.”

The wine came from Opus One Winery in Oakville, California. Christopher Barefoot, who heads public relations at Opus One, said the winery was thrilled to have their wine featured at such an esteemed gathering and took pride in Ginsburg’s enjoyment. “It seems like she enjoyed the wine, and we’re glad she liked it,” he said.

While Ginsburg quipped about her usual preference for sparkling water, she noted that such a delicious dinner deserved a glass or two of good wine. Opus One highlights the distinct craftsmanship, character, and teamwork that define its brand, stating that their wine captures the essence of time and place.

After the speech, President Obama gave Ginsburg a warm hug—proof that her nap and the celebrated wine ended up generating good spirits all around.

Ginsburg, o anda “tamamen ayık” olmadığını kabul etti ve uykulu halini, yemeğe beraber geldiği meslektaşı Yargıç Anthony Kennedy’nin getirdiği şarap şişesine bağladı. Bahsi geçen şarap, Oakville, California’daki Opus One bağ evinden. Opus One’ın halkla ilişkiler sorumlusu Christopher Barefoot, şaraplarının böyle seçkin bir ortamda yer almasından büyük mutluluk duyduklarını ve Ginsburg’ün şaraptan keyif almasının kendilerini gururlandırdığını söyledi. “Şarabı beğenmiş gibi görünüyor ve biz de bu durumdan memnunuz,” dedi.

article_content: In 2008, as crude oil prices soared, Gulf countries experienced an economic boom. Arab investors acquired properties and businesses globally, including in the United States, strengthening Western perceptions of immense Arab wealth and extravagance—especially amid the 2008 financial crisis. Busta Rhymes, a rapper and singer from Brooklyn, reflected this sentiment with his October 2008 release 'Arab Money,' a highly controversial track. Renowned for his flamboyant persona, Busta Rhymes aimed to tap into the image of wealthy Gulf Arabs, showcasing affluence and attracting a wider audience. Some Arabs viewed the song as cultural appropriation, feeling that Busta Rhymes used aspects of Arab culture for personal gain and perpetuated stereotypes. In response to criticism, Busta Rhymes released a remix with Arab rappers, including Arabic verses, though the song was still banned in the United Arab Emirates. Despite the controversy, 'Arab Money' achieved commercial success, reaching number 100 on the US Billboard Hot 100. It also influenced artists like Jay-Z and Kanye West, who referenced Arab wealth and culture in their music. In current pop culture, 'Arab Money' symbolizes both stereotypes and a celebration of the fortunes associated with Gulf nations like Saudi Arabia, the UAE (especially Dubai), Qatar, Kuwait, and Oman, an image stemming from decades of oil revenues. While the accuracy of Busta Rhymes’s depiction is debatable, the scale of the Gulf states’ wealth and influence is undeniable. According to the 2023 Global Sovereign Wealth Fund report, five of the ten most active global state investors are from the Middle East. Middle Eastern sovereign wealth funds invested $89 billion in 2022, more than double the previous year, with $51.6 billion of that going to Europe and North America. After recent energy price hikes, sovereign wealth funds from Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Abu Dhabi control over $3.5 trillion. Bloomberg reports they are among the world’s largest investors in rescue packages, acquisitions, and corporate investments. Historically, Gulf investors focused on high-profile assets like real estate, sports, and retail. Now, they are adopting more strategic approaches, leveraging their wealth for global influence, economic diversification, and political clout. Since 2022, Gulf leaders have shown greater confidence and authority, a result of growing dependence by Western countries on Gulf oil and gas during the Russo-Ukrainian War and sanctions on Russia. This has elevated the Gulf Cooperation Council’s role. Even so, a large proportion of Middle Eastern investment capital remains untapped, according to Global SWF. Nigerian President Bola Tinubu, recognizing these global shifts, led a delegation to Riyadh for the first Saudi-Africa Summit in November 2023 to attract new investment to Nigeria. He offered assurances about Nigeria’s economic reforms, legal safeguards, and improved investment conditions. At the Nigeria-Saudi Investment Roundtable, Tinubu pledged an end to barriers on capital flows and foreign exchange, inviting the Islamic Development Bank to support Nigeria’s infrastructure projects. Saudi leaders responded positively, planning investments in Nigerian refineries and support for Nigeria’s currency reforms. The Islamic Development Bank also committed a significant share of its $50 billion Africa fund to Nigeria. Saudi Trade and Investment Minister Kahlid El-Falih announced an upcoming visit with a delegation of top Saudi CEOs, aiming for actionable investment agreements. The article warns that such promises have been made before and emphasizes the need for Nigeria to follow through on reforms to sustain investor trust. It calls on both officials and citizens to help transform these opportunities into lasting progress and to represent Nigeria positively to attract more foreign capital. The piece concludes by honoring Usman Pategi (Samanja), a celebrated Nigerian entertainer and Kannywood pioneer. President Tinubu mourned his loss, highlighting his unique character, contributions to culture, and role in fostering patriotism and national unity.

Arap yatırımcılar Amerika Birleşik Devletleri de dahil olmak üzere dünyanın dört bir yanında mülk ve iş satın aldı. Bu durum, Batı’da Arapların aşırı zengin ve gösterişli olduğu algısını güçlendirdi—özellikle 2008 finansal krizi sırasında. Brooklynli rapçi ve şarkıcı Busta Rhymes, Ekim 2008’de yayımladığı ve oldukça tartışılan 'Arab Money' şarkısıyla bu algıyı yakaladı. Gösterişli tarzıyla tanınan Busta Rhymes, zengin Körfez Arapları imajından faydalanarak şöhretini ve kitlesini büyütmek istedi. Bazı Araplar ise bu şarkının kültürel bir sömürü ve klişeleri pekiştiren bir yaklaşım olduğunu düşündü. Gelen eleştiriler üzerine Busta Rhymes, Arap rapçilerle birlikte hazırladığı ve Arapça sözlerin de olduğu bir remiks yayımlasa da parça Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri'nde yine de yasaklandı. Tartışmalara rağmen, 'Arab Money' ABD Billboard Hot 100 listesinde 100. sıraya çıkarak ticari başarı elde etti. Şarkı, Jay-Z ve Kanye West gibi sanatçıları da Arap zenginliği ve kültürünü müziklerine yansıtmada etkiledi. Günümüzde pop kültürde 'Arab Money', Suudi Arabistan, BAE (özellikle Dubai), Katar, Kuveyt ve Umman gibi Körfez ülkelerinin servetiyle ilgili hem klişeleri hem de bir nevi kutlamayı simgeliyor. Bu imaj, on yıllardır süren petrol gelirlerinden besleniyor. Busta Rhymes’ın portresinin ne kadar doğru olduğu tartışılır; ancak Körfez ülkelerinin ekonomik gücü ve etkisi yadsınamaz. 2023 Küresel Varlık Fonu raporuna göre, dünyanın en aktif 10 devlet yatırım fonundan 5’i Ortadoğu’dan. 2022’de Ortadoğu fonları 89 milyar dolar yatırım yaptı—bir önceki yılın iki katı—ve bunun 51,6 milyar doları Avrupa ile Kuzey Amerika’ya aktı. Enerji fiyatlarındaki son artışlarla, Suudi Arabistan, Katar ve Abu Dhabi varlık fonları 3,5 trilyon doları yönetiyor. Bloomberg, bu fonların şimdiye kadarki en büyük kurtarma paketlerini, yatırımları ve satın alımları finanse ettiğini bildiriyor. Geçmişte Körfez yatırımcıları, gayrimenkul, spor ve perakende gibi gösterişli varlıklara yönelirken; bugün daha stratejik adımlar atıp, küresel etkinlik, ekonomik çeşitlilik ve siyasi nüfuz peşindeler. 2022’den beri, Körfez liderlerinin, Rusya-Ukrayna Savaşı ve Rusya’ya uygulanan yaptırımlar nedeniyle Batı ülkelerinin petrole ve doğalgaza artan bağımlılığı sayesinde daha özgüvenli ve etkili olduğu görülüyor. Bu da Körfez İşbirliği Konseyi’nin rolünü artırdı. Yine de, Global SWF’ye göre Ortadoğu’dan çıkan sermayenin önemli bir kısmı hâlâ değerlendirilmemiş durumda. Nijerya Devlet Başkanı Bola Tinubu, bu küresel trendleri görerek, Kasım 2023’te Riyad’da ilk kez düzenlenen Suudi-Afrika Zirvesi’ne bir heyetle katılarak yeni yatırımları ülkesine çekmeye çalıştı. Tinubu, ekonomik reformlar, hukuki güvence ve gelişen yatırım ortamı konusunda yatırımcılara teminat verdi. Nijerya-Suudi Yatırım Yuvarlak Masası’nda Tinubu, sermaye akışında ve döviz politikalarındaki eski engellerin kalktığını belirterek, İslam Kalkınma Bankası’nı altyapı projelerine destek olmaya davet etti. Suudi liderler ise Nijerya’daki gelişmeleri olumlu karşılayıp, rafinerilere yatırım ve döviz reformlarına destek verme niyetlerini dile getirdi. Aynı zamanda İslam Kalkınma Bankası, 50 milyar dolarlık Afrika fonunun kayda değer bir kısmını Nijerya’ya ayıracağını belirtti. Suudi Arabistan Ticaret ve Yatırım Bakanı Halid El-Falih de, kısa süre içinde üst düzey CEO’lardan oluşan bir heyetle Nijerya’yı ziyaret edip, somut yatırım anlaşmaları gerçekleştirmeyi planladıklarını açıkladı. Yazı, böyle yatırım vaatlerinin daha önce de yapıldığına dikkat çekerek; Nijerya’nın reformlarını uygulamaya koyup, yatırımcı güvenini sürdürebilmesinin önemini vurguluyor. Hem yetkilileri hem vatandaşları bu fırsatları kalıcı ilerlemeye dönüştürmeye ve ülkenin iyi tanıtımına katkıda bulunmaya davet ediyor. Makale, Nijeryalı ünlü sanatçı ve Kannywood’un öncüsü Usman Pategi’ye (Samanja) saygı duruşuyla bitiyor. Başkan Tinubu, Samanja’nın vefatını milli bir kayıp olarak nitelendirerek, onun ülke kültürüne ve birliğine katkılarını önemle vurguladı.

article_content: Chelsea Football Club has announced the acquisition of Oriol Romeu from FC Barcelona. The 19-year-old midfielder, currently representing Spain at the U-20 World Cup in Colombia, has signed a four-year contract with Chelsea, last season's Premier League runners-up. The transfer fee is $7 million, with Barcelona having a buy-back option at $14 million after one year and $21 million after two years. Romeu started his football career at Espanyol before joining Barcelona’s youth system in 2004. He made his senior debut for Barcelona in the Spanish Supercup against Sevilla and played his first La Liga game against Deportivo in May 2010. In the U-20 World Cup, he has played every minute in Spain’s games against Costa Rica and Ecuador. Chelsea described Romeu as notable for his strength and range of passing. Barcelona has also transferred Jeffren Suarez to Sporting Lisbon. The Portuguese club paid $5 million for the 23-year-old winger and secured a buy-back clause for Barcelona. Jeffren joined Barcelona from Tenerife in 2004 and debuted in the senior squad in the 2006-07 season. On Sporting's website, Jeffren expressed commitment to his new club’s values. Barcelona further announced that Argentine defender Gabriel Milito is free to leave the club without a transfer fee. In other news, Juventus confirmed they have declined an offer from Russian club Zenit St Petersburg for defender Leonardo Bonucci. The 24-year-old, who joined from Bari at the beginning of last season, will remain with Juventus as per the club's official statement.
