The Punjab and Haryana High Court has directed the Haryana Police to expedite its investigation into a Gurgaon land deal case involving Robert Vadra, the son-in-law of Congress leader Sonia Gandhi. The court noted the probe has been dragging on for five years. The order, issued by Justices GS Sandhawalia and Harpreet Kaur Jeewan, came during a hearing on a public interest litigation concerning the swift resolution of cases against current and former MPs and MLAs in the region.

The Haryana government, under Chief Minister Manohar Lal Khattar, registered an FIR on September 1, 2018, at Gurgaon’s Kherki Daula police station. The FIR named Bhupinder Singh Hooda, Robert Vadra, DLF, Onkareshwar Properties, and Vadra’s firm Skylight Hospitality as accused. The case invokes multiple sections of the Indian Penal Code and the Prevention of Corruption Act.

Allegations include Skylight Hospitality purchasing 3.5 acres of land in Shikohpur, Gurgaon, from Onkareshwar Properties in February 2008 for Rs 7.5 crore and, after securing a commercial license, selling it to DLF for Rs 58 crore. It is also alleged that, in exchange, the Hooda government allotted 350 acres of land in Wazirabad, Gurgaon, to DLF.

This matter was a significant political issue during the 2014 general elections, with the BJP highlighting the so-called 'Vadra deal' as an example of corruption to target the then-ruling Congress party.

A Special Investigation Team (SIT)—comprising one Deputy Commissioner of Police, two Assistant Commissioners of Police, an inspector, and an Assistant Sub-Inspector—is probing the case. Recently, IAS officer Mukul Kumar and former chief town planner Dilbag Singh were appointed to assist the SIT, along with an additional advocate-general from the Haryana Advocate-General's office.

The tehsildar of Manesar, Gurgaon, submitted a report stating that Skylight Hospitality sold the 3.5-acre property to DLF Universal Ltd on September 18, 2012, and that there was no violation of regulations in the transaction. However, investigators found that crucial financial records relating to Vadra’s company had been destroyed due to water entering a bank branch.
translated_content:
Pencap ve Haryana Yüksek Mahkemesi, Kongre lideri Sonia Gandhi'nin damadı Robert Vadra'nın da sanık olduğu Gurgaon’daki bir arazi anlaşmasına ilişkin soruşturmayı hızlandırması için Haryana Polisini görevlendirdi. Mahkeme, soruşturmanın beş yıldır sürüncemede kaldığını belirtti. Yargıçlar GS Sandhawalia ile Harpreet Kaur Jeewan’in imzaladığı karar, bölgede eski ve mevcut milletvekilleri hakkındaki davaların hızla sonuçlandırılması için açılan bir kamu yararı davası çerçevesinde verildi.

Haryana hükümeti, Başbakan Manohar Lal Khattar yönetiminde, 1 Eylül 2018’de Gurgaon’un Kherki Daula karakolunda bir FIR kaydı yaptırdı. Bildiride Bhupinder Singh Hooda, Robert Vadra, DLF, Onkareshwar Properties ve Vadra’nın şirketi Skylight Hospitality sanık olarak yer aldı. Dava, Hindistan Ceza Kanunu’ndaki çeşitli maddeler ve Yolsuzluğun Önlenmesi Yasası kapsamında açıldı.

İddialara göre Skylight Hospitality, 2008 Şubat ayında Shikohpur, Gurgaon’daki 3,5 dönümlük araziyi Onkareshwar Properties'den 7,5 crore rupiye aldı. Ticarî ruhsat aldıktan sonra bu araziyi DLF’ye 58 crore rupiye sattı. Ayrıca, dönemin Hooda hükümetinin bunun karşılığında DLF’ye, Gurgaon’un Wazirabad bölgesinde 350 dönümlük arazi tahsis ettiği iddia ediliyor.

Bu konu, 2014 genel seçimlerinde önemli bir siyasal mesele olmuş ve BJP, o dönemin Kongre iktidarını hedef almak için ‘Vadra anlaşması’nı yolsuzluğun simgesi olarak göstermişti.

Bir Başkomiser Yardımcısı, iki Komiser Yardımcısı, bir müfettiş ve bir yardımcı komiserden oluşan Özel Soruşturma Ekibi (SIT) davayı yürütüyor. Son zamanda, IAS memuru Mukul Kumar ve eski baş şehir plancısı Dilbag Singh, Haryana Başsavcılığı’ndan bir ek savunma avukatı ile birlikte SIT’ye destek için görevlendirildiler.

Manesar, Gurgaon’un emlak müdürü (tehsildar), Skylight Hospitality’nin 3,5 dönümlük araziyi 18 Eylül 2012’de DLF Universal Ltd.’ye sattığı ve işlemde herhangi bir yönetmelik ihlali olmadığını rapor etti. Ancak araştırmacılar, Vadra’ya ait şirketin önemli mali kayıtlarının bir banka şubesini su basması nedeniyle yok olduğunu tespit etti.

article_content:
In 1797, a notorious mutiny unfolded aboard the Lady Shore, a ship transporting 66 female convicts from Kent to Australia. French soldiers hired as guards seized control off the South American coast, killing Captain James Willcocks and abandoning 28 people off Brazil's shores. The convicts—mostly women sentenced to seven years’ transportation for minor thefts—faced grim conditions.

The ship’s carpenter, Thomas Millard of Deptford, chronicled these harrowing events and his own survival in a 320-page diary. His account describes being awakened by gunfire and the captain’s death, witnessing the chaos as mutineers threatened the crew. The ship’s purser, John Black, attempted to take his own life rather than fall into French hands, but later reappeared onboard.

After the mutiny, survivors endured 18 months in captivity under Spanish authorities in South America. Many of the transported women wound up working as unpaid servants in Buenos Aires. Millard, forced to assist the mutineers and later allowed out on day-release to work as a shipwright, eventually gained his freedom and emigrated to New Jersey, marrying and raising a family there.

Millard’s diary, offering firsthand insights into this turbulent period—including relationships between prisoners, the dire circumstances they faced, and the births and deaths among them—was recently sold at Sotheby’s for £12,500. Dr. Gabriel Heaton called it a unique perspective on early colonial history and the ordeal of those unwillingly caught up in extraordinary events.
translated_content:
1797 yılında, Kent’ten Avustralya’ya 66 kadın mahkûmu taşıyan Lady Shore gemisinde kötü şöhretli bir isyan çıktı. Konvoydaki mahkûmları korumakla görevli Fransız askerleri, Güney Amerika kıyılarında geminin kontrolünü ele geçirdi, Kaptan James Willcocks’u öldürdü ve 28 kişiyi Brezilya açıklarında denize bıraktı. Mahkûmlar, çoğunluğu küçük hırsızlık suçlarından yedi yıllık sürgün cezası almış kadınlardı ve çok ağır koşullarda yaşadı.

Deptfordlu gemi marangozu Thomas Millard, bu olayları ve kendi hayatta kalma mücadelesini 320 sayfalık güncesinde anlattı. Anlatısında, silah sesleriyle uyanışını, kaptanın ölümünü ve mürettebatın isyancılar tarafından tehdit edilmesini aktardı. Geminin muhasebecisi John Black, Fransızların eline geçmemek için intihar girişiminde bulundu; ancak daha sonra tekrar gemiye döndü.

İsyandan sonra, hayatta kalanlar Güney Amerika’da İspanyol yetkililer tarafından 18 ay boyunca esir tutuldu. Sürgün edilen kadınların çoğu, Buenos Aires’te ücretsiz hizmetçi olarak çalıştırıldı. Millard, isyancılara yardım etmeye zorlanmış, ardından gündüzleri bir tersanede çalışmasına izin verilmiş ve geceleri hapishaneye geri dönmüştü. Sonunda özgürlüğüne kavuşup Amerika’ya göç etti, New Jersey’de evlenip bir aile kurdu.

Millard’ın güncesi, bu zorlu döneme ve mahkûmlar arasındaki ilişkilere, karşılaşılan ağır şartlara, doğumlara ve ölümlere birinci elden ışık tutuyor. Bu günce, kısa süre önce Sotheby’s müzayedesinde 12.500 pounda satıldı. Dr. Gabriel Heaton, eserin erken sömürge tarihine ve olağanüstü olaylara istemeden karışan insanların yaşadığı zorluklara eşsiz bir bakış sunduğunu ifade etti.

article_content: Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, renowned for her modeling career, attributes her toned appearance to the guidance of her personal trainer, James Duigan. As the creator of the widely followed 'Clean & Lean' lifestyle, Duigan promotes eating whole, unprocessed foods and adopting healthy daily habits. This method, favored by well-known figures such as Elle Macpherson and David Gandy, avoids strict calorie counting or eliminating entire food groups. Instead, it focuses on nutrient-rich meals, reducing refined sugars, and moderating caffeine intake. Duigan emphasizes that lowering stress is just as crucial as diet for holistic health and a lean body. He recommends activities like regular workouts, yoga, massage, and mindful breathing to control stress hormone levels, particularly cortisol, which is linked to increased abdominal fat and sugar cravings. Dietary suggestions from Duigan include adding coconut products like coconut yogurt or organic coconut oil and prioritizing leafy greens such as kale and spinach each day. Hydration is also important—he suggests starting the day with a glass of water to help flush out toxins and keep skin healthy. The core of Duigan’s approach is sustainability and enjoyment—he discourages crash diets and processed, low-fat foods, citing their potential to cause toxin buildup and unsustainable weight loss. Instead, he encourages eating foods in their natural state and listening to the body's needs. Although the 'Clean & Lean' plan is not heavily promoted, it has become popular through word of mouth, especially among those seeking lasting health changes. Huntington-Whiteley herself supports these principles, highlighting the strength and wellbeing she’s achieved by following Duigan’s guidance. Duigan believes that managing stress, choosing wholesome foods, exercising regularly, and maintaining hydration are key pillars of a healthy lifestyle.

Bu yöntem, Elle Macpherson ve David Gandy gibi tanınmış isimler tarafından da tercih ediliyor ve katı kalori sayımı ya da besin gruplarının tamamen kesilmesini gerektirmiyor. article_content: Mumbai, traditionally known for its proximity to the sea and relatively cleaner air, is now confronting a worrying rise in air pollution. In October, air quality index (AQI) readings in some western suburbs exceeded 300, making it one of the city’s most polluted months. On a few days, Mumbai’s particulate levels even surpassed those of Delhi, a city often recognized for its severe pollution. A Times of India report highlights an increase in respiratory complaints, particularly among individuals with sensitive airways. A pediatric hospital reported a 30% rise in children seeking treatment for respiratory issues within a month. Dr. Dilip Boralkar, former member secretary of the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board, noted that smog, which previously cleared by 9 am, now lingers until 11 am or later. The precise causes of this worsening pollution remain uncertain. However, ongoing construction projects, covering an area estimated at five times the size of Nariman Point (a major commercial zone), are believed to be a contributing factor. Green activists also point to metro construction, which has narrowed key roads such as the iconic Dr. D N Road. Further, Mumbai’s dense network of private vehicles—about 600 cars per kilometer—adds to the city’s vehicular pollution. Climate change is also a concern. While last year’s particulate matter spike was linked to La Nina disrupting coastal winds, this year’s deteriorating air quality is attributed to October heat and a delayed monsoon retreat. Dr. Boralkar asserts that photochemical reactions triggered by heat have become a notable cause of smog over the past three years. Harish Phuleria, associate professor at IIT Bombay’s Environmental Science and Engineering Department, suggests that pollution from vehicles and construction, combined with meteorological factors, collectively contribute to the problem. He states further studies are needed to pinpoint the sources and identify if pollution is evenly spread or concentrated in specific areas. Some experts speculate that high-rise buildings might disrupt Mumbai’s sea breeze, though Dr. Phuleria believes their effect is too limited to cause widespread meteorological change. Scientists are also studying other potential pollutants, including emissions from wood burning in bakeries and crematoria, as well as cooking and open waste burning. Currently, Mumbai's average AQI is an unhealthy 160, while cities like New York and London report ‘good’ AQIs of under 30. The worsening air quality underscores the urgent need for coordinated efforts to reduce pollution and safeguard public health. (Additional news: Tata Group has acquired Wistron’s manufacturing facility, making it the first Indian company to assemble iPhones; India now leads the QS World University Rankings Asia 2024; Religare Enterprises’ directors express concerns about a potential takeover by the Burman family.)
translated_content: Deniz kıyısına yakınlığı ve nispeten temiz havasıyla bilinen Mumbai, artık endişe verici derecede artan hava kirliliğiyle karşı karşıya. Ekim ayında bazı batı banliyölerinde hava kalitesi endeksi (AQI) 300'ün üzerine çıktı ve bu durum şehrin en kirli aylarından biri olmasına yol açtı. Bazı günlerde, Mumbai'nin partikül seviyeleri, genellikle ağır kirliliğiyle bilinen Delhi'yi bile aştı. Times of India'nın bir raporu, özellikle hassas solunum yollarına sahip kişilerde solunum şikayetlerinde artış olduğunu vurguluyor. Bir çocuk hastanesi, yalnızca bir ay içinde solunum sorunları nedeniyle tedaviye başvuran çocuklarda %30'luk bir artış kaydetti. Maharashtra Kirliliği Kontrol Kurulu'nun eski genel sekreteri Dr. Dilip Boralkar, daha önce sabah 09.00'da dağılan sisin artık 11.00'e kadar veya daha geç saatlere kadar kaldığını belirtiyor. Artan kirliliğin kesin nedenleri hâlâ net olarak bilinmiyor. Ancak Nariman Point'in (büyük bir ticaret bölgesi) yaklaşık beş katı alana yayılan aktif inşaat projelerinin önemli bir etken olduğuna inanılıyor. Çevreciler ayrıca, ana yolları daraltan metro inşaatına da dikkat çekiyor; örneğin ikonik Dr. D N Road. Ayrıca, Mumbai'de kilometre başına yaklaşık 600 özel araç olması trafik kaynaklı kirliliği ciddi şekilde artırıyor. İklim değişikliği de farklı bir endişe kaynağı. Geçen yılki partikül artışı sahil rüzgârlarını bozan La Niña'ya bağlanırken, bu yılki artışta ekim sıcakları ve geciken musonun etkisi öne çıkarılıyor. Dr. Boralkar, ısının tetiklediği fotokimyasal reaksiyonların son üç yılda smogun önemli bir nedeni olduğunu belirtiyor. IIT Bombay Çevre Bilimleri ve Mühendisliği Bölümü’nden Doç. Dr. Harish Phuleria, araçlar ve inşaatlardan kaynaklanan kirliliğin meteorolojik faktörlerle birleşerek problemi büyüttüğünü söylüyor. Ayrıca, kirliliğin şehrin geneline mi yoksa belirli bölgelere mi yoğunlaştığını anlamak için daha fazla araştırmaya ihtiyaç olduğunu ekliyor. Bazı uzmanlar, yüksek binaların Mumbai'deki deniz meltemini bozabileceğini öne sürüyor. Ancak Dr. Phuleria, bu etkinin şehir çapında büyük meteorolojik değişiklikler yaratacak kadar güçlü olmadığını savunuyor. Bilim insanları ayrıca, fırın ve krematoryumlarda odun yakımı, evde, restoranlarda ve sokak tezgâhlarında yapılan pişirme ile açık atık yakımının da kirliliğe etkisini inceliyor. Şu anda Mumbai'nin ortalama AQI değeri sağlıksız kabul edilen 160'ta bulunurken, New York ve Londra gibi küresel şehirlerde bu değer 30'un oldukça altında ve 'iyi' olarak sınıflandırılıyor. Kötüleşen hava kalitesi, kirliliği azaltmak ve halk sağlığını korumak için acil ve toplu aksiyonlar gerektiriyor. article_content: A chair held aloft, its legs shattered from being thrown across the room—this scene was not from a riot or a bar fight, but from inside the Nepalese parliament yesterday. A session to decide the country’s new constitution descended into chaos, injuring three parliamentarians—including Khadga Prasad Oli, leader of the ruling party—and three security staff who intervened. During a late-night parliamentary session, leaders of the Maoist parties, bitterly opposed to current constitutional proposals they say would marginalize them, began throwing microphones and chairs. Six people, including the ruling party leader, were injured in the resulting scuffle. The fight broke out after members of the minority Maoist party hurled furniture and microphones at the house speaker during a session in Kathmandu. The altercation began near the end of an all-night meeting aimed at drafting a new constitution, which is scheduled to be signed into law on Thursday. As the ruling coalition and opposition parties disagreed, the speaker proposed a vote on the constitution instead of seeking unanimous agreement from all 605 MPs. This prompted Maoist leaders to throw objects in fierce opposition. The latest draft of the constitution is backed by roughly two-thirds of the MPs, making its passage likely in a standard vote. However, Maoists fear the legislation, as written, would marginalize their parties and demand new provinces for increased representation. Nepal has been trying to draft a new constitution since 2006, when the Maoists ended their armed rebellion. Despite six prime ministers and two elections, consensus remains elusive. After the speaker suggested a vote, anger spilled into the streets, with Maoist parties announcing a general strike that shut down schools, factories, and markets in Kathmandu. Police reported arresting 19 people for vandalizing vehicles as protesters tried to halt commuter traffic. Media showed burning tires and deserted roads in the normally busy capital. Nepal has struggled with a political crisis since 2006, when Maoists joined parliament after ending their insurgency. Political leaders had set Thursday as the deadline for new legislation, but the session was adjourned until later, making agreement unlikely. The Maoists’ general strike brought Kathmandu to a standstill. Since 2006, Nepal has had two elections and six prime ministers, yet the political deadlock remains. The current MPs officially have until 2018 to finalize a constitution but hoped to resolve it sooner, as ongoing uncertainty has hurt the economy. According to World Bank data, annual growth dropped from 6.1% in 2008 to 3.6% in 2013.

Ülkenin yeni anayasasına karar vermek için yapılan oturum kaosa döndü; iktidar partisinin lideri Khadga Prasad Oli dahil üç milletvekili ve müdahale eden üç güvenlik görevlisi yaralandı. Gece geç saatlerdeki parlamento oturumunda, mevcut anayasa önerilerinin kendilerini marjinalleştireceğini söyleyen Maoist parti liderleri mikrofon ve sandalyeleri fırlatmaya başladı. Sonuçta iktidar partisi liderinin de dahil olduğu altı kişi yaralandı. Kavgalar, azınlık Maoist partisi üyelerinin Kathmandu’daki bir oturumda meclis başkanına mobilya ve mikrofon fırlatmasıyla başladı. Bu arbede, perşembe günü yasalaşması planlanan yeni anayasa taslağını hazırlamaya yönelik tüm gece süren toplantının sonunda yaşandı. İktidar koalisyonu ve muhalefet partileri anlaşamayınca, başkan anayasayı tüm 605 milletvekilinin oy birliğiyle değil oylamayla geçirmeyi önerdi. Bu durum Maoist liderlerin sert şekilde karşı çıkıp eşyaları fırlatmasına neden oldu. Anayasanın en son taslağı, milletvekillerinin yaklaşık üçte ikisinin desteğine sahip ve normal bir oylamada kabul edilmesi muhtemel. Ancak Maoistler mevcut yasaların partilerini marjinalleştireceğinden endişeli ve daha fazla temsil için yeni eyaletler talep ediyor. Nepal, Maoistlerin silahlı isyanını 2006'da bitirmesinden beri yeni bir anayasa taslağı hazırlamaya çalışıyor. Altı başbakan ve iki seçim geçmesine rağmen hala uzlaşı sağlanamadı. Başkan oylama önerdikten sonra öfke sokaklara taştı; Maoist partiler Kathmandu’da okulları, fabrikaları ve pazarları kapatan genel grev ilan etti. Polis, protestocular işe gitmek isteyenleri engellemeye çalışırken araçlara zarar veren 19 kişiyi tutukladığını açıkladı. Medyada ise normalde kalabalık olan başkentte yakılan lastikler ve boş yollar gösterildi. Nepal, Maoistlerin isyanı bitirip parlamentoya katıldığı 2006’dan beri siyasi krizle mücadele ediyor. Siyasi liderler yeni yasaları kabul edebilmek için perşembe gününü son tarih olarak belirlemişti, ancak oturum ertelendiği için uzlaşı olasılığı düşük kaldı. Maoistlerin genel grevi Kathmandu’yu durdurdu. 2006’dan bu yana Nepal’de iki seçim ve altı başbakan değişti fakat siyasi çıkmaz sürüyor. Mevcut milletvekilleri anayasa için resmen 2018’e kadar zamana sahipler, fakat belirsizlik ülke ekonomisini olumsuz etkilediğinden süreci hızlandırmak istemişlerdi. Dünya Bankası’na göre yıllık ekonomik büyüme 2008’de %6,1 iken 2013’te %3,6’ya düştü.

article_content: Kaley Cuoco and David Oyelowo star in 'Role Play,' an action-comedy spy thriller debuting on Prime Video January 12, 2024. Cuoco portrays Emma, a suburban New Jersey mom leading a seemingly perfect life with her husband and two kids. Their relationship takes a wild turn when, during an attempt to spice things up with role-playing, David discovers Emma is actually an assassin for hire. The film is directed by Thomas Vincent and written by Seth Owen. Studiocanal fully financed the movie, with U.S. and international distribution handled by Amazon Prime Video. The film is based on an original idea from George Heller of Brillstein Entertainment Partners. Producers include Alex Heineman and Andrew Rona from The Picture Company via a long-term deal with Studiocanal, along with Cuoco through her Yes Norman Productions. Bill Nighy and Connie Nielsen also star. Principal photography took place mainly in Berlin, Germany. The official trailer is available to watch online.

article_content:
US Secretary of State Antony Blinken met with Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas in Ramallah on Sunday, as the death toll in Gaza rises and anger builds across the Arab world. During the meeting, Abbas called for an immediate ceasefire in Gaza, echoing calls from Arab leaders urging an end to the conflict as casualties near 10,000.

Al Jazeera's Mohammed Jamjoom reported that the meeting lasted under an hour—shorter than expected—and ended without a joint press conference, highlighting significant disagreements between the US and Palestinian positions. Abbas pressed for a ceasefire, while Blinken reiterated that the US supports only temporary humanitarian pauses, not a full ceasefire.

Rising casualties in Gaza have brought greater scrutiny to US diplomatic efforts, with Arab allies expressing frustration over the growing humanitarian crisis. Israel's ongoing military offensive has resulted in over 50 deaths from air raids on Saturday night alone.

At a news conference in Amman, Jordan’s Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi stressed the urgent need for a ceasefire, warning the region faces enduring consequences if the conflict continues. He rejected Israel’s justification of self-defense for its operations in Gaza, which have killed at least 9,488 Palestinians, more than a third of them children. Egypt’s Foreign Minister Sameh Shoukry echoed the demand for an immediate and comprehensive ceasefire, noting Egypt’s role in facilitating aid and evacuations.

Blinken, meanwhile, stated that a ceasefire would allow Hamas to regroup and repeat attacks like those of October 7, when about 1,400 Israelis, primarily civilians, were killed. On his third visit to the region in a month, Blinken sought to balance calls for humanitarian pauses with Israel’s insistence on continuing its offensive and Arab demands for a permanent ceasefire. His proposal for temporary pauses was dismissed by both Arab leaders and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu, who reaffirmed that Israel would press on with its operation until all hostages are released.

During Blinken’s visit, Israeli strikes hit several UN-run schools and refugee centers, including an attack on al-Maghazi refugee camp that killed at least 47 people.

Al Jazeera’s Alan Fisher reported discontent with the US approach to the crisis. UAE diplomat Anwar Gargash suggested that unless US policy shifts, its effectiveness will be questioned. Marwan Bishara, Al Jazeera analyst, argued that calls for humanitarian pauses fall short and amount to supporting ongoing warfare if a ceasefire is not prioritized.

After meeting Abbas, Blinken traveled to Turkey to meet President Recep Tayyip Erdogan. Turkish-Israeli relations have deteriorated since the start of the conflict. Erdogan condemned Israeli actions and recalled Turkey’s ambassador from Tel Aviv, a move criticized by Israel as siding with Hamas. Turkish media quoted Erdogan as saying: 'Netanyahu is no longer someone we can talk to. We have written him off.'

The US State Department said Blinken reaffirmed the US’s commitment to humanitarian aid and essential services in Gaza and stressed that Palestinians should not be forcibly displaced. The talks also covered stability in the West Bank and the need to stop violence by Israeli settlers. Blinken has previously suggested the Palestinian Authority could play a future governance role in Gaza, though it is unclear if this was discussed in detail during the meeting with Abbas.

ABD Dışişleri Bakanı Antony Blinken, Pazar günü Ramallah'ta Filistin Devlet Başkanı Mahmud Abbas ile bir araya geldi. Görüşme, Gazze'deki ölüm sayısının artması ve Arap dünyasında öfkenin büyümesiyle gerçekleşti. Abbas, toplantı sırasında saldırıların sona erdirilmesi için acil ateşkes çağrısında bulunarak, ölü sayısı 10.000’e yaklaşırken çatışmanın sona erdirilmesini isteyen Arap liderlerle aynı görüşü paylaştı.

Al Jazeera'dan Mohammed Jamjoom’un aktardığına göre, toplantı beklenenden kısa – bir saatten az – sürdü ve ortak bir basın toplantısı olmadan sona erdi. Bu durum, ABD ile Filistin tarafı arasında önemli görüş ayrılıkları olduğunu gösteriyor. Abbas ateşkes için ısrar ederken, Blinken ABD'nin tam bir ateşkesi değil, yalnızca geçici insani araları desteklediğini yineledi.

Gazze'deki artan ölümler, ABD’nin diplomatik çabalarına yönelik Arap müttefiklerden gelen eleştirileri artırdı. İsrail’in süren askeri operasyonu, yalnızca Cumartesi gecesi gerçekleşen hava saldırılarında 50’den fazla kişinin ölmesine yol açtı.

Ürdün Başbakan Yardımcısı ve Dışişleri Bakanı Ayman Safadi, Amman'da yaptığı basın toplantısında acil ateşkesin gerekliliğini vurguladı ve çatışmanın devamı halinde bölgenin derin ve kalıcı sorunlarla karşılaşacağı uyarısında bulundu. Safadi, İsrail'in Gazze'deki operasyonlarının öz savunma olmadığını belirterek, saldırılarda şu ana dek 9.488’den fazla Filistinlinin – üçte birinden fazlası çocuk – hayatını kaybettiğini ifade etti. Mısır Dışişleri Bakanı Sameh Shoukry de Mısır’ın yardım ve tahliyelerdeki rolünü vurgulayıp, acil ve kapsamlı bir ateşkes çağrısı yaptı.

Blinken ise ateşkesin Hamas’a yeniden organize olma ve 7 Ekim benzeri saldırılar düzenleme fırsatı tanıyacağını savundu. Bu ay içindeki üçüncü ziyaretinde, insani aralar ile İsrail’in operasyonunun sürmesi ve Arap liderlerin kalıcı ateşkes talepleri arasında denge kurmaya çalıştı. Blinken’ın öne sürdüğü insani aralar, hem Arap liderler hem de İsrail Başbakanı Netanyahu tarafından kabul edilmedi. Netanyahu, rehineler serbest bırakılana kadar operasyonun devam edeceğini açıkladı.

Blinken’ın ziyareti sırasında İsrail, BM’ye bağlı birkaç okul ve mülteci merkezini vurdu; el-Maghazi Mülteci Kampı’na düzenlenen saldırıda en az 47 kişi öldü.

Al Jazeera’den Alan Fisher, ABD'nin krizi yönetme biçiminden hoşnutsuzluğun bariz olduğunu aktardı. BAE’li diplomat Anwar Gargash, ABD yaklaşımında değişiklik olmazsa etkinliğin sorgulanacağını belirtti. Al Jazeera analisti Marwan Bishara ise insani araların yetersiz olduğunu, ateşkes olmadan bu yaklaşımın savaşın devamına katkı sunduğunu savundu.

Abbas ile görüşmesinin ardından Blinken, Türkiye Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ile görüşmek için Türkiye’ye geçti. Türkiye-İsrail ilişkileri, savaşın başlamasından bu yana kötüleşti; Erdoğan İsrail’in eylemlerini kınadı ve Tel Aviv’deki büyükelçisini geri çağırdı. Bu adım, İsrail tarafından Türkiye’nin Hamas’ın yanında yer aldığı şeklinde yorumlandı. Türk medyasına göre Erdoğan, 'Netanyahu artık görüşebileceğimiz biri değil. Onu sildik.' dedi.

ABD Dışişleri Bakanlığı, Blinken’ın Gazze’ye insani yardım ve temel hizmetlerin sağlanmasına olan bağlılığını yinelediğini ve Filistinlilerin zorla yerinden edilmemesi gerektiğini belirtti. Görüşmelerde ayrıca Batı Şeria’da istikrarın yeniden sağlanması ve İsrailli yerleşimciler kaynaklı şiddetin sona erdirilmesi konuları da ele alındı. Blinken’ın, Filistin Yönetimi’nin gelecekte Gazze’nin idaresinde rol oynayabileceğine dair önceki açıklamalarına rağmen, bu konunun Abbas ile görüşmede detaylıca işlenip işlenmediği net değil.

article_content: Once, wearing a revealing dress meant relying on sticky tape and a lot of confidence—much like a Hollywood star. Now, the secret behind celebrities’ daring outfits is out: the InvisiBra. This self-adhesive bra, with silicone cups that stick securely to the skin, is keeping stars comfortable and confident. Recently, the strapless InvisiBra was revealed to be a must-have in celebrity wardrobes, as the trend for backless and sideless dresses migrates from the runway to the high street. High street alternatives are appearing as demand grows. Gwyneth Paltrow wore a dress with sheer side panels at a premiere last year, and is thought to have used an InvisiBra or a similar product. Emma Watson chose the bra for a completely backless dress at the Golden Globes, pairing it with leggings for added modesty. Actresses such as Natalie Portman and judge Darcey Bussell are also believed to have opted for adhesive bras. The InvisiBra is welcomed by those who have struggled with traditional tape to keep dresses in place, or gone braless, risking wardrobe malfunctions. Actress Anne Hathaway exposed her back at the Les Miserables premiere in London—another moment where discreet support was invaluable. Created by lingerie company Lavalia, the InvisiBra is the first bra designed without straps or a back. Available in silicone (£48) or fabric (£38), the bra features two cups joined by a small clasp. Originally conceived for brides seeking invisible support on their wedding day, the product’s popularity has expanded. According to Lavalia, sales have grown consistently since the London launch last summer, with a 30% monthly increase reported from December to January and daily sales now around 70 bras. A Lavalia spokesperson commented, 'January has been fantastic for InvisiBra. We’re selling about 70 bras a day, likely due to the awards season—women are seeing red-carpet gowns and want similar looks without risking wardrobe slips.' Though only available online, similar adhesive bras are now stocked by high-street chains like Debenhams and Marks & Spencer. Marks & Spencer has reported increased sales of its Strapless Stick On Adhesive Bra, which incorporates a sheer silicone band for extra support, while Debenhams’ Natural Stick On Bra uses adhesive tabs on the sides for security.

article_content: "Argo" took home three Oscars at the 85th Academy Awards, including the prestigious Best Picture. The film, based on the rescue of six Americans during the Iran hostage crisis, was produced by Ben Affleck, George Clooney, and Grant Heslov. Affleck, who did not receive a Best Director nomination, acknowledged his career ups and downs and expressed gratitude during his acceptance speech. Initially, Argo was not a leading contender due to Affleck's omission from the directing category. Only three previous films had won Best Picture without a directing nod, with 'Driving Miss Daisy' being the sole instance in the prior 80 years. However, Argo gained significant momentum, garnering awards from the Producers Guild, Directors Guild, Actors Guild, Golden Globes, AFI, and BAFTA. Chris Terrio was awarded Best Adapted Screenplay, and William Goldenberg won for Film Editing. Oscar night had few surprises; the biggest was First Lady Michelle Obama joining Jack Nicholson via satellite to present Best Picture. Jennifer Lawrence, aged 22, won Best Actress for "Silver Linings Playbook." She endeared the audience by tripping on her gown on her way to the stage and wished a happy birthday to fellow nominee Emmanuelle Riva, who turned 86. Daniel Day-Lewis made history by earning his third Best Actor Oscar for his portrayal of Abraham Lincoln in Steven Spielberg’s "Lincoln." During his speech, he joked with presenter Meryl Streep about role reversals; Streep had won the previous year for playing Margaret Thatcher in "The Iron Lady." Ang Lee received the Best Director award for "Life of Pi," which took home four Oscars in total. He thanked the extensive team involved in the film. Supporting acting honors went to Anne Hathaway for "Les Miserables" and Christoph Waltz for "Django Unchained." Memorable music performances included Adele’s win for Best Original Song with "Skyfall." Standout acts from Shirley Bassey, Jennifer Hudson, Adele, and Barbra Streisand elevated the ceremony, especially during the 'In Memoriam' tribute. Host Seth MacFarlane started the evening carefully but became more relaxed and humorous as the night progressed. William Shatner appeared as Captain Kirk in a comedic segment. MacFarlane’s approach kept the show entertaining, drawing a range of responses. Social media buzzed with reactions about awards and notable snubs, such as Harry Potter being overlooked and some omissions from the 'In Memoriam' montage. The discussion of snubs extended to Affleck’s Best Director exclusion, though he focused on acknowledgment and gratitude. Affleck described his rise from career setbacks to Oscar success, highlighting resilience and appreciation for those who supported him. His message encouraged perseverance and letting go of grudges.

Shirley Bassey, Jennifer Hudson, Adele ve Barbra Streisand’ın unutulmaz performansları, özellikle de 'Aramızdan Ayrılanlar' bölümünde törene ayrı bir değer kattı. MacFarlane’in tarzı geceyi eğlenceli hale getirdi ve çeşitli tepkiler aldı. Sosyal medyada Harry Potter’ın yine ödül alamaması ve 'Aramızdan Ayrılanlar' bölümünde bazı isimlerin unutulması gibi ödül ve göz ardı edilenler tartışıldı. Affleck’in En İyi Yönetmen adaylığındaki yokluğu da konuşuldu, fakat kendisi önceliğini minnettarlığa verdi. article_content: Protean eGov Technologies' Initial Public Offering (IPO) opens for subscription from November 6 to November 8, with expected listing on both major Indian stock exchanges. Protean eGov Technologies is an IT-enabled solutions provider specializing in large-scale, critical technology projects for government and public sector services. The firm has significant experience in building digital public infrastructure and delivering citizen-centric e-governance solutions. E-governance employs information and communication technology (ICT) to enable government functions and provide public services. The sector's growth is driven by technological advancements and ongoing initiatives by central and state governments. The IPO is a complete offer for sale (OFS) of 61.9 lakh shares. Key selling shareholders include 360 One Special Opportunities Fund, NSE Investments, HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, and Deutsche Bank, each offloading part of their stakes. The price band for the IPO is set between Rs 752 and Rs 792 per share, with the offering aiming to raise up to Rs 490 crore at the upper band. Shares allocation: 50% for qualified institutional buyers, 35% for retail investors, and 15% for non-institutional investors. Additionally, 1.5 lakh shares are reserved for company employees at a Rs 75 discount to the final offer price. For the quarter ended June 2023, the company reported a 40% rise in operating revenue to Rs 220 crore and a 52% jump in profit to Rs 32.2 crore. Since the IPO is solely an offer for sale, Protean eGov Technologies will not receive any proceeds from the issue. Market analysts report the current grey market premium (GMP) is Rs 0. ICICI Securities, Equirus Capital, IIFL Securities, and Nomura Financial Advisory and Securities (India) are the book-running lead managers for the IPO.

On Monday, the International Olympic Committee (IOC) approved Los Angeles 2028’s (LA28) proposal to add five new sports—baseball/softball, cricket (T20), flag football, lacrosse (sixes), and squash—to the program for the 2028 Olympic Games. Baseball/softball, cricket, and lacrosse are making a return, while flag football and squash will debut for the first time. The updated LA28 lineup also includes sports that made their Olympic debuts recently, such as skateboarding and surfing at Tokyo 2020.

At the 141st IOC Session, members also confirmed the return of modern pentathlon and weightlifting to the 28 previously announced sports. Boxing, which has been featured at every Olympic Games since 1920, remains undecided for LA28 due to unresolved governance issues; the IOC removed the International Boxing Association (IBA) over leadership conflicts and controversial sponsorships.

Olympic sport programs often reflect the host country’s culture. For example, baseball—hugely popular in Japan—was part of Tokyo 2020 but won’t return until LA28, while cricket last featured in Paris 1900 and lacrosse in St. Louis 1904 and London 1908. The Olympics are increasingly targeting younger viewers by adding sports like skateboarding, surfing, freestyle BMX, and sport climbing, along with the new LA28 inclusions.

Casey Wasserman, LA28 Chairperson, highlighted ‘game-changing collaborations with major professional leagues’ designed to expand the Olympics’ reach and engage new audiences. MLB Commissioner Rob Manfred praised the return of baseball and softball for enhancing youth involvement in the U.S. and abroad. Cricket’s comeback was announced in Mumbai during the ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup, with South African cricketer AB de Villiers expressing excitement about Olympic exposure for the sport.

Lacrosse’s Olympic return, a century after its last appearance, reflects its growth into one of America’s fastest-growing sports. Originating with Indigenous peoples of Eastern North America, lacrosse now boasts over 900 NCAA varsity teams and three professional leagues, with ongoing regional and national expansion. The inclusion of lacrosse and softball presents major opportunities for female athletes, as the Olympics are set to reach gender parity at Paris 2024.

Squash is positioned to gain global recognition and encourage youth and female participation. World Squash Federation president Zena Wooldridge called the sport ‘perfectly suited’ for the Olympics, while American star Amanda Sobhy hopes to compete in front of a home crowd at LA28.

Flag football’s Olympic debut offers a safer, rapidly growing format of American football, especially for youth and women. Former NFL player Rob Gronkowski expressed interest in joining the U.S. Olympic flag football team. NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell and International Federation of American Football president Pierre Trochet underscored the sport’s potential to unite new audiences and promote accessibility.

For the LA28 Paralympics, sport selection is managed separately by the International Paralympic Committee (IPC), which has already approved 22 sports. Additional sports, like para climbing and para surfing, may be considered by the end of 2023.

Beyzbol/softbol, kriket ve lakros Olimpiyatlara geri dönerken, bayrak futbolu ve squash ilk kez yer alacak. LA28’in yeni programında Tokyo 2020’de ilk kez olimpiyatta olan kaykay ve sörf gibi branşlar da mevcut.

141. IOC Toplantısı’nda ayrıca modern pentatlon ve halterin daha önce açıklanan 28 spor dalına tekrar dahil edilmesi onaylandı. 1920'den bu yana her Olimpiyat'ta yer alan boks, yönetişimdeki belirsizlik nedeniyle LA28'de henüz onaylanmadı; IOC, liderlik çatışmaları ve tartışmalı sponsorluklar nedeniyle Uluslararası Boks Birliği’ni (IBA) turnuvadan çıkarmıştı.

Olimpiyat spor programları genellikle ev sahibinin spor kültürünü yansıtır. Örneğin Japonya’da çok izlenen beyzbol Tokyo 2020’de yer aldı ve LA28'de tekrar programa dahil olacak; kriket en son Paris 1900'da, lakros ise St. Louis 1904 ve Londra 1908'de yer aldı. Olimpiyatlar, kaykay, sörf, BMX ve spor tırmanışı gibi yeni branşları ve LA28’in ilavelerini ekleyerek genç izleyicileri hedefliyor.

LA28 Başkanı Casey Wasserman, büyük profesyonel liglerle kurduğu iş birliğinin Olimpiyatların etkisini artıracağını ve yeni seyirciler kazanılacağını ifade etti. MLB Komiseri Rob Manfred, beyzbol ve softbolun dönüşünün özellikle ABD’de ve dünyada genç katılımını artıracağını belirtti. Kriketin dönüşü, ICC Erkekler Kriket Dünya Kupası sırasında Mumbai’de duyuruldu; Güney Afrikalı kriketçi AB de Villiers, spora Olimpiyatlarda daha geniş kitlelerin ulaşacağını söyledi.

Lakrosun bir asır sonra Olimpiyatlara dönüşü, ABD’deki hızlı büyümesini gösteriyor. Doğu Kuzey Amerika’daki yerli halk tarafından oynanan lakros, bugün 900'den fazla NCAA üniversite takımına ve üç profesyonel lige sahip. Lakros ve softbolun dahil edilmesi, Paris 2024’te tam cinsiyet eşitliğine ulaşacak olan Olimpiyatlarda kadın sporcular için büyük bir fırsat.

Squash, Olimpiyatlara girişiyle gençler ve kadınlar başta olmak üzere dünya çapında ilgi kazanmayı hedefliyor. Dünya Squash Federasyonu Başkanı Zena Wooldridge, branşın Olimpiyatlar için çok uygun olduğunu söylerken, Amerikalı yıldız Amanda Sobhy LA28’de evinde yarışmayı umduğunu belirtti.

Bayrak futbolunun Olimpiyatlara girişi; gençler ve kadınlar arasında büyüyen ve daha güvenli bir Amerikan futbolu alternatifi sunuyor. Eski NFL oyuncusu Rob Gronkowski, ABD bayrak futbolu olimpik takımında yer alma isteğini dile getirdi. NFL Komiseri Roger Goodell ve Amerikan Futbolu Uluslararası Federasyonu Başkanı Pierre Trochet, bu branşın yeni seyircileri bir araya getirmede ve erişilebilirliği artırmada önemli rol oynayacağına dikkat çekti.

LA28 Paralimpik Oyunlarındaki spor seçimi ise Uluslararası Paralimpik Komite (IPC) tarafından ayrıca yürütülüyor. IPC şu ana kadar 22 sporu onayladı; para tırmanış ve para sörf gibi yeni branşlar yıl sonuna kadar değerlendirmede olacak.

article_content: TOKYO — SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son said Wednesday that he believes artificial intelligence (AI) will surpass human intelligence within a decade. He urged Japanese companies to embrace AI or risk being left behind. Speaking at a corporate conference in Tokyo, Son stated, 'Artificial general intelligence will surpass the total intelligence of humankind by ten times within ten years.' According to Son, AI will influence every industry, including transportation, pharmaceuticals, finance, manufacturing, and logistics. He emphasized that companies and individuals who work with AI will be industry leaders in the next 10 to 20 years. Son, the founder of SoftBank and a prominent figure in Japan's business community, has experienced both successes and challenges in his technology investments. After recognizing the potential of the internet decades ago, he is now investing in AI-related companies. 'I want to be on the side of progress,' Son said. 'It would be unfortunate to be left behind, like an old, shuttered high street.' He encouraged Japanese companies to 'wake up' to the potential of an AI-led future, and called on Japan's youth to recognize this opportunity. At the G7 summit in Hiroshima in May, leaders agreed to promote trustworthy AI. Japan’s government is seeking to participate in international rule-making to ensure reliable use of AI. Prime Minister Fumio Kishida, speaking at a science forum in Kyoto on Sunday, acknowledged the significant potential of generative AI while also pointing out concerns about disinformation, privacy, and copyright risks. Son warned that Japan should avoid repeating past mistakes of lagging during the internet era. He cautioned against reluctance among companies due to fears of data leaks and other risks. SoftBank recently expanded the Nasdaq listing of its chip subsidiary, Arm Holdings Plc, which Son acquired in 2016. Son noted that Arm will play a key role in AI development.

SoftBank’ın kurucusu ve Japonya iş dünyasının önde gelen isimlerinden olan Son, teknoloji yatırımlarında hem başarılar hem de zorluklar yaşadı. On yıllar önce internetin potansiyelini gören Son, şimdi de YZ ile ilgili şirketlere yatırım yapıyor. 'Gelişimin tarafında olmak istiyorum,' dedi Son. 'Eski ve kapanmış bir ana cadde gibi geride kalmak üzücü olurdu.' Japon şirketlerini YZ’nin öncülük edeceği geleceğin potansiyeline 'uyanmak' için çağırdı; ayrıca Japon gençliğini de bu fırsatı görmeye davet etti. Mayıs ayında Hiroşima’da düzenlenen G7 zirvesinde liderler, güvenilir YZ’yi teşvik etme konusunda anlaştılar. Japonya hükûmeti, YZ’nin güvenilir bir şekilde kullanılması için uluslararası kural oluşturma sürecine katılmayı hedefliyor. Başbakan Fumio Kishida, Pazar günü Kyoto’daki bir bilim forumunda yaptığı konuşmada, üretken YZ’nin büyük potansiyelinin farkında olduğunu; ancak dezenformasyon, gizlilik ve telif hakkı ile ilgili risklere de dikkat çekti. Son, Japonya’nın internet çağında geride kalma hatasını tekrarlamaması gerektiği konusunda uyardı. Şirketlerin veri sızıntısı ve diğer risklerden dolayı duyduğu çekingenliğe karşı dikkatli olunması gerektiğini belirtti. SoftBank kısa süre önce, Son'un 2016'da satın aldığı çip iştiraki Arm Holdings Plc'nin Nasdaq’taki listesini genişletti. article_content: Brazilian footballer Rodrygo attracted attention online after an altercation with Argentina's Lionel Messi and Rodrigo De Paul during a World Cup qualifier at Maracana Stadium in Rio de Janeiro. The incident took place amid a 30-minute delay caused by violent clashes between fans, police, and security staff in the stands. Following the on-field dispute, Rodrygo, who is Black, became the target of racial abuse on social media. He publicly condemned these messages, highlighting the ongoing problem of racism in football. 'Racists are always present, always out there,' the 22-year-old posted online, noting that many messages included monkey or banana emojis and images. Rodrygo affirmed that such abuse will not silence him or others. 'If we don't act as they expect, racists respond with criminal behavior. We will not stop,' he wrote. Before the match began, Argentina's captain Lionel Messi was seen talking with Brazil's Marquinhos and Rodrygo, while other players attempted to calm the unfolding situation in the stands. The match had been scheduled for 9:30 pm local time but was postponed after clashes erupted during the national anthems, prompting police intervention and incidents of fans throwing seats at officers. In response to the unrest, the Argentine squad temporarily left the pitch. Messi was seen on camera saying, 'We're not playing, we're leaving,' before the team returned to the dressing room. Once order was restored, play resumed, and Argentina secured a 1-0 victory.

article_content: Tesla is bringing an update to its most affordable car, the Model 3, known as the 'Highland' version. While there is no confirmed U.S. launch date yet, the Highland is already available in major markets worldwide, including the UK, Germany, Australia, and China. American consumers likely won’t have to wait much longer, as the Model 3 Highland has been spotted in California. Affordability is a key selling point. The Model 3 starts at under $39,000, making it Tesla’s least expensive vehicle and almost $9,000 cheaper than the average price for a new car in September 2023, according to Kelley Blue Book. Tesla’s price reductions have had a notable effect, pushing electric vehicle (EV) prices down over 22% year-over-year, from $65,295 to $50,683. Compared to September 2022, Tesla’s average transaction prices have dropped 24.7%. The Model 3’s price alone has dropped more than 26% year-over-year to $41,484, positioning it well below the average luxury car price. Tesla’s average transaction prices are now lower than brands like Acura, Lexus, Infiniti, and Volvo, based on KBB data. The 'Highland' version features a range of updates rather than a complete redesign. A recent review from Singapore summarized key features: new Aero wheels, updated Hardware 4 cameras, a steering wheel without stalks, improved ambient lighting, a rear passenger touchscreen, and more. Additional upgrades, like acoustic glass and improved hood aerodynamics for a quieter ride, were not covered in the short review. One essential aspect not discussed is the driving range. According to Motor Trend, the rear-wheel-drive Model 3 Standard Range may have a lower estimated range than the outgoing 2023 model, while the Long Range variant could exceed it. Other visible changes include sharper headlights and new tail lights.

article_content: It might not be the most prestigious of world records, but a teenager has officially become the world’s fastest texter. Sixteen-year-old Brazilian student Marcel Fernandes Filho typed a 25-word paragraph in just 18.19 seconds—equivalent to 82.5 words per minute—using an app called Fleksy. This beat the previous record by 0.25 seconds, earning Marcel a place in the record books. Marcel, a physics student from Brazil, achieved the record on a Samsung Galaxy S4 using the Fleksy keyboard app, which was developed by the software company Syntellia. Fleksy features large keys and intuitive swipe gestures, allowing users to type in a way similar to a desktop keyboard. The app joins popular typing apps like Swype and Microsoft’s Word Flow. To set the record, Marcel had to type a specific paragraph without using autocorrect or predictive text. The passage was: 'The razor-toothed piranhas of the genera Serrasalmus and Pygocentrus are the most ferocious freshwater fish in the world. In reality they seldom attack a human.' The previous record of 18.44 seconds was set in January by Microsoft’s Gaurav Sharma. Marcel’s time was more than twice as fast as the original 2010 record of 35.54 seconds by Franklin Page. Fleksy, available for iOS and Android devices, is designed to help people type quickly and even without looking at their screens. After winning an online competition, Marcel was flown to New York City by Fleksy. The record attempt was made on April 25 but was only recently confirmed by Guinness World Records. Marcel explained to CNN that he developed his typing skills after breaking his desktop monitor in frustration in 2009. Without the funds to buy a new one, he relied solely on his iPhone 3GS and became adept at mobile typing. Anyone can submit an application to set a Guinness World Record online free of charge. Once accepted, applicants receive a General Info pack, specific Record Guidelines, and an Evidence Required pack outlining the materials needed for verification. After submission, record adjudicators assess the evidence, and successful applicants receive an official certificate.

Çevrimiçi bir yarışmayı kazanan Marcel, Fleksy tarafından New York’a davet edildi. Rekor denemesi 25 Nisan’da yapıldı ama sadece kısa bir süre önce Guinness Dünya Rekorları tarafından onaylandı. Speculation is mounting over the location and date of Prince William and Kate Middleton’s wedding, with many expecting the historic Westminster Abbey to be chosen. Middleton and her parents were seen leaving the Abbey on Wednesday night after a reported private tour, according to British newspapers. The Daily Mirror labeled Westminster Abbey as the likely venue, even publishing a suggested seating arrangement. Betting agency Ladbrokes gave the venue 1/33 odds, reinforcing expectations. A new CNN/ComRes poll released Friday found that most Britons supported the engagement—announced Tuesday following William’s recent proposal—with 79 percent of respondents believing it would benefit the monarchy. Opinions remain divided on who should succeed Queen Elizabeth II, with more people favoring William and Middleton as the future king and queen over Charles and Camilla. The poll also noted that older and wealthier individuals were more inclined to maintain the traditional succession line, while younger and less affluent people leaned towards William. The survey included 2,015 British adults between Wednesday and Friday.

Founded in 960, Westminster Abbey’s current Gothic structure was built in 1245. The church has hosted coronations since 1066, various royal weddings and funerals, including those of Queen Elizabeth II, King George VI, and Princess Diana. Alternatives to Westminster Abbey include St. Paul’s Cathedral, where Diana married Charles in 1981, St. George’s Chapel at Windsor Castle, St. Clement Danes—the Royal Air Force’s central church where Prince William serves—and the Chapel of St. Salvator at St. Andrews, where William and Middleton met.

The palace has announced that the wedding will take place in the spring or summer of 2011, with May being the favored month, according to bookmakers. Prime Minister David Cameron has proposed a national holiday for the wedding, pending government approval.

article_content: Netflix is taking a bold gamble with Zack Snyder’s upcoming sci-fi saga, Rebel Moon, and that risk appears promising if the latest character posters are any indication. Duffy, a new face. article_content: Sudan and Iran have agreed to restore diplomatic relations, seven years after ties were severed, according to Sudan's foreign ministry. In a statement, the ministry said, 'The two countries have decided to resume diplomatic relations following high-level contacts in recent months.' Both nations agreed to take steps to reopen embassies in the near future and to exchange official delegations. Iran’s ISNA news agency also reported the agreement, stating that the two governments plan to foster friendly relations based on mutual respect, equality, common interests, and peaceful coexistence. Sudan broke ties with Iran in 2016 in solidarity with Saudi Arabia, after the Saudi embassy in Tehran was attacked following the execution of a prominent Shiite cleric in Saudi Arabia. Several Saudi allies in the region also cut diplomatic relations with Iran at that time. In March 2023, however, Riyadh and Tehran announced the renewal of their relations, following a China-brokered deal. Iran has subsequently worked to improve ties with neighboring Arab countries. Meanwhile, Sudan has been embroiled in conflict since April 15, when fighting erupted between army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan and his former deputy Mohamed Hamdan Daglo, leader of the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces.

Her iki ülke, yakın gelecekte büyükelçiliklerini yeniden açmak ve resmi heyet değişimi yapmak için gerekli adımları atma konusunda anlaştı. İran’ın ISNA haber ajansı da anlaşmayı doğruladı ve iki hükümetin, egemenliğe saygı, eşitlik, ortak çıkarlar ve barış içinde bir arada yaşama temelinde dostane ilişkiler geliştirmeyi planladığını belirtti. Bölgede Suudi Arabistan’ın pek çok müttefiki de o dönemde İran ile diplomatik ilişkilerini kesti. Mart 2023’te ise, Riyad ve Tahran Çin arabuluculuğu ile ilişkileri yeniden başlatacaklarını duyurdu. article_content: Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) publicly named the American official believed to oversee CIA operations in Moscow, breaking conventional protocol. This announcement followed the detention of US diplomat Ryan Fogle, who was accused of attempting to recruit a Russian intelligence officer. Fogle, identified as a third secretary in the political section of the US embassy, was reportedly apprehended while trying to enlist a Russian anti-terrorism expert. This detail aligns with listings of foreign officials in Moscow. At the time of arrest, Fogle was said to be carrying espionage equipment, including two wigs, three pairs of glasses, a Moscow map, a folding knife, cash, and written instructions that promised up to $1 million a year for cooperation, according to an FSB-released letter. The arrest took place in Moscow’s Vorontsovski Park. Fogle was then taken to FSB headquarters at Lubyanka before being released to US embassy officials, following diplomatic protocols. He has since been ordered to leave Russia. Recently, the US and Russia agreed to cooperate on intelligence related to the Boston Marathon bombing investigation, which involved suspects with ties to Russia’s North Caucasus. Reports indicate this led to contact between US intelligence and a Russian anti-terrorism officer. Fogle’s purported espionage tactics, such as wearing wigs and overt offers of payment, were widely mocked by Russian and Western media. The FSB claimed that the US has made repeated attempts to recruit Russian security officials. This case is considered the most significant US–Russia spy scandal since the 2010 Anna Chapman incident. FSB publicly released images of Fogle’s arrest and the equipment he carried. US Ambassador Michael McFaul was summoned to Russia’s foreign ministry but did not comment on the events. Despite the tensions, Russian authorities stated their intention to focus on the positive aspects of US-Russia relations moving forward.

Bu açıklama, Amerikalı diplomat Ryan Fogle’ın bir Rus istihbarat görevlisini işe almaya çalıştığı iddiasıyla gözaltına alınmasının ardından geldi. ABD Büyükelçiliği'nin siyasi bölümünde üçüncü sekreter olarak görev yapan Fogle’ın, bir Rus terörle mücadele uzmanını kendi tarafına çekmeye çalışırken yakalandığı bildirildi. Bu ayrıntı, Moskova’daki yabancı yetkililer listesindeki bilgilerle de uyumlu. Fogle’ın yakalandığı sırada iki peruk, üç gözlük, bir Moskova haritası, katlanır bıçak, bir miktar nakit para ve FSB'nin yayımladığı bir mektuba göre yılda 1 milyon dolara kadar iş birliği vaadi içeren yazılı talimatlar taşıdığı belirtildi. Bu olay, 2010’da patlak veren Anna Chapman skandalından bu yana ABD ile Rusya arasındaki en büyük casusluk olayı olarak nitelendiriliyor. FSB, Fogle’ın gözaltına alınışına ve yanındaki ekipmanlara dair görüntüleri hemen paylaştı. ABD Büyükelçisi Michael McFaul, konu hakkında yorum yapmazken Rusya Dışişleri Bakanlığı’na çağrıldı. article_content: Flu, pneumonia, and COVID cases have sharply increased among children in China in recent weeks, overwhelming hospitals and raising fears of a new epidemic. Pediatric units in northern Chinese cities report record-high visits, worsened by the typical rise in respiratory illnesses during winter. Beijing Aviation General Hospital stated on Friday that its pediatrics unit has been handling significant numbers of pneumonia and flu cases since autumn, reaching between 550 and 650 daily visits—an increase of 30 to 50% compared to previous years. In response, the hospital has brought in senior doctors from other specialties and raised security staffing on-site. Approximately 60 miles southeast, Tianjin Children's Hospital Director Liu Wei reported through a public WeChat letter that his staff are overwhelmed, with more than 13,171 patient admissions at its two campuses within a 24-hour period. Liu encouraged parents to remain calm and noted that hospital staff are working hard, many of whom are also parents facing similar family illnesses. A parent in Wuhan told JiuPai News on Friday that their fourth-grade son was suffering from pneumonia and described waitlists at some medical facilities extending up to five days. The outlet did not disclose the family’s identities. National Health Commission spokesperson Mi Feng warned on November 13 that China is entering a high-incidence season for respiratory diseases and called for coordinated medical resources at hospitals. The surge has led to widespread concern on Chinese social media, with parents reporting difficulty booking hospital appointments. Some urged authorities to close schools and shift to online classes. Viral posts have circulated, including photos of children doing homework while receiving IV treatment—though their authenticity could not be verified by Business Insider. State media has advised parents to seek medical help for children only if their fevers last more than three days, noting that most respiratory infections in children are not severe and are best treated symptomatically. Hu Xijin, former editor of The Global Times, posted on Weibo urging people to get flu vaccines as a preventive measure. The World Health Organization issued a statement on Wednesday saying it has asked China for more information about the increase in pediatric respiratory illnesses, including data on flu, COVID-19, pneumonia, and RSV, as well as the healthcare system’s capacity. Experts, including David Heymann and Francois Balloux, suggest the surge is likely due to seasonal respiratory viruses and reduced immunity following prolonged lockdowns, stating there is no current evidence of a novel pathogen.

Özellikle kuzey şehirlerindeki pediatri birimleri, kış aylarında her zamanki solunum yolu hastalıklarındaki artışın da etkisiyle rekor sayıda hasta bildiriyor. Pekin Havacılık Genel Hastanesi, Cuma günü yaptığı açıklamada pediatri biriminin sonbahardan bu yana önemli sayıda zatürre ve grip vakasıyla ilgilendiğini, günlük 550 ila 650 başvuruya ulaştıklarını ve bunun önceki yıllara göre %30 ila %50 artış anlamına geldiğini belirtti. Hastane, buna yanıt olarak diğer branşlardan kıdemli doktorları görevlendirdi ve sahadaki güvenlik personelini artırdı. Yaklaşık 100 kilometre güneydoğuda bulunan Tianjin Çocuk Hastanesi Müdürü Liu Wei, şehirdeki WeChat üzerinden yayımladığı bir açık mektupta, personelinin aşırı yüklendiğini ve iki kampüslerinde son 24 saatte 13.171'den fazla hasta kabul ettiklerini bildirdi. Liu, ebeveynlere sakin olmalarını tavsiye etti ve birçok sağlık çalışanının da kendi ailelerinde benzer hastalıklarla mücadele ettiğine dikkat çekti. Wuhan'da bir veli, Cuma günü JiuPai News'a yaptığı açıklamada, dördüncü sınıfa giden oğlunun zatürre olduğunu ve bazı hastanelerde bekleme sürelerinin beş güne kadar çıktığını söyledi. Haberde ailenin kimlik bilgilerine yer verilmedi. Ulusal Sağlık Komisyonu Sözcüsü Mi Feng, 13 Kasım'da Çin'in solunum yolu hastalıklarında yüksek sıklık sezonuna girdiğini ve hastanelerde tıbbi kaynakların koordinasyonunun önemli olduğunu vurguladı. Vaka artışı, Çin sosyal medyasında endişeyi artırdı; ebeveynler hastane randevusu almakta zorlandıklarını belirtiyor. Bazıları yetkilileri okulları kapatmaya ve online eğitime geçmeye çağırıyor. Bazı viral paylaşımlarda, serum takılırken ödev yapan çocukların fotoğrafları yer aldı, ancak Business Insider bu fotoğrafların gerçekliğini doğrulayamadı. Devlet medyası, ebeveynlere çocuklarının ateşi üç günden fazla sürerse doktora başvurmalarını tavsiye etti; çoğu çocukta görülen solunum yolu enfeksiyonlarının ağır seyretmediğini ve semptomlara yönelik tedavinin genellikle yeterli olduğunu belirtti. Global Times'ın eski editörü Hu Xijin, Weibo hesabından herkese grip aşısı yaptırmaları çağrısı yaptı. Dünya Sağlık Örgütü, Çarşamba günü yaptığı açıklamada, Çin'den çocuklarda artan solunum yolu hastalıklarıyla ilgili, grip, COVID-19, zatürre ve RSV vakalarını ve sağlık sisteminin kapasitesini de içeren daha ayrıntılı bilgi istediğini duyurdu. Uzmanlar — David Heymann ve Francois Balloux dahil — artışın büyük olasılıkla mevsimsel solunum yolu virüslerinden ve uzun süren kapanmanın ardından azalan bağışıklıktan kaynaklandığını, yeni bir patojenle ilgili şu anda bir kanıt bulunmadığını belirtiyor.

article_content: Labour councillor Anita Ward, who is also a former Lord Mayor of Birmingham and Birmingham County Royal British Legion chairman, has apologised after accidentally tweeting a hashtag associated with the Charlie Hebdo attackers. Ward intended to support the Je Suis Charlie unity marchers on Sunday but inadvertently included a hashtag, #JeSuisKouachi, which has been used on social media by those supporting the attackers who killed 17 people in Paris. Her tweet read: "Thoughts are in Paris with all those marching in unity for #JeSuisCharlie but don't forget #JeSuisKouachi #JeSuisAhmed & Others." #JeSuisKouachi refers to the attackers, while #JeSuisAhmed is used as a tribute to Ahmed Merabet, a police officer killed in the attacks. Ward explained the mistake occurred due to Twitter's auto-complete function and her own carelessness. She received a strong negative reaction online and deleted both the tweet and her account. Ward said, "It was literally down to carelessness on my part. When I started typing #JeSuis, suggestions automatically came up, and I accidentally pressed the wrong one. I apologised immediately. If I could take it back, I would." She is a known supporter of the British forces and Birmingham's Veterans' Champion. Her son was shot and injured by the Taliban while serving with the Irish Guards in Afghanistan. Ward expressed regret chiefly to the victims' families and to her son, saying she has learned from the mistake. Some people online called for her resignation despite her apology, while others understood how easy it was to make such a mistake using social media's auto-complete. The article also mentions a recent controversy after Fox News pundit Steven Emerson incorrectly claimed Birmingham was 'closed to non-Muslims,' a statement widely mocked and refuted by UK officials, including Prime Minister David Cameron.

article_content:
Tiger Woods is making his return to professional golf at the WGC-Bridgestone Invitational this Thursday after being sidelined by a knee injury since May. For this comeback, Woods will not have his long-time caddie Steve Williams by his side. Williams, who played a role in 13 of Woods’s 14 major victories, was recently let go. Bryon Bell, a close friend of Woods, will step in as his temporary caddie as Woods looks for a permanent replacement.

In response to being dismissed, Williams commented that he had wasted two years with Woods during difficult times in Woods’s life and career. Woods told reporters that he felt the partnership had run its course, despite their success, and believed change was needed. He said he appreciates what Williams contributed but is comfortable moving forward with Bell for now. Woods is seeking a new caddie who has experience in high-pressure situations on the golf course, noting that many have applied, including several who are not professional caddies.

Woods also shared that his work with coach Sean Foley is starting to positively impact his performance. Focused on the upcoming tournament, Woods said he is eager to contend and try to secure a victory.

Woods’un bu dönüşünde, 14 majör zaferinin 13’ünde yanında olan uzun soluklu caddie’si Steve Williams yer almayacak. Woods, Williams ile yollarını kısa süre önce ayırdı. Geçici olarak yakın arkadaşı Bryon Bell caddie’lik görevini üstlenecek ve Woods, kalıcı caddie’sini aramaya devam edecek.

Williams, işine son verilmesine ilişkin yaptığı açıklamada, Woods’un zorlu dönemlerinde iki yılının boşa gittiğini ifade etti. Woods ise gazetecilere, her ne kadar birlikte büyük başarılar yakalamış olsalar da, artık değişim zamanının geldiğine inandığını söyledi. Williams’ın katkılarını takdir ettiğini belirten Woods, şu an için Bell ile çalışmaktan memnun olduğunu vurguladı. Yeni caddie arayışında baskı altında tecrübeli birini istediğini, bu pozisyon için profesyonel olmayan birçok başvuru aldıklarını da ekledi.

Kendisi ayrıca koçu Sean Foley ile yaptığı çalışmaların oyunu üzerinde olumlu etkileri olduğunu paylaştı. Woods, yaklaşan turnuvada kazanmak için hazırlık yaptığını ve buna odaklandığını belirtti.
